verses.sa:
मा चिदन्यद्वि शंसत सखायो मा रिषण्यत ।
इन्द्रमित्स्तोता वृषणं सचा सुते मुहुरुक्था च शंसत ॥
verses.rom:
ma chidanyadvi shamsata sakhayo ma rishanyata |
indramitstota vrishanam sacha sute muhuruktha cha shamsata ||
verses.en:
GLORIFY naught besides, O friends; so shall no sorrow trouble you.
Praise only mighty Indra when the juice is shed, and say your lauds repeatedly:

verses.sa:
अवक्रक्षिणं वृषभं यथाजुरं गां न चर्षणीसहम् ।
विद्वेषणं संवननोभयंकरं मंहिष्ठमुभयाविनम् ॥
verses.rom:
avakrakshinam vrishabham yathajuram gam na charshanisaham |
vidveshanam samvananobhayamkaram mamhishthamubhayavinam ||
verses.en:
Even him, eternal, like a bull who rushes down, men's Conqueror, bounteous like a cow;
Him who is cause of both, of enmity and peace, to both sides most munificent.

verses.sa:
यच्चिद्धि त्वा जना इमे नाना हवन्त ऊतये ।
अस्माकं ब्रह्मेदमिन्द्र भूतु तेऽहा विश्वा च वर्धनम् ॥
verses.rom:
yachchiddhi tva jana ime nana havanta utaye |
asmakam brahmedamindra bhutu te'ha vishva cha vardhanam ||
verses.en:
Although these men in sundry ways invoke thee to obtain thine aid,
Be this our prayer, addressed, O Indra, unto thee, thine exaltation every day.

verses.sa:
वि तर्तूर्यन्ते मघवन्विपश्चितोऽर्यो विपो जनानाम् ।
उप क्रमस्व पुरुरूपमा भर वाजं नेदिष्ठमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
vi tarturyante maghavanvipashchito'ryo vipo jananam |
upa kramasva pururupama bhara vajam nedishthamutaye ||
verses.en:
Those skilled in song, O Maghavan among these men o'ercome with might the foeman's songs.
Come hither, bring us strength in many a varied form most near that it may succour us.

verses.sa:
महे चन त्वामद्रिवः परा शुल्काय देयाम् ।
न सहस्राय नायुताय वज्रिवो न शताय शतामघ ॥
verses.rom:
mahe chana tvamadrivah para shulkaya deyam |
na sahasraya nayutaya vajrivo na shataya shatamagha ||
verses.en:
O Caster of the Stone, I would not sell thee for a mighty price,
Not for a thousand, Thunderer! nor ten thousand, nor a hundred, Lord of countless wealth!

verses.sa:
वस्याँ इन्द्रासि मे पितुरुत भ्रातुरभुञ्जतः ।
माता च मे छदयथः समा वसो वसुत्वनाय राधसे ॥
verses.rom:
vasyan indrasi me pituruta bhraturabhunjatah |
mata cha me chhadayathah sama vaso vasutvanaya radhase ||
verses.en:
O Indra, thou art more to me than sire or niggard brother is.
Thou and my mother, O Good Lord, appear alike, to give me wealth abundantly.

verses.sa:
क्वेयथ क्वेदसि पुरुत्रा चिद्धि ते मनः ।
अलर्षि युध्म खजकृत्पुरंदर प्र गायत्रा अगासिषुः ॥
verses.rom:
kveyatha kvedasi purutra chiddhi te manah |
alarshi yudhma khajakritpuramdara pra gayatra agasishuh ||
verses.en:
Where art thou? Whither art thou gone? For many a place attracts thy mind.
Haste, Warrior, Fort-destroyer, Lord of battle's din, haste, holy songs have sounded forth.

verses.sa:
प्रास्मै गायत्रमर्चत वावातुर्यः पुरंदरः ।
याभिः काण्वस्योप बर्हिरासदं यासद्वज्री भिनत्पुरः ॥
verses.rom:
prasmai gayatramarchata vavaturyah puramdarah |
yabhih kanvasyopa barhirasadam yasadvajri bhinatpurah ||
verses.en:
Sing out the psalm to him who breaks down castles for his faithful friend,
Verses to bring the Thunderer to destroy the forts and sit on Kanva's sacred grass.

verses.sa:
ये ते सन्ति दशग्विनः शतिनो ये सहस्रिणः ।
अश्वासो ये ते वृषणो रघुद्रुवस्तेभिर्नस्तूयमा गहि ॥
verses.rom:
ye te santi dashagvinah shatino ye sahasrinah |
ashvaso ye te vrishano raghudruvastebhirnastuyama gahi ||
verses.en:
The Horses which are thine in tens, in hundreds, yea, in thousands thine,
Even those vigorous Steeds, fleet-footed in the course, with those come quickly near to us.

verses.sa:
आ त्वद्य सबर्दुघां हुवे गायत्रवेपसम् ।
इन्द्रं धेनुं सुदुघामन्यामिषमुरुधारामरंकृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
a tvadya sabardugham huve gayatravepasam |
indram dhenum sudughamanyamishamurudharamaramkritam ||
verses.en:
This day I call Sabardugiha who animates the holy song,
Indra the richly-yielding Milch-cow who provides unfailing food in ample stream.

verses.sa:
यत्तुदत्सूर एतशं वङ्कू वातस्य पर्णिना ।
वहत्कुत्समार्जुनेयं शतक्रतुः त्सरद्गन्धर्वमस्तृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yattudatsura etasham vanku vatasya parnina |
vahatkutsamarjuneyam shatakratuh tsaradgandharvamastritam ||
verses.en:
When Sura wounded Etasa, with Vata's rolling winged car.
Indra bore Kutsa Arjuneya off, and mocked Gandharva. the unconquered One.

verses.sa:
य ऋते चिदभिश्रिषः पुरा जत्रुभ्य आतृदः ।
संधाता संधिं मघवा पुरूवसुरिष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
ya rite chidabhishrishah pura jatrubhya atridah |
samdhata samdhim maghava puruvasurishkarta vihrutam punah ||
verses.en:
He without ligature, before making incision in the neck,
Closed up the wound again, most wealthy Maghavan, who maketh whole the injured part.

verses.sa:
मा भूम निष्ट्या इवेन्द्र त्वदरणा इव ।
वनानि न प्रजहितान्यद्रिवो दुरोषासो अमन्महि ॥
verses.rom:
ma bhuma nishtya ivendra tvadarana iva |
vanani na prajahitanyadrivo duroshaso amanmahi ||
verses.en:
May we be never cast aside, and strangers, as it were, to thee.
We, Thunder-wielding Indra, count ourselves as trees rejected and unfit to burn.

verses.sa:
अमन्महीदनाशवोऽनुग्रासश्च वृत्रहन् ।
सकृत्सु ते महता शूर राधसा अनु स्तोमं मुदीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
amanmahidanashavo'nugrasashcha vritrahan |
sakritsu te mahata shura radhasa anu stomam mudimahi ||
verses.en:
O Vrtra-slayer, we were thought slow and unready for the fray.
Yet once in thy great bounty may we have delight, O Hero, after praising thee.

verses.sa:
यदि स्तोमं मम श्रवदस्माकमिन्द्रमिन्दवः ।
तिरः पवित्रं ससृवांस आशवो मन्दन्तु तुग्र्यावृधः ॥
verses.rom:
yadi stomam mama shravadasmakamindramindavah |
tirah pavitram sasrivamsa ashavo mandantu tugryavridhah ||
verses.en:
If he will listen to my laud, then may out Soma-drops that flow
Rapidly through the strainer gladden Indra, drops due to the Tugryas' Strengthener.

verses.sa:
आ त्वद्य सधस्तुतिं वावातुः सख्युरा गहि ।
उपस्तुतिर्मघोनां प्र त्वावत्वधा ते वश्मि सुष्टुतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
a tvadya sadhastutim vavatuh sakhyura gahi |
upastutirmaghonam pra tvavatvadha te vashmi sushtutim ||
verses.en:
Come now unto the common laud of thee and of thy faithful friend.
So may our wealthy nobles' praise give joy to thee. Fain would I sing thine eulogy.

verses.sa:
सोता हि सोममद्रिभिरेमेनमप्सु धावत ।
गव्या वस्त्रेव वासयन्त इन्नरो निर्धुक्षन्वक्षणाभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
sota hi somamadribhiremenamapsu dhavata |
gavya vastreva vasayanta innaro nirdhukshanvakshanabhyah ||
verses.en:
Press out the Soma with the stones, and in the waters wash it clean.
The men investing it with raiment made of milk shall milk it forth from out the stems.

verses.sa:
अध ज्मो अध वा दिवो बृहतो रोचनादधि ।
अया वर्धस्व तन्वा गिरा ममा जाता सुक्रतो पृण ॥
verses.rom:
adha jmo adha va divo brihato rochanadadhi |
aya vardhasva tanva gira mama jata sukrato prina ||
verses.en:
Whether thou come from earth or from the lustre of the lofty heaven,
Wax stronger in thy body through my song of praise: fill full all creatures, O most Wise.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय सु मदिन्तमं सोमं सोता वरेण्यम् ।
शक्र एणं पीपयद्विश्वया धिया हिन्वानं न वाजयुम् ॥
verses.rom:
indraya su madintamam somam sota varenyam |
shakra enam pipayadvishvaya dhiya hinvanam na vajayum ||
verses.en:
For India press the Soma out, most gladdening and most excellent.
May Sakra make it swell sent forth with every prayer and asking, as it were, for strength.

verses.sa:
मा त्वा सोमस्य गल्दया सदा याचन्नहं गिरा ।
भूर्णिं मृगं न सवनेषु चुक्रुधं क ईशानं न याचिषत् ॥
verses.rom:
ma tva somasya galdaya sada yachannaham gira |
bhurnim mrigam na savaneshu chukrudham ka ishanam na yachishat ||
verses.en:
Let me not, still beseeching thee with earnest song at Soma rites,
Anger thee like soma wild beast. Who would not beseech him who hath power to grant his prayer?

verses.sa:
मदेनेषितं मदमुग्रमुग्रेण शवसा ।
विश्वेषां तरुतारं मदच्युतं मदे हि ष्मा ददाति नः ॥
verses.rom:
madeneshitam madamugramugrena shavasa |
vishvesham tarutaram madachyutam made hi shma dadati nah ||
verses.en:
The draught made swift with rapturous joy, effectual with its mighty strength,
All-conquering, distilling transport, let him drink: for he in ecstasy gives us gifts.

verses.sa:
शेवारे वार्या पुरु देवो मर्ताय दाशुषे ।
स सुन्वते च स्तुवते च रासते विश्वगूर्तो अरिष्टुतः ॥
verses.rom:
shevare varya puru devo martaya dashushe |
sa sunvate cha stuvate cha rasate vishvagurto arishtutah ||
verses.en:
Where bliss is not, may he, All-praised, God whom the pious glorify,
Bestow great wealth upon the mortal worshipper who sheds the juice and praises him.

verses.sa:
एन्द्र याहि मत्स्व चित्रेण देव राधसा ।
सरो न प्रास्युदरं सपीतिभिरा सोमेभिरुरु स्फिरम् ॥
verses.rom:
endra yahi matsva chitrena deva radhasa |
saro na prasyudaram sapitibhira somebhiruru sphiram ||
verses.en:
Come, Indra, and rejoice thyself, O God, in manifold affluence.
Thou fillest like a lake thy vast capacious bulk with Soma and with draughts besides.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा सहस्रमा शतं युक्ता रथे हिरण्यये ।
ब्रह्मयुजो हरय इन्द्र केशिनो वहन्तु सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
a tva sahasrama shatam yukta rathe hiranyaye |
brahmayujo haraya indra keshino vahantu somapitaye ||
verses.en:
A thousand and a hundred Steeds are harnessed to thy golden car.
So may the long-maned Bays, yoked by devotion, bring Indra to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा रथे हिरण्यये हरी मयूरशेप्या ।
शितिपृष्ठा वहतां मध्वो अन्धसो विवक्षणस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
a tva rathe hiranyaye hari mayurashepya |
shitiprishtha vahatam madhvo andhaso vivakshanasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Yoked to thy chariot wrought of gold, may thy two Bays with peacock tails,
Convey thee hither, Steeds with their white backs, to quaff sweet juice that makes us eloquent.

verses.sa:
पिबा त्वस्य गिर्वणः सुतस्य पूर्वपा इव ।
परिष्कृतस्य रसिन इयमासुतिश्चारुर्मदाय पत्यते ॥
verses.rom:
piba tvasya girvanah sutasya purvapa iva |
parishkritasya rasina iyamasutishcharurmadaya patyate ||
verses.en:
So drink, thou Lover of the Song, as the first drinker, of this juice.
This the outpouring of the savoury sap prepared is good and meet to gladden thee.

verses.sa:
य एको अस्ति दंसना महाँ उग्रो अभि व्रतैः ।
गमत्स शिप्री न स योषदा गमद्धवं न परि वर्जति ॥
verses.rom:
ya eko asti damsana mahan ugro abhi vrataih |
gamatsa shipri na sa yoshada gamaddhavam na pari varjati ||
verses.en:
He who alone by wondrous deed is Mighty, Strong by holy works,
May he come, fair of cheek; may he not stay afar, but come and turn not from our call.

verses.sa:
त्वं पुरं चरिष्ण्वं वधैः शुष्णस्य सं पिणक् ।
त्वं भा अनु चरो अध द्विता यदिन्द्र हव्यो भुवः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam puram charishnvam vadhaih shushnasya sam pinak |
tvam bha anu charo adha dvita yadindra havyo bhuvah ||
verses.en:
Susna's quick moving castle thou hast crushed to pieces with thy bolts.
Thou, Indra, from of old, hast followed after light, since we have had thee to invoke.

verses.sa:
मम त्वा सूर उदिते मम मध्यंदिने दिवः ।
मम प्रपित्वे अपिशर्वरे वसवा स्तोमासो अवृत्सत ॥
verses.rom:
mama tva sura udite mama madhyamdine divah |
mama prapitve apisharvare vasava stomaso avritsata ||
verses.en:
My praises when the Sun hath risen, my praises at the time of noon,
My praises at the coming of the gloom of night, O Vasu, have gone forth to thee.

verses.sa:
स्तुहि स्तुहीदेते घा ते मंहिष्ठासो मघोनाम् ।
निन्दिताश्वः प्रपथी परमज्या मघस्य मेध्यातिथे ॥
verses.rom:
stuhi stuhidete gha te mamhishthaso maghonam |
ninditashvah prapathi paramajya maghasya medhyatithe ||
verses.en:
Praise yea, praise him. Of princes these are the most liberal of their gifts,
These, Paramajya, Ninditasva, Prapathi, most bounteous, O Medhyatithi.

verses.sa:
आ यदश्वान्वनन्वतः श्रद्धयाहं रथे रुहम् ।
उत वामस्य वसुनश्चिकेतति यो अस्ति याद्वः पशुः ॥
verses.rom:
a yadashvanvananvatah shraddhayaham rathe ruham |
uta vamasya vasunashchiketati yo asti yadvah pashuh ||
verses.en:
When to the car, by faith, I yoked the horses longing for the way-
For skilled is Yadu's son in dealing precious wealth, he who is rich in herds of kine.

verses.sa:
य ऋज्रा मह्यं मामहे सह त्वचा हिरण्यया ।
एष विश्वान्यभ्यस्तु सौभगासङ्गस्य स्वनद्रथः ॥
verses.rom:
ya rijra mahyam mamahe saha tvacha hiranyaya |
esha vishvanyabhyastu saubhagasangasya svanadrathah ||
verses.en:
May he who gave me two brown steeds together with their cloths of gold,
May he, Asanga's son Svanadratha, obtain all joy and high felicities.

verses.sa:
अध प्लायोगिरति दासदन्यानासङ्गो अग्ने दशभिः सहस्रैः ।
अधोक्षणो दश मह्यं रुशन्तो नळा इव सरसो निरतिष्ठन् ॥
verses.rom:
adha playogirati dasadanyanasango agne dashabhih sahasraih |
adhokshano dasha mahyam rushanto nala iva saraso niratishthan ||
verses.en:
Playoga's son Asanga, by ten thousand, O Agni, hath surpassed the rest in giving.
For me ten bright-hued oxen have come forward like lotus-stalks from out a lake upstanding.

verses.sa:
अन्वस्य स्थूरं ददृशे पुरस्तादनस्थ ऊरुरवरम्बमाणः ।
शश्वती नार्यभिचक्ष्याह सुभद्रमर्य भोजनं बिभर्षि ॥
verses.rom:
anvasya sthuram dadrishe purastadanastha ururavarambamanah |
shashvati naryabhichakshyaha subhadramarya bhojanam bibharshi ||
verses.en:
What time her husband's perfect restoration to his lost strength and manhood was apparent,
His consort Sasvati with joy addressed him, Now art thou well, my lord, and shalt be happy.

verses.sa:
इदं वसो सुतमन्धः पिबा सुपूर्णमुदरम् ।
अनाभयिन्ररिमा ते ॥
verses.rom:
idam vaso sutamandhah piba supurnamudaram |
anabhayinrarima te ||
verses.en:
HERE is the Soma juice expressed; O Vasu, drink till thou art full:
Undaunted God, we give it thee.

verses.sa:
नृभिर्धूतः सुतो अश्नैरव्यो वारैः परिपूतः ।
अश्वो न निक्तो नदीषु ॥
verses.rom:
nribhirdhutah suto ashnairavyo varaih pariputah |
ashvo na nikto nadishu ||
verses.en:
Washed by the men, pressed out with stones, strained through the filter made of wool,
'Tis like a courser bathed in stream.

verses.sa:
तं ते यवं यथा गोभिः स्वादुमकर्म श्रीणन्तः ।
इन्द्र त्वास्मिन्सधमादे ॥
verses.rom:
tam te yavam yatha gobhih svadumakarma shrinantah |
indra tvasminsadhamade ||
verses.en:
This juice have we made sweet for thee like barley, blending it with milk.
Indra, I call thee to our feast.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र इत्सोमपा एक इन्द्रः सुतपा विश्वायुः ।
अन्तर्देवान्मर्त्याँश्च ॥
verses.rom:
indra itsomapa eka indrah sutapa vishvayuh |
antardevanmartyanshcha ||
verses.en:
Beloved of all, Indra alone drinks up the flowing Soma juice
Among the Gods and mortal men.

verses.sa:
न यं शुक्रो न दुराशीर्न तृप्रा उरुव्यचसम् ।
अपस्पृण्वते सुहार्दम् ॥
verses.rom:
na yam shukro na durashirna tripra uruvyachasam |
apasprinvate suhardam ||
verses.en:
The Friend, whom not the brilliant-hued, the badly-mixt or bitter draught,
Repels, the far-extending God;

verses.sa:
गोभिर्यदीमन्ये अस्मन्मृगं न व्रा मृगयन्ते ।
अभित्सरन्ति धेनुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
gobhiryadimanye asmanmrigam na vra mrigayante |
abhitsaranti dhenubhih ||
verses.en:
While other men than we with milk chase him as hunters chase a deer,
And with their kine inveigle him.

verses.sa:
त्रय इन्द्रस्य सोमाः सुतासः सन्तु देवस्य ।
स्वे क्षये सुतपाव्नः ॥
verses.rom:
traya indrasya somah sutasah santu devasya |
sve kshaye sutapavnah ||
verses.en:
For him, for Indra, for the God, be pressed three draughts of Soma juice
In the juice-drinker's own abode.

verses.sa:
त्रयः कोशास श्चोतन्ति तिस्रश्चम्वः सुपूर्णाः ।
समाने अधि भार्मन् ॥
verses.rom:
trayah koshasa shchotanti tisrashchamvah supurnah |
samane adhi bharman ||
verses.en:
Three reservoirs exude their drops, filled are three beakers to the brim,
All for one offering to the God.

verses.sa:
शुचिरसि पुरुनिष्ठाः क्षीरैर्मध्यत आशीर्तः ।
दध्ना मन्दिष्ठः शूरस्य ॥
verses.rom:
shuchirasi purunishthah kshirairmadhyata ashirtah |
dadhna mandishthah shurasya ||
verses.en:
Pure art thou, set in many a place, and blended in the midst with milk
And curd, to cheer the Hero best.

verses.sa:
इमे त इन्द्र सोमास्तीव्रा अस्मे सुतासः ।
शुक्रा आशिरं याचन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
ime ta indra somastivra asme sutasah |
shukra ashiram yachante ||
verses.en:
Here, Indra, are thy Soma-draughts pressed out by us, the strong, the pure:
They crave admixture of the milk.

verses.sa:
ताँ आशिरं पुरोळाशमिन्द्रेमं सोमं श्रीणीहि ।
रेवन्तं हि त्वा शृणोमि ॥
verses.rom:
tan ashiram purolashamindremam somam shrinihi |
revantam hi tva shrinomi ||
verses.en:
O Indra, pour in milk, prepare the cake, and mix the Soma-draught.
I hear them say that thou art rich.

verses.sa:
हृत्सु पीतासो युध्यन्ते दुर्मदासो न सुरायाम् ।
ऊधर्न नग्ना जरन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
hritsu pitaso yudhyante durmadaso na surayam |
udharna nagna jarante ||
verses.en:
Quaffed juices fight within the breast. The drunken praise not by their wine,
The naked praise not when it rains.

verses.sa:
रेवाँ इद्रेवत स्तोता स्यात्त्वावतो मघोनः ।
प्रेदु हरिवः श्रुतस्य ॥
verses.rom:
revan idrevata stota syattvavato maghonah |
predu harivah shrutasya ||
verses.en:
Rich be the praiser of one rich, munificent and famed like thee:
High rank be his, O Lord of Bays.

verses.sa:
उक्थं चन शस्यमानमगोररिरा चिकेत ।
न गायत्रं गीयमानम् ॥
verses.rom:
uktham chana shasyamanamagorarira chiketa |
na gayatram giyamanam ||
verses.en:
Foe of the man who adds no milk, he heeds not any chanted hymn
Or holy psalm that may he sung.

verses.sa:
मा न इन्द्र पीयत्नवे मा शर्धते परा दाः ।
शिक्षा शचीवः शचीभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ma na indra piyatnave ma shardhate para dah |
shiksha shachivah shachibhih ||
verses.en:
Give us not, Indra, as a prey unto the scornful or the proud:
Help, Mighty One, with power and might.

verses.sa:
वयमु त्वा तदिदर्था इन्द्र त्वायन्तः सखायः ।
कण्वा उक्थेभिर्जरन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
vayamu tva tadidartha indra tvayantah sakhayah |
kanva ukthebhirjarante ||
verses.en:
This, even this, O Indra, we implore. as thy devoted friends,
The Kanvas praise thee with their hymns.

verses.sa:
न घेमन्यदा पपन वज्रिन्नपसो नविष्टौ ।
तवेदु स्तोमं चिकेत ॥
verses.rom:
na ghemanyada papana vajrinnapaso navishtau |
tavedu stomam chiketa ||
verses.en:
Naught else, O Thunderer, have I praised in the skilled singer's eulogy:
On thy land only have I thought.

verses.sa:
इच्छन्ति देवाः सुन्वन्तं न स्वप्नाय स्पृहयन्ति ।
यन्ति प्रमादमतन्द्राः ॥
verses.rom:
ichchhanti devah sunvantam na svapnaya sprihayanti |
yanti pramadamatandrah ||
verses.en:
The Gods seek him who presses out the Soma; they desire not sleep
They punish sloth unweariedly.

verses.sa:
ओ षु प्र याहि वाजेभिर्मा हृणीथा अभ्यस्मान् ।
महाँ इव युवजानिः ॥
verses.rom:
o shu pra yahi vajebhirma hrinitha abhyasman |
mahan iva yuvajanih ||
verses.en:
Come hither swift with gifts of wealth - be not thou angry with us-like
A great man with a youthful bride.

verses.sa:
मो ष्वद्य दुर्हणावान्सायं करदारे अस्मत् ।
अश्रीर इव जामाता ॥
verses.rom:
mo shvadya durhanavansayam karadare asmat |
ashrira iva jamata ||
verses.en:
Let him not, wrathful with us, spend the evening far from us to-day,
Like some unpleasant son-in-law.

verses.sa:
विद्मा ह्यस्य वीरस्य भूरिदावरीं सुमतिम् ।
त्रिषु जातस्य मनांसि ॥
verses.rom:
vidma hyasya virasya bhuridavarim sumatim |
trishu jatasya manamsi ||
verses.en:
For well we know this Hero's love, most liberal of the boons he gives,
His plans whom the three worlds display.

verses.sa:
आ तू षिञ्च कण्वमन्तं न घा विद्म शवसानात् ।
यशस्तरं शतमूतेः ॥
verses.rom:
a tu shincha kanvamantam na gha vidma shavasanat |
yashastaram shatamuteh ||
verses.en:
Pour forth the gift which Kanvas bring, for none more glorious do we know
Than the Strong Lord with countless aids.

verses.sa:
ज्येष्ठेन सोतरिन्द्राय सोमं वीराय शक्राय ।
भरा पिबन्नर्याय ॥
verses.rom:
jyeshthena sotarindraya somam viraya shakraya |
bhara pibannaryaya ||
verses.en:
O presser, offer Soma first to Indra, Hero, Sakra, him
The Friend of man, that he may drink;

verses.sa:
यो वेदिष्ठो अव्यथिष्वश्वावन्तं जरितृभ्यः ।
वाजं स्तोतृभ्यो गोमन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo vedishtho avyathishvashvavantam jaritribhyah |
vajam stotribhyo gomantam ||
verses.en:
Who, in untroubled ways, is best provider, for his worshippers.
Of strength in horses and in kine.

verses.sa:
पन्यम्पन्यमित्सोतार आ धावत मद्याय ।
सोमं वीराय शूराय ॥
verses.rom:
panyampanyamitsotara a dhavata madyaya |
somam viraya shuraya ||
verses.en:
Pressers, for him blend Soma juice, each draught most excellent, for him
The Brave, the Hero, for his joy.

verses.sa:
पाता वृत्रहा सुतमा घा गमन्नारे अस्मत् ।
नि यमते शतमूतिः ॥
verses.rom:
pata vritraha sutama gha gamannare asmat |
ni yamate shatamutih ||
verses.en:
The Vrtra-slayer drinks the juice. May he who gives a hundred aids
Approach, nor stay afar from us.

verses.sa:
एह हरी ब्रह्मयुजा शग्मा वक्षतः सखायम् ।
गीर्भिः श्रुतं गिर्वणसम् ॥
verses.rom:
eha hari brahmayuja shagma vakshatah sakhayam |
girbhih shrutam girvanasam ||
verses.en:
May the strong Bay Steeds, yoked by prayer, bring hither unto us our Friend,
Lover of Song, renowned by songs.

verses.sa:
स्वादवः सोमा आ याहि श्रीताः सोमा आ याहि ।
शिप्रिन्नृषीवः शचीवो नायमच्छा सधमादम् ॥
verses.rom:
svadavah soma a yahi shritah soma a yahi |
shiprinnrishivah shachivo nayamachchha sadhamadam ||
verses.en:
Sweet are the Soma juices, come! Blent are the Soma juices, come!
Rsi-like, mighty, fair of cheek, come hither quickly to the feast.

verses.sa:
स्तुतश्च यास्त्वा वर्धन्ति महे राधसे नृम्णाय ।
इन्द्र कारिणं वृधन्तः ॥
verses.rom:
stutashcha yastva vardhanti mahe radhase nrimnaya |
indra karinam vridhantah ||
verses.en:
And lauds which strengthen thee for great bounty and valour, and exalt
Indra who doeth glorious deeds,

verses.sa:
गिरश्च यास्ते गिर्वाह उक्था च तुभ्यं तानि ।
सत्रा दधिरे शवांसि ॥
verses.rom:
girashcha yaste girvaha uktha cha tubhyam tani |
satra dadhire shavamsi ||
verses.en:
And songs to thee who lovest song, and all those hymns addressed to thee-
These evermore confirm thy might.

verses.sa:
एवेदेष तुविकूर्मिर्वाजाँ एको वज्रहस्तः ।
सनादमृक्तो दयते ॥
verses.rom:
evedesha tuvikurmirvajan eko vajrahastah |
sanadamrikto dayate ||
verses.en:
Thus he, sole doer of great deeds whose hand holds thunder, gives us strength,
He who hath never been subdued.

verses.sa:
हन्ता वृत्रं दक्षिणेनेन्द्रः पुरू पुरुहूतः ।
महान्महीभिः शचीभिः ॥
verses.rom:
hanta vritram dakshinenendrah puru puruhutah |
mahanmahibhih shachibhih ||
verses.en:
Vrtra he slays with his right hand, even Indra, great with mighty power,
And much-invoked in many a place.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्विश्वाश्चर्षणय उत च्यौत्ना ज्रयांसि च ।
अनु घेन्मन्दी मघोनः ॥
verses.rom:
yasminvishvashcharshanaya uta chyautna jrayamsi cha |
anu ghenmandi maghonah ||
verses.en:
He upon whom all men depend, all regions, all achievements, he
Takes pleasure in our wealthy chiefs.

verses.sa:
एष एतानि चकारेन्द्रो विश्वा योऽति शृण्वे ।
वाजदावा मघोनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
esha etani chakarendro vishva yo'ti shrinve |
vajadava maghonam ||
verses.en:
All this hath he accomplished, yea, Indra, most gloriously renowned,
Who gives our wealthy princes strength.

verses.sa:
प्रभर्ता रथं गव्यन्तमपाकाच्चिद्यमवति ।
इनो वसु स हि वोळ्हा ॥
verses.rom:
prabharta ratham gavyantamapakachchidyamavati |
ino vasu sa hi volha ||
verses.en:
Who drives his chariot seeking spoil, from afar, to him he loves:
For swift is he to bring men wealth.

verses.sa:
सनिता विप्रो अर्वद्भिर्हन्ता वृत्रं नृभिः शूरः ।
सत्योऽविता विधन्तम् ॥
verses.rom:
sanita vipro arvadbhirhanta vritram nribhih shurah |
satyo'vita vidhantam ||
verses.en:
The Sage who, winning spoil with steeds, slays Vrtra, Hero with the men,
His servant's faithful succourer.

verses.sa:
यजध्वैनं प्रियमेधा इन्द्रं सत्राचा मनसा ।
यो भूत्सोमैः सत्यमद्वा ॥
verses.rom:
yajadhvainam priyamedha indram satracha manasa |
yo bhutsomaih satyamadva ||
verses.en:
O Priyamedhas, worship with collected mind this Indra whom
The Soma hath full well inspired.

verses.sa:
गाथश्रवसं सत्पतिं श्रवस्कामं पुरुत्मानम् ।
कण्वासो गात वाजिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
gathashravasam satpatim shravaskamam purutmanam |
kanvaso gata vajinam ||
verses.en:
Ye Kanvas, sing the Mighty One, Lord of the Brave, who loves renown,
All-present, glorified by song.

verses.sa:
य ऋते चिद्गास्पदेभ्यो दात्सखा नृभ्यः शचीवान् ।
ये अस्मिन्काममश्रियन् ॥
verses.rom:
ya rite chidgaspadebhyo datsakha nribhyah shachivan |
ye asminkamamashriyan ||
verses.en:
Strong Friend, who, with no trace of feet, restores the cattle to the men,
Who rest their wish and hope on him.

verses.sa:
इत्था धीवन्तमद्रिवः काण्वं मेध्यातिथिम् ।
मेषो भूतोऽभि यन्नयः ॥
verses.rom:
ittha dhivantamadrivah kanvam medhyatithim |
mesho bhuto'bhi yannayah ||
verses.en:
Shaped as a Ram, Stone-hurler I once thou camest hither to the son
Of Kanva, wise Medhyatithi.

verses.sa:
शिक्षा विभिन्दो अस्मै चत्वार्ययुता ददत् ।
अष्टा परः सहस्रा ॥
verses.rom:
shiksha vibhindo asmai chatvaryayuta dadat |
ashta parah sahasra ||
verses.en:
Vibhindu, thou hast helped this man, giving him thousands four times ten,
And afterward eight thousand more.

verses.sa:
उत सु त्ये पयोवृधा माकी रणस्य नप्त्या ।
जनित्वनाय मामहे ॥
verses.rom:
uta su tye payovridha maki ranasya naptya |
janitvanaya mamahe ||
verses.en:
And these twain pouring streams of milk, creative, daughters of delight,
For wedlock sake I glorify.

verses.sa:
पिबा सुतस्य रसिनो मत्स्वा न इन्द्र गोमतः ।
आपिर्नो बोधि सधमाद्यो वृधेऽस्माँ अवन्तु ते धियः ॥
verses.rom:
piba sutasya rasino matsva na indra gomatah |
apirno bodhi sadhamadyo vridhe'sman avantu te dhiyah ||
verses.en:
DRINK, Indra, of the savoury juice, and cheer thee with our milky draught.
Be, for our weal, our Friend and sharer of the feast, and let thy wisdom guard us well.

verses.sa:
भूयाम ते सुमतौ वाजिनो वयं मा न स्तरभिमातये ।
अस्माञ्चित्राभिरवतादभिष्टिभिरा नः सुम्नेषु यामय ॥
verses.rom:
bhuyama te sumatau vajino vayam ma na starabhimataye |
asmanchitrabhiravatadabhishtibhira nah sumneshu yamaya ||
verses.en:
In thy kind grace and favour may we still be strong: expose us not to foe's attack.
With manifold assistance guard and succour us, and bring us to felicity.

verses.sa:
इमा उ त्वा पुरूवसो गिरो वर्धन्तु या मम ।
पावकवर्णाः शुचयो विपश्चितोऽभि स्तोमैरनूषत ॥
verses.rom:
ima u tva puruvaso giro vardhantu ya mama |
pavakavarnah shuchayo vipashchito'bhi stomairanushata ||
verses.en:
May these my songs of praise exalt thee, Lord, who hast abundant wealth.
Men skilled in holy hymns, pure, with the hues of fire, have sung them with their lauds to thee.

verses.sa:
अयं सहस्रमृषिभिः सहस्कृतः समुद्र इव पप्रथे ।
सत्यः सो अस्य महिमा गृणे शवो यज्ञेषु विप्रराज्ये ॥
verses.rom:
ayam sahasramrishibhih sahaskritah samudra iva paprathe |
satyah so asya mahima grine shavo yajneshu viprarajye ||
verses.en:
He, with his might enhanced by Rsis thousand fold, hath like an ocean spread himself.
His majesty is praised as true at solemn rites, his power where holy singers rule.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमिद्देवतातय इन्द्रं प्रयत्यध्वरे ।
इन्द्रं समीके वनिनो हवामह इन्द्रं धनस्य सातये ॥
verses.rom:
indramiddevatataya indram prayatyadhvare |
indram samike vanino havamaha indram dhanasya sataye ||
verses.en:
Indra for worship of the Gods, Indra while sacrifice proceeds,
Indra, as worshippers in battle-shock, we call, Indra that we may win the spoil.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो मह्ना रोदसी पप्रथच्छव इन्द्रः सूर्यमरोचयत् ।
इन्द्रे ह विश्वा भुवनानि येमिर इन्द्रे सुवानास इन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
indro mahna rodasi paprathachchhava indrah suryamarochayat |
indre ha vishva bhuvanani yemira indre suvanasa indavah ||
verses.en:
With might hath Indra spread out heaven and earth, with power hath Indra lighted up the Sun.
In Indra are all creatures closely held; in him meet the distilling Soma-drops.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा पूर्वपीतय इन्द्र स्तोमेभिरायवः ।
समीचीनास ऋभवः समस्वरन्रुद्रा गृणन्त पूर्व्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva purvapitaya indra stomebhirayavah |
samichinasa ribhavah samasvaranrudra grinanta purvyam ||
verses.en:
Men with their lauds are urging thee, Indra, to drink the Soma first.
The Rbhus in accord have lifted up their voice, and Rudras sung thee as the first.

verses.sa:
अस्येदिन्द्रो वावृधे वृष्ण्यं शवो मदे सुतस्य विष्णवि ।
अद्या तमस्य महिमानमायवोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा ॥
verses.rom:
asyedindro vavridhe vrishnyam shavo made sutasya vishnavi |
adya tamasya mahimanamayavo'nu shtuvanti purvatha ||
verses.en:
Indra increased his manly strength at sacrifice, in the wild rapture of this juice.
And living men to-day, even as of old, sing forth their praises to his majesty.

verses.sa:
तत्त्वा यामि सुवीर्यं तद्ब्रह्म पूर्वचित्तये ।
येना यतिभ्यो भृगवे धने हिते येन प्रस्कण्वमाविथ ॥
verses.rom:
tattva yami suviryam tadbrahma purvachittaye |
yena yatibhyo bhrigave dhane hite yena praskanvamavitha ||
verses.en:
I crave of thee that hero strength, that thou mayst first regard this prayer,
Wherewith thou holpest Bhrgu and the Yatis and Praskanva when the prize was staked.

verses.sa:
येना समुद्रमसृजो महीरपस्तदिन्द्र वृष्णि ते शवः ।
सद्यः सो अस्य महिमा न संनशे यं क्षोणीरनुचक्रदे ॥
verses.rom:
yena samudramasrijo mahirapastadindra vrishni te shavah |
sadyah so asya mahima na samnashe yam kshoniranuchakrade ||
verses.en:
Wherewith thou sentest mighty waters to the sea, that, Indra, is thy manly strength.
For ever unattainable is this power of him to whom the worlds have cried aloud.

verses.sa:
शग्धी न इन्द्र यत्त्वा रयिं यामि सुवीर्यम् ।
शग्धि वाजाय प्रथमं सिषासते शग्धि स्तोमाय पूर्व्य ॥
verses.rom:
shagdhi na indra yattva rayim yami suviryam |
shagdhi vajaya prathamam sishasate shagdhi stomaya purvya ||
verses.en:
Help us, O Indra, when we pray to thee for wealth and hero might.
First help thou on to strength the man who strives to win, and aid our laud, O Ancient One.

verses.sa:
शग्धी नो अस्य यद्ध पौरमाविथ धिय इन्द्र सिषासतः ।
शग्धि यथा रुशमं श्यावकं कृपमिन्द्र प्रावः स्वर्णरम् ॥
verses.rom:
shagdhi no asya yaddha pauramavitha dhiya indra sishasatah |
shagdhi yatha rushamam shyavakam kripamindra pravah svarnaram ||
verses.en:
Help for us, Indra, as thou holpest Paura once, this man's devotions bent on gain.
Help, as thou gavest Rugama and Syavaka and Svarnara and Krpa aid.

verses.sa:
कन्नव्यो अतसीनां तुरो गृणीत मर्त्यः ।
नही न्वस्य महिमानमिन्द्रियं स्वर्गृणन्त आनशुः ॥
verses.rom:
kannavyo atasinam turo grinita martyah |
nahi nvasya mahimanamindriyam svargrinanta anashuh ||
verses.en:
What newest of imploring prayers shall, then, the zealous mortal sing?
For have not they who laud his might, and Indra-power won for themselves the light of heaven?

verses.sa:
कदु स्तुवन्त ऋतयन्त देवत ऋषिः को विप्र ओहते ।
कदा हवं मघवन्निन्द्र सुन्वतः कदु स्तुवत आ गमः ॥
verses.rom:
kadu stuvanta ritayanta devata rishih ko vipra ohate |
kada havam maghavannindra sunvatah kadu stuvata a gamah ||
verses.en:
When shall they keep the Law and praise thee mid the Gods? Who counts as Rsi and as sage?
When ever wilt thou, Indra Maghavan, come nigh to presser's or to praiser's call?

verses.sa:
उदु त्ये मधुमत्तमा गिर स्तोमास ईरते ।
सत्राजितो धनसा अक्षितोतयो वाजयन्तो रथा इव ॥
verses.rom:
udu tye madhumattama gira stomasa irate |
satrajito dhanasa akshitotayo vajayanto ratha iva ||
verses.en:
These songs of ours exceeding sweet, these hymns of praise ascend to thee,
Like ever-conquering chariots that display their strength, gain wealth, and give unfailing aid.

verses.sa:
कण्वा इव भृगवः सूर्या इव विश्वमिद्धीतमानशुः ।
इन्द्रं स्तोमेभिर्महयन्त आयवः प्रियमेधासो अस्वरन् ॥
verses.rom:
kanva iva bhrigavah surya iva vishvamiddhitamanashuh |
indram stomebhirmahayanta ayavah priyamedhaso asvaran ||
verses.en:
The Bhrgus are like Suns, like Kanvas, and have gained all that their thoughts were bent upon.
The living men of Priyamedha's race have sung exalting Indra with their lauds.

verses.sa:
युक्ष्वा हि वृत्रहन्तम हरी इन्द्र परावतः ।
अर्वाचीनो मघवन्सोमपीतय उग्र ऋष्वेभिरा गहि ॥
verses.rom:
yukshva hi vritrahantama hari indra paravatah |
arvachino maghavansomapitaya ugra rishvebhira gahi ||
verses.en:
Best slayer of the Vrtras, yoke thy Bay Steeds, Indra, from afar.
Come with the High Ones hither, Maghavan, to us, Mighty, to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
इमे हि ते कारवो वावशुर्धिया विप्रासो मेधसातये ।
स त्वं नो मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणो वेनो न शृणुधी हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
ime hi te karavo vavashurdhiya vipraso medhasataye |
sa tvam no maghavannindra girvano veno na shrinudhi havam ||
verses.en:
For these, the bards and singers, have cried out to thee with prayer, to gain the sacrifice.
As such, O Maghavan, Indra, who lovest song, even as a lover bear my call.

verses.sa:
निरिन्द्र बृहतीभ्यो वृत्रं धनुभ्यो अस्फुरः ।
निरर्बुदस्य मृगयस्य मायिनो निः पर्वतस्य गा आजः ॥
verses.rom:
nirindra brihatibhyo vritram dhanubhyo asphurah |
nirarbudasya mrigayasya mayino nih parvatasya ga ajah ||
verses.en:
Thou from the lofty plains above, O Indra, hurledst Vrtra down.
Thou dravest forth the kine of guileful Mrgaya and Arbuda from the mountain's hold.

verses.sa:
निरग्नयो रुरुचुर्निरु सूर्यो निः सोम इन्द्रियो रसः ।
निरन्तरिक्षादधमो महामहिं कृषे तदिन्द्र पौंस्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
niragnayo ruruchurniru suryo nih soma indriyo rasah |
nirantarikshadadhamo mahamahim krishe tadindra paumsyam ||
verses.en:
Bright were the flaming fires, the Sun gave forth his shine, and Soma, Indra's juice, shone clear.
Indra, thou blewest the great Dragon from the air -. men must regard that valorous deed.

verses.sa:
यं मे दुरिन्द्रो मरुतः पाकस्थामा कौरयाणः ।
विश्वेषां त्मना शोभिष्ठमुपेव दिवि धावमानम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam me durindro marutah pakasthama kaurayanah |
vishvesham tmana shobhishthamupeva divi dhavamanam ||
verses.en:
The fairest courser of them all, who runneth on as 'twere to heaven.
Which Indra and the Maruts gave, and Pakasthaman Kaurayan.

verses.sa:
रोहितं मे पाकस्थामा सुधुरं कक्ष्यप्राम् ।
अदाद्रायो विबोधनम् ॥
verses.rom:
rohitam me pakasthama sudhuram kakshyapram |
adadrayo vibodhanam ||
verses.en:
To me hath Pakasthaman given, a ruddy horse, good at the pole,
Filling is girth and rousing wealth;

verses.sa:
यस्मा अन्ये दश प्रति धुरं वहन्ति वह्नयः ।
अस्तं वयो न तुग्र्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasma anye dasha prati dhuram vahanti vahnayah |
astam vayo na tugryam ||
verses.en:
Compared with whom no other ten strong coursers, harnessed to the pole,
Bear Tugrya to his dwelling place.

verses.sa:
आत्मा पितुस्तनूर्वास ओजोदा अभ्यञ्जनम् ।
तुरीयमिद्रोहितस्य पाकस्थामानं भोजं दातारमब्रवम् ॥
verses.rom:
atma pitustanurvasa ojoda abhyanjanam |
turiyamidrohitasya pakasthamanam bhojam dataramabravam ||
verses.en:
Raiment is body, food is life, and healing ointment giveth strength.
As the free-handed giver of the ruddy steed, I have named Pakasthaman fourth.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र प्रागपागुदङ्न्यग्वा हूयसे नृभिः ।
सिमा पुरू नृषूतो अस्यानवेऽसि प्रशर्ध तुर्वशे ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra pragapagudannyagva huyase nribhih |
sima puru nrishuto asyanave'si prashardha turvashe ||
verses.en:
THOUGH, Indra, thou art called by men eastward and westward, north and south,
Thou chiefly art with Anava and Turvasa, brave Champion I urged by men to Come.

verses.sa:
यद्वा रुमे रुशमे श्यावके कृप इन्द्र मादयसे सचा ।
कण्वासस्त्वा ब्रह्मभि स्तोमवाहस इन्द्रा यच्छन्त्या गहि ॥
verses.rom:
yadva rume rushame shyavake kripa indra madayase sacha |
kanvasastva brahmabhi stomavahasa indra yachchhantya gahi ||
verses.en:
Or, Indra, when with Ruma, Rusama, Syavaka, and Krpa thou rejoicest thee,
Still do the Kanvas, bringing praises, with their prayers, O Indra, draw thee hither: come.

verses.sa:
यथा गौरो अपा कृतं तृष्यन्नेत्यवेरिणम् ।
आपित्वे नः प्रपित्वे तूयमा गहि कण्वेषु सु सचा पिब ॥
verses.rom:
yatha gauro apa kritam trishyannetyaverinam |
apitve nah prapitve tuyama gahi kanveshu su sacha piba ||
verses.en:
Even as the wild-bull, when he thirsts, goes to the desert's watery pool,
Come hither quickly both at morning and at eve, and with the Kanvas drink thy fill.

verses.sa:
मन्दन्तु त्वा मघवन्निन्द्रेन्दवो राधोदेयाय सुन्वते ।
आमुष्या सोममपिबश्चमू सुतं ज्येष्ठं तद्दधिषे सहः ॥
verses.rom:
mandantu tva maghavannindrendavo radhodeyaya sunvate |
amushya somamapibashchamu sutam jyeshtham taddadhishe sahah ||
verses.en:
May the drops gladden thee, rich Indra, and obtain bounty for him who pours the juice.
Soma pressed in the mortar didst thou take and drink, and hence hast won surpassing might.

verses.sa:
प्र चक्रे सहसा सहो बभञ्ज मन्युमोजसा ।
विश्वे त इन्द्र पृतनायवो यहो नि वृक्षा इव येमिरे ॥
verses.rom:
pra chakre sahasa saho babhanja manyumojasa |
vishve ta indra pritanayavo yaho ni vriksha iva yemire ||
verses.en:
With mightier strength he conquered strength, with energy he crushed their wrath.
O Indra, Strong in youth, all those who sought the fray bent and bowed down to thee like trees.

verses.sa:
सहस्रेणेव सचते यवीयुधा यस्त आनळुपस्तुतिम् ।
पुत्रं प्रावर्गं कृणुते सुवीर्ये दाश्नोति नमउक्तिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sahasreneva sachate yaviyudha yasta analupastutim |
putram pravargam krinute suvirye dashnoti namauktibhih ||
verses.en:
He who wins promise of thine aid goes girt as with a thousand mighty men of war.
He makes his son preeminent in hero might - he serves with reverential prayer.

verses.sa:
मा भेम मा श्रमिष्मोग्रस्य सख्ये तव ।
महत्ते वृष्णो अभिचक्ष्यं कृतं पश्येम तुर्वशं यदुम् ॥
verses.rom:
ma bhema ma shramishmograsya sakhye tava |
mahatte vrishno abhichakshyam kritam pashyema turvasham yadum ||
verses.en:
With thee, the Mighty, for our Friend, we will riot fear or feel fatigue.
May we see Turvasa and Yadu: thy great deed, O Hero, must be glorified.

verses.sa:
सव्यामनु स्फिग्यं वावसे वृषा न दानो अस्य रोषति ।
मध्वा सम्पृक्ताः सारघेण धेनवस्तूयमेहि द्रवा पिब ॥
verses.rom:
savyamanu sphigyam vavase vrisha na dano asya roshati |
madhva sampriktah saraghena dhenavastuyamehi drava piba ||
verses.en:
On his left hip the Hero hath reclined himself: the proffered feast offends him not.
The milk is blended with the honey of the bee: quickly come hither, baste, and drink.

verses.sa:
अश्वी रथी सुरूप इद्गोमाँ इदिन्द्र ते सखा ।
श्वात्रभाजा वयसा सचते सदा चन्द्रो याति सभामुप ॥
verses.rom:
ashvi rathi surupa idgoman idindra te sakha |
shvatrabhaja vayasa sachate sada chandro yati sabhamupa ||
verses.en:
Indra, thy friend is fair of form and rich in horses, cars, and kine.
He evermore hath food accompanied by wealth, and radiant joins the company.

verses.sa:
ऋश्यो न तृष्यन्नवपानमा गहि पिबा सोमं वशाँ अनु ।
निमेघमानो मघवन्दिवेदिव ओजिष्ठं दधिषे सहः ॥
verses.rom:
rishyo na trishyannavapanama gahi piba somam vashan anu |
nimeghamano maghavandivediva ojishtham dadhishe sahah ||
verses.en:
Come like a thirsty antelope to the drinking-place: drink Soma to thy heart's desire.
Raining it down, O Maghavan, day after day, thou gainest thy surpassing might.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यो द्रावया त्वं सोममिन्द्रः पिपासति ।
उप नूनं युयुजे वृषणा हरी आ च जगाम वृत्रहा ॥
verses.rom:
adhvaryo dravaya tvam somamindrah pipasati |
upa nunam yuyuje vrishana hari a cha jagama vritraha ||
verses.en:
Priest, let the Soma juice flow forth, for Indra longs to drink thereof.
He even now hath yoked his vigorous Bay Steeds: the Vrtra-slayer hath come near.

verses.sa:
स्वयं चित्स मन्यते दाशुरिर्जनो यत्रा सोमस्य तृम्पसि ।
इदं ते अन्नं युज्यं समुक्षितं तस्येहि प्र द्रवा पिब ॥
verses.rom:
svayam chitsa manyate dashurirjano yatra somasya trimpasi |
idam te annam yujyam samukshitam tasyehi pra drava piba ||
verses.en:
The man with whom thou fillest thee with Soma deems himself a pious worshipper.
This thine appropriate food is here poured out for thee: come, hasten forward. drink of it,

verses.sa:
रथेष्ठायाध्वर्यवः सोममिन्द्राय सोतन ।
अधि ब्रध्नस्याद्रयो वि चक्षते सुन्वन्तो दाश्वध्वरम् ॥
verses.rom:
ratheshthayadhvaryavah somamindraya sotana |
adhi bradhnasyadrayo vi chakshate sunvanto dashvadhvaram ||
verses.en:
Press out the Soma juice, ye priests, for Indra borne upon his car.
The pressing-stones speak loud of Indra, while they shed the juice which, offered, honours him.

verses.sa:
उप ब्रध्नं वावाता वृषणा हरी इन्द्रमपसु वक्षतः ।
अर्वाञ्चं त्वा सप्तयोऽध्वरश्रियो वहन्तु सवनेदुप ॥
verses.rom:
upa bradhnam vavata vrishana hari indramapasu vakshatah |
arvancham tva saptayo'dhvarashriyo vahantu savanedupa ||
verses.en:
To the brown juice may his dear vigorous Bay Steeds bring Indra, to our holy task.
Hither let thy Car-steeds who seek the sacrifice bring thee to our drink-offerings.

verses.sa:
प्र पूषणं वृणीमहे युज्याय पुरूवसुम् ।
स शक्र शिक्ष पुरुहूत नो धिया तुजे राये विमोचन ॥
verses.rom:
pra pushanam vrinimahe yujyaya puruvasum |
sa shakra shiksha puruhuta no dhiya tuje raye vimochana ||
verses.en:
Pusan, the Lord of ample wealth, for firm alliance we elect.
May he with wisdom, Sakra! Looser! Much-invoked! aid us to riches and to seed.

verses.sa:
सं नः शिशीहि भुरिजोरिव क्षुरं रास्व रायो विमोचन ।
त्वे तन्नः सुवेदमुस्रियं वसु यं त्वं हिनोषि मर्त्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
sam nah shishihi bhurijoriva kshuram rasva rayo vimochana |
tve tannah suvedamusriyam vasu yam tvam hinoshi martyam ||
verses.en:
Sharpen us like a razor in the barber's hands: send riches thou who settest free.
Easy to find with thee are treasures of the Dawn for mortal man whom thou dost speed.

verses.sa:
वेमि त्वा पूषन्नृञ्जसे वेमि स्तोतव आघृणे ।
न तस्य वेम्यरणं हि तद्वसो स्तुषे पज्राय साम्ने ॥
verses.rom:
vemi tva pushannrinjase vemi stotava aghrine |
na tasya vemyaranam hi tadvaso stushe pajraya samne ||
verses.en:
Pusan, I long to win thy love, I long to praise thee, Radiant God.
Excellent Lord, 'tis strange tome, no wish have I to sing the psalm that Pajra sings.

verses.sa:
परा गावो यवसं कच्चिदाघृणे नित्यं रेक्णो अमर्त्य ।
अस्माकं पूषन्नविता शिवो भव मंहिष्ठो वाजसातये ॥
verses.rom:
para gavo yavasam kachchidaghrine nityam rekno amartya |
asmakam pushannavita shivo bhava mamhishtho vajasataye ||
verses.en:
My kine, O Radiant God, seek pasture where they will, my during wealth, Immortal One.
Be our protector, Pusan! be, most liberal Lord, propitious to our gathering strength.

verses.sa:
स्थूरं राधः शताश्वं कुरुङ्गस्य दिविष्टिषु ।
राज्ञस्त्वेषस्य सुभगस्य रातिषु तुर्वशेष्वमन्महि ॥
verses.rom:
sthuram radhah shatashvam kurungasya divishtishu |
rajnastveshasya subhagasya ratishu turvasheshvamanmahi ||
verses.en:
Rich was the gift Kurunga gave, a hundred steeds at morning rites.
Among the gifts of Turvasas we thought of him, the opulent, the splendid King.

verses.sa:
धीभिः सातानि काण्वस्य वाजिनः प्रियमेधैरभिद्युभिः ।
षष्टिं सहस्रानु निर्मजामजे निर्यूथानि गवामृषिः ॥
verses.rom:
dhibhih satani kanvasya vajinah priyamedhairabhidyubhih |
shashtim sahasranu nirmajamaje niryuthani gavamrishih ||
verses.en:
What by his morning songs Kanva, the powerful, hath, with the Priyamedhas, gained-
The herds of sixty thousand pure and spotless kine, have I, the Rsi, driven away.

verses.sa:
वृक्षाश्चिन्मे अभिपित्वे अरारणुः ।
गां भजन्त मेहनाश्वं भजन्त मेहना ॥
verses.rom:
vrikshashchinme abhipitve araranuh |
gam bhajanta mehanashvam bhajanta mehana ||
verses.en: The very trees were joyful at my coming: kine they obtained in plenty, steeds in plenty.

verses.sa:
दूरादिहेव यत्सत्यरुणप्सुरशिश्वितत् ।
वि भानुं विश्वधातनत् ॥
verses.rom:
duradiheva yatsatyarunapsurashishvitat |
vi bhanum vishvadhatanat ||
verses.en:
WHEN, even as she were present here, red Dawn hath shone from far away,
She spreadeth light on every side.

verses.sa:
नृवद्दस्रा मनोयुजा रथेन पृथुपाजसा ।
सचेथे अश्विनोषसम् ॥
verses.rom:
nrivaddasra manoyuja rathena prithupajasa |
sachethe ashvinoshasam ||
verses.en:
Like Heroes on your will-yoked car far shining, Wonder-Workers! ye
Attend, O Asvins, on the Dawn.

verses.sa:
युवाभ्यां वाजिनीवसू प्रति स्तोमा अदृक्षत ।
वाचं दूतो यथोहिषे ॥
verses.rom:
yuvabhyam vajinivasu prati stoma adrikshata |
vacham duto yathohishe ||
verses.en:
By you, O Lords of ample wealth our songs of praise have been observed:
As envoy have I brought the prayer.

verses.sa:
पुरुप्रिया ण ऊतये पुरुमन्द्रा पुरूवसू ।
स्तुषे कण्वासो अश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
purupriya na utaye purumandra puruvasu |
stushe kanvaso ashvina ||
verses.en:
Kanvas must praise the Asvins dear to many, making many glad,
Most rich, that they may succour us.

verses.sa:
मंहिष्ठा वाजसातमेषयन्ता शुभस्पती ।
गन्तारा दाशुषो गृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
mamhishtha vajasatameshayanta shubhaspati |
gantara dashusho griham ||
verses.en:
Most liberal, best at winning strength, inciters, Lords of splendour who
Visit the worshipper's abode.

verses.sa:
ता सुदेवाय दाशुषे सुमेधामवितारिणीम् ।
घृतैर्गव्यूतिमुक्षतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ta sudevaya dashushe sumedhamavitarinim |
ghritairgavyutimukshatam ||
verses.en:
So for devout Sudeva dew with fatness his unfailing mead,
And make it rich for sacrifice.

verses.sa:
आ न स्तोममुप द्रवत्तूयं श्येनेभिराशुभिः ।
यातमश्वेभिरश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
a na stomamupa dravattuyam shyenebhirashubhih |
yatamashvebhirashvina ||
verses.en:
Hitherward running speedily with horses, as with rapid hawks,
Come, Asvins, to our song of praise

verses.sa:
येभिस्तिस्रः परावतो दिवो विश्वानि रोचना ।
त्रीँरक्तून्परिदीयथः ॥
verses.rom:
yebhistisrah paravato divo vishvani rochana |
trinraktunparidiyathah ||
verses.en:
Wherewith the three wide distances, and all the lights that are in heaven.
Ye traverse, and three times of night.

verses.sa:
उत नो गोमतीरिष उत सातीरहर्विदा ।
वि पथः सातये सितम् ॥
verses.rom:
uta no gomatirisha uta satiraharvida |
vi pathah sataye sitam ||
verses.en:
O Finders of the Day, that we may win us food of kine and wealth,
Open the paths for us to tread.

verses.sa:
आ नो गोमन्तमश्विना सुवीरं सुरथं रयिम् ।
वोळ्हमश्वावतीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
a no gomantamashvina suviram suratham rayim |
volhamashvavatirishah ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, bring us wealth in kine, in noble heroes, and in cars:
Bring us the strength that horses give.

verses.sa:
वावृधाना शुभस्पती दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी ।
पिबतं सोम्यं मधु ॥
verses.rom:
vavridhana shubhaspati dasra hiranyavartani |
pibatam somyam madhu ||
verses.en:
Ye Lords of splendour, glorified, ye Wonder-Workers borne on paths
Of gold, drink sweets with Soma juice.

verses.sa:
अस्मभ्यं वाजिनीवसू मघवद्भ्यश्च सप्रथः ।
छर्दिर्यन्तमदाभ्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
asmabhyam vajinivasu maghavadbhyashcha saprathah |
chhardiryantamadabhyam ||
verses.en:
To us, ye Lords of ample wealth, and to our wealth chiefs extend
Wide shelter, ne'er to be assailed.

verses.sa:
नि षु ब्रह्म जनानां याविष्टं तूयमा गतम् ।
मो ष्वन्याँ उपारतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ni shu brahma jananam yavishtam tuyama gatam |
mo shvanyan uparatam ||
verses.en:
Come quickly downward to the prayer of people whom ye favour most:
Approach not unto other folk.

verses.sa:
अस्य पिबतमश्विना युवं मदस्य चारुणः ।
मध्वो रातस्य धिष्ण्या ॥
verses.rom:
asya pibatamashvina yuvam madasya charunah |
madhvo ratasya dhishnya ||
verses.en:
Ye Asvins whom our minds perceive, drink of this lovely gladdening draught,
The meath which we present to you.

verses.sa:
अस्मे आ वहतं रयिं शतवन्तं सहस्रिणम् ।
पुरुक्षुं विश्वधायसम् ॥
verses.rom:
asme a vahatam rayim shatavantam sahasrinam |
purukshum vishvadhayasam ||
verses.en:
Bring riches hither unto us in hundreds and in thousands, source
Of plenteous food, sustaining all.

verses.sa:
पुरुत्रा चिद्धि वां नरा विह्वयन्ते मनीषिणः ।
वाघद्भिरश्विना गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
purutra chiddhi vam nara vihvayante manishinah |
vaghadbhirashvina gatam ||
verses.en:
Verily sages call on you, ye Heroes, in full many a place.
Moved by the priests, O Asvins, conic.

verses.sa:
जनासो वृक्तबर्हिषो हविष्मन्तो अरंकृतः ।
युवां हवन्ते अश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
janaso vriktabarhisho havishmanto aramkritah |
yuvam havante ashvina ||
verses.en:
Men who have trimmed the sacred grass, bringing oblations and prepared,
O Asvins, are invoking you.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमद्य वामयं स्तोमो वाहिष्ठो अन्तमः ।
युवाभ्यां भूत्वश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
asmakamadya vamayam stomo vahishtho antamah |
yuvabhyam bhutvashvina ||
verses.en:
May this our hymn of praise to-day, most powerful to bring you, be,
O Asvins, nearest to your hearts.

verses.sa:
यो ह वां मधुनो दृतिराहितो रथचर्षणे ।
ततः पिबतमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
yo ha vam madhuno dritirahito rathacharshane |
tatah pibatamashvina ||
verses.en:
The skin filled full of savoury meath, laid in the pathway of your car-
O Asvins, drink ye both therefrom.

verses.sa:
तेन नो वाजिनीवसू पश्वे तोकाय शं गवे ।
वहतं पीवरीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
tena no vajinivasu pashve tokaya sham gave |
vahatam pivaririshah ||
verses.en:
For this, ye Lords of ample wealth, bring blessing for our herd, our kine,
Our progeny, and plenteous food.

verses.sa:
उत नो दिव्या इष उत सिन्धूँरहर्विदा ।
अप द्वारेव वर्षथः ॥
verses.rom:
uta no divya isha uta sindhunraharvida |
apa dvareva varshathah ||
verses.en:
Ye too unclose to us like doors the strengthening waters of the sky,
And rivers, ye who find the day.

verses.sa:
कदा वां तौग्र्यो विधत्समुद्रे जहितो नरा ।
यद्वां रथो विभिष्पतात् ॥
verses.rom:
kada vam taugryo vidhatsamudre jahito nara |
yadvam ratho vibhishpatat ||
verses.en:
When did the son of' Tugra serve you, Men? Abandoned in the sea,
That with winged steeds your car might fly.

verses.sa:
युवं कण्वाय नासत्या ऋपिरिप्ताय हर्म्ये ।
शश्वदूतीर्दशस्यथः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam kanvaya nasatya ripiriptaya harmye |
shashvadutirdashasyathah ||
verses.en:
Ye, O Nasatyas, ministered to Kanva with repeated aid,
When cast into the heated pit.

verses.sa:
ताभिरा यातमूतिभिर्नव्यसीभिः सुशस्तिभिः ।
यद्वां वृषण्वसू हुवे ॥
verses.rom:
tabhira yatamutibhirnavyasibhih sushastibhih |
yadvam vrishanvasu huve ||
verses.en:
Come near with those most recent aids of yours which merit eulogy,
When I invoke you, Wealthy Gods.

verses.sa:
यथा चित्कण्वमावतं प्रियमेधमुपस्तुतम् ।
अत्रिं शिञ्जारमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
yatha chitkanvamavatam priyamedhamupastutam |
atrim shinjaramashvina ||
verses.en:
As ye protected Kanva erst, Priyamedha and Upastuta,
Atri, Sinjara, Asvins Twain

verses.sa:
यथोत कृत्व्ये धनेऽंशुं गोष्वगस्त्यम् ।
यथा वाजेषु सोभरिम् ॥
verses.rom:
yathota kritvye dhane'mshum goshvagastyam |
yatha vajeshu sobharim ||
verses.en:
And Amsu in decisive fight, Agastya in the fray for kine.
And, in his battles, Sobhari.

verses.sa:
एतावद्वां वृषण्वसू अतो वा भूयो अश्विना ।
गृणन्तः सुम्नमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
etavadvam vrishanvasu ato va bhuyo ashvina |
grinantah sumnamimahe ||
verses.en:
For so much bliss, or even more, O Asvins, Wealthy Gods, than this,
We pray white singing hymns to you.

verses.sa:
रथं हिरण्यवन्धुरं हिरण्याभीशुमश्विना ।
आ हि स्थाथो दिविस्पृशम् ॥
verses.rom:
ratham hiranyavandhuram hiranyabhishumashvina |
a hi sthatho divisprisham ||
verses.en:
Ascend your car with golden seat, O Asvins, and with reins of gold,
That reaches even to the sky.

verses.sa:
हिरण्ययी वां रभिरीषा अक्षो हिरण्ययः ।
उभा चक्रा हिरण्यया ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyayi vam rabhirisha aksho hiranyayah |
ubha chakra hiranyaya ||
verses.en:
Golden is its supporting shaft, the axle also is of gold,
And both the wheels are made of gold.

verses.sa:
तेन नो वाजिनीवसू परावतश्चिदा गतम् ।
उपेमां सुष्टुतिं मम ॥
verses.rom:
tena no vajinivasu paravatashchida gatam |
upemam sushtutim mama ||
verses.en:
Thereon, ye Lords of ample wealth, come to us even from afar,
Come ye to this mine eulogy.

verses.sa:
आ वहेथे पराकात्पूर्वीरश्नन्तावश्विना ।
इषो दासीरमर्त्या ॥
verses.rom:
a vahethe parakatpurvirashnantavashvina |
isho dasiramartya ||
verses.en:
From far away ye come to us, Asvins, enjoying plenteous food
Of Dasas, O Immortal Ones.

verses.sa:
आ नो द्युम्नैरा श्रवोभिरा राया यातमश्विना ।
पुरुश्चन्द्रा नासत्या ॥
verses.rom:
a no dyumnaira shravobhira raya yatamashvina |
purushchandra nasatya ||
verses.en:
With splendour, riches, and renown, O Asvins, hither come to us,
Nasatyas, shining brilliantly.

verses.sa:
एह वां प्रुषितप्सवो वयो वहन्तु पर्णिनः ।
अच्छा स्वध्वरं जनम् ॥
verses.rom:
eha vam prushitapsavo vayo vahantu parninah |
achchha svadhvaram janam ||
verses.en:
May dappled horses, steeds who fly with pinions, bring you hitherward
To people skilled in sacrifice.

verses.sa:
रथं वामनुगायसं य इषा वर्तते सह ।
न चक्रमभि बाधते ॥
verses.rom:
ratham vamanugayasam ya isha vartate saha |
na chakramabhi badhate ||
verses.en:
The whcel delayeth not that car of yours accompanied by song,
That cometh with a store of food.

verses.sa:
हिरण्ययेन रथेन द्रवत्पाणिभिरश्वैः ।
धीजवना नासत्या ॥
verses.rom:
hiranyayena rathena dravatpanibhirashvaih |
dhijavana nasatya ||
verses.en:
Borne on that chariot wrought of gold, with coursers very fleet of foot,
Come, O Nasatyas, swift as thought.

verses.sa:
युवं मृगं जागृवांसं स्वदथो वा वृषण्वसू ।
ता नः पृङ्क्तमिषा रयिम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam mrigam jagrivamsam svadatho va vrishanvasu |
ta nah prinktamisha rayim ||
verses.en:
O Wealthy Gods, ye taste and find the brisk and watchful wild beast good.
Associate wealth with food for us.

verses.sa:
ता मे अश्विना सनीनां विद्यातं नवानाम् ।
यथा चिच्चैद्यः कशुः शतमुष्ट्रानां ददत्सहस्रा दश गोनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ta me ashvina saninam vidyatam navanam |
yatha chichchaidyah kashuh shatamushtranam dadatsahasra dasha gonam ||
verses.en:
As such, O Asvins, find for me my share of new-presented gifts,
As Kasu, Cedi's son, gave me a hundred head of buffaloes, and ten thousand kine.

verses.sa:
यो मे हिरण्यसंदृशो दश राज्ञो अमंहत ।
अधस्पदा इच्चैद्यस्य कृष्टयश्चर्मम्ना अभितो जनाः ॥
verses.rom:
yo me hiranyasamdrisho dasha rajno amamhata |
adhaspada ichchaidyasya krishtayashcharmamna abhito janah ||
verses.en:
He who hath given me for mine own ten Kings like gold to look upon.
At Caidya's feet are all the people round about, all those who think upon the shield.

verses.sa:
माकिरेना पथा गाद्येनेमे यन्ति चेदयः ।
अन्यो नेत्सूरिरोहते भूरिदावत्तरो जनः ॥
verses.rom:
makirena patha gadyeneme yanti chedayah |
anyo netsurirohate bhuridavattaro janah ||
verses.en:
No man, not any, goes upon the path on which the Cedis walk.
No other prince, no folk is held more liberal of gifts than they.

verses.sa:
महाँ इन्द्रो य ओजसा पर्जन्यो वृष्टिमाँ इव ।
स्तोमैर्वत्सस्य वावृधे ॥
verses.rom:
mahan indro ya ojasa parjanyo vrishtiman iva |
stomairvatsasya vavridhe ||
verses.en:
INDRA, great in his power and might, and like Parjanya rich in rain,
Is magnified by Vatsa's lauds.

verses.sa:
प्रजामृतस्य पिप्रतः प्र यद्भरन्त वह्नयः ।
विप्रा ऋतस्य वाहसा ॥
verses.rom:
prajamritasya pipratah pra yadbharanta vahnayah |
vipra ritasya vahasa ||
verses.en:
When the priests, strengthening the Son of Holy Law, present their gifts,
Singers with Order's hymn of praiser.

verses.sa:
कण्वा इन्द्रं यदक्रत स्तोमैर्यज्ञस्य साधनम् ।
जामि ब्रुवत आयुधम् ॥
verses.rom:
kanva indram yadakrata stomairyajnasya sadhanam |
jami bruvata ayudham ||
verses.en:
Since Kanvas with their lauds have made Indra complete the sacrifice.
Words are their own appropriate arms.

verses.sa:
समस्य मन्यवे विशो विश्वा नमन्त कृष्टयः ।
समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः ॥
verses.rom:
samasya manyave visho vishva namanta krishtayah |
samudrayeva sindhavah ||
verses.en:
Before his hot displeasure all the peoples, all the men, bow down,
As rivers bow them to the sea.

verses.sa:
ओजस्तदस्य तित्विष उभे यत्समवर्तयत् ।
इन्द्रश्चर्मेव रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
ojastadasya titvisha ubhe yatsamavartayat |
indrashcharmeva rodasi ||
verses.en:
This power of his shone brightly forth when Indra brought together, like
A skin, the worlds of heaven and earth.

verses.sa:
वि चिद्वृत्रस्य दोधतो वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ।
शिरो बिभेद वृष्णिना ॥
verses.rom:
vi chidvritrasya dodhato vajrena shataparvana |
shiro bibheda vrishnina ||
verses.en:
The fiercely-moving Vrtra's head he severed with his thunderbolt,
His mighty hundred-knotted bolt.

verses.sa:
इमा अभि प्र णोनुमो विपामग्रेषु धीतयः ।
अग्नेः शोचिर्न दिद्युतः ॥
verses.rom:
ima abhi pra nonumo vipamagreshu dhitayah |
agneh shochirna didyutah ||
verses.en:
Here are-we sing them loudly forth-our thoughts among-the best of songs.
Even lightnings like the blaze of fire.

verses.sa:
गुहा सतीरुप त्मना प्र यच्छोचन्त धीतयः ।
कण्वा ऋतस्य धारया ॥
verses.rom:
guha satirupa tmana pra yachchhochanta dhitayah |
kanva ritasya dharaya ||
verses.en:
When bidden thoughts, spontaneously advancing, glow, and with the stream
Of sacrifice the Kanvas shine.

verses.sa:
प्र तमिन्द्र नशीमहि रयिं गोमन्तमश्विनम् ।
प्र ब्रह्म पूर्वचित्तये ॥
verses.rom:
pra tamindra nashimahi rayim gomantamashvinam |
pra brahma purvachittaye ||
verses.en:
Indra, may we obtain that wealth in horses and in herds of cows,
And prayer that may be noticed first.

verses.sa:
अहमिद्धि पितुष्परि मेधामृतस्य जग्रभ ।
अहं सूर्य इवाजनि ॥
verses.rom:
ahamiddhi pitushpari medhamritasya jagrabha |
aham surya ivajani ||
verses.en:
I from my Father have received deep knowledge of the Holy Law
I was born like unto the Sun.

verses.sa:
अहं प्रत्नेन मन्मना गिरः शुम्भामि कण्ववत् ।
येनेन्द्रः शुष्ममिद्दधे ॥
verses.rom:
aham pratnena manmana girah shumbhami kanvavat |
yenendrah shushmamiddadhe ||
verses.en:
After the lore of ancient time I make, like Kanva, beauteous songs,
And Indra's self gains strength thereby.

verses.sa:
ये त्वामिन्द्र न तुष्टुवुरृषयो ये च तुष्टुवुः ।
ममेद्वर्धस्व सुष्टुतः ॥
verses.rom:
ye tvamindra na tushtuvurrishayo ye cha tushtuvuh |
mamedvardhasva sushtutah ||
verses.en:
Whatever Rsis have not praised thee, Indra, or have lauded thee,
By me exalted wax thou strong.

verses.sa:
यदस्य मन्युरध्वनीद्वि वृत्रं पर्वशो रुजन् ।
अपः समुद्रमैरयत् ॥
verses.rom:
yadasya manyuradhvanidvi vritram parvasho rujan |
apah samudramairayat ||
verses.en:
When his wrath thundered, when he rent Vrtra to pieces, limb by limb,
He sent the waters to the sea.

verses.sa:
नि शुष्ण इन्द्र धर्णसिं वज्रं जघन्थ दस्यवि ।
वृषा ह्युग्र शृण्विषे ॥
verses.rom:
ni shushna indra dharnasim vajram jaghantha dasyavi |
vrisha hyugra shrinvishe ||
verses.en:
Against the Dasyu Susna thou, Indra, didst hurl thy during bolt:
Thou, Dread one, hast a hero's fame.

verses.sa:
न द्याव इन्द्रमोजसा नान्तरिक्षाणि वज्रिणम् ।
न विव्यचन्त भूमयः ॥
verses.rom:
na dyava indramojasa nantarikshani vajrinam |
na vivyachanta bhumayah ||
verses.en:
Neither the heavens nor firmaments nor regions of the earth contain
Indra, the Thunderer with his might.

verses.sa:
यस्त इन्द्र महीरप स्तभूयमान आशयत् ।
नि तं पद्यासु शिश्नथः ॥
verses.rom:
yasta indra mahirapa stabhuyamana ashayat |
ni tam padyasu shishnathah ||
verses.en:
O Indra him who lay at length staying thy copious waters thou,
In his own footsteps, smotest down

verses.sa:
य इमे रोदसी मही समीची समजग्रभीत् ।
तमोभिरिन्द्र तं गुहः ॥
verses.rom:
ya ime rodasi mahi samichi samajagrabhit |
tamobhirindra tam guhah ||
verses.en:
Thou hiddest deep in darkness within, O Indra, who had set his grasp
On spacious heaven and earth conjoined.

verses.sa:
य इन्द्र यतयस्त्वा भृगवो ये च तुष्टुवुः ।
ममेदुग्र श्रुधी हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
ya indra yatayastva bhrigavo ye cha tushtuvuh |
mamedugra shrudhi havam ||
verses.en:
Indra, whatever Yatis and Bhrgus have offered praise to thee,
Listen, thou Mighty, to my call.

verses.sa:
इमास्त इन्द्र पृश्नयो घृतं दुहत आशिरम् ।
एनामृतस्य पिप्युषीः ॥
verses.rom:
imasta indra prishnayo ghritam duhata ashiram |
enamritasya pipyushih ||
verses.en:
Indra, these spotted cows yield thee their butter and the milky draught;
Aiders, thereby, of sacrifice;

verses.sa:
या इन्द्र प्रस्वस्त्वासा गर्भमचक्रिरन् ।
परि धर्मेव सूर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
ya indra prasvastvasa garbhamachakriran |
pari dharmeva suryam ||
verses.en:
Which, teeming, have received thee as a life-germ, Indra, with their mouth,
Like Surya who sustaineth all.

verses.sa:
त्वामिच्छवसस्पते कण्वा उक्थेन वावृधुः ।
त्वां सुतास इन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamichchhavasaspate kanva ukthena vavridhuh |
tvam sutasa indavah ||
verses.en:
O Lord of Might, with hymns of praise the Kanvas have increased thy power,
The drops poured forth have strengthened thee.

verses.sa:
तवेदिन्द्र प्रणीतिषूत प्रशस्तिरद्रिवः ।
यज्ञो वितन्तसाय्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tavedindra pranitishuta prashastiradrivah |
yajno vitantasayyah ||
verses.en:
Under thy guidance, Indra, mid thy praises, Lord of Thunder, shall
The sacrifice be soon performed.

verses.sa:
आ न इन्द्र महीमिषं पुरं न दर्षि गोमतीम् ।
उत प्रजां सुवीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
a na indra mahimisham puram na darshi gomatim |
uta prajam suviryam ||
verses.en:
Indra, disclose much food for us, like a stronghold with store of kine:
Give progeny and heroic strength.

verses.sa:
उत त्यदाश्वश्व्यं यदिन्द्र नाहुषीष्वा ।
अग्रे विक्षु प्रदीदयत् ॥
verses.rom:
uta tyadashvashvyam yadindra nahushishva |
agre vikshu pradidayat ||
verses.en:
And, Indra, grant us all that wealth of fleet steeds which shone bright of old
Among the tribes of Nahusas.

verses.sa:
अभि व्रजं न तत्निषे सूर उपाकचक्षसम् ।
यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi vrajam na tatnishe sura upakachakshasam |
yadindra mrilayasi nah ||
verses.en:
Hither thou seemest to attract heaven's fold which shines before our eyes,
When, Indra, thou art kind to us.

verses.sa:
यदङ्ग तविषीयस इन्द्र प्रराजसि क्षितीः ।
महाँ अपार ओजसा ॥
verses.rom:
yadanga tavishiyasa indra prarajasi kshitih |
mahan apara ojasa ||
verses.en:
Yea, when thou puttest forth thy power, Indra, thou governest the folk.
Mighty, unlimited in strength.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा हविष्मतीर्विश उप ब्रुवत ऊतये ।
उरुज्रयसमिन्दुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva havishmatirvisha upa bruvata utaye |
urujrayasamindubhih ||
verses.en:
The tribes who bring oblations call to thee, to thee to give them help,
With drops to thee who spreadest far.

verses.sa:
उपह्वरे गिरीणां संगथे च नदीनाम् ।
धिया विप्रो अजायत ॥
verses.rom:
upahvare girinam samgathe cha nadinam |
dhiya vipro ajayata ||
verses.en:
There where the mountains downward slope, there by the meeting of the streams
The Sage was manifest with song.

verses.sa:
अतः समुद्रमुद्वतश्चिकित्वाँ अव पश्यति ।
यतो विपान एजति ॥
verses.rom:
atah samudramudvatashchikitvan ava pashyati |
yato vipana ejati ||
verses.en:
Thence, marking, from his lofty place downward he looks upon the sea,
And thence with rapid stir he moves.

verses.sa:
आदित्प्रत्नस्य रेतसो ज्योतिष्पश्यन्ति वासरम् ।
परो यदिध्यते दिवा ॥
verses.rom:
aditpratnasya retaso jyotishpashyanti vasaram |
paro yadidhyate diva ||
verses.en:
Then, verify, they see the light refulgent of primeval seed,
Kindled on yonder side of heaven.

verses.sa:
कण्वास इन्द्र ते मतिं विश्वे वर्धन्ति पौंस्यम् ।
उतो शविष्ठ वृष्ण्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
kanvasa indra te matim vishve vardhanti paumsyam |
uto shavishtha vrishnyam ||
verses.en:
Indra, the Kanvas all exalt thy wisdom and thy manly power,
And, Mightiest! thine heroic strength.

verses.sa:
इमां म इन्द्र सुष्टुतिं जुषस्व प्र सु मामव ।
उत प्र वर्धया मतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
imam ma indra sushtutim jushasva pra su mamava |
uta pra vardhaya matim ||
verses.en:
Accept this eulogy of mine, Indra, and guard me carefully:
Strengthen my thought and prosper it.

verses.sa:
उत ब्रह्मण्या वयं तुभ्यं प्रवृद्ध वज्रिवः ।
विप्रा अतक्ष्म जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
uta brahmanya vayam tubhyam pravriddha vajrivah |
vipra atakshma jivase ||
verses.en:
For thee, O Mighty, Thunder-armed, we singers through devotion have
Fashioned the hymn that we may live.

verses.sa:
अभि कण्वा अनूषतापो न प्रवता यतीः ।
इन्द्रं वनन्वती मतिः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi kanva anushatapo na pravata yatih |
indram vananvati matih ||
verses.en:
To Indra have the Kanvas sung, like waters speeding down a slope:
The song is fain to go to him.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमुक्थानि वावृधुः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः ।
अनुत्तमन्युमजरम् ॥
verses.rom:
indramukthani vavridhuh samudramiva sindhavah |
anuttamanyumajaram ||
verses.en:
As rivers swell the ocean, so our hymns of praise make Indra strong,
Eternal, of resistless wrath.

verses.sa:
आ नो याहि परावतो हरिभ्यां हर्यताभ्याम् ।
इममिन्द्र सुतं पिब ॥
verses.rom:
a no yahi paravato haribhyam haryatabhyam |
imamindra sutam piba ||
verses.en:
Come with thy lovely Bay Steeds, come to us from regions far away
O Indra, drink this Soma juice.

verses.sa:
त्वामिद्वृत्रहन्तम जनासो वृक्तबर्हिषः ।
हवन्ते वाजसातये ॥
verses.rom:
tvamidvritrahantama janaso vriktabarhishah |
havante vajasataye ||
verses.en:
Best slayer of Vrtras, men whose sacred grass is ready trimmed
Invoke thee for the gain of spoil.

verses.sa:
अनु त्वा रोदसी उभे चक्रं न वर्त्येतशम् ।
अनु सुवानास इन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
anu tva rodasi ubhe chakram na vartyetasham |
anu suvanasa indavah ||
verses.en:
The heavens and earth come after thee as the wheel follows Etasa:
To thee flow Soma-drops effused.

verses.sa:
मन्दस्वा सु स्वर्णर उतेन्द्र शर्यणावति ।
मत्स्वा विवस्वतो मती ॥
verses.rom:
mandasva su svarnara utendra sharyanavati |
matsva vivasvato mati ||
verses.en:
Rejoice, O Indra, in the light, rejoice in Saryandyan,
Be Glad in the sacrificer's hymn.

verses.sa:
वावृधान उप द्यवि वृषा वज्र्यरोरवीत् ।
वृत्रहा सोमपातमः ॥
verses.rom:
vavridhana upa dyavi vrisha vajryaroravit |
vritraha somapatamah ||
verses.en:
Grown strong in heaven, the Thunder-armed hath bellowed, Vrtra-slayer, Bull,
Chief drinker of the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
ऋषिर्हि पूर्वजा अस्येक ईशान ओजसा ।
इन्द्र चोष्कूयसे वसु ॥
verses.rom:
rishirhi purvaja asyeka ishana ojasa |
indra choshkuyase vasu ||
verses.en:
Thou art a Rsi born of old, sole Ruler over all by might:
Thou, Indra, guardest well our wealth.

verses.sa:
अस्माकं त्वा सुताँ उप वीतपृष्ठा अभि प्रयः ।
शतं वहन्तु हरयः ॥
verses.rom:
asmakam tva sutan upa vitaprishtha abhi prayah |
shatam vahantu harayah ||
verses.en:
May thy Bay Steeds with beauteous backs, a hundred, bring thee to the feast,
Bring thee to these our Soma-draughts.

verses.sa:
इमां सु पूर्व्यां धियं मधोर्घृतस्य पिप्युषीम् ।
कण्वा उक्थेन वावृधुः ॥
verses.rom:
imam su purvyam dhiyam madhorghritasya pipyushim |
kanva ukthena vavridhuh ||
verses.en:
The Kanvas with their hymns of praise have magnified this ancient thought
That swells with streams of meath and oil.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमिद्विमहीनां मेधे वृणीत मर्त्यः ।
इन्द्रं सनिष्युरूतये ॥
verses.rom:
indramidvimahinam medhe vrinita martyah |
indram sanishyurutaye ||
verses.en:
Mid mightiest Gods let mortal man choose Indra at the sacrifice,
Indra, whoe'er would win, for help.

verses.sa:
अर्वाञ्चं त्वा पुरुष्टुत प्रियमेधस्तुता हरी ।
सोमपेयाय वक्षतः ॥
verses.rom:
arvancham tva purushtuta priyamedhastuta hari |
somapeyaya vakshatah ||
verses.en:
Thy steeds, by Priyamedhas praised, shall bring thee, God whom all invoke,
Hither to drink the Somajuice.

verses.sa:
शतमहं तिरिन्दिरे सहस्रं पर्शावा ददे ।
राधांसि याद्वानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
shatamaham tirindire sahasram parshava dade |
radhamsi yadvanam ||
verses.en:
A hundred thousand have I gained from Parsu, from Tirindira,
And presents of the Yadavas.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि शतान्यर्वतां सहस्रा दश गोनाम् ।
ददुष्पज्राय साम्ने ॥
verses.rom:
trini shatanyarvatam sahasra dasha gonam |
dadushpajraya samne ||
verses.en:
Ten thousand head of kine, and steeds three times a hundred they bestowed
On Pajra for the Sama-song.

verses.sa:
उदानट् ककुहो दिवमुष्ट्राञ्चतुर्युजो ददत् ।
श्रवसा याद्वं जनम् ॥
verses.rom:
udanat kakuho divamushtranchaturyujo dadat |
shravasa yadvam janam ||
verses.en:
Kakuha hath reached up to heaven, bestowing buffaloes yoked in fours,
And matched in fame the Yadavas.

verses.sa:
प्र यद्वस्त्रिष्टुभमिषं मरुतो विप्रो अक्षरत् ।
वि पर्वतेषु राजथ ॥
verses.rom:
pra yadvastrishtubhamisham maruto vipro aksharat |
vi parvateshu rajatha ||
verses.en:
O MARUTS, when the sage hath poured the Trstup forth as food for you,
Ye shine amid the mountain-clouds.

verses.sa:
यदङ्ग तविषीयवो यामं शुभ्रा अचिध्वम् ।
नि पर्वता अहासत ॥
verses.rom:
yadanga tavishiyavo yamam shubhra achidhvam |
ni parvata ahasata ||
verses.en:
When, Bright Ones, fain to show your might ye have determined on your course,
The mountain-clouds have bent them down.

verses.sa:
उदीरयन्त वायुभिर्वाश्रासः पृश्निमातरः ।
धुक्षन्त पिप्युषीमिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
udirayanta vayubhirvashrasah prishnimatarah |
dhukshanta pipyushimisham ||
verses.en:
Loud roaring with the winds the Sons of Prsni have upraised themselves:
They have poured out the streaming food.

verses.sa:
वपन्ति मरुतो मिहं प्र वेपयन्ति पर्वतान् ।
यद्यामं यान्ति वायुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
vapanti maruto miham pra vepayanti parvatan |
yadyamam yanti vayubhih ||
verses.en:
The Maruts spread the mist abroad and make mountains rock and reel,
When with the winds they go their way

verses.sa:
नि यद्यामाय वो गिरिर्नि सिन्धवो विधर्मणे ।
महे शुष्माय येमिरे ॥
verses.rom:
ni yadyamaya vo girirni sindhavo vidharmane |
mahe shushmaya yemire ||
verses.en:
What time the rivers and the hills before your coming bowed them down,
So to sustain your mighty force.

verses.sa:
युष्माँ उ नक्तमूतये युष्मान्दिवा हवामहे ।
युष्मान्प्रयत्यध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
yushman u naktamutaye yushmandiva havamahe |
yushmanprayatyadhvare ||
verses.en:
We call on you for aid by night, on you for succour in the day,
On you while sacrifice proceeds.

verses.sa:
उदु त्ये अरुणप्सवश्चित्रा यामेभिरीरते ।
वाश्रा अधि ष्णुना दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
udu tye arunapsavashchitra yamebhirirate |
vashra adhi shnuna divah ||
verses.en:
These, verily, wondrous, red of hue, speed on their courses with a roar
Over the ridges of the sky.

verses.sa:
सृजन्ति रश्मिमोजसा पन्थां सूर्याय यातवे ।
ते भानुभिर्वि तस्थिरे ॥
verses.rom:
srijanti rashmimojasa pantham suryaya yatave |
te bhanubhirvi tasthire ||
verses.en:
With might they drop the loosened rein so that the Sun may run his course,
And spread themselves with beams of light.

verses.sa:
इमां मे मरुतो गिरमिमं स्तोममृभुक्षणः ।
इमं मे वनता हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
imam me maruto giramimam stomamribhukshanah |
imam me vanata havam ||
verses.en:
Accept, ye Maruts, this my song, accept ye this mine hymn of praise,
Accept, Rbhuksans, this my call.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि सरांसि पृश्नयो दुदुह्रे वज्रिणे मधु ।
उत्सं कवन्धमुद्रिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
trini saramsi prishnayo duduhre vajrine madhu |
utsam kavandhamudrinam ||
verses.en:
The dappled Cows have poured three lakes, meath for the Thunder-wielding God,
From the great cask, the watery cloud.

verses.sa:
मरुतो यद्ध वो दिवः सुम्नायन्तो हवामहे ।
आ तू न उप गन्तन ॥
verses.rom:
maruto yaddha vo divah sumnayanto havamahe |
a tu na upa gantana ||
verses.en:
O Maruts, quickly come to us when, longing for felicity,
We call you hither from the sky.

verses.sa:
यूयं हि ष्ठा सुदानवो रुद्रा ऋभुक्षणो दमे ।
उत प्रचेतसो मदे ॥
verses.rom:
yuyam hi shtha sudanavo rudra ribhukshano dame |
uta prachetaso made ||
verses.en:
For, Rudras and Rbhuksans, ye, Most Bountiful, are in the house,
Wise when the gladdening draught is drunk.

verses.sa:
आ नो रयिं मदच्युतं पुरुक्षुं विश्वधायसम् ।
इयर्ता मरुतो दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
a no rayim madachyutam purukshum vishvadhayasam |
iyarta maruto divah ||
verses.en:
O Maruts, send us down from heaven riches distilling rapturous joy,
With plenteous food, sustaining all.

verses.sa:
अधीव यद्गिरीणां यामं शुभ्रा अचिध्वम् ।
सुवानैर्मन्दध्व इन्दुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
adhiva yadgirinam yamam shubhra achidhvam |
suvanairmandadhva indubhih ||
verses.en:
When, Bright Ones, hither from the hills ye have resolved to take your way,
Ye revel in the drops effused.

verses.sa:
एतावतश्चिदेषां सुम्नं भिक्षेत मर्त्यः ।
अदाभ्यस्य मन्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
etavatashchidesham sumnam bhiksheta martyah |
adabhyasya manmabhih ||
verses.en:
Man should solicit with his lauds happiness which belongs to them,
So great a band invincible.

verses.sa:
ये द्रप्सा इव रोदसी धमन्त्यनु वृष्टिभिः ।
उत्सं दुहन्तो अक्षितम् ॥
verses.rom:
ye drapsa iva rodasi dhamantyanu vrishtibhih |
utsam duhanto akshitam ||
verses.en:
They who like fiery sparks with showers of rain blow through the heaven and earth,
Milking the spring that never fails.

verses.sa:
उदु स्वानेभिरीरत उद्रथैरुदु वायुभिः ।
उत्स्तोमैः पृश्निमातरः ॥
verses.rom:
udu svanebhirirata udrathairudu vayubhih |
utstomaih prishnimatarah ||
verses.en:
With chariots and tumultuous roar, with tempests and with hymns of praise
The Sons of Prsni hurry forth.

verses.sa:
येनाव तुर्वशं यदुं येन कण्वं धनस्पृतम् ।
राये सु तस्य धीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
yenava turvasham yadum yena kanvam dhanaspritam |
raye su tasya dhimahi ||
verses.en:
For wealth, we think of that whereby ye aided Yadu, Turvasa,
And KanVa who obtained the spoil.

verses.sa:
इमा उ वः सुदानवो घृतं न पिप्युषीरिषः ।
वर्धान्काण्वस्य मन्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ima u vah sudanavo ghritam na pipyushirishah |
vardhankanvasya manmabhih ||
verses.en:
May these our viands Bounteous Ones I that flow in streams like holy oil,
With Kanva's hymns, increase your might.

verses.sa:
क्व नूनं सुदानवो मदथा वृक्तबर्हिषः ।
ब्रह्मा को वः सपर्यति ॥
verses.rom:
kva nunam sudanavo madatha vriktabarhishah |
brahma ko vah saparyati ||
verses.en:
Where, Bounteous Lords for whom the grass is trimmed, are ye rejoicing now?
What Brahman is adoring you?

verses.sa:
नहि ष्म यद्ध वः पुरा स्तोमेभिर्वृक्तबर्हिषः ।
शर्धाँ ऋतस्य जिन्वथ ॥
verses.rom:
nahi shma yaddha vah pura stomebhirvriktabarhishah |
shardhan ritasya jinvatha ||
verses.en:
Is it not there where ye of old, supplied with sacred grass, for lauds
Inspired the strong in sacrifice?

verses.sa:
समु त्ये महतीरपः सं क्षोणी समु सूर्यम् ।
सं वज्रं पर्वशो दधुः ॥
verses.rom:
samu tye mahatirapah sam kshoni samu suryam |
sam vajram parvasho dadhuh ||
verses.en:
They brought together both the worlds, the mighty waters, and the Sun,
And, joint by joint, the thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
वि वृत्रं पर्वशो ययुर्वि पर्वताँ अराजिनः ।
चक्राणा वृष्णि पौंस्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
vi vritram parvasho yayurvi parvatan arajinah |
chakrana vrishni paumsyam ||
verses.en:
They sundered Vrtra limb from limb and split the gloomy mountain-clouds,
Performing a heroic deed.

verses.sa:
अनु त्रितस्य युध्यतः शुष्ममावन्नुत क्रतुम् ।
अन्विन्द्रं वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
verses.rom:
anu tritasya yudhyatah shushmamavannuta kratum |
anvindram vritraturye ||
verses.en:
They reinforced the power and strength of Trita as he fought, and helped
Indra in battle with the foe.

verses.sa:
विद्युद्धस्ता अभिद्यवः शिप्राः शीर्षन्हिरण्ययीः ।
शुभ्रा व्यञ्जत श्रिये ॥
verses.rom:
vidyuddhasta abhidyavah shiprah shirshanhiranyayih |
shubhra vyanjata shriye ||
verses.en:
They deck themselves for glory, bright, celestial, lightning in their hands,
And helms of gold upon their heads.

verses.sa:
उशना यत्परावत उक्ष्णो रन्ध्रमयातन ।
द्यौर्न चक्रदद्भिया ॥
verses.rom:
ushana yatparavata ukshno randhramayatana |
dyaurna chakradadbhiya ||
verses.en:
When eagerly ye from far away came to the cavern of the Bull,
He bellowed in his fear like Heaven.

verses.sa:
आ नो मखस्य दावनेऽश्वैर्हिरण्यपाणिभिः ।
देवास उप गन्तन ॥
verses.rom:
a no makhasya davane'shvairhiranyapanibhih |
devasa upa gantana ||
verses.en:
Borne by your golden-footed steeds, O Gods, come hither to receive
The sacrifice we offer you.

verses.sa:
यदेषां पृषती रथे प्रष्टिर्वहति रोहितः ।
यान्ति शुभ्रा रिणन्नपः ॥
verses.rom:
yadesham prishati rathe prashtirvahati rohitah |
yanti shubhra rinannapah ||
verses.en:
When the red leader draws along their spotted deer yoked to the car.
The Bright Ones come, and shed the rain.

verses.sa:
सुषोमे शर्यणावत्यार्जीके पस्त्यावति ।
ययुर्निचक्रया नरः ॥
verses.rom:
sushome sharyanavatyarjike pastyavati |
yayurnichakraya narah ||
verses.en:
Susoma, Saryakiavan, and Arjika full of homes, have they.
These Heroes, sought with downward car.

verses.sa:
कदा गच्छाथ मरुत इत्था विप्रं हवमानम् ।
मार्डीकेभिर्नाधमानम् ॥
verses.rom:
kada gachchhatha maruta ittha vipram havamanam |
mardikebhirnadhamanam ||
verses.en:
When, Maruts, ye come to him, the singer who invokes you thus,
With favours to your suppliant?

verses.sa:
कद्ध नूनं कधप्रियो यदिन्द्रमजहातन ।
को वः सखित्व ओहते ॥
verses.rom:
kaddha nunam kadhapriyo yadindramajahatana |
ko vah sakhitva ohate ||
verses.en:
What now? where have ye still a friend since ye left Indra all alone?
Who counteth on your friendship now?

verses.sa:
सहो षु णो वज्रहस्तैः कण्वासो अग्निं मरुद्भिः ।
स्तुषे हिरण्यवाशीभिः ॥
verses.rom:
saho shu no vajrahastaih kanvaso agnim marudbhih |
stushe hiranyavashibhih ||
verses.en:
The Kanvas sing forth Agni's praise together with our Maruts' who
Wield thunder and wear swords of gold.

verses.sa:
ओ षु वृष्णः प्रयज्यूना नव्यसे सुविताय ।
ववृत्यां चित्रवाजान् ॥
verses.rom:
o shu vrishnah prayajyuna navyase suvitaya |
vavrityam chitravajan ||
verses.en:
Hither for new felicity may I attract the Impetuous Ones,
The Heroes with their wondrous strength

verses.sa:
गिरयश्चिन्नि जिहते पर्शानासो मन्यमानाः ।
पर्वताश्चिन्नि येमिरे ॥
verses.rom:
girayashchinni jihate parshanaso manyamanah |
parvatashchinni yemire ||
verses.en:
Before them sink the very hills deerning themselves abysses: yea,
Even the mountains bend them down.

verses.sa:
आक्ष्णयावानो वहन्त्यन्तरिक्षेण पततः ।
धातार स्तुवते वयः ॥
verses.rom:
akshnayavano vahantyantarikshena patatah |
dhatara stuvate vayah ||
verses.en:
Steeds flying on their tortuous path through mid-air carry them, and give
The man who lauds them strength and life.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्हि जानि पूर्व्यश्छन्दो न सूरो अर्चिषा ।
ते भानुभिर्वि तस्थिरे ॥
verses.rom:
agnirhi jani purvyashchhando na suro archisha |
te bhanubhirvi tasthire ||
verses.en:
Agni was born the first of all, like Surya lovely with his light:
With lustre these have spread abroad.

verses.sa:
आ नो विश्वाभिरूतिभिरश्विना गच्छतं युवम् ।
दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी पिबतं सोम्यं मधु ॥
verses.rom:
a no vishvabhirutibhirashvina gachchhatam yuvam |
dasra hiranyavartani pibatam somyam madhu ||
verses.en:
WITH all the succours that are yours, O Asvins, hither come to us:
Wonderful, borne on paths of gold, drink ye the meath with Soma juice.

verses.sa:
आ नूनं यातमश्विना रथेन सूर्यत्वचा ।
भुजी हिरण्यपेशसा कवी गम्भीरचेतसा ॥
verses.rom:
a nunam yatamashvina rathena suryatvacha |
bhuji hiranyapeshasa kavi gambhirachetasa ||
verses.en:
Come now, ye Asvins, on your car decked with a sun-bright canopy,
Bountiful, with your golden forms, Sages with depth of intellect.

verses.sa:
आ यातं नहुषस्पर्यान्तरिक्षात्सुवृक्तिभिः ।
पिबाथो अश्विना मधु कण्वानां सवने सुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
a yatam nahushasparyantarikshatsuvriktibhih |
pibatho ashvina madhu kanvanam savane sutam ||
verses.en:
Come hither from the Nahusas, come, drawn by pure hymns, from mid-air.
O Asvins, drink the savoury juice shed in the Kanvas' sacrifice.

verses.sa:
आ नो यातं दिवस्पर्यान्तरिक्षादधप्रिया ।
पुत्रः कण्वस्य वामिह सुषाव सोम्यं मधु ॥
verses.rom:
a no yatam divasparyantarikshadadhapriya |
putrah kanvasya vamiha sushava somyam madhu ||
verses.en:
Come to us hither from the heavens, come from mid-air, well-loved by us:
Here Kanva's son hath pressed for you the pleasant meath of Soma juice.

verses.sa:
आ नो यातमुपश्रुत्यश्विना सोमपीतये ।
स्वाहा स्तोमस्य वर्धना प्र कवी धीतिभिर्नरा ॥
verses.rom:
a no yatamupashrutyashvina somapitaye |
svaha stomasya vardhana pra kavi dhitibhirnara ||
verses.en:
Come, Asvins, to give car to us, to drink the Soma, Asvins, come.
Hail, Strengtheners of the praise-song speed onward, ye Heroes, with your thoughts.

verses.sa:
यच्चिद्धि वां पुर ऋषयो जुहूरेऽवसे नरा ।
आ यातमश्विना गतमुपेमां सुष्टुतिं मम ॥
verses.rom:
yachchiddhi vam pura rishayo juhure'vase nara |
a yatamashvina gatamupemam sushtutim mama ||
verses.en:
As, Heroes, in the olden time the Rsis called you to their aid,
So now, O Asvins, come to us, come near to this mine eulogy.

verses.sa:
दिवश्चिद्रोचनादध्या नो गन्तं स्वर्विदा ।
धीभिर्वत्सप्रचेतसा स्तोमेभिर्हवनश्रुता ॥
verses.rom:
divashchidrochanadadhya no gantam svarvida |
dhibhirvatsaprachetasa stomebhirhavanashruta ||
verses.en:
Even from the luminous sphere of heaven come to us, ye who find the light,
Carers for Vatsa, through our prayers and lauds, O ye who hear our call.

verses.sa:
किमन्ये पर्यासतेऽस्मत्स्तोमेभिरश्विना ।
पुत्रः कण्वस्य वामृषिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीवृधत् ॥
verses.rom:
kimanye paryasate'smatstomebhirashvina |
putrah kanvasya vamrishirgirbhirvatso avivridhat ||
verses.en:
Do others more than we adore the Asvins with their hymns of praise?
The Rsi Vatsa, Kanva's son, hath magnified you with his songs.

verses.sa:
आ वां विप्र इहावसेऽह्वत्स्तोमेभिरश्विना ।
अरिप्रा वृत्रहन्तमा ता नो भूतं मयोभुवा ॥
verses.rom:
a vam vipra ihavase'hvatstomebhirashvina |
aripra vritrahantama ta no bhutam mayobhuva ||
verses.en:
The holy singer with his hymns hath called you, Asvins, hither-ward;
Best Vrtra-slayers, free from stain, as such bring us felicity.

verses.sa:
आ यद्वां योषणा रथमतिष्ठद्वाजिनीवसू ।
विश्वान्यश्विना युवं प्र धीतान्यगच्छतम् ॥
verses.rom:
a yadvam yoshana rathamatishthadvajinivasu |
vishvanyashvina yuvam pra dhitanyagachchhatam ||
verses.en:
What time, ye Lords of ample wealth, the Lady mounted on your car,
Then, O ye Asvins, ye attained all wishes that your hearts desired.

verses.sa:
अतः सहस्रनिर्णिजा रथेना यातमश्विना ।
वत्सो वां मधुमद्वचोऽशंसीत्काव्यः कविः ॥
verses.rom:
atah sahasranirnija rathena yatamashvina |
vatso vam madhumadvacho'shamsitkavyah kavih ||
verses.en:
Come thence, O Asvins, on your car that hath a thousand ornaments:
Vatsa the sage, the sage's son, hath sung a song of sweets to you.

verses.sa:
पुरुमन्द्रा पुरूवसू मनोतरा रयीणाम् ।
