स्तोमं मे अश्विनाविममभि वह्नी अनूषाताम् ॥
verses.rom:
purumandra puruvasu manotara rayinam |
stomam me ashvinavimamabhi vahni anushatam ||
verses.en:
Cheerers of many, rich in goods, discoverers of opulence,
The Asvins, Riders through the sky, have welcomed this my song of praise.

verses.sa:
आ नो विश्वान्यश्विना धत्तं राधांस्यह्रया ।
कृतं न ऋत्वियावतो मा नो रीरधतं निदे ॥
verses.rom:
a no vishvanyashvina dhattam radhamsyahraya |
kritam na ritviyavato ma no riradhatam nide ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, grant us all rich gifts wherewith no man may interfere.
Make us observe the stated times: give us not over to reproach.

verses.sa:
यन्नासत्या परावति यद्वा स्थो अध्यम्बरे ।
अतः सहस्रनिर्णिजा रथेना यातमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
yannasatya paravati yadva stho adhyambare |
atah sahasranirnija rathena yatamashvina ||
verses.en:
Whether, Nasatyas, ye be nigh, or whether ye be far away,
Come thence, O Asvins, on your car that hath a thousand ornaments.

verses.sa:
यो वां नासत्यावृषिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीवृधत् ।
तस्मै सहस्रनिर्णिजमिषं धत्तं घृतश्चुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo vam nasatyavrishirgirbhirvatso avivridhat |
tasmai sahasranirnijamisham dhattam ghritashchutam ||
verses.en:
Vatsa the Rsi with his songs, Nasatyas, hath exalted you:
Grant him rich food distilling oil, graced with a thousand ornaments.

verses.sa:
प्रास्मा ऊर्जं घृतश्चुतमश्विना यच्छतं युवम् ।
यो वां सुम्नाय तुष्टवद्वसूयाद्दानुनस्पती ॥
verses.rom:
prasma urjam ghritashchutamashvina yachchhatam yuvam |
yo vam sumnaya tushtavadvasuyaddanunaspati ||
verses.en:
Bestow on him, O Asvins, food that strengthens, and that drops with oil,
On him who praises you for bliss, and, Lords of bounty, prays for wealth.

verses.sa:
आ नो गन्तं रिशादसेमं स्तोमं पुरुभुजा ।
कृतं नः सुश्रियो नरेमा दातमभिष्टये ॥
verses.rom:
a no gantam rishadasemam stomam purubhuja |
kritam nah sushriyo narema datamabhishtaye ||
verses.en:
Come to us, ye who slay the foe, Lords of rich treasure, to this hymn.
O Heroes, give us high renown and these good things of earth for help.

verses.sa:
आ वां विश्वाभिरूतिभिः प्रियमेधा अहूषत ।
राजन्तावध्वराणामश्विना यामहूतिषु ॥
verses.rom:
a vam vishvabhirutibhih priyamedha ahushata |
rajantavadhvaranamashvina yamahutishu ||
verses.en:
The Priyamedhas have invoked you with all succours that are yours,
You, Asvins, Lords of solemn rites, with calls entreating you to come.

verses.sa:
आ नो गन्तं मयोभुवाश्विना शम्भुवा युवम् ।
यो वां विपन्यू धीतिभिर्गीर्भिर्वत्सो अवीवृधत् ॥
verses.rom:
a no gantam mayobhuvashvina shambhuva yuvam |
yo vam vipanyu dhitibhirgirbhirvatso avivridhat ||
verses.en:
Come to us, Asvins, ye Who bring felicity, auspicious Ones,
To Vatsa who with prayer and hymn, lovers of song, hath honoured you.

verses.sa:
याभिः कण्वं मेधातिथिं याभिर्वशं दशव्रजम् ।
याभिर्गोशर्यमावतं ताभिर्नोऽवतं नरा ॥
verses.rom:
yabhih kanvam medhatithim yabhirvasham dashavrajam |
yabhirgosharyamavatam tabhirno'vatam nara ||
verses.en:
Aid us, O Heroes, for those hymns for which ye helped Go Sarya erst,
Gave Vasa, Dasavraja aid, and Kanva and Medhatithi:

verses.sa:
याभिर्नरा त्रसदस्युमावतं कृत्व्ये धने ।
ताभिः ष्वस्माँ अश्विना प्रावतं वाजसातये ॥
verses.rom:
yabhirnara trasadasyumavatam kritvye dhane |
tabhih shvasman ashvina pravatam vajasataye ||
verses.en:
And favoured Trasadasyu, ye Heroes, in spoil-deciding fray:
For these, O Asvins, graciously assist us in acquiring strength.

verses.sa:
प्र वां स्तोमाः सुवृक्तयो गिरो वर्धन्त्वश्विना ।
पुरुत्रा वृत्रहन्तमा ता नो भूतं पुरुस्पृहा ॥
verses.rom:
pra vam stomah suvriktayo giro vardhantvashvina |
purutra vritrahantama ta no bhutam puruspriha ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, may pure hymns of ours, and songs and praises, honour you:
Best slayers everywhere of foes, as such we fondly yearn for you.

verses.sa:
त्रीणि पदान्यश्विनोराविः सान्ति गुहा परः ।
कवी ऋतस्य पत्मभिरर्वाग्जीवेभ्यस्परि ॥
verses.rom:
trini padanyashvinoravih santi guha parah |
kavi ritasya patmabhirarvagjivebhyaspari ||
verses.en:
Three places of the Asvins, erst concealed, are made apparent now.
Both Sages, with the flight of Law come hither unto those who live.

verses.sa:
आ नूनमश्विना युवं वत्सस्य गन्तमवसे ।
प्रास्मै यच्छतमवृकं पृथु च्छर्दिर्युयुतं या अरातयः ॥
verses.rom:
a nunamashvina yuvam vatsasya gantamavase |
prasmai yachchhatamavrikam prithu chchhardiryuyutam ya aratayah ||
verses.en:
To help and favour Vatsa now, O Asvins, come ye hitherward.
Bestow on him a dwelling spacious and secure, and keep malignities away.

verses.sa:
यदन्तरिक्षे यद्दिवि यत्पञ्च मानुषाँ अनु ।
नृम्णं तद्धत्तमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
yadantarikshe yaddivi yatpancha manushan anu |
nrimnam taddhattamashvina ||
verses.en:
All manliness that is in heaven, with the Five Tribes, or in mid-air,
Bestow, ye Asvins, upon us.

verses.sa:
ये वां दंसांस्यश्विना विप्रासः परिमामृशुः ।
एवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ye vam damsamsyashvina viprasah parimamrishuh |
evetkanvasya bodhatam ||
verses.en:
Remember Kanva first of all among the singers, Asvins, who
Have thought upon your wondrous deeds.

verses.sa:
अयं वां घर्मो अश्विना स्तोमेन परि षिच्यते ।
अयं सोमो मधुमान्वाजिनीवसू येन वृत्रं चिकेतथः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vam gharmo ashvina stomena pari shichyate |
ayam somo madhumanvajinivasu yena vritram chiketathah ||
verses.en:
Asvins, for you with song of praise this hot oblation is effused,
This your sweet Soma juice, ye Lords of ample wealth, through which ye think upon the foe.

verses.sa:
यदप्सु यद्वनस्पतौ यदोषधीषु पुरुदंससा कृतम् ।
तेन माविष्टमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
yadapsu yadvanaspatau yadoshadhishu purudamsasa kritam |
tena mavishtamashvina ||
verses.en:
Whatever ye have done in floods, in the tree, Wonder-Workers, and in growing plants,
Therewith, O Asvins, succour me.

verses.sa:
यन्नासत्या भुरण्यथो यद्वा देव भिषज्यथः ।
अयं वां वत्सो मतिभिर्न विन्धते हविष्मन्तं हि गच्छथः ॥
verses.rom:
yannasatya bhuranyatho yadva deva bhishajyathah |
ayam vam vatso matibhirna vindhate havishmantam hi gachchhathah ||
verses.en:
What force, Nasatyas, ye exert, whatever, Gods, ye tend and heal,
This your own Vatsa gains not by his hymns alone: ye visit him who offers gifts.

verses.sa:
आ नूनमश्विनोरृषि स्तोमं चिकेत वामया ।
आ सोमं मधुमत्तमं घर्मं सिञ्चादथर्वणि ॥
verses.rom:
a nunamashvinorrishi stomam chiketa vamaya |
a somam madhumattamam gharmam sinchadatharvani ||
verses.en:
Now hath the Rsi splendidly thought out the Asvins' hymn of praise.
Let the Atharvan pour the warm oblation forth, and Soma very rich in sweets.

verses.sa:
आ नूनं रघुवर्तनिं रथं तिष्ठाथो अश्विना ।
आ वां स्तोमा इमे मम नभो न चुच्यवीरत ॥
verses.rom:
a nunam raghuvartanim ratham tishthatho ashvina |
a vam stoma ime mama nabho na chuchyavirata ||
verses.en:
Ye Asvins, now ascend your car that lightly rolls upon its way.
May these my praises make you speed hitherward like a cloud of heaven.

verses.sa:
यदद्य वां नासत्योक्थैराचुच्युवीमहि ।
यद्वा वाणीभिरश्विनेवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadadya vam nasatyokthairachuchyuvimahi |
yadva vanibhirashvinevetkanvasya bodhatam ||
verses.en:
When, O Nasatyas, we this day make you speed hither with our hymns,
Or, Asvins, with our songs of praise, remember Kanya specially.

verses.sa:
यद्वां कक्षीवाँ उत यद्व्यश्व ऋषिर्यद्वां दीर्घतमा जुहाव ।
पृथी यद्वां वैन्यः सादनेष्वेवेदतो अश्विना चेतयेथाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadvam kakshivan uta yadvyashva rishiryadvam dirghatama juhava |
prithi yadvam vainyah sadaneshvevedato ashvina chetayetham ||
verses.en:
As erst Kaksivan and the Rsi Vyasva, as erst Dirghatamas invoked your presence,
Or, in the sacrificial chambers, Vainya Prthi, so be ye mindful of us here, O Asvins.

verses.sa:
यातं छर्दिष्पा उत नः परस्पा भूतं जगत्पा उत नस्तनूपा ।
वर्तिस्तोकाय तनयाय यातम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatam chhardishpa uta nah paraspa bhutam jagatpa uta nastanupa |
vartistokaya tanayaya yatam ||
verses.en:
Come as home-guardians, saving us from foemen, guarding our living creatures and our bodies,
Come to the house to give us seed and offspring,

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्रेण सरथं याथो अश्विना यद्वा वायुना भवथः समोकसा ।
यदादित्येभिरृभुभिः सजोषसा यद्वा विष्णोर्विक्रमणेषु तिष्ठथः ॥
verses.rom:
yadindrena saratham yatho ashvina yadva vayuna bhavathah samokasa |
yadadityebhirribhubhih sajoshasa yadva vishnorvikramaneshu tishthathah ||
verses.en:
Whether with Indra ye be faring, Asvins, or resting in one dwelling-place with Vayu,
In concord with the Rbhus or Adityas, or standing still in Visnu's striding-places.

verses.sa:
यदद्याश्विनावहं हुवेय वाजसातये ।
यत्पृत्सु तुर्वणे सहस्तच्छ्रेष्ठमश्विनोरवः ॥
verses.rom:
yadadyashvinavaham huveya vajasataye |
yatpritsu turvane sahastachchhreshthamashvinoravah ||
verses.en:
When I, O Asvins, call on you to-day that I may gather strength,
Or as all-conquering might in war, be that the Asvins' noblest grace.

verses.sa:
आ नूनं यातमश्विनेमा हव्यानि वां हिता ।
इमे सोमासो अधि तुर्वशे यदाविमे कण्वेषु वामथ ॥
verses.rom:
a nunam yatamashvinema havyani vam hita |
ime somaso adhi turvashe yadavime kanveshu vamatha ||

verses.sa:
यन्नासत्या पराके अर्वाके अस्ति भेषजम् ।
तेन नूनं विमदाय प्रचेतसा छर्दिर्वत्साय यच्छतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yannasatya parake arvake asti bheshajam |
tena nunam vimadaya prachetasa chhardirvatsaya yachchhatam ||
verses.en:
Whatever healing balm is yours, Nisatyas, near or far away,
Therewith, great Sages, grant a home to Vatsa and to Vimada.

verses.sa:
अभुत्स्यु प्र देव्या साकं वाचाहमश्विनोः ।
व्यावर्देव्या मतिं वि रातिं मर्त्येभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
abhutsyu pra devya sakam vachahamashvinoh |
vyavardevya matim vi ratim martyebhyah ||
verses.en:
Together with the Goddess, with the Asvins' Speech have I awoke.
Thou, Goddess, hast disclosed the hymn, and holy gift from mortal men.

verses.sa:
प्र बोधयोषो अश्विना प्र देवि सूनृते महि ।
प्र यज्ञहोतरानुषक्प्र मदाय श्रवो बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
pra bodhayosho ashvina pra devi sunrite mahi |
pra yajnahotaranushakpra madaya shravo brihat ||
verses.en:
Awake the Asvins, Goddess Dawn! Up Mighty Lady of sweet strains!
Rise, straightway, priest of sacrifice! High glory to the gladdening draught!

verses.sa:
यदुषो यासि भानुना सं सूर्येण रोचसे ।
आ हायमश्विनो रथो वर्तिर्याति नृपाय्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadusho yasi bhanuna sam suryena rochase |
a hayamashvino ratho vartiryati nripayyam ||
verses.en:
Thou, Dawn, approaching with thy light shinest together with the Sun,
And to this man-protecting home the chariot of the Asvins comes.

verses.sa:
यदापीतासो अंशवो गावो न दुह्र ऊधभिः ।
यद्वा वाणीरनूषत प्र देवयन्तो अश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
yadapitaso amshavo gavo na duhra udhabhih |
yadva vaniranushata pra devayanto ashvina ||
verses.en:
When yellow stalks give forth the juice, as cows from udders pour their milk,
And voices sound the song of praise, the Asvins' worshippers show first.

verses.sa:
प्र द्युम्नाय प्र शवसे प्र नृषाह्याय शर्मणे ।
प्र दक्षाय प्रचेतसा ॥
verses.rom:
pra dyumnaya pra shavase pra nrishahyaya sharmane |
pra dakshaya prachetasa ||
verses.en:
Forward for glory and for strength, protection that shall conquer men,
And power and skill, most sapient Ones!

verses.sa:
यन्नूनं धीभिरश्विना पितुर्योना निषीदथः ।
यद्वा सुम्नेभिरुक्थ्या ॥
verses.rom:
yannunam dhibhirashvina pituryona nishidathah |
yadva sumnebhirukthya ||
verses.en:
When Asvins, worthy of our lauds, ye seat you in the father's house.
With wisdom or the bliss ye bring.

verses.sa:
यत्स्थो दीर्घप्रसद्मनि यद्वादो रोचने दिवः ।
यद्वा समुद्रे अध्याकृते गृहेऽत आ यातमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
yatstho dirghaprasadmani yadvado rochane divah |
yadva samudre adhyakrite grihe'ta a yatamashvina ||
verses.en:
WHETHER ye travel far away or dwell in yonder light of heaven,
Or in a mansion that is built above the sea, come thence, ye Asvins, hitherward.

verses.sa:
यद्वा यज्ञं मनवे सम्मिमिक्षथुरेवेत्काण्वस्य बोधतम् ।
बृहस्पतिं विश्वान्देवाँ अहं हुव इन्द्राविष्णू अश्विनावाशुहेषसा ॥
verses.rom:
yadva yajnam manave sammimikshathurevetkanvasya bodhatam |
brihaspatim vishvandevan aham huva indravishnu ashvinavashuheshasa ||
verses.en:
Or if for Manu.ye prepared the sacrifice, remember also Kanva's son.
I call Brhaspati, Indra, Visnu, all the gods, the Asvins borne by rapid steeds.

verses.sa:
त्या न्वश्विना हुवे सुदंससा गृभे कृता ।
ययोरस्ति प्र णः सख्यं देवेष्वध्याप्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
tya nvashvina huve sudamsasa gribhe krita |
yayorasti pra nah sakhyam deveshvadhyapyam ||
verses.en:
Those Asvins I invoke who work marvels, brought hither to receive,
With whom our friendship is most famed, and kinship passing that of Gods.

verses.sa:
ययोरधि प्र यज्ञा असूरे सन्ति सूरयः ।
ता यज्ञस्याध्वरस्य प्रचेतसा स्वधाभिर्या पिबतः सोम्यं मधु ॥
verses.rom:
yayoradhi pra yajna asure santi surayah |
ta yajnasyadhvarasya prachetasa svadhabhirya pibatah somyam madhu ||
verses.en:
On whom the solemn rites depend, whose worshippers rise without the Sun:
These who foreknow the holy work of sacrifice, and by their Godhead drink the sweets of Soma juice.

verses.sa:
यदद्याश्विनावपाग्यत्प्राक्स्थो वाजिनीवसू ।
यद्द्रुह्यव्यनवि तुर्वशे यदौ हुवे वामथ मा गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadadyashvinavapagyatprakstho vajinivasu |
yaddruhyavyanavi turvashe yadau huve vamatha ma gatam ||
verses.en:
Whether ye, Lords of ample wealth, now linger in the cast or west,
With Druhyu, or with Anu, Yadu, Turvaga, I call you hither; come to me.

verses.sa:
यदन्तरिक्षे पतथः पुरुभुजा यद्वेमे रोदसी अनु ।
यद्वा स्वधाभिरधितिष्ठथो रथमत आ यातमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
yadantarikshe patathah purubhuja yadveme rodasi anu |
yadva svadhabhiradhitishthatho rathamata a yatamashvina ||
verses.en:
Lords of great riches, whether through the firmament ye fly or speed through heaven and earth,
Or with your Godlike natures stand upon your cars, come thence, O Asvins, hitherward.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने व्रतपा असि देव आ मर्त्येष्वा ।
त्वं यज्ञेष्वीड्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne vratapa asi deva a martyeshva |
tvam yajneshvidyah ||
verses.en:
THOU Agni, God mid mortal men, art guard of sacred rites, thou art
To be adored at sacrifice.

verses.sa:
त्वमसि प्रशस्यो विदथेषु सहन्त्य ।
अग्ने रथीरध्वराणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamasi prashasyo vidatheshu sahantya |
agne rathiradhvaranam ||
verses.en:
O Mighty Agni, thou must be glorified at our festivals,
Bearing our offerings to the Gods.

verses.sa:
स त्वमस्मदप द्विषो युयोधि जातवेदः ।
अदेवीरग्ने अरातीः ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvamasmadapa dvisho yuyodhi jatavedah |
adeviragne aratih ||
verses.en:
O Jatavedas Agni, fight and drive our foes afar from us,
Them and their godless enmities.

verses.sa:
अन्ति चित्सन्तमह यज्ञं मर्तस्य रिपोः ।
नोप वेषि जातवेदः ॥
verses.rom:
anti chitsantamaha yajnam martasya ripoh |
nopa veshi jatavedah ||
verses.en:
Thou, Jatavedas, seekest not the worship of a hostile man,
However nigh itbe to thee.

verses.sa:
मर्ता अमर्त्यस्य ते भूरि नाम मनामहे ।
विप्रासो जातवेदसः ॥
verses.rom:
marta amartyasya te bhuri nama manamahe |
vipraso jatavedasah ||
verses.en:
We sages, mortals as we are, adore the mighty name of thee,
Immortal Jatavedas' name.

verses.sa:
विप्रं विप्रासोऽवसे देवं मर्तास ऊतये ।
अग्निं गीर्भिर्हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
vipram vipraso'vase devam martasa utaye |
agnim girbhirhavamahe ||
verses.en:
Sages, we call the Sage to help, mortals, we call the God to aid:
We call on Agni with our songs.

verses.sa:
आ ते वत्सो मनो यमत्परमाच्चित्सधस्थात् ।
अग्ने त्वांकामया गिरा ॥
verses.rom:
a te vatso mano yamatparamachchitsadhasthat |
agne tvamkamaya gira ||
verses.en:
May Vatsa draw- thy mind away even from thy loftiest dwelling-place,
Agni, with song that yearns for thee.

verses.sa:
पुरुत्रा हि सदृङ्ङसि विशो विश्वा अनु प्रभुः ।
समत्सु त्वा हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
purutra hi sadrinnasi visho vishva anu prabhuh |
samatsu tva havamahe ||
verses.en:
Thou art the same in many a place: mid all the people thou art Lord.
In fray and fight we call on thee.

verses.sa:
समत्स्वग्निमवसे वाजयन्तो हवामहे ।
वाजेषु चित्रराधसम् ॥
verses.rom:
samatsvagnimavase vajayanto havamahe |
vajeshu chitraradhasam ||
verses.en:
When we are seeking strength we call Agni to help us in the strife,
The giver of rich gifts in war.

verses.sa:
प्रत्नो हि कमीड्यो अध्वरेषु सनाच्च होता नव्यश्च सत्सि ।
स्वां चाग्ने तन्वं पिप्रयस्वास्मभ्यं च सौभगमा यजस्व ॥
verses.rom:
pratno hi kamidyo adhvareshu sanachcha hota navyashcha satsi |
svam chagne tanvam piprayasvasmabhyam cha saubhagama yajasva ||
verses.en:
Ancient, adorable at sacrifices, Priest from of old, meet for our praise, thou sittest.
Fill full and satisfy thy body, Agni, and win us happiness by offering worship.

verses.sa:
य इन्द्र सोमपातमो मदः शविष्ठ चेतति ।
येना हंसि न्यत्रिणं तमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
ya indra somapatamo madah shavishtha chetati |
yena hamsi nyatrinam tamimahe ||
verses.en:
JOY, Mightiest Indra, known and marked, sprung most from Soma-draughts, wherewith
Thou smitest down the greedy fiend, for that we long.

verses.sa:
येना दशग्वमध्रिगुं वेपयन्तं स्वर्णरम् ।
येना समुद्रमाविथा तमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
yena dashagvamadhrigum vepayantam svarnaram |
yena samudramavitha tamimahe ||
verses.en:
Wherewith thou bolpest Adhrigu, the great Dasagva, and the God
Who stirs the sunlight, and the sea, for that we long.

verses.sa:
येन सिन्धुं महीरपो रथाँ इव प्रचोदयः ।
पन्थामृतस्य यातवे तमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
yena sindhum mahirapo rathan iva prachodayah |
panthamritasya yatave tamimahe ||
verses.en:
Wherewith thou dravest forth like cars Sindhu and all the mighty floods
To go the way ordained by Law, for that we long.

verses.sa:
इमं स्तोममभिष्टये घृतं न पूतमद्रिवः ।
येना नु सद्य ओजसा ववक्षिथ ॥
verses.rom:
imam stomamabhishtaye ghritam na putamadrivah |
yena nu sadya ojasa vavakshitha ||
verses.en:
Accept this laud for aid, made pure like oil, thou Caster of the Stone,
Whereby even in a moment thou hast waxen great.

verses.sa:
इमं जुषस्व गिर्वणः समुद्र इव पिन्वते ।
इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिर्ववक्षिथ ॥
verses.rom:
imam jushasva girvanah samudra iva pinvate |
indra vishvabhirutibhirvavakshitha ||
verses.en:
Be pleased, Song-lover, with this song it flows abundant like the sea.
Indra, with all thy succours thou hast waxen great.

verses.sa:
यो नो देवः परावतः सखित्वनाय मामहे ।
दिवो न वृष्टिं प्रथयन्ववक्षिथ ॥
verses.rom:
yo no devah paravatah sakhitvanaya mamahe |
divo na vrishtim prathayanvavakshitha ||
verses.en:
The God who from afar hath sent gifts to maintain our friendship's bond,
Thou. spreading them like rain from heaven, hast waxen great.

verses.sa:
ववक्षुरस्य केतवो उत वज्रो गभस्त्योः ।
यत्सूर्यो न रोदसी अवर्धयत् ॥
verses.rom:
vavakshurasya ketavo uta vajro gabhastyoh |
yatsuryo na rodasi avardhayat ||
verses.en:
The beams that mark him have grown strong, the thunder rests between his arms,
When, like the Sun, he hath increased both Heaven and Earth.

verses.sa:
यदि प्रवृद्ध सत्पते सहस्रं महिषाँ अघः ।
आदित्त इन्द्रियं महि प्र वावृधे ॥
verses.rom:
yadi pravriddha satpate sahasram mahishan aghah |
aditta indriyam mahi pra vavridhe ||
verses.en:
When, Mighty Lord of Heroes, thou didst cat a thousand buffaloes,
Then grew and waxed exceeding great thine Indra-power.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिर्न्यर्शसानमोषति ।
अग्निर्वनेव सासहिः प्र वावृधे ॥
verses.rom:
indrah suryasya rashmibhirnyarshasanamoshati |
agnirvaneva sasahih pra vavridhe ||
verses.en:
Indra consumeth with the rays of Surya the malicious man:
Like Agni conquering the woods, he hath grown strong.

verses.sa:
इयं त ऋत्वियावती धीतिरेति नवीयसी ।
सपर्यन्ती पुरुप्रिया मिमीत इत् ॥
verses.rom:
iyam ta ritviyavati dhitireti naviyasi |
saparyanti purupriya mimita it ||
verses.en:
This newest thought of ours that suits the time approaches unto thee:
Serving, beloved in many a place it metes and marks.

verses.sa:
गर्भो यज्ञस्य देवयुः क्रतुं पुनीत आनुषक् ।
स्तोमैरिन्द्रस्य वावृधे मिमीत इत् ॥
verses.rom:
garbho yajnasya devayuh kratum punita anushak |
stomairindrasya vavridhe mimita it ||
verses.en:
The pious germ of sacrifice directly purifies the soul.
By Indra's lauds it waxes great, it metes and marks.

verses.sa:
सनिर्मित्रस्य पप्रथ इन्द्रः सोमस्य पीतये ।
प्राची वाशीव सुन्वते मिमीत इत् ॥
verses.rom:
sanirmitrasya papratha indrah somasya pitaye |
prachi vashiva sunvate mimita it ||
verses.en:
Indra who wins the friend hath spread himself to drink the Soma-draught:
Like worshipper's dilating praise; it metes and marks.

verses.sa:
यं विप्रा उक्थवाहसोऽभिप्रमन्दुरायवः ।
घृतं न पिप्य आसन्यृतस्य यत् ॥
verses.rom:
yam vipra ukthavahaso'bhipramandurayavah |
ghritam na pipya asanyritasya yat ||
verses.en:
He whom the sages, living men, have gladdened, offering up their hymns,
Hath swelled like oil of sacrifice in Agni's mouth.

verses.sa:
उत स्वराजे अदिति स्तोममिन्द्राय जीजनत् ।
पुरुप्रशस्तमूतय ऋतस्य यत् ॥
verses.rom:
uta svaraje aditi stomamindraya jijanat |
puruprashastamutaya ritasya yat ||
verses.en:
Aditi also hath brought forth a hymn for Indra, Sovran Lord:
The work of sacrifice for help is glorified.

verses.sa:
अभि वह्नय ऊतयेऽनूषत प्रशस्तये ।
न देव विव्रता हरी ऋतस्य यत् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi vahnaya utaye'nushata prashastaye |
na deva vivrata hari ritasya yat ||
verses.en:
The ministering priests have sung their songs for aid and eulogy:
God, thy Bays turn not from the rite which Law ordains.

verses.sa:
यत्सोममिन्द्र विष्णवि यद्वा घ त्रित आप्त्ये ।
यद्वा मरुत्सु मन्दसे समिन्दुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yatsomamindra vishnavi yadva gha trita aptye |
yadva marutsu mandase samindubhih ||
verses.en:
If, Indra, thou drink Soma by Visnu's or Trta Aptya's side,
Or with the Maruts take delight in flowing drops;

verses.sa:
यद्वा शक्र परावति समुद्रे अधि मन्दसे ।
अस्माकमित्सुते रणा समिन्दुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yadva shakra paravati samudre adhi mandase |
asmakamitsute rana samindubhih ||
verses.en:
Or, Sakra, if thou gladden thee afar or in the sea of air,
Rejoice thee in this juice of ours, in flowing drops.

verses.sa:
यद्वासि सुन्वतो वृधो यजमानस्य सत्पते ।
उक्थे वा यस्य रण्यसि समिन्दुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yadvasi sunvato vridho yajamanasya satpate |
ukthe va yasya ranyasi samindubhih ||
verses.en:
Or, Lord of Heroes if thou aid the worshipper who shed; the, juice,
Or him whose laud delights thee, and his flowing drops.

verses.sa:
देवंदेवं वोऽवस इन्द्रमिन्द्रं गृणीषणि ।
अधा यज्ञाय तुर्वणे व्यानशुः ॥
verses.rom:
devamdevam vo'vasa indramindram grinishani |
adha yajnaya turvane vyanashuh ||
verses.en:
To magnify the God, the God, Indra, yea, Indra for your help,
And promptly end the sacrifice-this have they gained.

verses.sa:
यज्ञेभिर्यज्ञवाहसं सोमेभिः सोमपातमम् ।
होत्राभिरिन्द्रं वावृधुर्व्यानशुः ॥
verses.rom:
yajnebhiryajnavahasam somebhih somapatamam |
hotrabhirindram vavridhurvyanashuh ||
verses.en:
With worship, him whom men adore, with Soma, him who drinks it most,
Indra with lauds have they increased this have they gained.

verses.sa:
महीरस्य प्रणीतयः पूर्वीरुत प्रशस्तयः ।
विश्वा वसूनि दाशुषे व्यानशुः ॥
verses.rom:
mahirasya pranitayah purviruta prashastayah |
vishva vasuni dashushe vyanashuh ||
verses.en:
His leadings are with power and might and his instructions manifold:
He gives the worshipper all wealth: this have they gained.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं वृत्राय हन्तवे देवासो दधिरे पुरः ।
इन्द्रं वाणीरनूषता समोजसे ॥
verses.rom:
indram vritraya hantave devaso dadhire purah |
indram vaniranushata samojase ||
verses.en:
For slaying Vrtra have the Gods set Indra in the foremost place.
Indra the choral bands have sung, for vigorous strength.

verses.sa:
महान्तं महिना वयं स्तोमेभिर्हवनश्रुतम् ।
अर्कैरभि प्र णोनुमः समोजसे ॥
verses.rom:
mahantam mahina vayam stomebhirhavanashrutam |
arkairabhi pra nonumah samojase ||
verses.en:
We to the Mighty with our might, with lauds to him who hears our call,
With holy hymns have sung aloud, for vigorous strength.

verses.sa:
न यं विविक्तो रोदसी नान्तरिक्षाणि वज्रिणम् ।
अमादिदस्य तित्विषे समोजसः ॥
verses.rom:
na yam vivikto rodasi nantarikshani vajrinam |
amadidasya titvishe samojasah ||
verses.en:
Not earth, nor heaven, nor firmaments contain the Thunder-wielding God:
They shake before his violent rush and vigorous strength.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र पृतनाज्ये देवास्त्वा दधिरे पुरः ।
आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra pritanajye devastva dadhire purah |
aditte haryata hari vavakshatuh ||
verses.en:
What time the Gods, O Indra, get thee foremost in the furious fight,
Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.

verses.sa:
यदा वृत्रं नदीवृतं शवसा वज्रिन्नवधीः ।
आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः ॥
verses.rom:
yada vritram nadivritam shavasa vajrinnavadhih |
aditte haryata hari vavakshatuh ||
verses.en:
When Vrtra, stayer of the floods, thou seest, Thunderor with might,
Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.

verses.sa:
यदा ते विष्णुरोजसा त्रीणि पदा विचक्रमे ।
आदित्ते हर्यता हरी ववक्षतुः ॥
verses.rom:
yada te vishnurojasa trini pada vichakrame |
aditte haryata hari vavakshatuh ||
verses.en:
When Visnu, through thine energy, strode wide those three great steps of his,
Then thy two beautiful Bay Steeds carried thee on.

verses.sa:
यदा ते हर्यता हरी वावृधाते दिवेदिवे ।
आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ॥
verses.rom:
yada te haryata hari vavridhate divedive |
aditte vishva bhuvanani yemire ||
verses.en:
When thy two beautiful Bay Steeds grew great and greater day by day,
Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.

verses.sa:
यदा ते मारुतीर्विशस्तुभ्यमिन्द्र नियेमिरे ।
आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ॥
verses.rom:
yada te marutirvishastubhyamindra niyemire |
aditte vishva bhuvanani yemire ||
verses.en:
When, Indra, all the Marut folk humbly submitted them to thee,
Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.

verses.sa:
यदा सूर्यममुं दिवि शुक्रं ज्योतिरधारयः ।
आदित्ते विश्वा भुवनानि येमिरे ॥
verses.rom:
yada suryamamum divi shukram jyotiradharayah |
aditte vishva bhuvanani yemire ||
verses.en:
When yonder Sun, that brilliant light, thou settest in the heaven above,
Even then all creatures that had life bowed down to thee.

verses.sa:
इमां त इन्द्र सुष्टुतिं विप्र इयर्ति धीतिभिः ।
जामिं पदेव पिप्रतीं प्राध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
imam ta indra sushtutim vipra iyarti dhitibhih |
jamim padeva pipratim pradhvare ||
verses.en:
To thee, O Indra, with this thought the sage lifts up this eulogy,
Akin and leading as on foot to sacrifice.

verses.sa:
यदस्य धामनि प्रिये समीचीनासो अस्वरन् ।
नाभा यज्ञस्य दोहना प्राध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
yadasya dhamani priye samichinaso asvaran |
nabha yajnasya dohana pradhvare ||
verses.en:
When in thine own dear dwelling all gathered have lifted up the voice
Milk-streams at worship's central spot, for sacrifice,

verses.sa:
सुवीर्यं स्वश्व्यं सुगव्यमिन्द्र दद्धि नः ।
होतेव पूर्वचित्तये प्राध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
suviryam svashvyam sugavyamindra daddhi nah |
hoteva purvachittaye pradhvare ||
verses.en:
As Priest, O Indra, give us wealth in brave men and good steeds and kine
That we may first remember thee for sacrifice.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः सुतेषु सोमेषु क्रतुं पुनीत उक्थ्यम् ।
विदे वृधस्य दक्षसो महान्हि षः ॥
verses.rom:
indrah suteshu someshu kratum punita ukthyam |
vide vridhasya dakshaso mahanhi shah ||
verses.en:
INDRA, when Soma juices flow, makes his mind pure and meet for lauds.
He gains the power that brings success, for great is he.

verses.sa:
स प्रथमे व्योमनि देवानां सदने वृधः ।
सुपारः सुश्रवस्तमः समप्सुजित् ॥
verses.rom:
sa prathame vyomani devanam sadane vridhah |
suparah sushravastamah samapsujit ||
verses.en:
In heaven's first region, in the seat of Gods, is he who brings success,
Most glorious, prompt to save, who wins the water-floods.

verses.sa:
तमह्वे वाजसातय इन्द्रं भराय शुष्मिणम् ।
भवा नः सुम्ने अन्तमः सखा वृधे ॥
verses.rom:
tamahve vajasataya indram bharaya shushminam |
bhava nah sumne antamah sakha vridhe ||
verses.en:
Him, to win strength, have I invoked, even Indra mighty for the fray.
Be thou most near to us for bliss, a Friend to aid.

verses.sa:
इयं त इन्द्र गिर्वणो रातिः क्षरति सुन्वतः ।
मन्दानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि ॥
verses.rom:
iyam ta indra girvano ratih ksharati sunvatah |
mandano asya barhisho vi rajasi ||
verses.en:
Indra, Song -lover, here for thee the worshipper's libation flows.
Rejoicing in this sacred grass thou shinest forth.

verses.sa:
नूनं तदिन्द्र दद्धि नो यत्त्वा सुन्वन्त ईमहे ।
रयिं नश्चित्रमा भरा स्वर्विदम् ॥
verses.rom:
nunam tadindra daddhi no yattva sunvanta imahe |
rayim nashchitrama bhara svarvidam ||
verses.en:
Even now, O Indra, give us that which, pressing juice, we crave of thee.
Bring us wealth manifold which finds the light of heaven.

verses.sa:
स्तोता यत्ते विचर्षणिरतिप्रशर्धयद्गिरः ।
वया इवानु रोहते जुषन्त यत् ॥
verses.rom:
stota yatte vicharshaniratiprashardhayadgirah |
vaya ivanu rohate jushanta yat ||
verses.en:
What time the zealous worshipper hath boldly sung his songs to thee,
Like branches of a tree up-grows what they desire.

verses.sa:
प्रत्नवज्जनया गिरः शृणुधी जरितुर्हवम् ।
मदेमदे ववक्षिथा सुकृत्वने ॥
verses.rom:
pratnavajjanaya girah shrinudhi jariturhavam |
mademade vavakshitha sukritvane ||
verses.en:
Generate songs even as of old, give car unto the singer's call.
Thou for the pious hast grown great at each carouse.

verses.sa:
क्रीळन्त्यस्य सूनृता आपो न प्रवता यतीः ।
अया धिया य उच्यते पतिर्दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
krilantyasya sunrita apo na pravata yatih |
aya dhiya ya uchyate patirdivah ||
verses.en:
Sweet strains that glorify him play like waters speeding down a slope,
Yea, him who in this song is called the Lord of Heaven;

verses.sa:
उतो पतिर्य उच्यते कृष्टीनामेक इद्वशी ।
नमोवृधैरवस्युभिः सुते रण ॥
verses.rom:
uto patirya uchyate krishtinameka idvashi |
namovridhairavasyubhih sute rana ||
verses.en:
Yea, who alone is called the Lord, the single Ruler of the folk,
By worshippers seeking aid: may he joy in the draught.

verses.sa:
स्तुहि श्रुतं विपश्चितं हरी यस्य प्रसक्षिणा ।
गन्तारा दाशुषो गृहं नमस्विनः ॥
verses.rom:
stuhi shrutam vipashchitam hari yasya prasakshina |
gantara dashusho griham namasvinah ||
verses.en:
Praise him, the Glorious, skilled in song, Lord of the two victorious Bays:
They seek the worshipper's abode who bows in prayer.

verses.sa:
तूतुजानो महेमतेऽश्वेभिः प्रुषितप्सुभिः ।
आ याहि यज्ञमाशुभिः शमिद्धि ते ॥
verses.rom:
tutujano mahemate'shvebhih prushitapsubhih |
a yahi yajnamashubhih shamiddhi te ||
verses.en:
Put forth thy strength: with dappled Steeds come, thou of mighty intellect,
With swift Steeds to the sacrifice, for 'tis thy joy.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र शविष्ठ सत्पते रयिं गृणत्सु धारय ।
श्रवः सूरिभ्यो अमृतं वसुत्वनम् ॥
verses.rom:
indra shavishtha satpate rayim grinatsu dharaya |
shravah suribhyo amritam vasutvanam ||
verses.en:
Grant wealth to those who praise thee, Lord of Heroes, Mightiest Indra: give
Our princes everlasting fame and opulence.

verses.sa:
हवे त्वा सूर उदिते हवे मध्यंदिने दिवः ।
जुषाण इन्द्र सप्तिभिर्न आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
have tva sura udite have madhyamdine divah |
jushana indra saptibhirna a gahi ||
verses.en:
I call thee when the Sun is risen, I call thee at the noon of day:
With thy car-horses, Indra, come well pleased to us.

verses.sa:
आ तू गहि प्र तु द्रव मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः ।
तन्तुं तनुष्व पूर्व्यं यथा विदे ॥
verses.rom:
a tu gahi pra tu drava matsva sutasya gomatah |
tantum tanushva purvyam yatha vide ||
verses.en:
Speed forward hither, come to us, rejoice thee in the milky draught:
Spin out the thread of ancient time, as well is known.

verses.sa:
यच्छक्रासि परावति यदर्वावति वृत्रहन् ।
यद्वा समुद्रे अन्धसोऽवितेदसि ॥
verses.rom:
yachchhakrasi paravati yadarvavati vritrahan |
yadva samudre andhaso'vitedasi ||
verses.en:
If, Sakra, Vrtra-slayer, thou be far away or near to us.
Or in the sea, thou art the guard of Soma juice.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं वर्धन्तु नो गिर इन्द्रं सुतास इन्दवः ।
इन्द्रे हविष्मतीर्विशो अराणिषुः ॥
verses.rom:
indram vardhantu no gira indram sutasa indavah |
indre havishmatirvisho aranishuh ||
verses.en:
Let songs we sing and Soma-drops expressed by us make Indra strong:
The tribes who bring oblations find delight in him.

verses.sa:
तमिद्विप्रा अवस्यवः प्रवत्वतीभिरूतिभिः ।
इन्द्रं क्षोणीरवर्धयन्वया इव ॥
verses.rom:
tamidvipra avasyavah pravatvatibhirutibhih |
indram kshoniravardhayanvaya iva ||
verses.en:
Him sages longing for his aid, with offerings brought in eager haste,
Him. even as branches, all mankind have made to grow.

verses.sa:
त्रिकद्रुकेषु चेतनं देवासो यज्ञमत्नत ।
तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरः सदावृधम् ॥
verses.rom:
trikadrukeshu chetanam devaso yajnamatnata |
tamidvardhantu no girah sadavridham ||
verses.en:
At the Trkadrukas the Gods span sacrifice that stirred the mind:
May our songs strengthen him who still hath strengthened us.

verses.sa:
स्तोता यत्ते अनुव्रत उक्थान्यृतुथा दधे ।
शुचिः पावक उच्यते सो अद्भुतः ॥
verses.rom:
stota yatte anuvrata ukthanyritutha dadhe |
shuchih pavaka uchyate so adbhutah ||
verses.en:
When, true to duty, at due times the worshipper offers lauds to thee,
They call him Purifier, Pure, and Wonderful.

verses.sa:
तदिद्रुद्रस्य चेतति यह्वं प्रत्नेषु धामसु ।
मनो यत्रा वि तद्दधुर्विचेतसः ॥
verses.rom:
tadidrudrasya chetati yahvam pratneshu dhamasu |
mano yatra vi taddadhurvichetasah ||
verses.en:
That mind of Rudra, fresh and strong, moves conscious in the ancient ways,
With reference whereto the wise have ordered this.

verses.sa:
यदि मे सख्यमावर इमस्य पाह्यन्धसः ।
येन विश्वा अति द्विषो अतारिम ॥
verses.rom:
yadi me sakhyamavara imasya pahyandhasah |
yena vishva ati dvisho atarima ||
verses.en:
If thou elect to be my Friend drink of this sacrificial juice,
By help whereof we may subdue all enemies.

verses.sa:
कदा त इन्द्र गिर्वण स्तोता भवाति शंतमः ।
कदा नो गव्ये अश्व्ये वसौ दधः ॥
verses.rom:
kada ta indra girvana stota bhavati shamtamah |
kada no gavye ashvye vasau dadhah ||
verses.en:
O Indra, Lover of the song, when shall thy praiser be most blest?
When wilt thou grant us wealth in herds of kine and steeds?

verses.sa:
उत ते सुष्टुता हरी वृषणा वहतो रथम् ।
अजुर्यस्य मदिन्तमं यमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
uta te sushtuta hari vrishana vahato ratham |
ajuryasya madintamam yamimahe ||
verses.en:
And thy two highly-lauded Bays, strong stallions, draw thy car who art
Untouched by age, most gladdening car for which we pray.

verses.sa:
तमीमहे पुरुष्टुतं यह्वं प्रत्नाभिरूतिभिः ।
नि बर्हिषि प्रिये सददध द्विता ॥
verses.rom:
tamimahe purushtutam yahvam pratnabhirutibhih |
ni barhishi priye sadadadha dvita ||
verses.en:
With ancient offerings we implore the Young and Strong whom many praise.
He from of old hath sat upon dear sacred grass.

verses.sa:
वर्धस्वा सु पुरुष्टुत ऋषिष्टुताभिरूतिभिः ।
धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषमवा च नः ॥
verses.rom:
vardhasva su purushtuta rishishtutabhirutibhih |
dhukshasva pipyushimishamava cha nah ||
verses.en:
Wax mighty, thou whom many laud for aids which Rsis have extolled.
Pour down for us abundant food and guard us well.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र त्वमवितेदसीत्था स्तुवतो अद्रिवः ।
ऋतादियर्मि ते धियं मनोयुजम् ॥
verses.rom:
indra tvamavitedasittha stuvato adrivah |
ritadiyarmi te dhiyam manoyujam ||
verses.en:
O Indra, Caster of the Stone, thou helpest him who praises thee:
From sacrifice I send to thee a mind yoked hymn.

verses.sa:
इह त्या सधमाद्या युजानः सोमपीतये ।
हरी इन्द्र प्रतद्वसू अभि स्वर ॥
verses.rom:
iha tya sadhamadya yujanah somapitaye |
hari indra pratadvasu abhi svara ||
verses.en:
Here, yoking for the Soma-draught these Horses, sharers of thy feast,
Thy Bay Steeds, Indra, fraught with weal to, consent to come.

verses.sa:
अभि स्वरन्तु ये तव रुद्रासः सक्षत श्रियम् ।
उतो मरुत्वतीर्विशो अभि प्रयः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi svarantu ye tava rudrasah sakshata shriyam |
uto marutvatirvisho abhi prayah ||
verses.en:
Attendants on thy glory, let the Rudras roar assent to thee,
And all the Marut companies come to the feast.

verses.sa:
इमा अस्य प्रतूर्तयः पदं जुषन्त यद्दिवि ।
नाभा यज्ञस्य सं दधुर्यथा विदे ॥
verses.rom:
ima asya praturtayah padam jushanta yaddivi |
nabha yajnasya sam dadhuryatha vide ||
verses.en:
These his victorious followers bold in the heavens the place they love,
Leagued in the heart of sacrifice, as well we know.

verses.sa:
अयं दीर्घाय चक्षसे प्राचि प्रयत्यध्वरे ।
मिमीते यज्ञमानुषग्विचक्ष्य ॥
verses.rom:
ayam dirghaya chakshase prachi prayatyadhvare |
mimite yajnamanushagvichakshya ||
verses.en:
That we may long behold the light, what time the ordered rite proceeds,
He duly measures, as he views, the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
वृषायमिन्द्र ते रथ उतो ते वृषणा हरी ।
वृषा त्वं शतक्रतो वृषा हवः ॥
verses.rom:
vrishayamindra te ratha uto te vrishana hari |
vrisha tvam shatakrato vrisha havah ||
verses.en:
O Indra, strong is this thy car, and strong are these Bay Steeds of thine:
O Satakratu, thou art strong, strong is our call.

verses.sa:
वृषा ग्रावा वृषा मदो वृषा सोमो अयं सुतः ।
वृषा यज्ञो यमिन्वसि वृषा हवः ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha grava vrisha mado vrisha somo ayam sutah |
vrisha yajno yaminvasi vrisha havah ||
verses.en:
Strong is the press-stone, strong thy joy, strong is the flowing Soma juice:
Strong is the rite thou furtherest, strong is our call.

verses.sa:
वृषा त्वा वृषणं हुवे वज्रिञ्चित्राभिरूतिभिः ।
वावन्थ हि प्रतिष्टुतिं वृषा हवः ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha tva vrishanam huve vajrinchitrabhirutibhih |
vavantha hi pratishtutim vrisha havah ||
verses.en:
As strong I call on thee the Strong, O Thunderer with thy thousand aids:
For thou hast won the hymn of praise. Strong is our call.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राहं यथा त्वमीशीय वस्व एक इत् ।
स्तोता मे गोषखा स्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
yadindraham yatha tvamishiya vasva eka it |
stota me goshakha syat ||
verses.en:
IF I, O Indra, were, like thee, the single Sovran of all wealth,
My worshipper should be rich in kine.

verses.sa:
शिक्षेयमस्मै दित्सेयं शचीपते मनीषिणे ।
यदहं गोपतिः स्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
shiksheyamasmai ditseyam shachipate manishine |
yadaham gopatih syam ||
verses.en:
I should be fain, O Lord of Power, to strengthen and enrich the sage,
Were I the Lord of herds of kine.

verses.sa:
धेनुष्ट इन्द्र सूनृता यजमानाय सुन्वते ।
गामश्वं पिप्युषी दुहे ॥
verses.rom:
dhenushta indra sunrita yajamanaya sunvate |
gamashvam pipyushi duhe ||
verses.en:
To worshippers who press the juice thy goodness, Indra, is a cow
Yielding in plenty kine and steeds.

verses.sa:
न ते वर्तास्ति राधस इन्द्र देवो न मर्त्यः ।
यद्दित्ससि स्तुतो मघम् ॥
verses.rom:
na te vartasti radhasa indra devo na martyah |
yadditsasi stuto magham ||
verses.en:
None is there, Indra, God or man, to hinder thy munificence,
The wealth which, lauded, thou wilt give.

verses.sa:
यज्ञ इन्द्रमवर्धयद्यद्भूमिं व्यवर्तयत् ।
चक्राण ओपशं दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
yajna indramavardhayadyadbhumim vyavartayat |
chakrana opasham divi ||
verses.en:
The sacrifice made Indra strong when he unrolled the earth, and made
Himself a diadem in heaven.

verses.sa:
वावृधानस्य ते वयं विश्वा धनानि जिग्युषः ।
ऊतिमिन्द्रा वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
vavridhanasya te vayam vishva dhanani jigyushah |
utimindra vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Thine aid we claim, O Indra, thine who after thou hast waxen great
Hast won all treasures for thine own.

verses.sa:
व्यन्तरिक्षमतिरन्मदे सोमस्य रोचना ।
इन्द्रो यदभिनद्वलम् ॥
verses.rom:
vyantarikshamatiranmade somasya rochana |
indro yadabhinadvalam ||
verses.en:
In Soma's ecstasy Indra spread the firmament and realms of light,
When he cleft Vala limb from limb.

verses.sa:
उद्गा आजदङ्गिरोभ्य आविष्कृण्वन्गुहा सतीः ।
अर्वाञ्चं नुनुदे वलम् ॥
verses.rom:
udga ajadangirobhya avishkrinvanguha satih |
arvancham nunude valam ||
verses.en:
Showing the hidden he drave forth the cows for the Angirases,
And Vala he cast headlong down.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रेण रोचना दिवो दृळ्हानि दृंहितानि च ।
स्थिराणि न पराणुदे ॥
verses.rom:
indrena rochana divo drilhani drimhitani cha |
sthirani na paranude ||
verses.en:
By Indra were the luminous realms of heaven established and secured,
Firm and immovable from their place.

verses.sa:
अपामूर्मिर्मदन्निव स्तोम इन्द्राजिरायते ।
वि ते मदा अराजिषुः ॥
verses.rom:
apamurmirmadanniva stoma indrajirayate |
vi te mada arajishuh ||
verses.en:
Indra, thy laud moves quickly like a joyous wave of water-floods:
Bright shine the drops that gladden thee.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि स्तोमवर्धन इन्द्रास्युक्थवर्धनः ।
स्तोतॄणामुत भद्रकृत् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi stomavardhana indrasyukthavardhanah |
stotrinamuta bhadrakrit ||
verses.en:
For thou, O Indra, art the God whom hymns and praises magnify:
Thou blessest those who worship thee.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रमित्केशिना हरी सोमपेयाय वक्षतः ।
उप यज्ञं सुराधसम् ॥
verses.rom:
indramitkeshina hari somapeyaya vakshatah |
upa yajnam suradhasam ||
verses.en:
Let the two long-maned Bay Steeds bring Indra to drink the Soma juice,
The Bountiful to our sacrifice.

verses.sa:
अपां फेनेन नमुचेः शिर इन्द्रोदवर्तयः ।$
विश्वा यदजय स्पृधः ॥
verses.rom:
apam phenena namucheh shira indrodavartayah |$
vishva yadajaya spridhah ||
verses.en:
With waters' foam thou torest off, Indra, the head of Namuci,
Subduing all contending hosts.

verses.sa:
मायाभिरुत्सिसृप्सत इन्द्र द्यामारुरुक्षतः ।
अव दस्यूँरधूनुथाः ॥
verses.rom:
mayabhirutsisripsata indra dyamarurukshatah |
ava dasyunradhunuthah ||
verses.en:
The Dasyus, when they fain would climb
by magic arts and mount to heaven,
Thou, Indra, castest down to earth.

verses.sa:
असुन्वामिन्द्र संसदं विषूचीं व्यनाशयः ।
सोमपा उत्तरो भवन् ॥
verses.rom:
asunvamindra samsadam vishuchim vyanashayah |
somapa uttaro bhavan ||
verses.en:
As Soma-drinker conquering all, thou scatteredst to every side
Their settlement who poured no gifts.

verses.sa:
तम्वभि प्र गायत पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतम् ।
इन्द्रं गीर्भिस्तविषमा विवासत ॥
verses.rom:
tamvabhi pra gayata puruhutam purushtutam |
indram girbhistavishama vivasata ||
verses.en:
SING forth to him whom many men invoke, to him whom many laud.
Invite the powerful Indra with your songs of praise.

verses.sa:
यस्य द्विबर्हसो बृहत्सहो दाधार रोदसी ।
गिरीँरज्राँ अपः स्वर्वृषत्वना ॥
verses.rom:
yasya dvibarhaso brihatsaho dadhara rodasi |
girinrajran apah svarvrishatvana ||
verses.en:
Whose lofty might-for doubly strong is he-supports the heavens and earth,
And hills and plains and floods and light with manly power.

verses.sa:
स राजसि पुरुष्टुतँ एको वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे ।
इन्द्र जैत्रा श्रवस्या च यन्तवे ॥
verses.rom:
sa rajasi purushtutan eko vritrani jighnase |
indra jaitra shravasya cha yantave ||
verses.en:
Such, Praised by many! thou art King alone thou smitest Vrtras dead,
To gain, O Indra, spoils of war and high renown.

verses.sa:
तं ते मदं गृणीमसि वृषणं पृत्सु सासहिम् ।
उ लोककृत्नुमद्रिवो हरिश्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam te madam grinimasi vrishanam pritsu sasahim |
u lokakritnumadrivo harishriyam ||
verses.en:
We sing this strong and wild delight of thine which conquers in the fray,
Which, Caster of the Stone! gives room and shines like gold.

verses.sa:
येन ज्योतींष्यायवे मनवे च विवेदिथ ।
मन्दानो अस्य बर्हिषो वि राजसि ॥
verses.rom:
yena jyotimshyayave manave cha viveditha |
mandano asya barhisho vi rajasi ||
verses.en:
Wherewith thou also foundest lights for Ayu and for Manu's sake:
Now joying in this sacred grass thou beamest forth.

verses.sa:
तदद्या चित्त उक्थिनोऽनु ष्टुवन्ति पूर्वथा ।
वृषपत्नीरपो जया दिवेदिवे ॥
verses.rom:
tadadya chitta ukthino'nu shtuvanti purvatha |
vrishapatnirapo jaya divedive ||
verses.en:
This day too singers of the hymn praise, as of old, this might of thine:
Win thou the waters day by day, thralls of the strong.

verses.sa:
तव त्यदिन्द्रियं बृहत्तव शुष्ममुत क्रतुम् ।
वज्रं शिशाति धिषणा वरेण्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
tava tyadindriyam brihattava shushmamuta kratum |
vajram shishati dhishana varenyam ||
verses.en:
That lofty Indra-power of thine, thy strength and thine intelligence,
Thy thunderbolt for which we long, the wish makes keen.

verses.sa:
तव द्यौरिन्द्र पौंस्यं पृथिवी वर्धति श्रवः ।
त्वामापः पर्वतासश्च हिन्विरे ॥
verses.rom:
tava dyaurindra paumsyam prithivi vardhati shravah |
tvamapah parvatasashcha hinvire ||
verses.en:
O Indra, Heaven and Earth augment thy manly power and thy renown;
The waters and thy mountains stir and urge thee on.

verses.sa:
त्वां विष्णुर्बृहन्क्षयो मित्रो गृणाति वरुणः ।
त्वां शर्धो मदत्यनु मारुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam vishnurbrihankshayo mitro grinati varunah |
tvam shardho madatyanu marutam ||
verses.en:
Visnu the lofty ruling Power, Varuna, Mitra sing thy praise:
In thee the Marut3' company have great delight.

verses.sa:
त्वं वृषा जनानां मंहिष्ठ इन्द्र जज्ञिषे ।
सत्रा विश्वा स्वपत्यानि दधिषे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam vrisha jananam mamhishtha indra jajnishe |
satra vishva svapatyani dadhishe ||
verses.en:
O Indra, thou wast born the Lord of men, most liberal of thy gifts:
Excellent deeds for evermore are all thine own.

verses.sa:
सत्रा त्वं पुरुष्टुतँ एको वृत्राणि तोशसे ।
नान्य इन्द्रात्करणं भूय इन्वति ॥
verses.rom:
satra tvam purushtutan eko vritrani toshase |
nanya indratkaranam bhuya invati ||
verses.en:
Ever, alone, O highly-praised, thou sendest Vrtras to their rest:
None else than Indra executes the mighty deed.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र मन्मशस्त्वा नाना हवन्त ऊतये ।
अस्माकेभिर्नृभिरत्रा स्वर्जय ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra manmashastva nana havanta utaye |
asmakebhirnribhiratra svarjaya ||
verses.en:
Though here and there, in varied hymns, Indra, men call on thee for aid,
Still with our heroes fight and win the light of heaven.

verses.sa:
अरं क्षयाय नो महे विश्वा रूपाण्याविशन् ।
इन्द्रं जैत्राय हर्षया शचीपतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
aram kshayaya no mahe vishva rupanyavishan |
indram jaitraya harshaya shachipatim ||
verses.en:
Already have all forms of him entered our spacious dwelling-place:
For victory stir thou Indra, up, the Lord of Might.

verses.sa:
प्र सम्राजं चर्षणीनामिन्द्रं स्तोता नव्यं गीर्भिः ।
नरं नृषाहं मंहिष्ठम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra samrajam charshaninamindram stota navyam girbhih |
naram nrishaham mamhishtham ||
verses.en:
PRAISE Indra whom our songs must laud, sole Sovran of mankind, the Chief
Most liberal who controlleth men.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्नुक्थानि रण्यन्ति विश्वानि च श्रवस्या ।
अपामवो न समुद्रे ॥
verses.rom:
yasminnukthani ranyanti vishvani cha shravasya |
apamavo na samudre ||
verses.en:
In whom the hymns of praise delight, and all the glory-giving songs.
Like the floods' longing for the sea.

verses.sa:
तं सुष्टुत्या विवासे ज्येष्ठराजं भरे कृत्नुम् ।
महो वाजिनं सनिभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tam sushtutya vivase jyeshtharajam bhare kritnum |
maho vajinam sanibhyah ||
verses.en:
Him I invite with eulogy, best King, effective in the fight,
Strong for the gain of mighty spoil.

verses.sa:
यस्यानूना गभीरा मदा उरवस्तरुत्राः ।
हर्षुमन्तः शूरसातौ ॥
verses.rom:
yasyanuna gabhira mada uravastarutrah |
harshumantah shurasatau ||
verses.en:
Whose perfect ecstasies are wide, profound, victorious, and give
joy in the field where heroes win.

verses.sa:
तमिद्धनेषु हितेष्वधिवाकाय हवन्ते ।
येषामिन्द्रस्ते जयन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
tamiddhaneshu hiteshvadhivakaya havante |
yeshamindraste jayanti ||
verses.en:
Him, when the spoils of war are staked, men call to be their advocate:
They who have Indra win the day.

verses.sa:
तमिच्च्यौत्नैरार्यन्ति तं कृतेभिश्चर्षणयः ।
एष इन्द्रो वरिवस्कृत् ॥
verses.rom:
tamichchyautnairaryanti tam kritebhishcharshanayah |
esha indro varivaskrit ||
verses.en:
Men honour him with stirring songs and magnify with solemn rites:
Indra is he who giveth case.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो ब्रह्मेन्द्र ऋषिरिन्द्रः पुरू पुरुहूतः ।
महान्महीभिः शचीभिः ॥
verses.rom:
indro brahmendra rishirindrah puru puruhutah |
mahanmahibhih shachibhih ||
verses.en:
1ndra is priest and Rsi, he is much invoked by many men,
And mighty by his mighty powers.

verses.sa:
स स्तोम्यः स हव्यः सत्यः सत्वा तुविकूर्मिः ।
एकश्चित्सन्नभिभूतिः ॥
verses.rom:
sa stomyah sa havyah satyah satva tuvikurmih |
ekashchitsannabhibhutih ||
verses.en:
Meet to be lauded and invoked, true Hero with his deeds of might,
Victorious even when alone.

verses.sa:
तमर्केभिस्तं सामभिस्तं गायत्रैश्चर्षणयः ।
इन्द्रं वर्धन्ति क्षितयः ॥
verses.rom:
tamarkebhistam samabhistam gayatraishcharshanayah |
indram vardhanti kshitayah ||
verses.en:
The men, the people magnify that Indra with their Slina. songs,
With hymns and sacred eulogies

verses.sa:
प्रणेतारं वस्यो अच्छा कर्तारं ज्योतिः समत्सु ।
सासह्वांसं युधामित्रान् ॥
verses.rom:
pranetaram vasyo achchha kartaram jyotih samatsu |
sasahvamsam yudhamitran ||
verses.en:
Him who advances them to wealth, sends light to lead them in the war,
And quells their foemen in the fray.

verses.sa:
स नः पप्रिः पारयाति स्वस्ति नावा पुरुहूतः ।
इन्द्रो विश्वा अति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah paprih parayati svasti nava puruhutah |
indro vishva ati dvishah ||
verses.en:
May he, the saviour much-invoked, may Indra bear us in a ship
Safely beyond all enemies.

verses.sa:
स त्वं न इन्द्र वाजेभिर्दशस्या च गातुया च ।
अच्छा च नः सुम्नं नेषि ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvam na indra vajebhirdashasya cha gatuya cha |
achchha cha nah sumnam neshi ||
verses.en:
As such, O Indra, honour us with gifts of booty, further us,
And lead us to felicity.

verses.sa:
आ याहि सुषुमा हि त इन्द्र सोमं पिबा इमम् ।
एदं बर्हिः सदो मम ॥
verses.rom:
a yahi sushuma hi ta indra somam piba imam |
edam barhih sado mama ||
verses.en:
COME, we have pressed the juice for thee; O Indra, drink this Soma here
Sit thou on this my sacred grass.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा ब्रह्मयुजा हरी वहतामिन्द्र केशिना ।
उप ब्रह्माणि नः शृणु ॥
verses.rom:
a tva brahmayuja hari vahatamindra keshina |
upa brahmani nah shrinu ||
verses.en:
O Indra, let thy long-maned Bays, yoked by prayer, bring thee hitherward
Give car and listen to our prayers.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्माणस्त्वा वयं युजा सोमपामिन्द्र सोमिनः ।
सुतावन्तो हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
brahmanastva vayam yuja somapamindra sominah |
sutavanto havamahe ||
verses.en:
We Soma-bearing Brahmans call thee Soma-drinker with thy friend,
We, Indra, bringing Soma juice.

verses.sa:
आ नो याहि सुतावतोऽस्माकं सुष्टुतीरुप ।
पिबा सु शिप्रिन्नन्धसः ॥
verses.rom:
a no yahi sutavato'smakam sushtutirupa |
piba su shiprinnandhasah ||
verses.en:
Come unto us who bring the juice, come unto this our eulogy,
Fair-visored! drink thou of the juice.

verses.sa:
आ ते सिञ्चामि कुक्ष्योरनु गात्रा वि धावतु ।
गृभाय जिह्वया मधु ॥
verses.rom:
a te sinchami kukshyoranu gatra vi dhavatu |
gribhaya jihvaya madhu ||
verses.en:
I pour it down within thee, so through all thy members let it spread:
Take with. thy tongue the pleasant drink.

verses.sa:
स्वादुष्टे अस्तु संसुदे मधुमान्तन्वे तव ।
सोमः शमस्तु ते हृदे ॥
verses.rom:
svadushte astu samsude madhumantanve tava |
somah shamastu te hride ||
verses.en:
Sweet to thy body let it be, delicious be the savoury juice:
Sweet be the Soma to thine heart.

verses.sa:
अयमु त्वा विचर्षणे जनीरिवाभि संवृतः ।
प्र सोम इन्द्र सर्पतु ॥
verses.rom:
ayamu tva vicharshane janirivabhi samvritah |
pra soma indra sarpatu ||
verses.en:
Like women, let this Soma-draught, invested with its robe, approach,
O active Indra, close to thee.

verses.sa:
तुविग्रीवो वपोदरः सुबाहुरन्धसो मदे ।
इन्द्रो वृत्राणि जिघ्नते ॥
verses.rom:
tuvigrivo vapodarah subahurandhaso made |
indro vritrani jighnate ||
verses.en:
Indra, transported with the juice, vast in his bulk, strong in his neck
And stout arms, smites the Vrtras down.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र प्रेहि पुरस्त्वं विश्वस्येशान ओजसा ।
वृत्राणि वृत्रहञ्जहि ॥
verses.rom:
indra prehi purastvam vishvasyeshana ojasa |
vritrani vritrahanjahi ||
verses.en:
O Indra, go thou forward, thou who rulest over all by might:
Thou Vrtra-slayer slay the fiends,

verses.sa:
दीर्घस्ते अस्त्वङ्कुशो येना वसु प्रयच्छसि ।
यजमानाय सुन्वते ॥
verses.rom:
dirghaste astvankusho yena vasu prayachchhasi |
yajamanaya sunvate ||
verses.en:
Long be thy grasping-hook wherewith thou givest ample wealth to him
Who sheds the juice and worships thee.

verses.sa:
अयं त इन्द्र सोमो निपूतो अधि बर्हिषि ।
एहीमस्य द्रवा पिब ॥
verses.rom:
ayam ta indra somo niputo adhi barhishi |
ehimasya drava piba ||
verses.en:
Here, Indra, is thy Soma-draught, made pure upon the sacred grass:
Run hither, come and drink thereof.

verses.sa:
शाचिगो शाचिपूजनायं रणाय ते सुतः ।
आखण्डल प्र हूयसे ॥
verses.rom:
shachigo shachipujanayam ranaya te sutah |
akhandala pra huyase ||
verses.en:
Famed for thy radiance, worshipped well this juice is shed for thy delight
Thou art invoked, Âkhaṇḍala!

verses.sa:
यस्ते शृङ्गवृषो नपात्प्रणपात्कुण्डपाय्यः ।
न्यस्मिन्दध्र आ मनः ॥
verses.rom:
yaste shringavrisho napatpranapatkundapayyah |
nyasmindadhra a manah ||
verses.en:
To Kundapayya, grandson's son, grandson of Ṣringavṛish! to thee,
To him have I addressed my thought.

verses.sa:
वास्तोष्पते ध्रुवा स्थूणांसत्रं सोम्यानाम् ।
द्रप्सो भेत्ता पुरां शश्वतीनामिन्द्रो मुनीनां सखा ॥
verses.rom:
vastoshpate dhruva sthunamsatram somyanam |
drapso bhetta puram shashvatinamindro muninam sakha ||
verses.en:
Strong pillar thou, Lord of the home armour of Soma-offerers:
The drop of Soma breaketh all the strongholds down, and Indra is the Rsis' Friend.

verses.sa:
पृदाकुसानुर्यजतो गवेषण एकः सन्नभि भूयसः ।
भूर्णिमश्वं नयत्तुजा पुरो गृभेन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
pridakusanuryajato gaveshana ekah sannabhi bhuyasah |
bhurnimashvam nayattuja puro gribhendram somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Holy Pṛidâkusânu, winner of the spoil, one eminent o'er many men,
Lead on the wild horse Indra with his vigorous grasp forward to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
इदं ह नूनमेषां सुम्नं भिक्षेत मर्त्यः ।
आदित्यानामपूर्व्यं सवीमनि ॥
verses.rom:
idam ha nunamesham sumnam bhiksheta martyah |
adityanamapurvyam savimani ||
verses.en:
Now let the mortal offer prayer to win the unexampled grace
Of these Adityas and their aid to cherish life.

verses.sa:
अनर्वाणो ह्येषां पन्था आदित्यानाम् ।
अदब्धाः सन्ति पायवः सुगेवृधः ॥
verses.rom:
anarvano hyesham pantha adityanam |
adabdhah santi payavah sugevridhah ||
verses.en:
For not an enemy molests the paths which these Adityas tread:
Infallible guards, they strengthen us in happiness.

verses.sa:
तत्सु नः सविता भगो वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
शर्म यच्छन्तु सप्रथो यदीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
tatsu nah savita bhago varuno mitro aryama |
sharma yachchhantu sapratho yadimahe ||
verses.en:
Now soon may Bhaga, Savitar, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman
Give us the shelter widely spread which we implore.

verses.sa:
देवेभिर्देव्यदितेऽरिष्टभर्मन्ना गहि ।
स्मत्सूरिभिः पुरुप्रिये सुशर्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
devebhirdevyadite'rishtabharmanna gahi |
smatsuribhih purupriye susharmabhih ||
verses.en:
With Gods come thou whose fostering care none checks, O Goddesss Aditi:
Come, dear to many, with the Lords who guard us well.

verses.sa:
ते हि पुत्रासो अदितेर्विदुर्द्वेषांसि योतवे ।
अंहोश्चिदुरुचक्रयोऽनेहसः ॥
verses.rom:
te hi putraso aditervidurdveshamsi yotave |
amhoshchiduruchakrayo'nehasah ||
verses.en:
For well these Sons of Aditi know to keep enmities aloof,
Unrivalled, giving ample room, they save from woe.

verses.sa:
अदितिर्नो दिवा पशुमदितिर्नक्तमद्वयाः ।
अदितिः पात्वंहसः सदावृधा ॥
verses.rom:
aditirno diva pashumaditirnaktamadvayah |
aditih patvamhasah sadavridha ||
verses.en:
Aditi guard our herd by day, Aditi, free from guile, by night,
Aditi, ever strengthening, save us from grief!

verses.sa:
उत स्या नो दिवा मतिरदितिरूत्या गमत् ।
सा शंताति मयस्करदप स्रिधः ॥
verses.rom:
uta sya no diva matiraditirutya gamat |
sa shamtati mayaskaradapa sridhah ||
verses.en:
And in the day our hymn is this: May Aditi come nigh to help,
With loving-kindness bring us weal and chase our foes.

verses.sa:
उत त्या दैव्या भिषजा शं नः करतो अश्विना ।
युयुयातामितो रपो अप स्रिधः ॥
verses.rom:
uta tya daivya bhishaja sham nah karato ashvina |
yuyuyatamito rapo apa sridhah ||
verses.en:
And may the Asvins, the divine Pair of Physicians, send us health:
May they remove iniquity and chase our foes.

verses.sa:
शमग्निरग्निभिः करच्छं नस्तपतु सूर्यः ।
शं वातो वात्वरपा अप स्रिधः ॥
verses.rom:
shamagniragnibhih karachchham nastapatu suryah |
sham vato vatvarapa apa sridhah ||
verses.en:
May Agni bless us with his fires, and Surya warm us pleasantly:
May the pure Wind breathe sweet on us, and chase our foes.

verses.sa:
अपामीवामप स्रिधमप सेधत दुर्मतिम् ।
आदित्यासो युयोतना नो अंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
apamivamapa sridhamapa sedhata durmatim |
adityaso yuyotana no amhasah ||
verses.en:
Drive ye disease and strife away, drive ye away malignity:
Adityas, keep us ever far from sore distress.

verses.sa:
युयोता शरुमस्मदाँ आदित्यास उतामतिम् ।
ऋधग्द्वेषः कृणुत विश्ववेदसः ॥
verses.rom:
yuyota sharumasmadan adityasa utamatim |
ridhagdveshah krinuta vishvavedasah ||
verses.en:
Remove from us the arrow, keep famine, Adityas! far away:
Keep enmities afar from us, Lords of all wealth!

verses.sa:
तत्सु नः शर्म यच्छतादित्या यन्मुमोचति ।
एनस्वन्तं चिदेनसः सुदानवः ॥
verses.rom:
tatsu nah sharma yachchhataditya yanmumochati |
enasvantam chidenasah sudanavah ||
verses.en:
Now, O Adityas, grant to us the shelter that lets man go free,
Yea, even the sinner from his sin, ye Bounteous Gods 1

verses.sa:
यो नः कश्चिद्रिरिक्षति रक्षस्त्वेन मर्त्यः ।
स्वैः ष एवै रिरिषीष्ट युर्जनः ॥
verses.rom:
yo nah kashchidririkshati rakshastvena martyah |
svaih sha evai ririshishta yurjanah ||
verses.en:
Whatever mortal with the powe r of demons fain would injure us,
May he, impetuous, suffer harm by his own deeds.

verses.sa:
समित्तमघमश्नवद्दुःशंसं मर्त्यं रिपुम् ।
यो अस्मत्रा दुर्हणावाँ उप द्वयुः ॥
verses.rom:
samittamaghamashnavadduhshamsam martyam ripum |
yo asmatra durhanavan upa dvayuh ||
verses.en:
May sin o'ertake our human foe, the man who speaketh evil thing,
Him who would cause our misery, whose heart is false.

verses.sa:
पाकत्रा स्थन देवा हृत्सु जानीथ मर्त्यम् ।
उप द्वयुं चाद्वयुं च वसवः ॥
verses.rom:
pakatra sthana deva hritsu janitha martyam |
upa dvayum chadvayum cha vasavah ||
verses.en:
Gods, ye are with the simple ones, ye know each mortal in your hearts;
Ye, Vasus, well discriminate the false and true.

verses.sa:
आ शर्म पर्वतानामोतापां वृणीमहे ।
द्यावाक्षामारे अस्मद्रपस्कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
a sharma parvatanamotapam vrinimahe |
dyavakshamare asmadrapaskritam ||
verses.en:
Fain would we have the sheltering aid of mountains and of water-floods:
Keep far from us iniquity, O Heaven and Earth.

verses.sa:
ते नो भद्रेण शर्मणा युष्माकं नावा वसवः ।
अति विश्वानि दुरिता पिपर्तन ॥
verses.rom:
te no bhadrena sharmana yushmakam nava vasavah |
ati vishvani durita pipartana ||
verses.en:
So with auspicious sheltering aid do ye, O Vasus, carry us
Beyond all trouble and distress, borne in your ship.

verses.sa:
तुचे तनाय तत्सु नो द्राघीय आयुर्जीवसे ।
आदित्यासः सुमहसः कृणोतन ॥
verses.rom:
tuche tanaya tatsu no draghiya ayurjivase |
adityasah sumahasah krinotana ||
verses.en:
Adityas, ye Most Mighty Ones, grant to our children and their seed
Extended term of life that they may live long days.

verses.sa:
यज्ञो हीळो वो अन्तर आदित्या अस्ति मृळत ।
युष्मे इद्वो अपि ष्मसि सजात्ये ॥
verses.rom:
yajno hilo vo antara aditya asti mrilata |
yushme idvo api shmasi sajatye ||
verses.en:
Sacrifice, O Adityas, is your inward monitor: be kind,
For in the bond of kindred we are bound to you.

verses.sa:
बृहद्वरूथं मरुतां देवं त्रातारमश्विना ।
मित्रमीमहे वरुणं स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
brihadvarutham marutam devam trataramashvina |
mitramimahe varunam svastaye ||
verses.en:
The Maruts' high protecting aid, the Asvins, and the God who saves,
Mitra and Varuna for weal we supplicate.

verses.sa:
अनेहो मित्रार्यमन्नृवद्वरुण शंस्यम् ।
त्रिवरूथं मरुतो यन्त नश्छर्दिः ॥
verses.rom:
aneho mitraryamannrivadvaruna shamsyam |
trivarutham maruto yanta nashchhardih ||
verses.en:
Grant us a home with triple guard, Aryaman, Mitra, Varuna!
Unthreatened, Maruts! meet for praise, and filled with men.

verses.sa:
ये चिद्धि मृत्युबन्धव आदित्या मनवः स्मसि ।
प्र सू न आयुर्जीवसे तिरेतन ॥
verses.rom:
ye chiddhi mrityubandhava aditya manavah smasi |
pra su na ayurjivase tiretana ||
verses.en:
And as we human beings, O Adityas, are akin to death,
Graciously lengthen ye our lives that we may live.

verses.sa:
तं गूर्धया स्वर्णरं देवासो देवमरतिं दधन्विरे ।
देवत्रा हव्यमोहिरे ॥
verses.rom:
tam gurdhaya svarnaram devaso devamaratim dadhanvire |
devatra havyamohire ||
verses.en:
SING praise to him, the Lord of Light. The Gods have made the God to be their messenger,
And sent oblation to Gods.

verses.sa:
विभूतरातिं विप्र चित्रशोचिषमग्निमीळिष्व यन्तुरम् ।
अस्य मेधस्य सोम्यस्य सोभरे प्रेमध्वराय पूर्व्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
vibhutaratim vipra chitrashochishamagnimilishva yanturam |
asya medhasya somyasya sobhare premadhvaraya purvyam ||
verses.en:
Agni, the Bounteous Giver, bright with varied flames, laud thou, O singer Sobhari-
Him who controls this sacred food with Soma blent, who hath first claim to sacrifice.

verses.sa:
यजिष्ठं त्वा ववृमहे देवं देवत्रा होतारममर्त्यम् ।
अस्य यज्ञस्य सुक्रतुम् ॥
verses.rom:
yajishtham tva vavrimahe devam devatra hotaramamartyam |
asya yajnasya sukratum ||
verses.en:
Thee have we chosen skill fullest in sacrifice, Immortal Priest among the Gods,
Wise finisher of this holy rite:

verses.sa:
ऊर्जो नपातं सुभगं सुदीदितिमग्निं श्रेष्ठशोचिषम् ।
स नो मित्रस्य वरुणस्य सो अपामा सुम्नं यक्षते दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
urjo napatam subhagam sudiditimagnim shreshthashochisham |
sa no mitrasya varunasya so apama sumnam yakshate divi ||
verses.en:
The Son of Strength, the blessed, brightly shining One, Agni whose light is excellent.
May be by sacrifice win us in heaven the grace of Mitra, Varuna, and the Floods.

verses.sa:
यः समिधा य आहुती यो वेदेन ददाश मर्तो अग्नये ।
यो नमसा स्वध्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
yah samidha ya ahuti yo vedena dadasha marto agnaye |
yo namasa svadhvarah ||
verses.en:
The mortal who hath ministered to Agni with oblation, fuel, ritual lore,
And reverence, skilled in sacrifice.

verses.sa:
तस्येदर्वन्तो रंहयन्त आशवस्तस्य द्युम्नितमं यशः ।
न तमंहो देवकृतं कुतश्चन न मर्त्यकृतं नशत् ॥
verses.rom:
tasyedarvanto ramhayanta ashavastasya dyumnitamam yashah |
na tamamho devakritam kutashchana na martyakritam nashat ||
verses.en:
Verily swift to run are his fleet-footed steeds, and most resplendent fame is his.
No trouble caused by Gods or wrought by mortal man from any side o'ertaketh him.

verses.sa:
स्वग्नयो वो अग्निभिः स्याम सूनो सहस ऊर्जां पते ।
सुवीरस्त्वमस्मयुः ॥
verses.rom:
svagnayo vo agnibhih syama suno sahasa urjam pate |
suvirastvamasmayuh ||
verses.en:
May we by thine own fires be well supplied with fire, O Son of Strength, O Lord of Might:
Thou as our Friend hast worthy men.

verses.sa:
प्रशंसमानो अतिथिर्न मित्रियोऽग्नी रथो न वेद्यः ।
त्वे क्षेमासो अपि सन्ति साधवस्त्वं राजा रयीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
prashamsamano atithirna mitriyo'gni ratho na vedyah |
tve kshemaso api santi sadhavastvam raja rayinam ||
verses.en:
Agni, who praises like a guest of friendly mind, is as a car that brings us gear.
Also in thee is found perfect security thou art the Sovran Lord of wealth.

verses.sa:
सो अद्धा दाश्वध्वरोऽग्ने मर्तः सुभग स प्रशंस्यः ।
स धीभिरस्तु सनिता ॥
verses.rom:
so addha dashvadhvaro'gne martah subhaga sa prashamsyah |
sa dhibhirastu sanita ||
verses.en:
That man, moreover, merits praise who brings, auspicious Agni, sacrificial gifts
May he win riches by his thoughts.

verses.sa:
यस्य त्वमूर्ध्वो अध्वराय तिष्ठसि क्षयद्वीरः स साधते ।
सो अर्वद्भिः सनिता स विपन्युभिः स शूरैः सनिता कृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasya tvamurdhvo adhvaraya tishthasi kshayadvirah sa sadhate |
so arvadbhih sanita sa vipanyubhih sa shuraih sanita kritam ||
verses.en:
He for whose sacrifice thou standest up erect is prosperous and rules o'er men.
He wins with coursers and with singers killed in song: with heroes he obtains the prize.

verses.sa:
यस्याग्निर्वपुर्गृहे स्तोमं चनो दधीत विश्ववार्यः ।
हव्या वा वेविषद्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
yasyagnirvapurgrihe stomam chano dadhita vishvavaryah |
havya va vevishadvishah ||
verses.en:
He in whose dwelling Agni is chief ornament, and, all-desired, loves his laud well,
And zealously tends his offerings-

verses.sa:
विप्रस्य वा स्तुवतः सहसो यहो मक्षूतमस्य रातिषु ।
अवोदेवमुपरिमर्त्यं कृधि वसो विविदुषो वचः ॥
verses.rom:
viprasya va stuvatah sahaso yaho makshutamasya ratishu |
avodevamuparimartyam kridhi vaso vividusho vachah ||
verses.en:
His, or the lauding sage's word, his, Son of Strength! who Is most prompt with sacred gifts,
Set thou beneath the Gods, Vasu, above mankind, the speech of the intelligent.

verses.sa:
यो अग्निं हव्यदातिभिर्नमोभिर्वा सुदक्षमाविवासति ।
गिरा वाजिरशोचिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
yo agnim havyadatibhirnamobhirva sudakshamavivasati |
gira vajirashochisham ||
verses.en:
He who with sacrificial gifts or homage bringeth very skilful Agni nigh,
Or him who flashes fast with song,

verses.sa:
समिधा यो निशिती दाशददितिं धामभिरस्य मर्त्यः ।
विश्वेत्स धीभिः सुभगो जनाँ अति द्युम्नैरुद्न इव तारिषत् ॥
verses.rom:
samidha yo nishiti dashadaditim dhamabhirasya martyah |
vishvetsa dhibhih subhago janan ati dyumnairudna iva tarishat ||
verses.en:
The mortal who with blazing fuel, as his laws command, adores the Perfect God,
Blest with his thoughts in splendour shall exceed all men, as though he overpassed the floods.

verses.sa:
तदग्ने द्युम्नमा भर यत्सासहत्सदने कं चिदत्रिणम् ।
मन्युं जनस्य दूढ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tadagne dyumnama bhara yatsasahatsadane kam chidatrinam |
manyum janasya dudhyah ||
verses.en:
Give us the splendour, Agni, which may overcome each greedy fiend in our abode,
The wrath of evil-hearted folk.

verses.sa:
येन चष्टे वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा येन नासत्या भगः ।
वयं तत्ते शवसा गातुवित्तमा इन्द्रत्वोता विधेमहि ॥
verses.rom:
yena chashte varuno mitro aryama yena nasatya bhagah |
vayam tatte shavasa gatuvittama indratvota vidhemahi ||
verses.en:
That, wherewith Mitra, Varuna, and Aryaman, the Asvins, Bhaga give us light,
That may we, by thy power finding best furtherance, worship, O Indra, helped by thee.

verses.sa:
ते घेदग्ने स्वाध्यो ये त्वा विप्र निदधिरे नृचक्षसम् ।
विप्रासो देव सुक्रतुम् ॥
verses.rom:
te ghedagne svadhyo ye tva vipra nidadhire nrichakshasam |
vipraso deva sukratum ||
verses.en:
O Agni, most devout are they, the sages who have set thee Sage exceeding wise,
O God, for men to look upon:

verses.sa:
त इद्वेदिं सुभग त आहुतिं ते सोतुं चक्रिरे दिवि ।
त इद्वाजेभिर्जिग्युर्महद्धनं ये त्वे कामं न्येरिरे ॥
verses.rom:
ta idvedim subhaga ta ahutim te sotum chakrire divi |
ta idvajebhirjigyurmahaddhanam ye tve kamam nyerire ||
verses.en:
Who have arranged thine altar Blessed God, at morn brought thine oblation, pressed the juice.
They by their deeds of strength have won diem, mighty wealth, who have set all their hope in thee.

verses.sa:
भद्रो नो अग्निराहुतो भद्रा रातिः सुभग भद्रो अध्वरः ।
भद्रा उत प्रशस्तयः ॥
verses.rom:
bhadro no agnirahuto bhadra ratih subhaga bhadro adhvarah |
bhadra uta prashastayah ||
verses.en:
May Agni worshipped bring us bliss, may the gift, Blessed One, and sacrifice bring bliss;
Yea, may our praises bring us bliss.

verses.sa:
भद्रं मनः कृणुष्व वृत्रतूर्ये येना समत्सु सासहः ।
अव स्थिरा तनुहि भूरि शर्धतां वनेमा ते अभिष्टिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
bhadram manah krinushva vritraturye yena samatsu sasahah |
ava sthira tanuhi bhuri shardhatam vanema te abhishtibhih ||
verses.en:
Show forth the mind that brings success in war with fiends, wherewith thou conquerest in fight.
Bring down the many firm hopes of our enemies, and let us vanquish with thine aid.

verses.sa:
ईळे गिरा मनुर्हितं यं देवा दूतमरतिं न्येरिरे ।
यजिष्ठं हव्यवाहनम् ॥
verses.rom:
ile gira manurhitam yam deva dutamaratim nyerire |
yajishtham havyavahanam ||
verses.en:
I praise with song the Friend of man, whom Gods sent down to be herald and messenger,
Best worshipper, bearer of our gifts.

verses.sa:
तिग्मजम्भाय तरुणाय राजते प्रयो गायस्यग्नये ।
यः पिंशते सूनृताभिः सुवीर्यमग्निर्घृतेभिराहुतः ॥
verses.rom:
tigmajambhaya tarunaya rajate prayo gayasyagnaye |
yah pimshate sunritabhih suviryamagnirghritebhirahutah ||
verses.en:
Thou unto sharp-toothed Agni, Young and Radiant God, proclaimest with thy song the feast-
Agni, who for our sweet strains moulds heroic strength when sacred oil is offered him,

verses.sa:
यदी घृतेभिराहुतो वाशीमग्निर्भरत उच्चाव च ।
असुर इव निर्णिजम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadi ghritebhirahuto vashimagnirbharata uchchava cha |
asura iva nirnijam ||
verses.en:
While, served with sacrificial oil, now upward and now downward Agni moves his sword,
As doth the Asura his robe.

verses.sa:
यो हव्यान्यैरयता मनुर्हितो देव आसा सुगन्धिना ।
विवासते वार्याणि स्वध्वरो होता देवो अमर्त्यः ॥
verses.rom:
yo havyanyairayata manurhito deva asa sugandhina |
vivasate varyani svadhvaro hota devo amartyah ||
verses.en:
The God, the Friend of man, who bears our gifts to heaven, the God with his sweet-smelling mouth,
Distributes, skilled in sacrifice, his precious things, Invoking Priest, Immortal God.

verses.sa:
यदग्ने मर्त्यस्त्वं स्यामहं मित्रमहो अमर्त्यः ।
सहसः सूनवाहुत ॥
verses.rom:
yadagne martyastvam syamaham mitramaho amartyah |
sahasah sunavahuta ||
verses.en:
Son of Strength, Agni, if thou wert the mortal, bright as Mitra, I worshipped with our gifts!
And I were the Immortal God

verses.sa:
न त्वा रासीयाभिशस्तये वसो न पापत्वाय सन्त्य ।
न मे स्तोतामतीवा न दुर्हितः स्यादग्ने न पापया ॥
verses.rom:
na tva rasiyabhishastaye vaso na papatvaya santya |
na me stotamativa na durhitah syadagne na papaya ||
verses.en:
I would not give thee up, Vasu, to calumny, or misery, O Bounteous One.
My worshipper should feel no hunger or distress, nor, Agni, should he live in sin.

verses.sa: पितुर्न पुत्रः सुभृतो दुरोण आ देवाँ एतु प्र णो हविः ॥
verses.rom: piturna putrah subhrito durona a devan etu pra no havih ||
verses.en:
Like a son cherished in his father's house,
Let our oblation rise unto the Gods.

verses.sa:
तवाहमग्न ऊतिभिर्नेदिष्ठाभिः सचेय जोषमा वसो ।
सदा देवस्य मर्त्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tavahamagna utibhirnedishthabhih sacheya joshama vaso |
sada devasya martyah ||
verses.en:
With thine immediate aid may I, excellent Agni, ever gain my wish
A mortal with a God to help.

verses.sa:
तव क्रत्वा सनेयं तव रातिभिरग्ने तव प्रशस्तिभिः ।
त्वामिदाहुः प्रमतिं वसो ममाग्ने हर्षस्व दातवे ॥
verses.rom:
tava kratva saneyam tava ratibhiragne tava prashastibhih |
tvamidahuh pramatim vaso mamagne harshasva datave ||
verses.en:
O Agni, by thy wisdom, by thy bounties, by thy leading may I gather wealth.
Excellent Agni, thou art called my Providence: delight thou to be liberal.

verses.sa:
प्र सो अग्ने तवोतिभिः सुवीराभिस्तिरते वाजभर्मभिः ।
यस्य त्वं सख्यमावरः ॥
verses.rom:
pra so agne tavotibhih suvirabhistirate vajabharmabhih |
yasya tvam sakhyamavarah ||
verses.en:
Agni, he conquers by thine aid that brings him store of noble heroes and great strength,
Whose bond of friendship is thy choice.

verses.sa:
तव द्रप्सो नीलवान्वाश ऋत्विय इन्धानः सिष्णवा ददे ।
त्वं महीनामुषसामसि प्रियः क्षपो वस्तुषु राजसि ॥
verses.rom:
tava drapso nilavanvasha ritviya indhanah sishnava dade |
tvam mahinamushasamasi priyah kshapo vastushu rajasi ||
verses.en:
Thy spark is black and crackling, kindled in due time, O Bounteous, it is taken up.
Thou art the dear Friend of the mighty Mornings: thou shinest in glimmerings of the night.

verses.sa:
तमागन्म सोभरयः सहस्रमुष्कं स्वभिष्टिमवसे ।
सम्राजं त्रासदस्यवम् ॥
verses.rom:
tamaganma sobharayah sahasramushkam svabhishtimavase |
samrajam trasadasyavam ||
verses.en:
We Sobharis have come to him, for succour, who is good to help with thousand powers,
The Sovran, Trasadasyu's Friend.

verses.sa:
यस्य ते अग्ने अन्ये अग्नय उपक्षितो वया इव ।
विपो न द्युम्ना नि युवे जनानां तव क्षत्राणि वर्धयन् ॥
verses.rom:
yasya te agne anye agnaya upakshito vaya iva |
vipo na dyumna ni yuve jananam tava kshatrani vardhayan ||
verses.en:
O Agni, thou on whom all other fires depend, as branches on the parent stem,
I make the treasures of the folk, like songs, mine own, while I exalt thy sovran might.

verses.sa:
यमादित्यासो अद्रुहः पारं नयथ मर्त्यम् ।
मघोनां विश्वेषां सुदानवः ॥
verses.rom:
yamadityaso adruhah param nayatha martyam |
maghonam vishvesham sudanavah ||
verses.en:
The mortal whom, Adityas, ye, Guilelew, lead to the farther bank
Of all the princes, Bounteous Ones

verses.sa:
यूयं राजानः कं चिच्चर्षणीसहः क्षयन्तं मानुषाँ अनु ।
वयं ते वो वरुण मित्रार्यमन्स्यामेदृतस्य रथ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
yuyam rajanah kam chichcharshanisahah kshayantam manushan anu |
vayam te vo varuna mitraryamansyamedritasya rathyah ||
verses.en:
Whoe'er he be, Man-ruling Kings! the Regent of the race of men-
May we, O Mitra, Varuna, and Aryaman, like him be furtherers of your law.

verses.sa:
अदान्मे पौरुकुत्स्यः पञ्चाशतं त्रसदस्युर्वधूनाम् ।
मंहिष्ठो अर्यः सत्पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
adanme paurukutsyah panchashatam trasadasyurvadhunam |
mamhishtho aryah satpatih ||
verses.en:
A gift of fifty female slaves hath Trasadasyu given me, Purukutsa's son,
Most liberal, kind, lord of the brave.

verses.sa:
उत मे प्रयियोर्वयियोः सुवास्त्वा अधि तुग्वनि ।
तिसॄणां सप्ततीनां श्यावः प्रणेता भुवद्वसुर्दियानां पतिः ॥
verses.rom:
uta me prayiyorvayiyoh suvastva adhi tugvani |
tisrinam saptatinam shyavah praneta bhuvadvasurdiyanam patih ||
verses.en:
And Syava too for me led forth a strong steed at Suvastu's ford:
A herd of three times seventy kine, good lord of gifts, he gave to me.

verses.sa:
आ गन्ता मा रिषण्यत प्रस्थावानो माप स्थाता समन्यवः ।
स्थिरा चिन्नमयिष्णवः ॥
verses.rom:
a ganta ma rishanyata prasthavano mapa sthata samanyavah |
sthira chinnamayishnavah ||
verses.en:
LET none, Swift Travellers! check you: come hither, like-spirited, stay not far away,
Ye benders even of what is firm.

verses.sa:
वीळुपविभिर्मरुत ऋभुक्षण आ रुद्रासः सुदीतिभिः ।
इषा नो अद्या गता पुरुस्पृहो यज्ञमा सोभरीयवः ॥
verses.rom:
vilupavibhirmaruta ribhukshana a rudrasah suditibhih |
isha no adya gata puruspriho yajnama sobhariyavah ||
verses.en:
Maruts, Rbhuksans, Rudras come ye with your cars strong-fellied and exceeding bright.
Come, ye for whom we long, with food, to sacrifice, come ye with love to Sobbari.

verses.sa:
विद्मा हि रुद्रियाणां शुष्ममुग्रं मरुतां शिमीवताम् ।
विष्णोरेषस्य मीळ्हुषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
vidma hi rudriyanam shushmamugram marutam shimivatam |
vishnoreshasya milhusham ||
verses.en:
For well we know the vigorous might of Rudra's Sons, the Maruts, who are passing strong,
Swift Visnu's band, who send the rain.,

verses.sa:
वि द्वीपानि पापतन्तिष्ठद्दुच्छुनोभे युजन्त रोदसी ।
प्र धन्वान्यैरत शुभ्रखादयो यदेजथ स्वभानवः ॥
verses.rom:
vi dvipani papatantishthadduchchhunobhe yujanta rodasi |
pra dhanvanyairata shubhrakhadayo yadejatha svabhanavah ||
verses.en:
Islands are bursting forth and misery is stayed: the heaven and earth are joined in one.
Decked with bright rings, ye spread the broad expanses out, when ye, Self. luminous, stirred yourselves.

verses.sa:
अच्युता चिद्वो अज्मन्ना नानदति पर्वतासो वनस्पतिः ।
भूमिर्यामेषु रेजते ॥
verses.rom:
achyuta chidvo ajmanna nanadati parvataso vanaspatih |
bhumiryameshu rejate ||
verses.en:
Even things immovable shake and reel, the mountains and the forest trees at your approach,
And the earth trembles as ye come.

verses.sa:
अमाय वो मरुतो यातवे द्यौर्जिहीत उत्तरा बृहत् ।
यत्रा नरो देदिशते तनूष्वा त्वक्षांसि बाह्वोजसः ॥
verses.rom:
amaya vo maruto yatave dyaurjihita uttara brihat |
yatra naro dedishate tanushva tvakshamsi bahvojasah ||
verses.en:
To lend free course, O Maruts, to your furious rush, heaven high and higher still gives way,
Where they, the Heroes mighty with their arms, display their gleaming ornaments on their forms.

verses.sa:
स्वधामनु श्रियं नरो महि त्वेषा अमवन्तो वृषप्सवः ।
वहन्ते अह्रुतप्सवः ॥
verses.rom:
svadhamanu shriyam naro mahi tvesha amavanto vrishapsavah |
vahante ahrutapsavah ||
verses.en:
After their Godlike nature they, the bull. like Heroes, dazzling and impetuous, wear
Great splendour as they show erect.

verses.sa:
गोभिर्वाणो अज्यते सोभरीणां रथे कोशे हिरण्यये ।
गोबन्धवः सुजातास इषे भुजे महान्तो न स्परसे नु ॥
verses.rom:
gobhirvano ajyate sobharinam rathe koshe hiranyaye |
gobandhavah sujatasa ishe bhuje mahanto na sparase nu ||
verses.en:
The pivot of the Sobharis' chariot within the golden box is balmed with milk.
May they the Well-born, Mighty, kindred of the Cow, aid us to food and to delight.

verses.sa:
प्रति वो वृषदञ्जयो वृष्णे शर्धाय मारुताय भरध्वम् ।
हव्या वृषप्रयाव्णे ॥
verses.rom:
prati vo vrishadanjayo vrishne shardhaya marutaya bharadhvam |
havya vrishaprayavne ||
verses.en:
Bring, ye who sprinkle balmy drops. oblations to your vigorous Marut company,
To those whose leader is the Bull.

verses.sa:
वृषणश्वेन मरुतो वृषप्सुना रथेन वृषनाभिना ।
आ श्येनासो न पक्षिणो वृथा नरो हव्या नो वीतये गत ॥
verses.rom:
vrishanashvena maruto vrishapsuna rathena vrishanabhina |
a shyenaso na pakshino vritha naro havya no vitaye gata ||
verses.en:
Come hither, O ye Mares, on your strong horsed car, solid in look, with solid naves.
Lightly like winged falcons, O ye Heroes, come, come to enjoy our offerings.

verses.sa:
समानमञ्ज्येषां वि भ्राजन्ते रुक्मासो अधि बाहुषु ।
दविद्युतत्यृष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
samanamanjyesham vi bhrajante rukmaso adhi bahushu |
davidyutatyrishtayah ||
verses.en:
Their decoration is the same: their ornaments of gold are bright upon their arms;
Their lances glitter splendidly.

verses.sa:
त उग्रासो वृषण उग्रबाहवो नकिष्टनूषु येतिरे ।
स्थिरा धन्वान्यायुधा रथेषु वोऽनीकेष्वधि श्रियः ॥
verses.rom:
ta ugraso vrishana ugrabahavo nakishtanushu yetire |
sthira dhanvanyayudha ratheshu vo'nikeshvadhi shriyah ||
verses.en:
They toil not to defend their bodies from attack, strong Heroes with their mighty arms.
Strong are your bows and strong the weapons in your cars, and glory sits on every face.

verses.sa:
येषामर्णो न सप्रथो नाम त्वेषं शश्वतामेकमिद्भुजे ।
वयो न पित्र्यं सहः ॥
verses.rom:
yeshamarno na sapratho nama tvesham shashvatamekamidbhuje |
vayo na pitryam sahah ||
verses.en:
Whose name extendeth like a sea, alone, resplendent, so that all have joy in it,
And life-power like ancestral might.

verses.sa:
तान्वन्दस्व मरुतस्ताँ उप स्तुहि तेषां हि धुनीनाम् ।
अराणां न चरमस्तदेषां दाना मह्ना तदेषाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tanvandasva marutastan upa stuhi tesham hi dhuninam |
aranam na charamastadesham dana mahna tadesham ||
verses.en:
Pay honour to these Maruts and sing praise to them, for of the wheel-spokes of the car
Of these loud roarers none is last: this is their power, this moves them to give mighty gifts.

verses.sa:
सुभगः स व ऊतिष्वास पूर्वासु मरुतो व्युष्टिषु ।
यो वा नूनमुतासति ॥
verses.rom:
subhagah sa va utishvasa purvasu maruto vyushtishu |
yo va nunamutasati ||
verses.en:
Blest by your favouring help was he, O Maruts, at the earlier flushings of the morn,
And even now shall he be blest.

verses.sa:
यस्य वा यूयं प्रति वाजिनो नर आ हव्या वीतये गथ ।
अभि ष द्युम्नैरुत वाजसातिभिः सुम्ना वो धूतयो नशत् ॥
verses.rom:
yasya va yuyam prati vajino nara a havya vitaye gatha |
abhi sha dyumnairuta vajasatibhih sumna vo dhutayo nashat ||
verses.en:
The strong man to whose sacrifice, O Heroes, ye approach that ye may taste thereof,
With glories and with war that winneth spoil shall gain great bliss, ye Shakers of the world.

verses.sa:
यथा रुद्रस्य सूनवो दिवो वशन्त्यसुरस्य वेधसः ।
युवानस्तथेदसत् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha rudrasya sunavo divo vashantyasurasya vedhasah |
yuvanastathedasat ||
verses.en:
Even as Rudra's Sons, the brood of the Creator Dyaus, the Asura, desire,
O Youthful Ones, so shall it be:

verses.sa:
ये चार्हन्ति मरुतः सुदानवः स्मन्मीळ्हुषश्चरन्ति ये ।
अतश्चिदा न उप वस्यसा हृदा युवान आ ववृध्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
ye charhanti marutah sudanavah smanmilhushashcharanti ye |
atashchida na upa vasyasa hrida yuvana a vavridhvam ||
verses.en:
And these the bounteous, worthy of the Maruts who move onward pouring down the rain-
Even for their sake, O Youthful Ones, with kindest heart take us to you to be your own.

verses.sa:
यून ऊ षु नविष्ठया वृष्णः पावकाँ अभि सोभरे गिरा ।
गाय गा इव चर्कृषत् ॥
verses.rom:
yuna u shu navishthaya vrishnah pavakan abhi sobhare gira |
gaya ga iva charkrishat ||
verses.en:
O Sobhari, with newest song sing out unto the youthful purifying Bulls,
Even as a plougher to his steers.

verses.sa:
साहा ये सन्ति मुष्टिहेव हव्यो विश्वासु पृत्सु होतृषु ।
वृष्णश्चन्द्रान्न सुश्रवस्तमान्गिरा वन्दस्व मरुतो अह ॥
verses.rom:
saha ye santi mushtiheva havyo vishvasu pritsu hotrishu |
vrishnashchandranna sushravastamangira vandasva maruto aha ||
verses.en:
Who, like a celebrated boxer, overcome the challengers in every fight:
They who, like shining bulls, are most illustrious-honour those Maruts with thy song.

verses.sa:
गावश्चिद्घा समन्यवः सजात्येन मरुतः सबन्धवः ।
रिहते ककुभो मिथः ॥
verses.rom:
gavashchidgha samanyavah sajatyena marutah sabandhavah |
rihate kakubho mithah ||
verses.en:
Allied by common ancestry, ye Maruts, even the Cows, alike in energy,
Lick, all by turns, each other's head.

verses.sa:
मर्तश्चिद्वो नृतवो रुक्मवक्षस उप भ्रातृत्वमायति ।
अधि नो गात मरुतः सदा हि व आपित्वमस्ति निध्रुवि ॥
verses.rom:
martashchidvo nritavo rukmavakshasa upa bhratritvamayati |
adhi no gata marutah sada hi va apitvamasti nidhruvi ||
verses.en:
