Even mortal man, ye Dancers breast adorned with gold, attains to brotherhood with you.
Mark ye and notice us, O Maruts; evermore your friendship is secured to us.

verses.sa:
मरुतो मारुतस्य न आ भेषजस्य वहता सुदानवः ।
यूयं सखायः सप्तयः ॥
verses.rom:
maruto marutasya na a bheshajasya vahata sudanavah |
yuyam sakhayah saptayah ||
verses.en:
O Maruts, rich in noble gifts, bring us a portion of the Maruts' medicine,
Ye Coursers who are Friends to us.

verses.sa:
याभिः सिन्धुमवथ याभिस्तूर्वथ याभिर्दशस्यथा क्रिविम् ।
मयो नो भूतोतिभिर्मयोभुवः शिवाभिरसचद्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
yabhih sindhumavatha yabhisturvatha yabhirdashasyatha krivim |
mayo no bhutotibhirmayobhuvah shivabhirasachadvishah ||
verses.en:
Haters of those who serve you not, bliss-bringers, bring us bliss with those auspicious aids
Wherewith ye are victorious and guard Sindhu well, and succour Krvi in his need.

verses.sa:
यत्सिन्धौ यदसिक्न्यां यत्समुद्रेषु मरुतः सुबर्हिषः ।
यत्पर्वतेषु भेषजम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatsindhau yadasiknyam yatsamudreshu marutah subarhishah |
yatparvateshu bheshajam ||
verses.en:
Maruts, who rest on fair trimmed grass, what balm soever Sindhu or Asikni hath,
Or mountains or the seas contain.

verses.sa:
विश्वं पश्यन्तो बिभृथा तनूष्वा तेना नो अधि वोचत ।
क्षमा रपो मरुत आतुरस्य न इष्कर्ता विह्रुतं पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
vishvam pashyanto bibhritha tanushva tena no adhi vochata |
kshama rapo maruta aturasya na ishkarta vihrutam punah ||
verses.en:
Ye carry on your bodies, ye who see it all: so bless us graciously therewith.
Cast, Maruts, to the ground our sick man's malady: replace the dislocated limb.

verses.sa:
वयमु त्वामपूर्व्य स्थूरं न कच्चिद्भरन्तोऽवस्यवः ।
वाजे चित्रं हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
vayamu tvamapurvya sthuram na kachchidbharanto'vasyavah |
vaje chitram havamahe ||
verses.en:
WE call on thee, O Matchless One! We seeking help, possessing nothing firm ourselves,
Call on thee wonderful in fight

verses.sa:
उप त्वा कर्मन्नूतये स नो युवोग्रश्चक्राम यो धृषत् ।
त्वामिद्ध्यवितारं ववृमहे सखाय इन्द्र सानसिम् ॥
verses.rom:
upa tva karmannutaye sa no yuvograshchakrama yo dhrishat |
tvamiddhyavitaram vavrimahe sakhaya indra sanasim ||
verses.en:
On thee for aid in sacrifice. This youth of ours, the bold, the mighty, hath gonse forth.
We therefore, we thy friends, Indra, have chosen thee, free-giver, as our Guardian God.

verses.sa:
आ याहीम इन्दवोऽश्वपते गोपत उर्वरापते ।
सोमं सोमपते पिब ॥
verses.rom:
a yahima indavo'shvapate gopata urvarapate |
somam somapate piba ||
verses.en:
Come hither, for the drops are here, O Lord of corn-lands. Lord of horses, Lord of kine:
Drink thou the Soma, Soma's Lord!

verses.sa:
वयं हि त्वा बन्धुमन्तमबन्धवो विप्रास इन्द्र येमिम ।
या ते धामानि वृषभ तेभिरा गहि विश्वेभिः सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
vayam hi tva bandhumantamabandhavo viprasa indra yemima |
ya te dhamani vrishabha tebhira gahi vishvebhih somapitaye ||
verses.en:
For we the kinless singers have drawn hither thee, O Indra, who hast numerous kin.
With all the forms thou hast, comic thou of bull-like strength, come near to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
सीदन्तस्ते वयो यथा गोश्रीते मधौ मदिरे विवक्षणे ।
अभि त्वामिन्द्र नोनुमः ॥
verses.rom:
sidantaste vayo yatha goshrite madhau madire vivakshane |
abhi tvamindra nonumah ||
verses.en:
Sitting like birds beside thy meath, mingled with milk, that gladdeneth and exalteth thee,
Indra, to thee we sing aloud.

verses.sa:
अच्छा च त्वैना नमसा वदामसि किं मुहुश्चिद्वि दीधयः ।
सन्ति कामासो हरिवो ददिष्ट्वं स्मो वयं सन्ति नो धियः ॥
verses.rom:
achchha cha tvaina namasa vadamasi kim muhushchidvi didhayah |
santi kamaso harivo dadishtvam smo vayam santi no dhiyah ||
verses.en:
We speak to thee with this our reverential prayer. Why art thou pondering yet awhile?
Here are our wishes; thou art liberal, Lord of Bays: we and our hymns are present here.

verses.sa:
नूत्ना इदिन्द्र ते वयमूती अभूम नहि नू ते अद्रिवः ।
विद्मा पुरा परीणसः ॥
verses.rom:
nutna idindra te vayamuti abhuma nahi nu te adrivah |
vidma pura parinasah ||
verses.en:
For not in recent times alone, O Indra, Thunder-armed, have we obtained thine aid.
Of old we knew thy plenteous wealth.

verses.sa:
विद्मा सखित्वमुत शूर भोज्यमा ते ता वज्रिन्नीमहे ।
उतो समस्मिन्ना शिशीहि नो वसो वाजे सुशिप्र गोमति ॥
verses.rom:
vidma sakhitvamuta shura bhojyama te ta vajrinnimahe |
uto samasminna shishihi no vaso vaje sushipra gomati ||
verses.en:
Hero, we knew thy friendship and thy rich rewards: these, Thunderer, now we crave of thee.
O Vasu, for all wealth that cometh of the kine, sharpen our powers, fair-visored God.

verses.sa:
यो न इदमिदं पुरा प्र वस्य आनिनाय तमु व स्तुषे ।
सखाय इन्द्रमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
yo na idamidam pura pra vasya aninaya tamu va stushe |
sakhaya indramutaye ||
verses.en:
Him who of old hath brought to us this and that blessing, him I magnify for you,
Even Indra, O my friends, for help

verses.sa:
हर्यश्वं सत्पतिं चर्षणीसहं स हि ष्मा यो अमन्दत ।
आ तु नः स वयति गव्यमश्व्यं स्तोतृभ्यो मघवा शतम् ॥
verses.rom:
haryashvam satpatim charshanisaham sa hi shma yo amandata |
a tu nah sa vayati gavyamashvyam stotribhyo maghava shatam ||
verses.en:
Borne by Bay Steeds, the Lord of heroes, ruling men, for it is he who takes; delight.
May Maghavan bestow on us his worshippers hundreds of cattle and of steeds.

verses.sa:
त्वया ह स्विद्युजा वयं प्रति श्वसन्तं वृषभ ब्रुवीमहि ।
संस्थे जनस्य गोमतः ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya ha svidyuja vayam prati shvasantam vrishabha bruvimahi |
samsthe janasya gomatah ||
verses.en:
Hero, may we, with thee for Friend, withstand the man who pants against us in his wrath,
In fight with people rich in kine.

verses.sa:
जयेम कारे पुरुहूत कारिणोऽभि तिष्ठेम दूढ्यः ।
नृभिर्वृत्रं हन्याम शूशुयाम चावेरिन्द्र प्र णो धियः ॥
verses.rom:
jayema kare puruhuta karino'bhi tishthema dudhyah |
nribhirvritram hanyama shushuyama chaverindra pra no dhiyah ||
verses.en:
May we be victors in the singer's battle song, and meet the wicked, Much invoked!
With heroes smite the foeman and show forth our strength. O Indra, further thou our thoughts.

verses.sa:
अभ्रातृव्यो अना त्वमनापिरिन्द्र जनुषा सनादसि ।
युधेदापित्वमिच्छसे ॥
verses.rom:
abhratrivyo ana tvamanapirindra janusha sanadasi |
yudhedapitvamichchhase ||
verses.en:
O Indra, from all ancient time rivalless ever and companionless art thou:
Thou seekest comradeship in war.

verses.sa:
नकी रेवन्तं सख्याय विन्दसे पीयन्ति ते सुराश्वः ।
यदा कृणोषि नदनुं समूहस्यादित्पितेव हूयसे ॥
verses.rom:
naki revantam sakhyaya vindase piyanti te surashvah |
yada krinoshi nadanum samuhasyaditpiteva huyase ||
verses.en:
Thou findest not the wealthy man to be thy friend: those scorn thee who are flown with wine.
What time thou thunderest and gatherest, then thou, even as a Father, art invoked.

verses.sa:
मा ते अमाजुरो यथा मूरास इन्द्र सख्ये त्वावतः ।
नि षदाम सचा सुते ॥
verses.rom:
ma te amajuro yatha murasa indra sakhye tvavatah |
ni shadama sacha sute ||
verses.en:
O Indra, let us not, like fools who waste their lives at home, with friendship such as thine
Sit idly by the poured-out juice.

verses.sa:
मा ते गोदत्र निरराम राधस इन्द्र मा ते गृहामहि ।
दृळ्हा चिदर्यः प्र मृशाभ्या भर न ते दामान आदभे ॥
verses.rom:
ma te godatra nirarama radhasa indra ma te grihamahi |
drilha chidaryah pra mrishabhya bhara na te damana adabhe ||
verses.en:
Giver of kine, may we not miss thy gracious gifts: let us not rob thee of thine own.
Strip even the strong places of the foe, and bring: thy gifts can never be made vain.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रो वा घेदियन्मघं सरस्वती वा सुभगा ददिर्वसु ।
त्वं वा चित्र दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
indro va ghediyanmagham sarasvati va subhaga dadirvasu |
tvam va chitra dashushe ||
verses.en:
Indra or blest Sarasvati alone bestows such wealth, treasure so great, or thou,
O Citra, on the worshipper.

verses.sa:
चित्र इद्राजा राजका इदन्यके यके सरस्वतीमनु ।
पर्जन्य इव ततनद्धि वृष्ट्या सहस्रमयुता ददत् ॥
verses.rom:
chitra idraja rajaka idanyake yake sarasvatimanu |
parjanya iva tatanaddhi vrishtya sahasramayuta dadat ||
verses.en:
Citra is King, and only kinglings are the rest who dwell beside Sarasvati.
He, like Parjanya with his rain, hath spread himself with thousand, yea, with myriad gifts.

verses.sa:
ओ त्यमह्व आ रथमद्या दंसिष्ठमूतये ।
यमश्विना सुहवा रुद्रवर्तनी आ सूर्यायै तस्थथुः ॥
verses.rom:
o tyamahva a rathamadya damsishthamutaye |
yamashvina suhava rudravartani a suryayai tasthathuh ||
verses.en:
HITHERWARD have I called to-day, for succour, that most wondrous car
Which ye ascended, Asvins, ye whose paths are red, swift to give Car, for Surya's sake.

verses.sa:
पूर्वायुषं सुहवं पुरुस्पृहं भुज्युं वाजेषु पूर्व्यम् ।
सचनावन्तं सुमतिभिः सोभरे विद्वेषसमनेहसम् ॥
verses.rom:
purvayusham suhavam puruspriham bhujyum vajeshu purvyam |
sachanavantam sumatibhih sobhare vidveshasamanehasam ||
verses.en:
Car ever young, much longed-for, easily invoked, soon guided, first in deeds of might,
Which waits and serves, O Sobhari, with benevolence, without a rival or a foe.

verses.sa:
इह त्या पुरुभूतमा देवा नमोभिरश्विना ।
अर्वाचीना स्ववसे करामहे गन्तारा दाशुषो गृहम् ॥
verses.rom:
iha tya purubhutama deva namobhirashvina |
arvachina svavase karamahe gantara dashusho griham ||
verses.en:
These Asvins with our homage, these Two Omnipresent Deities
Hitherward will we bring for kind help, these who seek the dwelling of the worshipper.

verses.sa:
युवो रथस्य परि चक्रमीयत ईर्मान्यद्वामिषण्यति ।
अस्माँ अच्छा सुमतिर्वां शुभस्पती आ धेनुरिव धावतु ॥
verses.rom:
yuvo rathasya pari chakramiyata irmanyadvamishanyati |
asman achchha sumatirvam shubhaspati a dhenuriva dhavatu ||
verses.en:
One of your chariot wheels is moving swiftly round, one speeds for you its onward course.
Like a milch-cow, O Lords of splendour, and with haste let your benevolence come to us.

verses.sa:
रथो यो वां त्रिवन्धुरो हिरण्याभीशुरश्विना ।
परि द्यावापृथिवी भूषति श्रुतस्तेन नासत्या गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ratho yo vam trivandhuro hiranyabhishurashvina |
pari dyavaprithivi bhushati shrutastena nasatya gatam ||
verses.en:
That chariot of yours which hath a triple seat and reins of gold,
The famous car that traverseth the heaven and earth, thereon Nasatyas, Asvins, come.

verses.sa:
दशस्यन्ता मनवे पूर्व्यं दिवि यवं वृकेण कर्षथः ।
ता वामद्य सुमतिभिः शुभस्पती अश्विना प्र स्तुवीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
dashasyanta manave purvyam divi yavam vrikena karshathah |
ta vamadya sumatibhih shubhaspati ashvina pra stuvimahi ||
verses.en:
Ye with your plough, when favouring Manu with your help, ploughed the first harvest in the sky.
As such will we exalt you, Lords of splendour, now, O Asvins, with our prayer and praise.

verses.sa:
उप नो वाजिनीवसू यातमृतस्य पथिभिः ।
येभिस्तृक्षिं वृषणा त्रासदस्यवं महे क्षत्राय जिन्वथः ॥
verses.rom:
upa no vajinivasu yatamritasya pathibhih |
yebhistrikshim vrishana trasadasyavam mahe kshatraya jinvathah ||
verses.en:
Come to us, Lords of ample wealth, by paths of everlasting Law,
Whereby to high dominion ye with mighty strength raised Trksi, Trasadasyu's son.

verses.sa:
अयं वामद्रिभिः सुतः सोमो नरा वृषण्वसू ।
आ यातं सोमपीतये पिबतं दाशुषो गृहे ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vamadribhih sutah somo nara vrishanvasu |
a yatam somapitaye pibatam dashusho grihe ||
verses.en:
This Soma pressed with stones is yours, ye Heroes, Lords of plenteous wealth.
Approach to drink the Soma, come, drink in the worshipper's abode.

verses.sa:
आ हि रुहतमश्विना रथे कोशे हिरण्यये वृषण्वसू ।
युञ्जाथां पीवरीरिषः ॥
verses.rom:
a hi ruhatamashvina rathe koshe hiranyaye vrishanvasu |
yunjatham pivaririshah ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, mount the chariot, mount the golden seat, ye who are Lords of plenteous wealth,
And bring to us abundant food.

verses.sa:
याभिः पक्थमवथो याभिरध्रिगुं याभिर्बभ्रुं विजोषसम् ।
ताभिर्नो मक्षू तूयमश्विना गतं भिषज्यतं यदातुरम् ॥
verses.rom:
yabhih pakthamavatho yabhiradhrigum yabhirbabhrum vijoshasam |
tabhirno makshu tuyamashvina gatam bhishajyatam yadaturam ||
verses.en:
The aids wherewith ye helped Paktha and Adhrigt;, and Babhru severed from his friends,-
With those, O Asvins, come hither with speed and soon, and heal whatever is diseased.

verses.sa:
यदध्रिगावो अध्रिगू इदा चिदह्नो अश्विना हवामहे ।
वयं गीर्भिर्विपन्यवः ॥
verses.rom:
yadadhrigavo adhrigu ida chidahno ashvina havamahe |
vayam girbhirvipanyavah ||
verses.en:
When we continually invoke the Asvins, the resistless, at this time of day,
We lovers of the song, with songs.

verses.sa:
ताभिरा यातं वृषणोप मे हवं विश्वप्सुं विश्ववार्यम् ।
इषा मंहिष्ठा पुरुभूतमा नरा याभिः क्रिविं वावृधुस्ताभिरा गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
tabhira yatam vrishanopa me havam vishvapsum vishvavaryam |
isha mamhishtha purubhutama nara yabhih krivim vavridhustabhira gatam ||
verses.en:
Through these, ye Mighty Ones, come hither to my call which brings all blessings, wears all forms,-
Through which, All-present Heroes, lavishest of food ye strengthened Krvi, come through these.

verses.sa:
ताविदा चिदहानां तावश्विना वन्दमान उप ब्रुवे ।
ता उ नमोभिरीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
tavida chidahanam tavashvina vandamana upa bruve |
ta u namobhirimahe ||
verses.en:
I speak to both of these as such, these Asvins whom I reverence at this time of day:
With homage we entreat them both.

verses.sa:
ताविद्दोषा ता उषसि शुभस्पती ता यामन्रुद्रवर्तनी ।
मा नो मर्ताय रिपवे वाजिनीवसू परो रुद्रावति ख्यतम् ॥
verses.rom:
taviddosha ta ushasi shubhaspati ta yamanrudravartani |
ma no martaya ripave vajinivasu paro rudravati khyatam ||
verses.en:
Ye who are Lords of splendour, ye whose paths are red, at eve, at mom, at sacrifice,
Give us not utterly as prey to mortal foe, ye Rudras, Lords of ample wealth.

verses.sa:
आ सुग्म्याय सुग्म्यं प्राता रथेनाश्विना वा सक्षणी ।
हुवे पितेव सोभरी ॥
verses.rom:
a sugmyaya sugmyam prata rathenashvina va sakshani |
huve piteva sobhari ||
verses.en:
For bliss I call. the blissful car, at morn the inseparable Asvins with their car
I call, like Sobhari our sire.

verses.sa:
मनोजवसा वृषणा मदच्युता मक्षुंगमाभिरूतिभिः ।
आरात्ताच्चिद्भूतमस्मे अवसे पूर्वीभिः पुरुभोजसा ॥
verses.rom:
manojavasa vrishana madachyuta makshumgamabhirutibhih |
arattachchidbhutamasme avase purvibhih purubhojasa ||
verses.en:
Rapid as thought, and strong, and speeding to the joy, bringing your swiftly-coming help,
Be to us a protection even from far away Lords of great wealth, with many aids.'

verses.sa:
आ नो अश्वावदश्विना वर्तिर्यासिष्टं मधुपातमा नरा ।
गोमद्दस्रा हिरण्यवत् ॥
verses.rom:
a no ashvavadashvina vartiryasishtam madhupatama nara |
gomaddasra hiranyavat ||
verses.en:
Come, Wonder-Workers, to our home, our home, O Asvins, rich in cattle, steeds, and gold,
Chief drinkers of the Soma's juice

verses.sa:
सुप्रावर्गं सुवीर्यं सुष्ठु वार्यमनाधृष्टं रक्षस्विना ।
अस्मिन्ना वामायाने वाजिनीवसू विश्वा वामानि धीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
supravargam suviryam sushthu varyamanadhrishtam rakshasvina |
asminna vamayane vajinivasu vishva vamani dhimahi ||
verses.en:
Choice-worthy strength, heroic, firm and excellent, uninjured by the Raksas foe,
At this your coming nigh, ye Lords of ample wealth and all good things, may we obtain.

verses.sa:
ईळिष्वा हि प्रतीव्यं यजस्व जातवेदसम् ।
चरिष्णुधूममगृभीतशोचिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
ilishva hi prativyam yajasva jatavedasam |
charishnudhumamagribhitashochisham ||
verses.en:
WORSHIP thou Jatavedas, pray to him who willingly accepts,
Whose smoke wanders at will, and none may grasp his flame.

verses.sa:
दामानं विश्वचर्षणेऽग्निं विश्वमनो गिरा ।
उत स्तुषे विष्पर्धसो रथानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
damanam vishvacharshane'gnim vishvamano gira |
uta stushe vishpardhaso rathanam ||
verses.en:
Thou, all men's friend, Visvamanas, exaltest Agni with thy song,
The Giver, and his flames with which no cars contend.

verses.sa:
येषामाबाध ऋग्मिय इषः पृक्षश्च निग्रभे ।
उपविदा वह्निर्विन्दते वसु ॥
verses.rom:
yeshamabadha rigmiya ishah prikshashcha nigrabhe |
upavida vahnirvindate vasu ||
verses.en:
Whose resolute assault, to win vigour and food, deserves our praise,-
Through whose discovering power the priest obtaineth wealth.

verses.sa:
उदस्य शोचिरस्थाद्दीदियुषो व्यजरम् ।
तपुर्जम्भस्य सुद्युतो गणश्रियः ॥
verses.rom:
udasya shochirasthaddidiyusho vyajaram |
tapurjambhasya sudyuto ganashriyah ||
verses.en:
Up springs the imperishable flame, the flame of the Refulgent One
Most bright, with glowing jaws and glory in his train.

verses.sa:
उदु तिष्ठ स्वध्वर स्तवानो देव्या कृपा ।
अभिख्या भासा बृहता शुशुक्वनिः ॥
verses.rom:
udu tishtha svadhvara stavano devya kripa |
abhikhya bhasa brihata shushukvanih ||
verses.en:
Skilled in fair sacrifice, extolled, arise in Godlike loveliness,
Shining with lofty splendour, with effulgent light.

verses.sa:
अग्ने याहि सुशस्तिभिर्हव्या जुह्वान आनुषक् ।
यथा दूतो बभूथ हव्यवाहनः ॥
verses.rom:
agne yahi sushastibhirhavya juhvana anushak |
yatha duto babhutha havyavahanah ||
verses.en:
Called straight to our oblations, come, O Agni, through our eulogies,
As thou hast been our envoy bearing up our gifts.

verses.sa:
अग्निं वः पूर्व्यं हुवे होतारं चर्षणीनाम् ।
तमया वाचा गृणे तमु व स्तुषे ॥
verses.rom:
agnim vah purvyam huve hotaram charshaninam |
tamaya vacha grine tamu va stushe ||
verses.en:
I call your Agni, from of old Invoking Priest of living men:
Him with this song I laud and magnify for you.

verses.sa:
यज्ञेभिरद्भुतक्रतुं यं कृपा सूदयन्त इत् ।
मित्रं न जने सुधितमृतावनि ॥
verses.rom:
yajnebhiradbhutakratum yam kripa sudayanta it |
mitram na jane sudhitamritavani ||
verses.en:
Whom, wondrous wise, they animate with solemn rites and his fair form,
Kind as a friend to men who keep the holy Law.

verses.sa:
ऋतावानमृतायवो यज्ञस्य साधनं गिरा ।
उपो एनं जुजुषुर्नमसस्पदे ॥
verses.rom:
ritavanamritayavo yajnasya sadhanam gira |
upo enam jujushurnamasaspade ||
verses.en:
Him, true to Law, who perfecteth the sacrifice,. Law-loving ones!
Ye with your song have gratified in the place of prayer.

verses.sa:
अच्छा नो अङ्गिरस्तमं यज्ञासो यन्तु संयतः ।
होता यो अस्ति विक्ष्वा यशस्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
achchha no angirastamam yajnaso yantu samyatah |
hota yo asti vikshva yashastamah ||
verses.en:
May all our sacrifices go to him the truest Angiras,
Who is among mankind the most illustrious Priest.

verses.sa:
अग्ने तव त्ये अजरेन्धानासो बृहद्भाः ।
अश्वा इव वृषणस्तविषीयवः ॥
verses.rom:
agne tava tye ajarendhanaso brihadbhah |
ashva iva vrishanastavishiyavah ||
verses.en:
Imperishable Agni, thine are all these high enkindled lights,
Like horses and like stallions showing forth their strength.

verses.sa:
स त्वं न ऊर्जां पते रयिं रास्व सुवीर्यम् ।
प्राव नस्तोके तनये समत्स्वा ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvam na urjam pate rayim rasva suviryam |
prava nastoke tanaye samatsva ||
verses.en:
So give us, Lord of Power and Might, riches combined with hero strength,
And guard us with our sons and grand. sons in our frays.

verses.sa:
यद्वा उ विश्पतिः शितः सुप्रीतो मनुषो विशि ।
विश्वेदग्निः प्रति रक्षांसि सेधति ॥
verses.rom:
yadva u vishpatih shitah suprito manusho vishi |
vishvedagnih prati rakshamsi sedhati ||
verses.en:
Soon as the eager Lord of men is friendly unto Manti's race,
Agni averteth from us all the demon host.

verses.sa:
श्रुष्ट्यग्ने नवस्य मे स्तोमस्य वीर विश्पते ।
नि मायिनस्तपुषा रक्षसो दह ॥
verses.rom:
shrushtyagne navasya me stomasya vira vishpate |
ni mayinastapusha rakshaso daha ||
verses.en:
O Hero Agni, Lord of men, on hearing this new laud of mine,
Burn down the Raksasas, enchanters, with thy flame.

verses.sa:
न तस्य मायया चन रिपुरीशीत मर्त्यः ।
यो अग्नये ददाश हव्यदातिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
na tasya mayaya chana ripurishita martyah |
yo agnaye dadasha havyadatibhih ||
verses.en:
No mortal foe can e'er prevail by arts of magic over him
Who serveth Agni well with sacrificial gifts.

verses.sa:
व्यश्वस्त्वा वसुविदमुक्षण्युरप्रीणादृषिः ।
महो राये तमु त्वा समिधीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
vyashvastva vasuvidamukshanyuraprinadrishih |
maho raye tamu tva samidhimahi ||
verses.en:
Vyasva the sage, who sought the Bull, hath won thee, finder of good things:
As such may we enkindle thee for ample wealth.

verses.sa:
उशना काव्यस्त्वा नि होतारमसादयत् ।
आयजिं त्वा मनवे जातवेदसम् ॥
verses.rom:
ushana kavyastva ni hotaramasadayat |
ayajim tva manave jatavedasam ||
verses.en:
Usana Kavya stablished thee, O Agni, as Invoking Priest:
Thee, Jatavedas, Sacrificing Priest for man.

verses.sa:
विश्वे हि त्वा सजोषसो देवासो दूतमक्रत ।
श्रुष्टी देव प्रथमो यज्ञियो भुवः ॥
verses.rom:
vishve hi tva sajoshaso devaso dutamakrata |
shrushti deva prathamo yajniyo bhuvah ||
verses.en:
All Deities of one accord appointed thee their messenger:
Thou, God, through hearing, hadst first claim to sacrifice.

verses.sa:
इमं घा वीरो अमृतं दूतं कृण्वीत मर्त्यः ।
पावकं कृष्णवर्तनिं विहायसम् ॥
verses.rom:
imam gha viro amritam dutam krinvita martyah |
pavakam krishnavartanim vihayasam ||
verses.en:
Him may the mortal hero make his own immortal messenger.
Far-spreading, Purifier, him whose path is black.

verses.sa:
तं हुवेम यतस्रुचः सुभासं शुक्रशोचिषम् ।
विशामग्निमजरं प्रत्नमीड्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam huvema yatasruchah subhasam shukrashochisham |
vishamagnimajaram pratnamidyam ||
verses.en:
With lifted ladles let us call him splendid with his brilliant flame,
Men's ancient Agni, wasting not, adorable.

verses.sa:
यो अस्मै हव्यदातिभिराहुतिं मर्तोऽविधत् ।
भूरि पोषं स धत्ते वीरवद्यशः ॥
verses.rom:
yo asmai havyadatibhirahutim marto'vidhat |
bhuri posham sa dhatte viravadyashah ||
verses.en:
The man who pays the worship due to him with sacrificial gifts
Obtains both plenteous nourishment and hero fame.

verses.sa:
प्रथमं जातवेदसमग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम् ।
प्रति स्रुगेति नमसा हविष्मती ॥
verses.rom:
prathamam jatavedasamagnim yajneshu purvyam |
prati srugeti namasa havishmati ||
verses.en:
To Jatavedas Agni, chief in sacrifices, first of all
With homage goes the ladle rich with sacred gifts.

verses.sa:
आभिर्विधेमाग्नये ज्येष्ठाभिर्व्यश्ववत् ।
मंहिष्ठाभिर्मतिभिः शुक्रशोचिषे ॥
verses.rom:
abhirvidhemagnaye jyeshthabhirvyashvavat |
mamhishthabhirmatibhih shukrashochishe ||
verses.en:
Even as Vyatya did, may we with these most high and liberal hymns
Pay worship unto Agni of the splendid flame.

verses.sa:
नूनमर्च विहायसे स्तोमेभि स्थूरयूपवत् ।
ऋषे वैयश्व दम्यायाग्नये ॥
verses.rom:
nunamarcha vihayase stomebhi sthurayupavat |
rishe vaiyashva damyayagnaye ||
verses.en:
Now sing, as Sthurayupa sang, with lands to him who spreadeth far,
To Agni of the home, O Rsi, Vyasva's son.

verses.sa:
अतिथिं मानुषाणां सूनुं वनस्पतीनाम् ।
विप्रा अग्निमवसे प्रत्नमीळते ॥
verses.rom:
atithim manushanam sunum vanaspatinam |
vipra agnimavase pratnamilate ||
verses.en:
As welcome guest of human kind, as offspring of the forest kings,
The sages worship ancient Agni for his aid.

verses.sa:
महो विश्वाँ अभि षतोऽभि हव्यानि मानुषा ।
अग्ने नि षत्सि नमसाधि बर्हिषि ॥
verses.rom:
maho vishvan abhi shato'bhi havyani manusha |
agne ni shatsi namasadhi barhishi ||
verses.en:
For men's oblations brought to him who is the mighty Lord of all,
Sit, Agni, mid our homage, on the sacred grass.

verses.sa:
वंस्वा नो वार्या पुरु वंस्व रायः पुरुस्पृहः ।
सुवीर्यस्य प्रजावतो यशस्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
vamsva no varya puru vamsva rayah purusprihah |
suviryasya prajavato yashasvatah ||
verses.en:
Grant us abundant. treasures, grant the opulence which many crave,
With store of heroes, progeny, and high renown.

verses.sa:
त्वं वरो सुषाम्णेऽग्ने जनाय चोदय ।
सदा वसो रातिं यविष्ठ शश्वते ॥
verses.rom:
tvam varo sushamne'gne janaya chodaya |
sada vaso ratim yavishtha shashvate ||
verses.en:
Agni, Most Youthful of the Gods, send evermore the gift of wealth
Unto Varosusaman and to all his folk.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि सुप्रतूरसि त्वं नो गोमतीरिषः ।
महो रायः सातिमग्ने अपा वृधि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi supraturasi tvam no gomatirishah |
maho rayah satimagne apa vridhi ||
verses.en:
A mighty Conqueror art thou, O Agni, so disclose to us
Food in our herds of kine and gain of ample wealth.

verses.sa:
अग्ने त्वं यशा अस्या मित्रावरुणा वह ।
ऋतावाना सम्राजा पूतदक्षसा ॥
verses.rom:
agne tvam yasha asya mitravaruna vaha |
ritavana samraja putadakshasa ||
verses.en:
Thou, Agni, art a glorious God: bring hither Mitra, Varuna,
Imperial Sovrans, holy-minded, true to Law.

verses.sa:
सखाय आ शिषामहि ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वज्रिणे ।
स्तुष ऊ षु वो नृतमाय धृष्णवे ॥
verses.rom:
sakhaya a shishamahi brahmendraya vajrine |
stusha u shu vo nritamaya dhrishnave ||
verses.en:
COMPANIONS, let us learn a prayer to Indra, whom the thunder arms,
To glorify your bold and most heroic Friend.

verses.sa:
शवसा ह्यसि श्रुतो वृत्रहत्येन वृत्रहा ।
मघैर्मघोनो अति शूर दाशसि ॥
verses.rom:
shavasa hyasi shruto vritrahatyena vritraha |
maghairmaghono ati shura dashasi ||
verses.en:
For thou by slaying Vrtra art the Vrtra-slayer, famed for might.
Thou, Hero, in rich gifts surpassest wealthy chiefs.

verses.sa:
स न स्तवान आ भर रयिं चित्रश्रवस्तमम् ।
निरेके चिद्यो हरिवो वसुर्ददिः ॥
verses.rom:
sa na stavana a bhara rayim chitrashravastamam |
nireke chidyo harivo vasurdadih ||
verses.en:
As such, when glorified, bring us riches of very wondrous fame,
Set in the highest rank, Wealth-giver, Lord of Bays!

verses.sa:
आ निरेकमुत प्रियमिन्द्र दर्षि जनानाम् ।
धृषता धृष्णो स्तवमान आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
a nirekamuta priyamindra darshi jananam |
dhrishata dhrishno stavamana a bhara ||
verses.en:
Yea, Indra, thou disclosest that preeminent dear wealth of men:
Boldly, O Bold One, glorified, bring it to us.

verses.sa:
न ते सव्यं न दक्षिणं हस्तं वरन्त आमुरः ।
न परिबाधो हरिवो गविष्टिषु ॥
verses.rom:
na te savyam na dakshinam hastam varanta amurah |
na paribadho harivo gavishtishu ||
verses.en:
The workers of destruction stay neither thy right hand nor thy left:
Nor hosts that press about thee, Lord of Bays, in fight.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा गोभिरिव व्रजं गीर्भिरृणोम्यद्रिवः ।
आ स्मा कामं जरितुरा मनः पृण ॥
verses.rom:
a tva gobhiriva vrajam girbhirrinomyadrivah |
a sma kamam jaritura manah prina ||
verses.en:
O Thunder-armed, I come with songs to thee as to a stall with kine:
Fulfil the wish and thought of him who sings thy praise.

verses.sa:
विश्वानि विश्वमनसो धिया नो वृत्रहन्तम ।
उग्र प्रणेतरधि षू वसो गहि ॥
verses.rom:
vishvani vishvamanaso dhiya no vritrahantama |
ugra pranetaradhi shu vaso gahi ||
verses.en:
Chief Vrtra-slayer, through the hymn of Visvamanas think of all,
All that concerneth us, Excellent, Mighty Guide.

verses.sa:
वयं ते अस्य वृत्रहन्विद्याम शूर नव्यसः ।
वसो स्पार्हस्य पुरुहूत राधसः ॥
verses.rom:
vayam te asya vritrahanvidyama shura navyasah |
vaso sparhasya puruhuta radhasah ||
verses.en:
May we, O Vrtra-slayer, O Hero, find this thy newest boon,
Longed-for, and excellent, thou who art much invoked!

verses.sa:
इन्द्र यथा ह्यस्ति तेऽपरीतं नृतो शवः ।
अमृक्ता रातिः पुरुहूत दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
indra yatha hyasti te'paritam nrito shavah |
amrikta ratih puruhuta dashushe ||
verses.en:
O Indra, Dancer, Much-invoked! as thy great power is unsurpassed,
So be thy bounty to the worshipper unchecked.

verses.sa:
आ वृषस्व महामह महे नृतम राधसे ।
दृळ्हश्चिद्दृह्य मघवन्मघत्तये ॥
verses.rom:
a vrishasva mahamaha mahe nritama radhase |
drilhashchiddrihya maghavanmaghattaye ||
verses.en:
Most Mighty, most heroic One, for mighty bounty fill thee full.
Though strong, strengthen thyself to win wealth, Maghavan!

verses.sa:
नू अन्यत्रा चिदद्रिवस्त्वन्नो जग्मुराशसः ।
मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
nu anyatra chidadrivastvanno jagmurashasah |
maghavanchhagdhi tava tanna utibhih ||
verses.en:
O Thunderer, never have our prayers gone forth to any God but thee:
So help us, Maghavan, with thine assistance now.

verses.sa:
नह्यङ्ग नृतो त्वदन्यं विन्दामि राधसे ।
राये द्युम्नाय शवसे च गिर्वणः ॥
verses.rom:
nahyanga nrito tvadanyam vindami radhase |
raye dyumnaya shavase cha girvanah ||
verses.en:
For, Dancer, verily I find none else for bounty, saving thee,
For splendid wealth and power, thou Lover of the Song.

verses.sa:
एन्दुमिन्द्राय सिञ्चत पिबाति सोम्यं मधु ।
प्र राधसा चोदयाते महित्वना ॥
verses.rom:
endumindraya sinchata pibati somyam madhu |
pra radhasa chodayate mahitvana ||
verses.en:
For Indra pour ye out the drops meath blent with Soma let him drink
With bounty and with majesty will he further us.

verses.sa:
उपो हरीणां पतिं दक्षं पृञ्चन्तमब्रवम् ।
नूनं श्रुधि स्तुवतो अश्व्यस्य ॥
verses.rom:
upo harinam patim daksham princhantamabravam |
nunam shrudhi stuvato ashvyasya ||
verses.en:
I spake to the Bay Coursers' Lord, to him who gives ability:
Now hear the son of Asva as he praises thee.

verses.sa:
नह्यङ्ग पुरा चन जज्ञे वीरतरस्त्वत् ।
नकी राया नैवथा न भन्दना ॥
verses.rom:
nahyanga pura chana jajne viratarastvat |
naki raya naivatha na bhandana ||
verses.en:
Never was any Hero born before thee mightier than thou:
None certainly like thee in goodness and in wealth.

verses.sa:
एदु मध्वो मदिन्तरं सिञ्च वाध्वर्यो अन्धसः ।
एवा हि वीर स्तवते सदावृधः ॥
verses.rom:
edu madhvo madintaram sincha vadhvaryo andhasah |
eva hi vira stavate sadavridhah ||
verses.en:
O ministering priest, pour out of the sweet juice what gladdens most:
So is the Hero praised who ever prospers us.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र स्थातर्हरीणां नकिष्टे पूर्व्यस्तुतिम् ।
उदानंश शवसा न भन्दना ॥
verses.rom:
indra sthatarharinam nakishte purvyastutim |
udanamsha shavasa na bhandana ||
verses.en:
Indra, whom Tawny Coursers bear, praise such as thine, preeminent,
None by his power or by his goodness hath attained.

verses.sa:
तं वो वाजानां पतिमहूमहि श्रवस्यवः ।
अप्रायुभिर्यज्ञेभिर्वावृधेन्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam vo vajanam patimahumahi shravasyavah |
aprayubhiryajnebhirvavridhenyam ||
verses.en:
We, seeking glory, have invoked this Master of all power and might
Who must be glorified by constant sacrifice.

verses.sa:
एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवाम सखाय स्तोम्यं नरम् ।
कृष्टीर्यो विश्वा अभ्यस्त्येक इत् ॥
verses.rom:
eto nvindram stavama sakhaya stomyam naram |
krishtiryo vishva abhyastyeka it ||
verses.en:
Come, sing we praise to Indra, friends, the Hero who deserves the laud,
Him who with none to aid o'ercomes all tribes of men.

verses.sa:
अगोरुधाय गविषे द्युक्षाय दस्म्यं वचः ।
घृतात्स्वादीयो मधुनश्च वोचत ॥
verses.rom:
agorudhaya gavishe dyukshaya dasmyam vachah |
ghritatsvadiyo madhunashcha vochata ||
verses.en:
To him who wins the kine, who keeps no cattle back, Celestial God,
Speak wondrous speech more sweet than butter and than meath.

verses.sa:
यस्यामितानि वीर्या न राधः पर्येतवे ।
ज्योतिर्न विश्वमभ्यस्ति दक्षिणा ॥
verses.rom:
yasyamitani virya na radhah paryetave |
jyotirna vishvamabhyasti dakshina ||
verses.en:
Whose hero powers are measureless, whose bounty ne'er may be surpassed,
Whose liberality, like light, is over all.

verses.sa:
स्तुहीन्द्रं व्यश्ववदनूर्मिं वाजिनं यमम् ।
अर्यो गयं मंहमानं वि दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
stuhindram vyashvavadanurmim vajinam yamam |
aryo gayam mamhamanam vi dashushe ||
verses.en:
As Vyasva did, praise Indra, praise the Strong unfluctuating Guide,
Who gives the foe's possessions to the worshipper.

verses.sa:
एवा नूनमुप स्तुहि वैयश्व दशमं नवम् ।
सुविद्वांसं चर्कृत्यं चरणीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
eva nunamupa stuhi vaiyashva dashamam navam |
suvidvamsam charkrityam charaninam ||
verses.en:
Now, son of Vyasva, praise thou him who to the tenth time still is new,
The very Wise, whom living men must glorify

verses.sa:
वेत्था हि निरृतीनां वज्रहस्त परिवृजम् ।
अहरहः शुन्ध्युः परिपदामिव ॥
verses.rom:
vettha hi nirritinam vajrahasta parivrijam |
aharahah shundhyuh paripadamiva ||
verses.en:
Thou knowest, Indra, Thunder-armed, how to avoid destructive powers,
As one secure from pitfalls each returning day.

verses.sa:
तदिन्द्राव आ भर येना दंसिष्ठ कृत्वने ।
द्विता कुत्साय शिश्नथो नि चोदय ॥
verses.rom:
tadindrava a bhara yena damsishtha kritvane |
dvita kutsaya shishnatho ni chodaya ||
verses.en:
O Indra, bring that aid wherewith of old, Most Wondrous! thou didst slay
His foes for active Kutsa: send it down to us.

verses.sa:
तमु त्वा नूनमीमहे नव्यं दंसिष्ठ सन्यसे ।
स त्वं नो विश्वा अभिमातीः सक्षणिः ॥
verses.rom:
tamu tva nunamimahe navyam damsishtha sanyase |
sa tvam no vishva abhimatih sakshanih ||
verses.en:
So now we seek thee fresh in might, Most Wonderful in act! for gain:
For thou art he who conquers all our foes for us.

verses.sa:
य ऋक्षादंहसो मुचद्यो वार्यात्सप्त सिन्धुषु ।
वधर्दासस्य तुविनृम्ण नीनमः ॥
verses.rom:
ya rikshadamhaso muchadyo varyatsapta sindhushu |
vadhardasasya tuvinrimna ninamah ||
verses.en:
Who will set free from ruinous woe, or Arya on the Seven Streams:
O valiant Hero, bend the Dasa's weapon down.

verses.sa:
यथा वरो सुषाम्णे सनिभ्य आवहो रयिम् ।
व्यश्वेभ्यः सुभगे वाजिनीवति ॥
verses.rom:
yatha varo sushamne sanibhya avaho rayim |
vyashvebhyah subhage vajinivati ||
verses.en:
As to Varosusaman thou broughtest great riches, for their gain,
To Vyasva's sons, Blest Lady, rich in ample wealth!

verses.sa:
आ नार्यस्य दक्षिणा व्यश्वाँ एतु सोमिनः ।
स्थूरं च राधः शतवत्सहस्रवत् ॥
verses.rom:
a naryasya dakshina vyashvan etu sominah |
sthuram cha radhah shatavatsahasravat ||
verses.en:
Let Narya's sacrificial meed reach Vyasva's Soma-bearing sons:
In hundreds and in thousands be the great reward.

verses.sa:
यत्त्वा पृच्छादीजानः कुहया कुहयाकृते ।
एषो अपश्रितो वलो गोमतीमव तिष्ठति ॥
verses.rom:
yattva prichchhadijanah kuhaya kuhayakrite |
esho apashrito valo gomatimava tishthati ||
verses.en:
If one should ask thee, Where is he who sacrificed? Whither lookest thou?
Like Vala he hath passed away and dwelleth now on Gomati.

verses.sa:
ता वां विश्वस्य गोपा देवा देवेषु यज्ञिया ।
ऋतावाना यजसे पूतदक्षसा ॥
verses.rom:
ta vam vishvasya gopa deva deveshu yajniya |
ritavana yajase putadakshasa ||
verses.en:
I WORSHIP you who guard this All, Gods, holiest among the Gods,
You, faithful to the Law, whose power is sanctified.

verses.sa:
मित्रा तना न रथ्या वरुणो यश्च सुक्रतुः ।
सनात्सुजाता तनया धृतव्रता ॥
verses.rom:
mitra tana na rathya varuno yashcha sukratuh |
sanatsujata tanaya dhritavrata ||
verses.en:
So, too, like charioteers are they, Mitra and sapient Varuna,
Sons high-born from of old, whose holy laws stand fast.

verses.sa:
ता माता विश्ववेदसासुर्याय प्रमहसा ।
मही जजानादितिरृतावरी ॥
verses.rom:
ta mata vishvavedasasuryaya pramahasa |
mahi jajanaditirritavari ||
verses.en:
These Twain, possessors of all wealth, most glorious, for supremest sway
Aditi, Mighty Mother, true to Law, brought forth.

verses.sa:
महान्ता मित्रावरुणा सम्राजा देवावसुरा ।
ऋतावानावृतमा घोषतो बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
mahanta mitravaruna samraja devavasura |
ritavanavritama ghoshato brihat ||
verses.en:
Great Varuna and Mitra, Gods, Asuras and imperial Lords,
True to Eternal Law proclaim the high decree.

verses.sa:
नपाता शवसो महः सूनू दक्षस्य सुक्रतू ।
सृप्रदानू इषो वास्त्वधि क्षितः ॥
verses.rom:
napata shavaso mahah sunu dakshasya sukratu |
sripradanu isho vastvadhi kshitah ||
verses.en:
The offspring of a lofty Power, Daksa's Two Sons exceeding strong,
Who, Lords of flowing rain, dwell in the place of food.

verses.sa:
सं या दानूनि येमथुर्दिव्याः पार्थिवीरिषः ।
नभस्वतीरा वां चरन्तु वृष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
sam ya danuni yemathurdivyah parthivirishah |
nabhasvatira vam charantu vrishtayah ||
verses.en:
Ye who have gathered up your gifts, celestial and terrestrial food,
Let your rain come to us fraught with the mist of heaven.

verses.sa:
अधि या बृहतो दिवोऽभि यूथेव पश्यतः ।
ऋतावाना सम्राजा नमसे हिता ॥
verses.rom:
adhi ya brihato divo'bhi yutheva pashyatah |
ritavana samraja namase hita ||
verses.en:
The Twain, who from the lofty sky seem to look down on herds below,
Holy, imperial Lords, are set to be revered.

verses.sa:
ऋतावाना नि षेदतुः साम्राज्याय सुक्रतू ।
धृतव्रता क्षत्रिया क्षत्रमाशतुः ॥
verses.rom:
ritavana ni shedatuh samrajyaya sukratu |
dhritavrata kshatriya kshatramashatuh ||
verses.en:
They, true to Law, exceeding strong, have sat them down for Savran rule:
Princes whose laws stand fast, they have obtained their sway.

verses.sa:
अक्ष्णश्चिद्गातुवित्तरानुल्बणेन चक्षसा ।
नि चिन्मिषन्ता निचिरा नि चिक्यतुः ॥
verses.rom:
akshnashchidgatuvittaranulbanena chakshasa |
ni chinmishanta nichira ni chikyatuh ||
verses.en:
Pathfinders even better than the eye, with unobstructed sight,
Even when they close their lids, observant, they perceive.

verses.sa:
उत नो देव्यदितिरुरुष्यतां नासत्या ।
उरुष्यन्तु मरुतो वृद्धशवसः ॥
verses.rom:
uta no devyaditirurushyatam nasatya |
urushyantu maruto vriddhashavasah ||
verses.en:
So may the Goddess Aditi, may the Nasatyas guard us well,
The Maruts guard us well endowed with mighty strength.

verses.sa:
ते नो नावमुरुष्यत दिवा नक्तं सुदानवः ।
अरिष्यन्तो नि पायुभिः सचेमहि ॥
verses.rom:
te no navamurushyata diva naktam sudanavah |
arishyanto ni payubhih sachemahi ||
verses.en:
Do ye, O Bounteous Gods, protect our dwelling lace by day and night:
With you for our defenders may we go unharmed.

verses.sa:
अघ्नते विष्णवे वयमरिष्यन्तः सुदानवे ।
श्रुधि स्वयावन्सिन्धो पूर्वचित्तये ॥
verses.rom:
aghnate vishnave vayamarishyantah sudanave |
shrudhi svayavansindho purvachittaye ||
verses.en:
May we, unharmed, serve bountiful Visnu, the God who slayeth none:
Self-moving Sindhu hear and be the first to mark.

verses.sa:
तद्वार्यं वृणीमहे वरिष्ठं गोपयत्यम् ।
मित्रो यत्पान्ति वरुणो यदर्यमा ॥
verses.rom:
tadvaryam vrinimahe varishtham gopayatyam |
mitro yatpanti varuno yadaryama ||
verses.en:
This sure protection we elect, desirable and reaching far,
Which Mitra, Varuna, and Aryaman afford.

verses.sa:
उत नः सिन्धुरपां तन्मरुतस्तदश्विना ।
इन्द्रो विष्णुर्मीढ्वांसः सजोषसः ॥
verses.rom:
uta nah sindhurapam tanmarutastadashvina |
indro vishnurmidhvamsah sajoshasah ||
verses.en:
And may the Sindhu of the floods, the Maruts, and the ASvin Pair,
Boon Indra, and boon Visnu have one mind with us.

verses.sa:
ते हि ष्मा वनुषो नरोऽभिमातिं कयस्य चित् ।
तिग्मं न क्षोदः प्रतिघ्नन्ति भूर्णयः ॥
verses.rom:
te hi shma vanusho naro'bhimatim kayasya chit |
tigmam na kshodah pratighnanti bhurnayah ||
verses.en:
Because these warring Heroes stay the enmity of every foe,
As the fierce water-flood repels the furious ones.

verses.sa:
अयमेक इत्था पुरूरु चष्टे वि विश्पतिः ।
तस्य व्रतान्यनु वश्चरामसि ॥
verses.rom:
ayameka ittha pururu chashte vi vishpatih |
tasya vratanyanu vashcharamasi ||
verses.en:
Here this one God, the Lord of men, looks forth exceeding far and wide:
And we, for your advantage, keep his holy laws.

verses.sa:
अनु पूर्वाण्योक्या साम्राज्यस्य सश्चिम ।
मित्रस्य व्रता वरुणस्य दीर्घश्रुत् ॥
verses.rom:
anu purvanyokya samrajyasya sashchima |
mitrasya vrata varunasya dirghashrut ||
verses.en:
We keep the old accustomed laws, the statutes of supremacy,
The Iong-known laws of Mitra and of Varuna.

verses.sa:
परि यो रश्मिना दिवोऽन्तान्ममे पृथिव्याः ।
उभे आ पप्रौ रोदसी महित्वा ॥
verses.rom:
pari yo rashmina divo'ntanmame prithivyah |
ubhe a paprau rodasi mahitva ||
verses.en:
He who hath measured with his ray the boundaries of heaven and earth,
And with his majesty hath filled the two worlds full,

verses.sa:
उदु ष्य शरणे दिवो ज्योतिरयंस्त सूर्यः ।
अग्निर्न शुक्रः समिधान आहुतः ॥
verses.rom:
udu shya sharane divo jyotirayamsta suryah |
agnirna shukrah samidhana ahutah ||
verses.en:
Surya hath spread his light aloft up to the region of the sky,
Like Agni all aflame when gifts are offered him.

verses.sa:
वचो दीर्घप्रसद्मनीशे वाजस्य गोमतः ।
ईशे हि पित्वोऽविषस्य दावने ॥
verses.rom:
vacho dirghaprasadmanishe vajasya gomatah |
ishe hi pitvo'vishasya davane ||
verses.en:
With him who sits afar the word is lord of food that comes from kine,
Controller of the gift of unempoisoned food.

verses.sa:
तत्सूर्यं रोदसी उभे दोषा वस्तोरुप ब्रुवे ।
भोजेष्वस्माँ अभ्युच्चरा सदा ॥
verses.rom:
tatsuryam rodasi ubhe dosha vastorupa bruve |
bhojeshvasman abhyuchchara sada ||
verses.en:
So unto Surya, Heaven, and Earth at morning and at eve I speak.
Bringing enjoyments ever rise thou up for us.

verses.sa:
ऋज्रमुक्षण्यायने रजतं हरयाणे ।
रथं युक्तमसनाम सुषामणि ॥
verses.rom:
rijramukshanyayane rajatam harayane |
ratham yuktamasanama sushamani ||
verses.en:
From Uksanyayana a bay, from Harayana a white steed,
And from Susaman we obtained a hamessed car.

verses.sa:
ता मे अश्व्यानां हरीणां नितोशना ।
उतो नु कृत्व्यानां नृवाहसा ॥
verses.rom:
ta me ashvyanam harinam nitoshana |
uto nu kritvyanam nrivahasa ||
verses.en:
These two shall bring me further gain of troops of tawny-coloured steeds,
The carriers shall they be of active men of war.

verses.sa:
स्मदभीशू कशावन्ता विप्रा नविष्ठया मती ।
महो वाजिनावर्वन्ता सचासनम् ॥
verses.rom:
smadabhishu kashavanta vipra navishthaya mati |
maho vajinavarvanta sachasanam ||
verses.en:
And the two sages have I gained who hold the reins and bear the whip,
And the two great strong coursers, with my newest song.

verses.sa:
युवोरु षू रथं हुवे सधस्तुत्याय सूरिषु ।
अतूर्तदक्षा वृषणा वृषण्वसू ॥
verses.rom:
yuvoru shu ratham huve sadhastutyaya surishu |
aturtadaksha vrishana vrishanvasu ||
verses.en:
I CALL your chariot to receive united praise mid princely men,
Strong Gods who pour down wealth, of never vanquished might!

verses.sa:
युवं वरो सुषाम्णे महे तने नासत्या ।
अवोभिर्याथो वृषणा वृषण्वसू ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam varo sushamne mahe tane nasatya |
avobhiryatho vrishana vrishanvasu ||
verses.en:
Ye to Varosusaman come, Nasatyas, for this glorious rite.
With your protecting aid. Strong Gods, who pour down wealth.

verses.sa:
ता वामद्य हवामहे हव्येभिर्वाजिनीवसू ।
पूर्वीरिष इषयन्तावति क्षपः ॥
verses.rom:
ta vamadya havamahe havyebhirvajinivasu |
purvirisha ishayantavati kshapah ||
verses.en:
So with oblations we invoke you, rich in ample wealth, to-day,
When night hath passed, O ye who send us plenteous food.

verses.sa:
आ वां वाहिष्ठो अश्विना रथो यातु श्रुतो नरा ।
उप स्तोमान्तुरस्य दर्शथः श्रिये ॥
verses.rom:
a vam vahishtho ashvina ratho yatu shruto nara |
upa stomanturasya darshathah shriye ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, Heroes, let your car, famed, best to travel, come to us,
And, for his glory, mark your zealous servant's lauds.

verses.sa:
जुहुराणा चिदश्विना मन्येथां वृषण्वसू ।
युवं हि रुद्रा पर्षथो अति द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
juhurana chidashvina manyetham vrishanvasu |
yuvam hi rudra parshatho ati dvishah ||
verses.en:
Asvins, who send us precious gifts, even when offended, think of him:
For ye, O Rudras, lead us safe beyond our foes.

verses.sa:
दस्रा हि विश्वमानुषङ्मक्षूभिः परिदीयथः ।
धियंजिन्वा मधुवर्णा शुभस्पती ॥
verses.rom:
dasra hi vishvamanushanmakshubhih paridiyathah |
dhiyamjinva madhuvarna shubhaspati ||
verses.en:
For, Wonder-Workers, with fleet steeds ye fly completely round this All,
Stirring our thoughts, ye Lords of splendour, honey-hued.

verses.sa:
उप नो यातमश्विना राया विश्वपुषा सह ।
मघवाना सुवीरावनपच्युता ॥
verses.rom:
upa no yatamashvina raya vishvapusha saha |
maghavana suviravanapachyuta ||
verses.en:
With all-sustaining opulence, Asvins, come hitherward to us,
Ye rich and noble Heroes, ne'er to be o'erthrown.

verses.sa:
आ मे अस्य प्रतीव्यमिन्द्रनासत्या गतम् ।
देवा देवेभिरद्य सचनस्तमा ॥
verses.rom:
a me asya prativyamindranasatya gatam |
deva devebhiradya sachanastama ||
verses.en:
To welcome this mine offering, O ye Indra-like Nasatyas, come
As Gods of best accord this day with other Gods.

verses.sa:
वयं हि वां हवामह उक्षण्यन्तो व्यश्ववत् ।
सुमतिभिरुप विप्राविहा गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
vayam hi vam havamaha ukshanyanto vyashvavat |
sumatibhirupa vipraviha gatam ||
verses.en:
For we, like Vyasva, lifting up our voice like oxen, call on you:
With all your loving kindness, Sages, come to us.

verses.sa:
अश्विना स्वृषे स्तुहि कुवित्ते श्रवतो हवम् ।
नेदीयसः कूळयातः पणीँरुत ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina svrishe stuhi kuvitte shravato havam |
nediyasah kulayatah paninruta ||
verses.en:
O Rsi, laud the Asvins well. Will they not listen to thy call?
Will they not burn the Panis who are nearer them?

verses.sa:
वैयश्वस्य श्रुतं नरोतो मे अस्य वेदथः ।
सजोषसा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ॥
verses.rom:
vaiyashvasya shrutam naroto me asya vedathah |
sajoshasa varuno mitro aryama ||
verses.en:
O Heroes, listen to the son of Vyasva, and regard me here,
Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, of one accord.

verses.sa:
युवादत्तस्य धिष्ण्या युवानीतस्य सूरिभिः ।
अहरहर्वृषण मह्यं शिक्षतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvadattasya dhishnya yuvanitasya suribhih |
aharaharvrishana mahyam shikshatam ||
verses.en:
Gods whom we yearn for, of your gifts, of what ye bring to us, bestow
By princes' hands on me, ye Mighty, day by day.

verses.sa:
यो वां यज्ञेभिरावृतोऽधिवस्त्रा वधूरिव ।
सपर्यन्ता शुभे चक्राते अश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
yo vam yajnebhiravrito'dhivastra vadhuriva |
saparyanta shubhe chakrate ashvina ||
verses.en:
Him whom your sacrifices clothe, even as a woman with her robe,
The Asvins help to glory honouring him well.

verses.sa:
यो वामुरुव्यचस्तमं चिकेतति नृपाय्यम् ।
वर्तिरश्विना परि यातमस्मयू ॥
verses.rom:
yo vamuruvyachastamam chiketati nripayyam |
vartirashvina pari yatamasmayu ||
verses.en:
Whoso regards your care of men as succour widest in its reach,
About his dwelling go, ye Asvins, loving us.

verses.sa:
अस्मभ्यं सु वृषण्वसू यातं वर्तिर्नृपाय्यम् ।
विषुद्रुहेव यज्ञमूहथुर्गिरा ॥
verses.rom:
asmabhyam su vrishanvasu yatam vartirnripayyam |
vishudruheva yajnamuhathurgira ||
verses.en:
Come to us ye who pour down wealth, come to the home which men must guard:
Like shafts, ye are made meet for sacrifice by song.

verses.sa:
वाहिष्ठो वां हवानां स्तोमो दूतो हुवन्नरा ।
युवाभ्यां भूत्वश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
vahishtho vam havanam stomo duto huvannara |
yuvabhyam bhutvashvina ||
verses.en:
Most fetching of all calls, the laud, as envoy, Heroes, called to you
Be it your own, O Asvin Pair.

verses.sa:
यददो दिवो अर्णव इषो वा मदथो गृहे ।
श्रुतमिन्मे अमर्त्या ॥
verses.rom:
yadado divo arnava isho va madatho grihe |
shrutaminme amartya ||
verses.en:
Be ye in yonder sea of heaven, or joying in the home of food,
Listen to me, Immortal Ones.

verses.sa:
उत स्या श्वेतयावरी वाहिष्ठा वां नदीनाम् ।
सिन्धुर्हिरण्यवर्तनिः ॥
verses.rom:
uta sya shvetayavari vahishtha vam nadinam |
sindhurhiranyavartanih ||
verses.en:
This river with his lucid flow attracts you, more than all the streams,-
Even Sindhu with his path of gold.

verses.sa:
स्मदेतया सुकीर्त्याश्विना श्वेतया धिया ।
वहेथे शुभ्रयावाना ॥
verses.rom:
smadetaya sukirtyashvina shvetaya dhiya |
vahethe shubhrayavana ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, with that glorious fame come hither, through our brilliant song,
Come ye whose ways are marked with light.

verses.sa:
युक्ष्वा हि त्वं रथासहा युवस्व पोष्या वसो ।
आन्नो वायो मधु पिबास्माकं सवना गहि ॥
verses.rom:
yukshva hi tvam rathasaha yuvasva poshya vaso |
anno vayo madhu pibasmakam savana gahi ||
verses.en:
Harness the steeds who draw the car, O Vasu, bring the well-fed pair.
O Vayu, drink thou of our meath: come unto our drink-offerings.

verses.sa:
तव वायवृतस्पते त्वष्टुर्जामातरद्भुत ।
अवांस्या वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
tava vayavritaspate tvashturjamataradbhuta |
avamsya vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Wonderful Vayu, Lord of Right, thou who art Tvastar's son-in-law,
Thy saving succour we elect.

verses.sa:
त्वष्टुर्जामातरं वयमीशानं राय ईमहे ।
सुतावन्तो वायुं द्युम्ना जनासः ॥
verses.rom:
tvashturjamataram vayamishanam raya imahe |
sutavanto vayum dyumna janasah ||
verses.en:
To Tvastar's son-in-law we pray for wealth whereof he hath control:
For glory we seek vayu, men with juice effused.

verses.sa:
वायो याहि शिवा दिवो वहस्वा सु स्वश्व्यम् ।
वहस्व महः पृथुपक्षसा रथे ॥
verses.rom:
vayo yahi shiva divo vahasva su svashvyam |
vahasva mahah prithupakshasa rathe ||
verses.en:
From heaven, auspicious Vayu, come drive hither with thy noble steeds:
Come on thy mighty car with wide-extending seat.

verses.sa:
त्वां हि सुप्सरस्तमं नृषदनेषु हूमहे ।
ग्रावाणं नाश्वपृष्ठं मंहना ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi supsarastamam nrishadaneshu humahe |
gravanam nashvaprishtham mamhana ||
verses.en:
We call thee to the homes of men, thee wealthiest in noble food,
And liberal as a press-stone with a horse's back.

verses.sa:
स त्वं नो देव मनसा वायो मन्दानो अग्रियः ।
कृधि वाजाँ अपो धियः ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvam no deva manasa vayo mandano agriyah |
kridhi vajan apo dhiyah ||
verses.en:
So, glad and joyful in thine heart, do thou, God, Vayu, first of all
Vouchsafe us water, strength, and thought.

verses.sa:
अग्निरुक्थे पुरोहितो ग्रावाणो बर्हिरध्वरे ।
ऋचा यामि मरुतो ब्रह्मणस्पतिं देवाँ अवो वरेण्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnirukthe purohito gravano barhiradhvare |
richa yami maruto brahmanaspatim devan avo varenyam ||
verses.en:
CHEIF Priest is Agni at the laud, as stones and grass at sacrifice:
With song I seek the Maruts, Brahmanaspati, Gods for help much to be desired.

verses.sa:
आ पशुं गासि पृथिवीं वनस्पतीनुषासा नक्तमोषधीः ।
विश्वे च नो वसवो विश्ववेदसो धीनां भूत प्रावितारः ॥
verses.rom:
a pashum gasi prithivim vanaspatinushasa naktamoshadhih |
vishve cha no vasavo vishvavedaso dhinam bhuta pravitarah ||
verses.en:
I sing to cattle and to Earth, to trees, to Dawns, to Night, to plants.
O all ye Vasus, ye possessors of all wealth, be ye the furtherers of our thoughts.

verses.sa:
प्र सू न एत्वध्वरोऽग्ना देवेषु पूर्व्यः ।
आदित्येषु प्र वरुणे धृतव्रते मरुत्सु विश्वभानुषु ॥
verses.rom:
pra su na etvadhvaro'gna deveshu purvyah |
adityeshu pra varune dhritavrate marutsu vishvabhanushu ||
verses.en:
Forth go, with Agni, to the Gods our sacrifice of ancient use,
To the Adityas, Varuna whose Law stands fast, and the all-lightening Marut troop.

verses.sa:
विश्वे हि ष्मा मनवे विश्ववेदसो भुवन्वृधे रिशादसः ।
अरिष्टेभिः पायुभिर्विश्ववेदसो यन्ता नोऽवृकं छर्दिः ॥
verses.rom:
vishve hi shma manave vishvavedaso bhuvanvridhe rishadasah |
arishtebhih payubhirvishvavedaso yanta no'vrikam chhardih ||
verses.en:
Lords of all wealth, may they be strengtheners of man, destroyers of his enemies.
Lords of all wealth, do ye, with guards which none may harm, preserve our dwelling free from foes.

verses.sa:
आ नो अद्य समनसो गन्ता विश्वे सजोषसः ।
ऋचा गिरा मरुतो देव्यदिते सदने पस्त्ये महि ॥
verses.rom:
a no adya samanaso ganta vishve sajoshasah |
richa gira maruto devyadite sadane pastye mahi ||
verses.en:
Come to us with one mind to-day, come to us all with one accord,
Maruts with holy song, and, Goddess Aditi, Mighty One, to our house and home.

verses.sa:
अभि प्रिया मरुतो या वो अश्व्या हव्या मित्र प्रयाथन ।
आ बर्हिरिन्द्रो वरुणस्तुरा नर आदित्यासः सदन्तु नः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi priya maruto ya vo ashvya havya mitra prayathana |
a barhirindro varunastura nara adityasah sadantu nah ||
verses.en:
Send us delightful things, ye Maruts, on your steeds: come ye, O Mitra, to our gifts.
Let Indra, Varuna, and the Adityas sit, swift Heroes, on our sacred grass.

verses.sa:
वयं वो वृक्तबर्हिषो हितप्रयस आनुषक् ।
सुतसोमासो वरुण हवामहे मनुष्वदिद्धाग्नयः ॥
verses.rom:
vayam vo vriktabarhisho hitaprayasa anushak |
sutasomaso varuna havamahe manushvadiddhagnayah ||
verses.en:
We who have trimmed the grass for you, and set the banquet in array,
And pressed the Soma, call you, Varuina, like men, with sacrificial fires aflame.

verses.sa:
आ प्र यात मरुतो विष्णो अश्विना पूषन्माकीनया धिया ।
इन्द्र आ यातु प्रथमः सनिष्युभिर्वृषा यो वृत्रहा गृणे ॥
verses.rom:
a pra yata maruto vishno ashvina pushanmakinaya dhiya |
indra a yatu prathamah sanishyubhirvrisha yo vritraha grine ||
verses.en:
O Maruts, Visinu, Asvins, Pusan, haste away with minds turned hitherward to Me.
Let the Strong Indra, famed as Vrtra's slayer, come first with the winners of the spoil.

verses.sa:
वि नो देवासो अद्रुहोऽच्छिद्रं शर्म यच्छत ।
न यद्दूराद्वसवो नू चिदन्तितो वरूथमादधर्षति ॥
verses.rom:
vi no devaso adruho'chchhidram sharma yachchhata |
na yadduradvasavo nu chidantito varuthamadadharshati ||
verses.en:
Ye Guileless Gods, bestow on us a refuge strong on every side,
A sure protection, Vasus, unassailable from near at hand or from afar.

verses.sa:
अस्ति हि वः सजात्यं रिशादसो देवासो अस्त्याप्यम् ।
प्र णः पूर्वस्मै सुविताय वोचत मक्षू सुम्नाय नव्यसे ॥
verses.rom:
asti hi vah sajatyam rishadaso devaso astyapyam |
pra nah purvasmai suvitaya vochata makshu sumnaya navyase ||
verses.en:
Kinship have I with you, and close alliance O ye Gods, destroyers of our foes.
Call us to our prosperity of former days, and soon to new felicity.

verses.sa:
इदा हि व उपस्तुतिमिदा वामस्य भक्तये ।
उप वो विश्ववेदसो नमस्युराँ असृक्ष्यन्यामिव ॥
verses.rom:
ida hi va upastutimida vamasya bhaktaye |
upa vo vishvavedaso namasyuran asrikshyanyamiva ||
verses.en:
For now have I sent forth to you, that I may win a fair reward,
Lords of all wealth, with homage, this my song of praise. like a milch-cow that faileth not.

verses.sa:
उदु ष्य वः सविता सुप्रणीतयोऽस्थादूर्ध्वो वरेण्यः ।
नि द्विपादश्चतुष्पादो अर्थिनोऽविश्रन्पतयिष्णवः ॥
verses.rom:
udu shya vah savita supranitayo'sthadurdhvo varenyah |
ni dvipadashchatushpado arthino'vishranpatayishnavah ||
verses.en:
Excellent Savitar hath mounted up on high for you, ye sure and careful Guides.
Bipeds and quadrupeds, with several hopes and aims, and birds have settled to their tasks.

verses.sa:
देवंदेवं वोऽवसे देवंदेवमभिष्टये ।
देवंदेवं हुवेम वाजसातये गृणन्तो देव्या धिया ॥
verses.rom:
devamdevam vo'vase devamdevamabhishtaye |
devamdevam huvema vajasataye grinanto devya dhiya ||
verses.en:
Singing their praise with God-like thought let us invoke each God for grace,
Each God to bring you help, each God to strengthen you.

verses.sa:
देवासो हि ष्मा मनवे समन्यवो विश्वे साकं सरातयः ।
ते नो अद्य ते अपरं तुचे तु नो भवन्तु वरिवोविदः ॥
verses.rom:
devaso hi shma manave samanyavo vishve sakam saratayah |
te no adya te aparam tuche tu no bhavantu varivovidah ||
verses.en:
For of one spirit are the Gods with mortal man, co-sharers all of gracious gifts.
May they increase our strength hereafter and to-day, providing case and ample room.

verses.sa:
प्र वः शंसाम्यद्रुहः संस्थ उपस्तुतीनाम् ।
न तं धूर्तिर्वरुण मित्र मर्त्यं यो वो धामभ्योऽविधत् ॥
verses.rom:
pra vah shamsamyadruhah samstha upastutinam |
na tam dhurtirvaruna mitra martyam yo vo dhamabhyo'vidhat ||
verses.en:
I laud you, O ye Guileless Gods, here where we meet to render praise.
None, Varuna and Mitra, harms the mortal, man who honours and obeys your laws.

verses.sa:
प्र स क्षयं तिरते वि महीरिषो यो वो वराय दाशति ।
प्र प्रजाभिर्जायते धर्मणस्पर्यरिष्टः सर्व एधते ॥
verses.rom:
pra sa kshayam tirate vi mahirisho yo vo varaya dashati |
pra prajabhirjayate dharmanasparyarishtah sarva edhate ||
verses.en:
He makes his house endure, he gathers plenteous food who pays obedience to your will.
Born in his sons anew he spreads as Law commands, and prospers every way unharmed.

verses.sa:
ऋते स विन्दते युधः सुगेभिर्यात्यध्वनः ।
अर्यमा मित्रो वरुणः सरातयो यं त्रायन्ते सजोषसः ॥
verses.rom:
rite sa vindate yudhah sugebhiryatyadhvanah |
aryama mitro varunah saratayo yam trayante sajoshasah ||
verses.en:
E'en without war he gathers wealth, and goes his way on pleasant paths,
Whom Mitra, Varuna and Aryaman protect, sharing the gift of one accord.

verses.sa:
अज्रे चिदस्मै कृणुथा न्यञ्चनं दुर्गे चिदा सुसरणम् ।
एषा चिदस्मादशनिः परो नु सास्रेधन्ती वि नश्यतु ॥
verses.rom:
ajre chidasmai krinutha nyanchanam durge chida susaranam |
esha chidasmadashanih paro nu sasredhanti vi nashyatu ||
verses.en:
E'en on the plain for him ye make a sloping path, an easy way where road is none:
And far away from him the ineffectual shaft must vanish, shot at him in vain.

verses.sa:
यदद्य सूर्य उद्यति प्रियक्षत्रा ऋतं दध ।
यन्निम्रुचि प्रबुधि विश्ववेदसो यद्वा मध्यंदिने दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
yadadya surya udyati priyakshatra ritam dadha |
yannimruchi prabudhi vishvavedaso yadva madhyamdine divah ||
verses.en:
If ye appoint the rite to-day, kind Rulers, when the Sun ascends,
Lords of all wealth, at sunset or at waking time, or be it at the noon of day,

verses.sa:
यद्वाभिपित्वे असुरा ऋतं यते छर्दिर्येम वि दाशुषे ।
वयं तद्वो वसवो विश्ववेदस उप स्थेयाम मध्य आ ॥
verses.rom:
yadvabhipitve asura ritam yate chhardiryema vi dashushe |
vayam tadvo vasavo vishvavedasa upa stheyama madhya a ||
verses.en:
Or, Asuras, when ye have sheltered the worshipper who goes to sacrifice, at eve
may we, O Vasus, ye possessors of all wealth, come then into the midst of You.

verses.sa:
यदद्य सूर उदिते यन्मध्यंदिन आतुचि ।
वामं धत्थ मनवे विश्ववेदसो जुह्वानाय प्रचेतसे ॥
verses.rom:
yadadya sura udite yanmadhyamdina atuchi |
vamam dhattha manave vishvavedaso juhvanaya prachetase ||
verses.en:
If ye to-day at sunrise, or at noon, or in the gloom of eve,
Lords of all riches, give fair treasure to the man, the wise man who hath sacrificed,

verses.sa:
वयं तद्वः सम्राज आ वृणीमहे पुत्रो न बहुपाय्यम् ।
अश्याम तदादित्या जुह्वतो हविर्येन वस्योऽनशामहै ॥
verses.rom:
vayam tadvah samraja a vrinimahe putro na bahupayyam |
ashyama tadaditya juhvato haviryena vasyo'nashamahai ||
verses.en:
Then we, imperial Rulers, claim of you this boon, your wide protection, as a son.
May we, Adityas, offering holy gifts, obtain that which shall bring us greater bliss.

verses.sa:
ये त्रिंशति त्रयस्परो देवासो बर्हिरासदन् ।
विदन्नह द्वितासनन् ॥
verses.rom:
ye trimshati trayasparo devaso barhirasadan |
vidannaha dvitasanan ||
verses.en:
THE Thirty Gods and Three besides, whose seat hath been the sacred grass,
From time of old have found and gained.

verses.sa:
वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा स्मद्रातिषाचो अग्नयः ।
पत्नीवन्तो वषट्कृताः ॥
verses.rom:
varuno mitro aryama smadratishacho agnayah |
patnivanto vashatkritah ||
verses.en:
Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman, Agnis, with Consorts, sending boons,
To whom our Vasat! is addressed:

verses.sa:
ते नो गोपा अपाच्यास्त उदक्त इत्था न्यक् ।
पुरस्तात्सर्वया विशा ॥
verses.rom:
te no gopa apachyasta udakta ittha nyak |
purastatsarvaya visha ||
verses.en:
These are our guardians in the west, and northward here, and in the south,
And on the cast, with all the tribe.

verses.sa:
यथा वशन्ति देवास्तथेदसत्तदेषां नकिरा मिनत् ।
अरावा चन मर्त्यः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha vashanti devastathedasattadesham nakira minat |
arava chana martyah ||
verses.en:
Even as the Gods desire so verily shall it be. None diminisheth this power of theirs,
No demon, and no mortal

verses.sa:
सप्तानां सप्त ऋष्टयः सप्त द्युम्नान्येषाम् ।
सप्तो अधि श्रियो धिरे ॥
verses.rom:
saptanam sapta rishtayah sapta dyumnanyesham |
sapto adhi shriyo dhire ||
verses.en:
The Seven carry seven spears; seven are the splendours they possess,
And seven the glories they assume.

verses.sa: बभ्रुरेको विषुणः सूनरो युवाञ्ज्यङ्क्ते हिरण्ययम् ॥
verses.rom: babhrureko vishunah sunaro yuvanjyankte hiranyayam ||
verses.en: ONE is a youth brown, active, manifold he decks the golden one with ornament.

verses.sa: योनिमेक आ ससाद द्योतनोऽन्तर्देवेषु मेधिरः ॥
verses.rom: yonimeka a sasada dyotano'ntardeveshu medhirah ||
verses.en: Another, luminous, occupies the place of sacrifice, Sage, among the Gods.

verses.sa: वाशीमेको बिभर्ति हस्त आयसीमन्तर्देवेषु निध्रुविः ॥
verses.rom: vashimeko bibharti hasta ayasimantardeveshu nidhruvih ||
verses.en: One brandishes in his hand an iron knife, firm, in his seat amid the Deities.

verses.sa: वज्रमेको बिभर्ति हस्त आहितं तेन वृत्राणि जिघ्नते ॥
verses.rom: vajrameko bibharti hasta ahitam tena vritrani jighnate ||
verses.en: Another holds the thunderbolt, wherewith he slays the Vrtras, resting in his hand.

verses.sa: तिग्ममेको बिभर्ति हस्त आयुधं शुचिरुग्रो जलाषभेषजः ॥
verses.rom: tigmameko bibharti hasta ayudham shuchirugro jalashabheshajah ||
verses.en: Another bears a pointed weapon: bright is he, and strong, with healing medicines.

verses.sa: पथ एकः पीपाय तस्करो यथाँ एष वेद निधीनाम् ॥
verses.rom: patha ekah pipaya taskaro yathan esha veda nidhinam ||
verses.en: Another, thief-like, watches well the ways, and knows the places where the treasures lie.

verses.sa: त्रीण्येक उरुगायो वि चक्रमे यत्र देवासो मदन्ति ॥
verses.rom: trinyeka urugayo vi chakrame yatra devaso madanti ||
verses.en: Another with his mighty stride hath made his three steps thither where the Gods rejoice.

verses.sa: विभिर्द्वा चरत एकया सह प्र प्रवासेव वसतः ॥
verses.rom: vibhirdva charata ekaya saha pra pravaseva vasatah ||
verses.en: Two with one Dame ride on with winged steeds, and journey forth like travellers on their way.

verses.sa: सदो द्वा चक्राते उपमा दिवि सम्राजा सर्पिरासुती ॥
verses.rom: sado dva chakrate upama divi samraja sarpirasuti ||
verses.en: Two, highest, in the heavens have set their seat, worshipped with holy oil, imperial Kings.

verses.sa: अर्चन्त एके महि साम मन्वत तेन सूर्यमरोचयन् ॥
verses.rom: archanta eke mahi sama manvata tena suryamarochayan ||
verses.en: Some, singing lauds, conceived the Sama-hymn, great hymn whereby they caused the Sun to shine.

verses.sa:
नहि वो अस्त्यर्भको देवासो न कुमारकः ।
विश्वे सतोमहान्त इत् ॥
verses.rom:
nahi vo astyarbhako devaso na kumarakah |
vishve satomahanta it ||
verses.en:
NOT one of you, ye Gods, is small, none of you is a feeble child:
All of you, verily, are great.

verses.sa:
इति स्तुतासो असथा रिशादसो ये स्थ त्रयश्च त्रिंशच्च ।
मनोर्देवा यज्ञियासः ॥
verses.rom:
iti stutaso asatha rishadaso ye stha trayashcha trimshachcha |
manordeva yajniyasah ||
verses.en:
Thus be ye lauded, ye destroyers of the foe, ye Three-and-Thirty Deities,
The Gods of man, the Holy Ones.

verses.sa:
ते नस्त्राध्वं तेऽवत त उ नो अधि वोचत ।
मा नः पथः पित्र्यान्मानवादधि दूरं नैष्ट परावतः ॥
verses.rom:
te nastradhvam te'vata ta u no adhi vochata |
ma nah pathah pitryanmanavadadhi duram naishta paravatah ||
verses.en:
As such defend and succour us, with benedictions speak to us:
Lead us not from our fathers' and from Manu's path into the distance far away.

verses.sa:
ये देवास इह स्थन विश्वे वैश्वानरा उत ।
अस्मभ्यं शर्म सप्रथो गवेऽश्वाय यच्छत ॥
verses.rom:
ye devasa iha sthana vishve vaishvanara uta |
asmabhyam sharma sapratho gave'shvaya yachchhata ||
verses.en:
Ye Deities who stay with us, and all ye Gods of all mankind,
Give us your wide protection, give shelter for cattle and for steed.

verses.sa:
यो यजाति यजात इत्सुनवच्च पचाति च ।
ब्रह्मेदिन्द्रस्य चाकनत् ॥
verses.rom:
yo yajati yajata itsunavachcha pachati cha |
brahmedindrasya chakanat ||
verses.en:
THAT Brahman pleases Indra well, who worships, sacrifices, pours
Libation, and prepares the meal.

verses.sa:
पुरोळाशं यो अस्मै सोमं ररत आशिरम् ।
पादित्तं शक्रो अंहसः ॥
verses.rom:
purolasham yo asmai somam rarata ashiram |
padittam shakro amhasah ||
verses.en:
Sakra protects from woe the man who gives him sacrificial cake.
And offers Soma blent with milk.

verses.sa:
तस्य द्युमाँ असद्रथो देवजूतः स शूशुवत् ।
विश्वा वन्वन्नमित्रिया ॥
verses.rom:
tasya dyuman asadratho devajutah sa shushuvat |
vishva vanvannamitriya ||
verses.en:
His chariot shall be glorious, sped by Gods, and mighty shall he be,
Subduing all hostilities.

verses.sa:
अस्य प्रजावती गृहेऽसश्चन्ती दिवेदिवे ।
इळा धेनुमती दुहे ॥
verses.rom:
asya prajavati grihe'sashchanti divedive |
ila dhenumati duhe ||
verses.en:
Each day that passes, in his house flows his libation, rich in milk,
Exhaustless, bringing progeny.

verses.sa:
या दम्पती समनसा सुनुत आ च धावतः ।
देवासो नित्ययाशिरा ॥
verses.rom:
ya dampati samanasa sunuta a cha dhavatah |
devaso nityayashira ||
verses.en:
O Gods, with constant draught of milk, husband and wife with one accord
Press out and wash the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
प्रति प्राशव्याँ इतः सम्यञ्चा बर्हिराशाते ।
न ता वाजेषु वायतः ॥
verses.rom:
prati prashavyan itah samyancha barhirashate |
na ta vajeshu vayatah ||
verses.en:
They gain sufficient food: they come united to the sacred grass,
And never do they fail in strength.

verses.sa:
न देवानामपि ह्नुतः सुमतिं न जुगुक्षतः ।
श्रवो बृहद्विवासतः ॥
verses.rom:
na devanamapi hnutah sumatim na jugukshatah |
shravo brihadvivasatah ||
verses.en:
Never do they deny or seek to hide the favour of the Gods:
They win high glory for themselves.

verses.sa:
पुत्रिणा ता कुमारिणा विश्वमायुर्व्यश्नुतः ।
उभा हिरण्यपेशसा ॥
verses.rom:
putrina ta kumarina vishvamayurvyashnutah |
ubha hiranyapeshasa ||
verses.en:
With sons and daughters by their side they reach their full extent of life,
Both decked with ornaments of gold.

verses.sa:
वीतिहोत्रा कृतद्वसू दशस्यन्तामृताय कम् ।
समूधो रोमशं हतो देवेषु कृणुतो दुवः ॥
verses.rom:
vitihotra kritadvasu dashasyantamritaya kam |
samudho romasham hato deveshu krinuto duvah ||
verses.en:
Serving the Immortal One with gifts of sacrificial meal and wealth,
They satisfy the claims of love and pay due honour to the Gods.

verses.sa:
आ शर्म पर्वतानां वृणीमहे नदीनाम् ।
आ विष्णोः सचाभुवः ॥
verses.rom:
a sharma parvatanam vrinimahe nadinam |
a vishnoh sachabhuvah ||
verses.en:
We claim protection from the Hills, we claim protection of the Floods,
Of him who stands by Visnu's side.

verses.sa:
ऐतु पूषा रयिर्भगः स्वस्ति सर्वधातमः ।
उरुरध्वा स्वस्तये ॥
verses.rom:
aitu pusha rayirbhagah svasti sarvadhatamah |
ururadhva svastaye ||
verses.en:
May Pusan come, and Bhaga, Lord of wealth, All-bounteous, for our weal
Broad be the path that leads to bliss:

verses.sa:
अरमतिरनर्वणो विश्वो देवस्य मनसा ।
आदित्यानामनेह इत् ॥
verses.rom:
aramatiranarvano vishvo devasya manasa |
adityanamaneha it ||
verses.en:
Aramati, and, free from foes, Visva with spirit of a God,
And the Adityas' peerless might.

verses.sa:
यथा नो मित्रो अर्यमा वरुणः सन्ति गोपाः ।
सुगा ऋतस्य पन्थाः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha no mitro aryama varunah santi gopah |
suga ritasya panthah ||
verses.en:
Seeing that Mitra, Aryaman, and Varuna are guarding us,
The paths of Law are fair to tread.

verses.sa:
अग्निं वः पूर्व्यं गिरा देवमीळे वसूनाम् ।
सपर्यन्तः पुरुप्रियं मित्रं न क्षेत्रसाधसम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnim vah purvyam gira devamile vasunam |
saparyantah purupriyam mitram na kshetrasadhasam ||
verses.en:
I glorify with song, for wealth, Agni the God, the first of you.
We honour as a well-loved Friend the God who prospereth our fields.

verses.sa:
मक्षू देववतो रथः शूरो वा पृत्सु कासु चित् ।
देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
makshu devavato rathah shuro va pritsu kasu chit |
devanam ya inmano yajamana iyakshatyabhidayajvano bhuvat ||
verses.en:
As in all frays the hero, so swift moves his car whom Gods attend.
The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.

verses.sa:
न यजमान रिष्यसि न सुन्वान न देवयो ।
देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
na yajamana rishyasi na sunvana na devayo |
devanam ya inmano yajamana iyakshatyabhidayajvano bhuvat ||
verses.en:
Ne'er are ye injured, worshipper, presser of juice, or pious man.
The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.

verses.sa:
नकिष्टं कर्मणा नशन्न प्र योषन्न योषति ।
देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
nakishtam karmana nashanna pra yoshanna yoshati |
devanam ya inmano yajamana iyakshatyabhidayajvano bhuvat ||
verses.en:
None in his action equals him, none holds him far or keeps him off.
The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.

verses.sa:
असदत्र सुवीर्यमुत त्यदाश्वश्व्यम् ।
देवानां य इन्मनो यजमान इयक्षत्यभीदयज्वनो भुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
asadatra suviryamuta tyadashvashvyam |
devanam ya inmano yajamana iyakshatyabhidayajvano bhuvat ||
verses.en:
Such strength of heroes shall be his, such mastery of fleet-foot steeds.
The man who, sacrificing, strives to win the heart of Deities will conquer those who worship not.

verses.sa:
प्र कृतान्यृजीषिणः कण्वा इन्द्रस्य गाथया ।
मदे सोमस्य वोचत ॥
verses.rom:
pra kritanyrijishinah kanva indrasya gathaya |
made somasya vochata ||
verses.en:
KANVAS, tell forth with song the deeds of Indra, the Impetuous,
Wrought in the Soma's wild delight.

verses.sa:
यः सृबिन्दमनर्शनिं पिप्रुं दासमहीशुवम् ।
वधीदुग्रो रिणन्नपः ॥
verses.rom:
yah sribindamanarshanim piprum dasamahishuvam |
vadhidugro rinannapah ||
verses.en:
Strong God, he slew Anarsani, Srbinda, Pipru, and the fiend,
Ahisuva, and loosed the floods.

verses.sa:
न्यर्बुदस्य विष्टपं वर्ष्माणं बृहतस्तिर ।
कृषे तदिन्द्र पौंस्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
nyarbudasya vishtapam varshmanam brihatastira |
krishe tadindra paumsyam ||
verses.en:
Thou broughtest down the dwelling-place, the height of lofty Arbuda.
That exploit, Indra, must be famed.

verses.sa:
प्रति श्रुताय वो धृषत्तूर्णाशं न गिरेरधि ।
हुवे सुशिप्रमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
prati shrutaya vo dhrishatturnasham na gireradhi |
huve sushipramutaye ||
verses.en:
Bold, to your famous Soma I call the fair-visored God for aid,
Down like a torrent from the hill.

verses.sa:
स गोरश्वस्य वि व्रजं मन्दानः सोम्येभ्यः ।
पुरं न शूर दर्षसि ॥
verses.rom:
sa gorashvasya vi vrajam mandanah somyebhyah |
puram na shura darshasi ||
verses.en:
Rejoicing in the Soma-draughts, Hero, burst open, like a fort,
The stall of horses and of kine.

verses.sa:
यदि मे रारणः सुत उक्थे वा दधसे चनः ।
आरादुप स्वधा गहि ॥
verses.rom:
yadi me raranah suta ukthe va dadhase chanah |
aradupa svadha gahi ||
verses.en:
If my libation gladdens, if thou takest pleasure in my laud,
Come with thy Godhead from afar.

verses.sa:
वयं घा ते अपि ष्मसि स्तोतार इन्द्र गिर्वणः ।
त्वं नो जिन्व सोमपाः ॥
verses.rom:
vayam gha te api shmasi stotara indra girvanah |
tvam no jinva somapah ||
verses.en:
O Indra, Lover of the Song, the singers of thy praise are we:
O Soma-drinker, quicken us.

verses.sa:
उत नः पितुमा भर संरराणो अविक्षितम् ।
मघवन्भूरि ते वसु ॥
verses.rom:
uta nah pituma bhara samrarano avikshitam |
maghavanbhuri te vasu ||
verses.en:
And, taking thy delight with us bring us still undiminished food:
Great is thy wealth, O Maghavan.

verses.sa:
उत नो गोमतस्कृधि हिरण्यवतो अश्विनः ।
इळाभिः सं रभेमहि ॥
verses.rom:
uta no gomataskridhi hiranyavato ashvinah |
ilabhih sam rabhemahi ||
verses.en:
Make thou us rich in herds of kine, in steeds, in gold: let us exert
Our strength in sacrificial gifts.

verses.sa:
बृबदुक्थं हवामहे सृप्रकरस्नमूतये ।
साधु कृण्वन्तमवसे ॥
verses.rom:
bribaduktham havamahe sriprakarasnamutaye |
sadhu krinvantamavase ||
verses.en:
Let us call him to aid whose hands stretch far, to whom high laud is due.
Who worketh well to succour us.

verses.sa:
यः संस्थे चिच्छतक्रतुरादीं कृणोति वृत्रहा ।
जरितृभ्यः पुरूवसुः ॥
verses.rom:
yah samsthe chichchhatakraturadim krinoti vritraha |
jaritribhyah puruvasuh ||
verses.en:
He, Satakratu, even in fight acts as a Vrtra-slayer still:
He gives his worshippers much wealth.

verses.sa:
स नः शक्रश्चिदा शकद्दानवाँ अन्तराभरः ।
इन्द्रो विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah shakrashchida shakaddanavan antarabharah |
indro vishvabhirutibhih ||
verses.en:
May he, this Aakra, strengthen us, Boon God who satisfies our needs,
Indra, with all his saving helps.

verses.sa:
यो रायोऽवनिर्महान्सुपारः सुन्वतः सखा ।
तमिन्द्रमभि गायत ॥
verses.rom:
yo rayo'vanirmahansuparah sunvatah sakha |
tamindramabhi gayata ||
verses.en:
To him, the mighty stream of wealth, the Soma-presser's rescuing Friend,
To Indra sing your song of praise;

verses.sa:
आयन्तारं महि स्थिरं पृतनासु श्रवोजितम् ।
भूरेरीशानमोजसा ॥
verses.rom:
ayantaram mahi sthiram pritanasu shravojitam |
bhurerishanamojasa ||
verses.en:
Who bringeth what is great and firm, who winneth glory in his wars,
Lord of vast wealth through power and might.

verses.sa:
नकिरस्य शचीनां नियन्ता सूनृतानाम् ।
नकिर्वक्ता न दादिति ॥
verses.rom:
nakirasya shachinam niyanta sunritanam |
nakirvakta na daditi ||
verses.en:
There liveth none to cheek or stay his energies and gracious deeds:
None who can say, He giveth not.

verses.sa:
न नूनं ब्रह्मणामृणं प्राशूनामस्ति सुन्वताम् ।
न सोमो अप्रता पपे ॥
verses.rom:
na nunam brahmanamrinam prashunamasti sunvatam |
na somo aprata pape ||
verses.en:
No debt is due by Brahmans now, by active men who press the juice:
Well hath each Soma-draught been paid.

verses.sa:
पन्य इदुप गायत पन्य उक्थानि शंसत ।
ब्रह्मा कृणोत पन्य इत् ॥
verses.rom:
panya idupa gayata panya ukthani shamsata |
brahma krinota panya it ||
verses.en:
Sing ye to him who must be praised, say lauds to him who must be praised,
Bring prayer to him who must be praised.

verses.sa:
पन्य आ दर्दिरच्छता सहस्रा वाज्यवृतः ।
इन्द्रो यो यज्वनो वृधः ॥
verses.rom:
panya a dardirachchhata sahasra vajyavritah |
indro yo yajvano vridhah ||
verses.en:
May be, unchecked, strong, meet for praise, bring hundreds, thousands forth to light,
Indra who aids the worshipper.

verses.sa:
वि षू चर स्वधा अनु कृष्टीनामन्वाहुवः ।
इन्द्र पिब सुतानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
vi shu chara svadha anu krishtinamanvahuvah |
indra piba sutanam ||
verses.en:
Go with thy God-like nature forth, go where the folk are calling thee:
Drink, Indra, of the drops we pour.

verses.sa:
पिब स्वधैनवानामुत यस्तुग्र्ये सचा ।
उतायमिन्द्र यस्तव ॥
verses.rom:
piba svadhainavanamuta yastugrye sacha |
utayamindra yastava ||
verses.en:
Drink milky draughts which are thine own, this too which was with Tugrya once,
This is it, Indra, that is thine.

verses.sa:
अतीहि मन्युषाविणं सुषुवांसमुपारणे ।
इमं रातं सुतं पिब ॥
verses.rom:
atihi manyushavinam sushuvamsamuparane |
imam ratam sutam piba ||
verses.en:
Pass him who pours libations out in angry mood or after sin:
Here drink the juice we offer thee.

verses.sa:
इहि तिस्रः परावत इहि पञ्च जनाँ अति ।
धेना इन्द्रावचाकशत् ॥
verses.rom:
ihi tisrah paravata ihi pancha janan ati |
dhena indravachakashat ||
verses.en:
Over the three great distances, past the Five Peoples go thy way,
O Indra, noticing our voice.

verses.sa:
सूर्यो रश्मिं यथा सृजा त्वा यच्छन्तु मे गिरः ।
निम्नमापो न सध्र्यक् ॥
verses.rom:
suryo rashmim yatha srija tva yachchhantu me girah |
nimnamapo na sadhryak ||
verses.en:
Send forth thy ray like Surya: let my songs attract thee hitherward,
Like waters gathering to the vale.

verses.sa:
अध्वर्यवा तु हि षिञ्च सोमं वीराय शिप्रिणे ।
भरा सुतस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
adhvaryava tu hi shincha somam viraya shiprine |
bhara sutasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Now to the Hero fair of cheek, Adhvaryu, pour the Soma forth:
Bring of the juice that he may drink

verses.sa:
य उद्नः फलिगं भिनन्न्यक्सिन्धूँरवासृजत् ।
यो गोषु पक्वं धारयत् ॥
verses.rom:
ya udnah phaligam bhinannyaksindhunravasrijat |
yo goshu pakvam dharayat ||
verses.en:
Who cleft the water-cloud in twain, loosed rivers for their downward flow,
And set the ripe milk in the kine.

verses.sa:
अहन्वृत्रमृचीषम और्णवाभमहीशुवम् ।
हिमेनाविध्यदर्बुदम् ॥
verses.rom:
ahanvritramrichishama aurnavabhamahishuvam |
himenavidhyadarbudam ||
verses.en:
He, meet for praise, slew Vrtra, slew Ahisuva, Urnavabha's son,
And pierced through Arbuda with frost.

verses.sa:
प्र व उग्राय निष्टुरेऽषाळ्हाय प्रसक्षिणे ।
देवत्तं ब्रह्म गायत ॥
verses.rom:
pra va ugraya nishture'shalhaya prasakshine |
devattam brahma gayata ||
verses.en:
To him your matchless Mighty One, unconquerable Conqueror,
Sing forth the prayer which Gods have given:

verses.sa:
यो विश्वान्यभि व्रता सोमस्य मदे अन्धसः ।
इन्द्रो देवेषु चेतति ॥
verses.rom:
yo vishvanyabhi vrata somasya made andhasah |
indro deveshu chetati ||
verses.en:
Indra, who in the wild delight of Soma juice considers here
All holy Laws among the Gods.

verses.sa:
इह त्या सधमाद्या हरी हिरण्यकेश्या ।
वोळ्हामभि प्रयो हितम् ॥
verses.rom:
iha tya sadhamadya hari hiranyakeshya |
volhamabhi prayo hitam ||
verses.en:
Hither let these thy Bays who share thy banquet, Steeds with golden manes,
Convey thee to the feast prepared.

verses.sa:
अर्वाञ्चं त्वा पुरुष्टुत प्रियमेधस्तुता हरी ।
सोमपेयाय वक्षतः ॥
verses.rom:
arvancham tva purushtuta priyamedhastuta hari |
somapeyaya vakshatah ||
verses.en:
Hither, O thou whom many laud, the Bays whom Priyamedha praised,
Shall bring thee to the Soma-draught.

verses.sa:
वयं घ त्वा सुतावन्त आपो न वृक्तबर्हिषः ।
पवित्रस्य प्रस्रवणेषु वृत्रहन्परि स्तोतार आसते ॥
verses.rom:
vayam gha tva sutavanta apo na vriktabarhishah |
pavitrasya prasravaneshu vritrahanpari stotara asate ||
verses.en:
WE compass thee like waters, we whose grass is trimmed and Soma pressed.
Here where the filter pours its stream, thy worshippers round thee, O Vrtra-slayer, sit.

verses.sa:
स्वरन्ति त्वा सुते नरो वसो निरेक उक्थिनः ।
कदा सुतं तृषाण ओक आ गम इन्द्र स्वब्दीव वंसगः ॥
verses.rom:
svaranti tva sute naro vaso nireka ukthinah |
kada sutam trishana oka a gama indra svabdiva vamsagah ||
verses.en:
Men, Vasu! by the Soma, with lauds call thee to the foremost place:
When comest thou athirst unto the juice as home, O Indra, like a bellowing bull?

verses.sa:
कण्वेभिर्धृष्णवा धृषद्वाजं दर्षि सहस्रिणम् ।
पिशङ्गरूपं मघवन्विचर्षणे मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
kanvebhirdhrishnava dhrishadvajam darshi sahasrinam |
pishangarupam maghavanvicharshane makshu gomantamimahe ||
verses.en:
Boldly, Bold Hero, bring us spoil in thousands for the Kanvas' sake.
O active Maghavan, with eager prayer we crave the yellow-hued with store ol kine.

verses.sa:
पाहि गायान्धसो मद इन्द्राय मेध्यातिथे ।
यः सम्मिश्लो हर्योर्यः सुते सचा वज्री रथो हिरण्ययः ॥
verses.rom:
pahi gayandhaso mada indraya medhyatithe |
yah sammishlo haryoryah sute sacha vajri ratho hiranyayah ||
verses.en:
Medhyatithi, to Indra sing, drink of the juice to make thee glad.
Close-knit to his Bay Steeds, bolt-armed, beside the juice is he: his chariot is of gold.

verses.sa:
यः सुषव्यः सुदक्षिण इनो यः सुक्रतुर्गृणे ।
य आकरः सहस्रा यः शतामघ इन्द्रो यः पूर्भिदारितः ॥
verses.rom:
yah sushavyah sudakshina ino yah sukraturgrine |
ya akarah sahasra yah shatamagha indro yah purbhidaritah ||
verses.en:
He Who is praised as strong of hand both right and left, most wise and hold:
Indra who, rich in hundreds, gathers thousands up, honoured as breaker-down of forts.

verses.sa:
यो धृषितो योऽवृतो यो अस्ति श्मश्रुषु श्रितः ।
विभूतद्युम्नश्च्यवनः पुरुष्टुतः क्रत्वा गौरिव शाकिनः ॥
verses.rom:
yo dhrishito yo'vrito yo asti shmashrushu shritah |
vibhutadyumnashchyavanah purushtutah kratva gauriva shakinah ||
verses.en:
The bold of heart whom none provokes, who stands in bearded confidence;
Much-lauded, very glorious, overthrowing foes, strong Helper, like a bull with might.

verses.sa:
क ईं वेद सुते सचा पिबन्तं कद्वयो दधे ।
अयं यः पुरो विभिनत्त्योजसा मन्दानः शिप्र्यन्धसः ॥
verses.rom:
ka im veda sute sacha pibantam kadvayo dadhe |
ayam yah puro vibhinattyojasa mandanah shipryandhasah ||
verses.en:
Who knows what vital power he wins, drinking beside the flowing juice?
This is the fair-checked God who, joying in the draught, breaks down the castles in his strength.

verses.sa:
दाना मृगो न वारणः पुरुत्रा चरथं दधे ।
नकिष्ट्वा नि यमदा सुते गमो महाँश्चरस्योजसा ॥
verses.rom:
dana mrigo na varanah purutra charatham dadhe |
nakishtva ni yamada sute gamo mahanshcharasyojasa ||
verses.en:
As a wild elephant rushes on this way and that way, mad with heat,'
None may compel thee, yet come hither to the draught: thou movest mighty in thy power.

verses.sa:
य उग्रः सन्ननिष्टृत स्थिरो रणाय संस्कृतः ।
यदि स्तोतुर्मघवा शृणवद्धवं नेन्द्रो योषत्या गमत् ॥
verses.rom:
ya ugrah sannanishtrita sthiro ranaya samskritah |
yadi stoturmaghava shrinavaddhavam nendro yoshatya gamat ||
verses.en:
When he, the Mighty, ne'er o'erthrown, steadfast, made ready for the fight,
When Indra Maghavan lists to his praiser's call, he will not stand aloof, but come.

verses.sa:
सत्यमित्था वृषेदसि वृषजूतिर्नोऽवृतः ।
वृषा ह्युग्र शृण्विषे परावति वृषो अर्वावति श्रुतः ॥
verses.rom:
satyamittha vrishedasi vrishajutirno'vritah |
vrisha hyugra shrinvishe paravati vrisho arvavati shrutah ||
verses.en:
Yea, verily, thou art a Bull, with a bull's rush. whom none may stay:
Thou Mighty One, art celebrated as a Bull, famed as a Bull both near and far.

verses.sa:
वृषणस्ते अभीशवो वृषा कशा हिरण्ययी ।
वृषा रथो मघवन्वृषणा हरी वृषा त्वं शतक्रतो ॥
verses.rom:
vrishanaste abhishavo vrisha kasha hiranyayi |
vrisha ratho maghavanvrishana hari vrisha tvam shatakrato ||
verses.en:
Thy reins are very bulls in strength, bulls' strength is in thy golden whip.
Thy car, O Maghavan, thy Bays are strong as bulls: thou, Satakratu, art a Bull.

verses.sa:
वृषा सोता सुनोतु ते वृषन्नृजीपिन्ना भर ।
वृषा दधन्वे वृषणं नदीष्वा तुभ्यं स्थातर्हरीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
vrisha sota sunotu te vrishannrijipinna bhara |
vrisha dadhanve vrishanam nadishva tubhyam sthatarharinam ||
verses.en:
Let the strong presser press for thee. Bring hither, thou straight-rushing Bull.
The mighty makes the mighty run in flowing streams for thee whom thy Bay Horses bear.

verses.sa:
एन्द्र याहि पीतये मधु शविष्ठ सोम्यम् ।
नायमच्छा मघवा शृणवद्गिरो ब्रह्मोक्था च सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
endra yahi pitaye madhu shavishtha somyam |
nayamachchha maghava shrinavadgiro brahmoktha cha sukratuh ||
verses.en:
Come, thou most potent Indra, come to drink the savoury Soma juice.
Maghavan, very wise, will quickly come to hear the songs, the prayer, the hymns of praise.

verses.sa:
वहन्तु त्वा रथेष्ठामा हरयो रथयुजः ।
तिरश्चिदर्यं सवनानि वृत्रहन्नन्येषां या शतक्रतो ॥
verses.rom:
vahantu tva ratheshthama harayo rathayujah |
tirashchidaryam savanani vritrahannanyesham ya shatakrato ||
verses.en:
