When thou hast mounted on thy car let thy yoked Bay Steeds carry thee,
Past other men's libations, Lord of Hundred Powers, thee, Vrtra-slayer, thee our Friend.

verses.sa:
अस्माकमद्यान्तमं स्तोमं धिष्व महामह ।
अस्माकं ते सवना सन्तु शंतमा मदाय द्युक्ष सोमपाः ॥
verses.rom:
asmakamadyantamam stomam dhishva mahamaha |
asmakam te savana santu shamtama madaya dyuksha somapah ||
verses.en:
O thou Most Lofty One, accept our laud as nearest to thine heart.
May our libations be most sweet to make thee glad, O Soma-drinker, Heavenly Lord.

verses.sa:
नहि षस्तव नो मम शास्त्रे अन्यस्य रण्यति ।
यो अस्मान्वीर आनयत् ॥
verses.rom:
nahi shastava no mama shastre anyasya ranyati |
yo asmanvira anayat ||
verses.en:
Neither in thy decree nor mine, but in another's he delights,-
The man who brought us unto this.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रश्चिद्घा तदब्रवीत्स्त्रिया अशास्यं मनः ।
उतो अह क्रतुं रघुम् ॥
verses.rom:
indrashchidgha tadabravitstriya ashasyam manah |
uto aha kratum raghum ||
verses.en:
Indra himself hath said, The mind of woman brooks not discipline,
Her intellect hath little weight.

verses.sa:
सप्ती चिद्घा मदच्युता मिथुना वहतो रथम् ।
एवेद्धूर्वृष्ण उत्तरा ॥
verses.rom:
sapti chidgha madachyuta mithuna vahato ratham |
eveddhurvrishna uttara ||
verses.en:
His pair of horses, rushing on in their wild transport, draw his car:
High-lifted is the stallion's yoke.

verses.sa:
अधः पश्यस्व मोपरि संतरां पादकौ हर ।
मा ते कशप्लकौ दृशन्स्त्री हि ब्रह्मा बभूविथ ॥
verses.rom:
adhah pashyasva mopari samtaram padakau hara |
ma te kashaplakau drishanstri hi brahma babhuvitha ||
verses.en:
Cast down thine eyes and look not up. More closely set thy feet. Let none
See what thy garment veils, for thou, a Brahman, hast become a dame.

verses.sa:
एन्द्र याहि हरिभिरुप कण्वस्य सुष्टुतिम् ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
endra yahi haribhirupa kanvasya sushtutim |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en:
Come hither, Indra, with thy Bays, come thou to Kanva's eulogy.
Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा ग्रावा वदन्निह सोमी घोषेण यच्छतु ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
a tva grava vadanniha somi ghoshena yachchhatu |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en:
May the stone draw thee as it speaks, the Soma-stone with ringing voice.
Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

verses.sa:
अत्रा वि नेमिरेषामुरां न धूनुते वृकः ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
atra vi nemireshamuram na dhunute vrikah |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en:
The stones' rim shakes the Soma here like a wolf worrying a sheep.
Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा कण्वा इहावसे हवन्ते वाजसातये ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
a tva kanva ihavase havante vajasataye |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en:
The Kanvas call thee hitherward for succour and to win the spoil.
Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

verses.sa:
दधामि ते सुतानां वृष्णे न पूर्वपाय्यम् ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
dadhami te sutanam vrishne na purvapayyam |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en: I set for thee, as for the Strong, the first draught of the juices shed.

verses.sa:
स्मत्पुरंधिर्न आ गहि विश्वतोधीर्न ऊतये ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
smatpuramdhirna a gahi vishvatodhirna utaye |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en: Come with abundant blessings, come with perfect care to succour us.

verses.sa:
आ नो याहि महेमते सहस्रोते शतामघ ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
a no yahi mahemate sahasrote shatamagha |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en: Come, Lord of lofty thought, who hast infinite wealth and countless aids.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा होता मनुर्हितो देवत्रा वक्षदीड्यः ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
a tva hota manurhito devatra vakshadidyah |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en: Adorable mid Gods, the Priest good to mankind shall bring thee near.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा मदच्युता हरी श्येनं पक्षेव वक्षतः ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
a tva madachyuta hari shyenam paksheva vakshatah |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en: As wings the falcon, so thy Bays rushing in joy shall carry thee.

verses.sa:
आ याह्यर्य आ परि स्वाहा सोमस्य पीतये ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
a yahyarya a pari svaha somasya pitaye |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en: Come from the enemy to us, to svaha and the Soma-draught.

verses.sa:
आ नो याह्युपश्रुत्युक्थेषु रणया इह ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
a no yahyupashrutyuktheshu ranaya iha |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en: Come hither with thine car inclined to hear, take pleasure in our lauds.

verses.sa:
सरूपैरा सु नो गहि सम्भृतैः सम्भृताश्वः ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
sarupaira su no gahi sambhritaih sambhritashvah |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en: Lord of well-nourished Horses, come with well-fed Steeds alike in hue.

verses.sa:
आ याहि पर्वतेभ्यः समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपः ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
a yahi parvatebhyah samudrasyadhi vishtapah |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en: Come hither from the mountains, come from regions of the sea of air.

verses.sa:
आ नो गव्यान्यश्व्या सहस्रा शूर दर्दृहि ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
a no gavyanyashvya sahasra shura dardrihi |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en: Disclose to us O Hero, wealth in thousands both of kine and steeds.

verses.sa:
आ नः सहस्रशो भरायुतानि शतानि च ।
दिवो अमुष्य शासतो दिवं यय दिवावसो ॥
verses.rom:
a nah sahasrasho bharayutani shatani cha |
divo amushya shasato divam yaya divavaso ||
verses.en:
Bring riches hitherward to us in hundreds, thousands, myriads.
Ye by command of yonder Dyaus, God bright by day! have gone to heaven.

verses.sa:
आ यदिन्द्रश्च दद्वहे सहस्रं वसुरोचिषः ।
ओजिष्ठमश्व्यं पशुम् ॥
verses.rom:
a yadindrashcha dadvahe sahasram vasurochishah |
ojishthamashvyam pashum ||
verses.en:
The thousand steeds, the mightiest troop, which we and Indra have received
From Vasurocis as a gift,

verses.sa:
य ऋज्रा वातरंहसोऽरुषासो रघुष्यदः ।
भ्राजन्ते सूर्या इव ॥
verses.rom:
ya rijra vataramhaso'rushaso raghushyadah |
bhrajante surya iva ||
verses.en:
The brown that match the wind in speed, and bright bay coursers fleet of foot,
Like Suns, resplendent are they all.

verses.sa:
पारावतस्य रातिषु द्रवच्चक्रेष्वाशुषु ।
तिष्ठं वनस्य मध्य आ ॥
verses.rom:
paravatasya ratishu dravachchakreshvashushu |
tishtham vanasya madhya a ||
verses.en:
Mid the Pargvata's rich gifts, swift steeds whose wheels run rapidly,
I seemed to stand amid a wood.

verses.sa:
अग्निनेन्द्रेण वरुणेन विष्णुनादित्यै रुद्रैर्वसुभिः सचाभुवा ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं पिबतमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
agninendrena varunena vishnunadityai rudrairvasubhih sachabhuva |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena cha somam pibatamashvina ||
verses.en:
WITH Agni and with Indra, Visnu, Varuna, with the Adityas, Rudras, Vasus, closely leagued;
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
विश्वाभिर्धीभिर्भुवनेन वाजिना दिवा पृथिव्याद्रिभिः सचाभुवा ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं पिबतमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
vishvabhirdhibhirbhuvanena vajina diva prithivyadribhih sachabhuva |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena cha somam pibatamashvina ||
verses.en:
With all the Holy Thoughts, all being Mighty Ones! in close alliance wil the Mountains, Heaven, and Earth;
Accordant. of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
विश्वैर्देवैस्त्रिभिरेकादशैरिहाद्भिर्मरुद्भिर्भृगुभिः सचाभुवा ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं पिबतमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
vishvairdevaistribhirekadashairihadbhirmarudbhirbhrigubhih sachabhuva |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena cha somam pibatamashvina ||
verses.en:
With all the Deities, three times eleven, here, in close alliance with the Maruts, Bhrgus, Floods;
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
जुषेथां यज्ञं बोधतं हवस्य मे विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गच्छतम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चेषं नो वोळ्हमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
jushetham yajnam bodhatam havasya me vishveha devau savanava gachchhatam |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena chesham no volhamashvina ||
verses.en:
Accept the sacrifice, attend to this my call: come nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here.
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, bring us strengthening food.

verses.sa:
स्तोमं जुषेथां युवशेव कन्यनां विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गच्छतम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चेषं नो वोळ्हमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
stomam jushetham yuvasheva kanyanam vishveha devau savanava gachchhatam |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena chesham no volhamashvina ||
verses.en:
Accept our praise-song as a youth accepts a maid. Come nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here.
Accordant, of one mind with Sarya and with Dawn O Asvins, bring us strengthening food.

verses.sa:
गिरो जुषेथामध्वरं जुषेथां विश्वेह देवौ सवनाव गच्छतम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चेषं नो वोळ्हमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
giro jushethamadhvaram jushetham vishveha devau savanava gachchhatam |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena chesham no volhamashvina ||
verses.en:
Accept the songs we sing, accept the solemn rite. Conie nigh, O ye Twain Gods, to all libations here.
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, bring us strengthening food.

verses.sa:
हारिद्रवेव पतथो वनेदुप सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गच्छथः ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
haridraveva patatho vanedupa somam sutam mahishevava gachchhathah |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena cha trirvartiryatamashvina ||
verses.en:
Ye fly as starlings fly unto the forest trees; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed.
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Asvins, to our home.

verses.sa:
हंसाविव पतथो अध्वगाविव सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गच्छथः ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
hamsaviva patatho adhvagaviva somam sutam mahishevava gachchhathah |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena cha trirvartiryatamashvina ||
verses.en:
Ye fly like swans, like those who travel on their way; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed.
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Asvins, to our home.

verses.sa:
श्येनाविव पतथो हव्यदातये सोमं सुतं महिषेवाव गच्छथः ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च त्रिर्वर्तिर्यातमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
shyenaviva patatho havyadataye somam sutam mahishevava gachchhathah |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena cha trirvartiryatamashvina ||
verses.en:
Ye fly to our oblation like a pair of hawks; like buffaloes ye seek the Soma we have shed.
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, come thrice, O Asvins, to our home.

verses.sa:
पिबतं च तृप्णुतं चा च गच्छतं प्रजां च धत्तं द्रविणं च धत्तम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं नो धत्तमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
pibatam cha tripnutam cha cha gachchhatam prajam cha dhattam dravinam cha dhattam |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena chorjam no dhattamashvina ||
verses.en:
Come hitherward and drink and satisfy yourselves, bestow upon us progeny and affluence.
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, grant us vigorous strength.

verses.sa:
जयतं च प्र स्तुतं च प्र चावतं प्रजां च धत्तं द्रविणं च धत्तम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं नो धत्तमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
jayatam cha pra stutam cha pra chavatam prajam cha dhattam dravinam cha dhattam |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena chorjam no dhattamashvina ||
verses.en:
Conquer your foes, protect us, praise your worshippers; bestow upon us progeny and affluence.
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, grant us vigorous strength.

verses.sa:
हतं च शत्रून्यततं च मित्रिणः प्रजां च धत्तं द्रविणं च धत्तम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चोर्जं नो धत्तमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
hatam cha shatrunyatatam cha mitrinah prajam cha dhattam dravinam cha dhattam |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena chorjam no dhattamashvina ||
verses.en:
Slay enemies, animate men whom ye befriend; bestow upon us progeny and affluence.
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, O Asvins, grant us vigorous strength.

verses.sa:
मित्रावरुणवन्ता उत धर्मवन्ता मरुत्वन्ता जरितुर्गच्छथो हवम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चादित्यैर्यातमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
mitravarunavanta uta dharmavanta marutvanta jariturgachchhatho havam |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena chadityairyatamashvina ||
verses.en:
With Mitra, Varuna, Dharma, and the Maruts in your company approach unto your praiser's call.
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, and with the Adityas, Asvins! come.

verses.sa:
अङ्गिरस्वन्ता उत विष्णुवन्ता मरुत्वन्ता जरितुर्गच्छथो हवम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चादित्यैर्यातमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
angirasvanta uta vishnuvanta marutvanta jariturgachchhatho havam |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena chadityairyatamashvina ||
verses.en:
With Visnu and the Angirases attending you, and with the Maruts come unto your praiser's call.
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, and with the Adityas, Asvins! come.

verses.sa:
ऋभुमन्ता वृषणा वाजवन्ता मरुत्वन्ता जरितुर्गच्छथो हवम् ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चादित्यैर्यातमश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
ribhumanta vrishana vajavanta marutvanta jariturgachchhatho havam |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena chadityairyatamashvina ||
verses.en:
With Rbhus and With Vajas. O ye Mighty Ones, leagued with the Maruts come ye to your praiser's call.
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, and with the Adityas, Asvins! come.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्म जिन्वतमुत जिन्वतं धियो हतं रक्षांसि सेधतममीवाः ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं सुन्वतो अश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
brahma jinvatamuta jinvatam dhiyo hatam rakshamsi sedhatamamivah |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena cha somam sunvato ashvina ||
verses.en:
Give spirit to our prayer and animate our thoughts; slay ye the Raksasas and drive away disease.
Accordant, of One mind with Surya and with Dawn, -the presser's Soma, Asvins drink.

verses.sa:
क्षत्रं जिन्वतमुत जिन्वतं नॄन्हतं रक्षांसि सेधतममीवाः ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं सुन्वतो अश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
kshatram jinvatamuta jinvatam nrinhatam rakshamsi sedhatamamivah |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena cha somam sunvato ashvina ||
verses.en:
Strengthen the Ruling Power, strengthen the men of war; slay ye the Raksasas and drive away disease.
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, the presser's Soma, Asvins drink.

verses.sa:
धेनूर्जिन्वतमुत जिन्वतं विशो हतं रक्षांसि सेधतममीवाः ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण च सोमं सुन्वतो अश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
dhenurjinvatamuta jinvatam visho hatam rakshamsi sedhatamamivah |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena cha somam sunvato ashvina ||
verses.en:
Give strength unto the milch-kine, give the people strength, slay ye the Raksasas and drive away disease.
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, the presser's Soma, Asvins drink.

verses.sa:
अत्रेरिव शृणुतं पूर्व्यस्तुतिं श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतो मदच्युता ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाश्विना तिरोअह्न्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
atreriva shrinutam purvyastutim shyavashvasya sunvato madachyuta |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena chashvina tiroahnyam ||
verses.en:
As ye heard Atri's earliest eulogy, so hear Syavasva, Soma-presser, ye who reel in joy.
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Asvins, three days old.

verses.sa:
सर्गाँ इव सृजतं सुष्टुतीरुप श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतो मदच्युता ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाश्विना तिरोअह्न्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
sargan iva srijatam sushtutirupa shyavashvasya sunvato madachyuta |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena chashvina tiroahnyam ||
verses.en:
Further like running streams Syavasva's eulogies who presses out the Soma, ye who reel in joy.
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Asvins, three days old.

verses.sa:
रश्मीँरिव यच्छतमध्वराँ उप श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतो मदच्युता ।
सजोषसा उषसा सूर्येण चाश्विना तिरोअह्न्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
rashminriva yachchhatamadhvaran upa shyavashvasya sunvato madachyuta |
sajoshasa ushasa suryena chashvina tiroahnyam ||
verses.en:
Seize, as ye grasp the reins, Syavasva's solemn rites who presses out the Soma, ye who reel in joy.
Accordant, of one mind with Surya and with Dawn, drink juice, O Asvins, three days old.

verses.sa:
अर्वाग्रथं नि यच्छतं पिबतं सोम्यं मधु ।
आ यातमश्विना गतमवस्युर्वामहं हुवे धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
arvagratham ni yachchhatam pibatam somyam madhu |
a yatamashvina gatamavasyurvamaham huve dhattam ratnani dashushe ||
verses.en:
Drive down your chariot hitherward drink ye the Soma's savoury juice.
Approach, ye Asvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper.

verses.sa:
नमोवाके प्रस्थिते अध्वरे नरा विवक्षणस्य पीतये ।
आ यातमश्विना गतमवस्युर्वामहं हुवे धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
namovake prasthite adhvare nara vivakshanasya pitaye |
a yatamashvina gatamavasyurvamaham huve dhattam ratnani dashushe ||
verses.en:
When sacrifice which tells our reverence hath begun. Heroes! to drink the gushing juice,
Approach, ye Asvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper.

verses.sa:
स्वाहाकृतस्य तृम्पतं सुतस्य देवावन्धसः ।
आ यातमश्विना गतमवस्युर्वामहं हुवे धत्तं रत्नानि दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
svahakritasya trimpatam sutasya devavandhasah |
a yatamashvina gatamavasyurvamaham huve dhattam ratnani dashushe ||
verses.en:
Sate you with consecrated drink, with juice effused, ye Deities.
Approach, ye Asvins, come to us: I call you, eager for your aid. Grant treasures to the worshipper.

verses.sa:
अवितासि सुन्वतो वृक्तबर्हिषः पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो ।
यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
verses.rom:
avitasi sunvato vriktabarhishah piba somam madaya kam shatakrato |
yam te bhagamadharayanvishvah sehanah pritana uru jrayah samapsujinmarutvan indra satpate ||
verses.en:
THOU helpest him whose grass is trimmed, who sheds the juice, O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.
The share which they have fixed for thee, thou, Indra, Victor o'er all hosts and space, begirt with Maruts, Lord of Heroes, winner of the floods.

verses.sa:
प्राव स्तोतारं मघवन्नव त्वां पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो ।
यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
verses.rom:
prava stotaram maghavannava tvam piba somam madaya kam shatakrato |
yam te bhagamadharayanvishvah sehanah pritana uru jrayah samapsujinmarutvan indra satpate ||
verses.en:
Maghavan, help thy worshipper: let him help thee. O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.
The share which they have fixed for thee, etc.

verses.sa:
ऊर्जा देवाँ अवस्योजसा त्वां पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो ।
यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
verses.rom:
urja devan avasyojasa tvam piba somam madaya kam shatakrato |
yam te bhagamadharayanvishvah sehanah pritana uru jrayah samapsujinmarutvan indra satpate ||
verses.en:
Thou aidest Gods with food, and that with might aidg thee,
O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.

verses.sa:
जनिता दिवो जनिता पृथिव्याः पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो ।
यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
verses.rom:
janita divo janita prithivyah piba somam madaya kam shatakrato |
yam te bhagamadharayanvishvah sehanah pritana uru jrayah samapsujinmarutvan indra satpate ||
verses.en: Creator of the heaven, creator of the earth, O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.

verses.sa:
जनिताश्वानां जनिता गवामसि पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो ।
यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
verses.rom:
janitashvanam janita gavamasi piba somam madaya kam shatakrato |
yam te bhagamadharayanvishvah sehanah pritana uru jrayah samapsujinmarutvan indra satpate ||
verses.en: Father of cattle, father of all steeds art thou. O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.

verses.sa:
अत्रीणां स्तोममद्रिवो महस्कृधि पिबा सोमं मदाय कं शतक्रतो ।
यं ते भागमधारयन्विश्वाः सेहानः पृतना उरु ज्रयः समप्सुजिन्मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र सत्पते ॥
verses.rom:
atrinam stomamadrivo mahaskridhi piba somam madaya kam shatakrato |
yam te bhagamadharayanvishvah sehanah pritana uru jrayah samapsujinmarutvan indra satpate ||
verses.en: Stone-hurler, glorify the Atris' hymn of praise. O Satakratu, drink Soma to make thee glad.

verses.sa:
श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतस्तथा शृणु यथाशृणोरत्रेः कर्माणि कृण्वतः ।
प्र त्रसदस्युमाविथ त्वमेक इन्नृषाह्य इन्द्र ब्रह्माणि वर्धयन् ॥
verses.rom:
shyavashvasya sunvatastatha shrinu yathashrinoratreh karmani krinvatah |
pra trasadasyumavitha tvameka innrishahya indra brahmani vardhayan ||
verses.en:
Hear thou Syavagva while he pours to thee, as erst thou heardest Atri when he wrought his holy rites.
Indra, thou only gavest Trasadasyu aid in the fierce fight with heroes, strengthening his prayers.

verses.sa:
प्रेदं ब्रह्म वृत्रतूर्येष्वाविथ प्र सुन्वतः शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
verses.rom:
predam brahma vritraturyeshvavitha pra sunvatah shachipata indra vishvabhirutibhih |
madhyamdinasya savanasya vritrahannanedya piba somasya vajrivah ||
verses.en:
THIS prayer, and those who shed the juice, in wars with Vrtra thou holpest, Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy succours.
O Vrtra-slayer, from libation poured at noon, drink of the Soma juice, thou blameless Thunderer.

verses.sa:
सेहान उग्र पृतना अभि द्रुहः शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
verses.rom:
sehana ugra pritana abhi druhah shachipata indra vishvabhirutibhih |
madhyamdinasya savanasya vritrahannanedya piba somasya vajrivah ||
verses.en: Thou mighty Conqueror of hostile armaments, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.

verses.sa:
एकराळस्य भुवनस्य राजसि शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
verses.rom:
ekaralasya bhuvanasya rajasi shachipata indra vishvabhirutibhih |
madhyamdinasya savanasya vritrahannanedya piba somasya vajrivah ||
verses.en: Sole Ruler, thou art Sovran of this world of life, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.

verses.sa:
सस्थावाना यवयसि त्वमेक इच्छचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
verses.rom:
sasthavana yavayasi tvameka ichchhachipata indra vishvabhirutibhih |
madhyamdinasya savanasya vritrahannanedya piba somasya vajrivah ||
verses.en: Thou only sunderest these two consistent worlds, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.

verses.sa:
क्षेमस्य च प्रयुजश्च त्वमीशिषे शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
verses.rom:
kshemasya cha prayujashcha tvamishishe shachipata indra vishvabhirutibhih |
madhyamdinasya savanasya vritrahannanedya piba somasya vajrivah ||
verses.en: Thou art the Lord supreme o'er rest and energy, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving help.

verses.sa:
क्षत्राय त्वमवसि न त्वमाविथ शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
माध्यंदिनस्य सवनस्य वृत्रहन्ननेद्य पिबा सोमस्य वज्रिवः ॥
verses.rom:
kshatraya tvamavasi na tvamavitha shachipata indra vishvabhirutibhih |
madhyamdinasya savanasya vritrahannanedya piba somasya vajrivah ||
verses.en: Thou helpest one to power, and one thou hast not helped, O Indra, Lord of Strength, with all thy saving aid.

verses.sa:
श्यावाश्वस्य रेभतस्तथा शृणु यथाशृणोरत्रेः कर्माणि कृण्वतः ।
प्र त्रसदस्युमाविथ त्वमेक इन्नृषाह्य इन्द्र क्षत्राणि वर्धयन् ॥
verses.rom:
shyavashvasya rebhatastatha shrinu yathashrinoratreh karmani krinvatah |
pra trasadasyumavitha tvameka innrishahya indra kshatrani vardhayan ||
verses.en:
Hear thou Syavasva while he sings to thee, as erst thou heardest Atri when he wrought his holy rites.
Indra, thou only gavest Trasadasyu aid in the fierce fight with heroes, strengthening his powers.

verses.sa:
यज्ञस्य हि स्थ ऋत्विजा सस्नी वाजेषु कर्मसु ।
इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yajnasya hi stha ritvija sasni vajeshu karmasu |
indragni tasya bodhatam ||
verses.en:
YE Twain are Priests of sacrifice, winners in war and holy works:
Indra and Agni, mark this well.

verses.sa:
तोशासा रथयावाना वृत्रहणापराजिता ।
इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम् ॥
verses.rom:
toshasa rathayavana vritrahanaparajita |
indragni tasya bodhatam ||
verses.en:
Ye bounteous riders on the car, ye Vrtra-slayers unsubdued:
Indra and Agni, mark this well.

verses.sa:
इदं वां मदिरं मध्वधुक्षन्नद्रिभिर्नरः ।
इन्द्राग्नी तस्य बोधतम् ॥
verses.rom:
idam vam madiram madhvadhukshannadribhirnarah |
indragni tasya bodhatam ||
verses.en:
The men with pressing-stones have pressed this meath of yours which gives delight:
Indra, and Agni, mark this well.

verses.sa:
जुषेथां यज्ञमिष्टये सुतं सोमं सधस्तुती ।
इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं नरा ॥
verses.rom:
jushetham yajnamishtaye sutam somam sadhastuti |
indragni a gatam nara ||
verses.en:
Accept our sacrifice for weal, sharers of praise! the Soma shed:
Indra and Agni, Heroes, come.

verses.sa:
इमा जुषेथां सवना येभिर्हव्यान्यूहथुः ।
इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं नरा ॥
verses.rom:
ima jushetham savana yebhirhavyanyuhathuh |
indragni a gatam nara ||
verses.en:
Be pleased with these libations which attract you to our sacred gifts
Indra and Agni, Heroes, come.

verses.sa:
इमां गायत्रवर्तनिं जुषेथां सुष्टुतिं मम ।
इन्द्राग्नी आ गतं नरा ॥
verses.rom:
imam gayatravartanim jushetham sushtutim mama |
indragni a gatam nara ||
verses.en:
Accept this eulogy of mine whose model is the Gayatri:
Indra and Agni, Heroes, Come.

verses.sa:
प्रातर्यावभिरा गतं देवेभिर्जेन्यावसू ।
इन्द्राग्नी सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
prataryavabhira gatam devebhirjenyavasu |
indragni somapitaye ||
verses.en:
Come with the early-faring Gods, ye who are Lords of genuine wealth:
Indra-Agni, to the Soma-draught

verses.sa:
श्यावाश्वस्य सुन्वतोऽत्रीणां शृणुतं हवम् ।
इन्द्राग्नी सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
shyavashvasya sunvato'trinam shrinutam havam |
indragni somapitaye ||
verses.en:
Hear ye the call of Atris, hear Syavasva as he sheds the juice:
Indra-Agni to the Soma-draught

verses.sa:
एवा वामह्व ऊतये यथाहुवन्त मेधिराः ।
इन्द्राग्नी सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
eva vamahva utaye yathahuvanta medhirah |
indragni somapitaye ||
verses.en:
Thus have I called you to our aid as sages called on you of old:
Indra-Agni to the Soma draught!

verses.sa:
आहं सरस्वतीवतोरिन्द्राग्न्योरवो वृणे ।
याभ्यां गायत्रमृच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
aham sarasvativatorindragnyoravo vrine |
yabhyam gayatramrichyate ||
verses.en:
Indra's and Agni's grace I claim, Sarasvati's associates
To whom this psalm of praise is sung.

verses.sa:
अग्निमस्तोष्यृग्मियमग्निमीळा यजध्यै ।
अग्निर्देवाँ अनक्तु न उभे हि विदथे कविरन्तश्चरति दूत्यं नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
agnimastoshyrigmiyamagnimila yajadhyai |
agnirdevan anaktu na ubhe hi vidathe kavirantashcharati dutyam nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
THE glorious Agni have I praised, and worshipped with. the sacred food.
May Agni deck the Gods for us. Between both gathering-places he goes on his embassy, the Sage. May all the others die away.

verses.sa:
न्यग्ने नव्यसा वचस्तनूषु शंसमेषाम् ।
न्यराती रराव्णां विश्वा अर्यो अरातीरितो युच्छन्त्वामुरो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
nyagne navyasa vachastanushu shamsamesham |
nyarati raravnam vishva aryo aratirito yuchchhantvamuro nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
Agni, burn down the word within their bodies through our newest speech,
All hatreds of the godless, all the wicked man's malignities. Away let the destroyers go. May all the others die away.

verses.sa:
अग्ने मन्मानि तुभ्यं कं घृतं न जुह्व आसनि ।
स देवेषु प्र चिकिद्धि त्वं ह्यसि पूर्व्यः शिवो दूतो विवस्वतो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
agne manmani tubhyam kam ghritam na juhva asani |
sa deveshu pra chikiddhi tvam hyasi purvyah shivo duto vivasvato nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
Agni, I offer hymns to thee, like holy oil within thy mouth.
Acknowledge them. among the Gods, for thou art the most excellent, the worshipper's blissful messenger. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
तत्तदग्निर्वयो दधे यथायथा कृपण्यति ।
ऊर्जाहुतिर्वसूनां शं च योश्च मयो दधे विश्वस्यै देवहूत्यै नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
tattadagnirvayo dadhe yathayatha kripanyati |
urjahutirvasunam sham cha yoshcha mayo dadhe vishvasyai devahutyai nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
Agni bestows all vital power even as each man supplicates.
He brings the Vasus strengthening gifts, and grants delight, in rest and stir, for every calling on the Gods. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
स चिकेत सहीयसाग्निश्चित्रेण कर्मणा ।
स होता शश्वतीनां दक्षिणाभिरभीवृत इनोति च प्रतीव्यं नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
sa chiketa sahiyasagnishchitrena karmana |
sa hota shashvatinam dakshinabhirabhivrita inoti cha prativyam nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
Agni hath made himself renowned by wonderful victorious act.
He is the Priest of all the tribes, chosen with sacrificial meads. He urges Deities to receive. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्जाता देवानामग्निर्वेद मर्तानामपीच्यम् ।
अग्निः स द्रविणोदा अग्निर्द्वारा व्यूर्णुते स्वाहुतो नवीयसा नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
agnirjata devanamagnirveda martanamapichyam |
agnih sa dravinoda agnirdvara vyurnute svahuto naviyasa nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
Agni knows all that springs from Gods, he knows the mystery of men.
Giver of wealth is Agni, he uncloses both the doors to us when worshipped with our newest gift. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्देवेषु संवसुः स विक्षु यज्ञियास्वा ।
स मुदा काव्या पुरु विश्वं भूमेव पुष्यति देवो देवेषु यज्ञियो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
agnirdeveshu samvasuh sa vikshu yajniyasva |
sa muda kavya puru vishvam bhumeva pushyati devo deveshu yajniyo nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
Agni inhabiteth with Gods and men who offer sacrifice.
He cherisheth with great delight much wisdom, as all things that be, God among Gods adorable. May all the others die away.

verses.sa:
यो अग्निः सप्तमानुषः श्रितो विश्वेषु सिन्धुषु ।
तमागन्म त्रिपस्त्यं मन्धातुर्दस्युहन्तममग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यं नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
yo agnih saptamanushah shrito vishveshu sindhushu |
tamaganma tripastyam mandhaturdasyuhantamamagnim yajneshu purvyam nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
Agni who liveth in all streams, Lord of the Sevenfold Race of men,
Him dweller in three homes we seek, best slayer of the Dasytis for Mandhatar, first in sacrifice. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
अग्निस्त्रीणि त्रिधातून्या क्षेति विदथा कविः ।
स त्रीँरेकादशाँ इह यक्षच्च पिप्रयच्च नो विप्रो दूतः परिष्कृतो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
agnistrini tridhatunya ksheti vidatha kavih |
sa trinrekadashan iha yakshachcha piprayachcha no vipro dutah parishkrito nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
Agni the Wise inhabiteth three gathering-places, triply formed.
Decked as our envoy let the Sage bring hither and conciliate the Thrice Eleven Deities. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्न आयुषु त्वं देवेषु पूर्व्य वस्व एक इरज्यसि ।
त्वामापः परिस्रुतः परि यन्ति स्वसेतवो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no agna ayushu tvam deveshu purvya vasva eka irajyasi |
tvamapah parisrutah pari yanti svasetavo nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
Our Agni, thou art first among the Gods, and first mid living men.
Thou only rulest over wealth. Round about thee, as natural dams, circumfluous the waters run. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राग्नी युवं सु नः सहन्ता दासथो रयिम् ।
येन दृळ्हा समत्स्वा वीळु चित्साहिषीमह्यग्निर्वनेव वात इन्नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
indragni yuvam su nah sahanta dasatho rayim |
yena drilha samatsva vilu chitsahishimahyagnirvaneva vata innabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
INDRA and Agni, surely ye as Conquerors will give us wealth,
Whereby in fight we may o'ercome that which is strong and firmly fixed, as Agni burns the woods with wind. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
नहि वां वव्रयामहेऽथेन्द्रमिद्यजामहे शविष्ठं नृणां नरम् ।
स नः कदा चिदर्वता गमदा वाजसातये गमदा मेधसातये नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
nahi vam vavrayamahe'thendramidyajamahe shavishtham nrinam naram |
sa nah kada chidarvata gamada vajasataye gamada medhasataye nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
We set no snares to tangle you; Indra we worship and adore, Hero of heroes mightiest.
Once may he come unto us with his Steed, come unto us to win us strength, and to complete the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
ता हि मध्यं भराणामिन्द्राग्नी अधिक्षितः ।
ता उ कवित्वना कवी पृच्छ्यमाना सखीयते सं धीतमश्नुतं नरा नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
ta hi madhyam bharanamindragni adhikshitah |
ta u kavitvana kavi prichchhyamana sakhiyate sam dhitamashnutam nara nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
For, famous Indra-Agni, ye are dwellers in the midst of frays.
Sages in wisdom, ye are knit to him who seeketh you as friends. Heroes, bestow on him his wish.

verses.sa:
अभ्यर्च नभाकवदिन्द्राग्नी यजसा गिरा ।
ययोर्विश्वमिदं जगदियं द्यौः पृथिवी मह्युपस्थे बिभृतो वसु नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
abhyarcha nabhakavadindragni yajasa gira |
yayorvishvamidam jagadiyam dyauh prithivi mahyupasthe bibhrito vasu nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
Nabhaka-like, with sacred song Indra's and Agni's praise I sing,
Theirs to whom all this world belongs, this heaven and this mighty earth which bear rich treasure in their lap.

verses.sa:
प्र ब्रह्माणि नभाकवदिन्द्राग्निभ्यामिरज्यत ।
या सप्तबुध्नमर्णवं जिह्मबारमपोर्णुत इन्द्र ईशान ओजसा नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
pra brahmani nabhakavadindragnibhyamirajyata |
ya saptabudhnamarnavam jihmabaramapornuta indra ishana ojasa nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
To Indra and to Agni send your prayers, as was Nabhaka's wont,-
Who open with sideway opening the sea with its foundations seven-Indra all powerful in his might.

verses.sa:
अपि वृश्च पुराणवद्व्रततेरिव गुष्पितमोजो दासस्य दम्भय ।
वयं तदस्य सम्भृतं वस्विन्द्रेण वि भजेमहि नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
api vrishcha puranavadvratateriva gushpitamojo dasasya dambhaya |
vayam tadasya sambhritam vasvindrena vi bhajemahi nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
Tear thou asunder, as of old, like tangles of a creeping plant,
Demolish thou the Dasa's might. May we with Indra's help divide the treasure he hath gathered up.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्राग्नी जना इमे विह्वयन्ते तना गिरा ।
अस्माकेभिर्नृभिर्वयं सासह्याम पृतन्यतो वनुयाम वनुष्यतो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
yadindragni jana ime vihvayante tana gira |
asmakebhirnribhirvayam sasahyama pritanyato vanuyama vanushyato nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
What time with this same song these men call Indra-Agni sundry ways,
May we with our own heroes quell those who provoke us to the fight, and conquer those who strive with us.

verses.sa:
या नु श्वेताववो दिव उच्चरात उप द्युभिः ।
इन्द्राग्न्योरनु व्रतमुहाना यन्ति सिन्धवो यान्त्सीं बन्धादमुञ्चतां नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
ya nu shvetavavo diva uchcharata upa dyubhih |
indragnyoranu vratamuhana yanti sindhavo yantsim bandhadamunchatam nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
The Two refulgent with their beams rise and come downward from the sky.
By Indra's and by Agni's behest, flowing away, the rivers, run which they released from their restraint.

verses.sa:
पूर्वीष्ट इन्द्रोपमातयः पूर्वीरुत प्रशस्तयः सूनो हिन्वस्य हरिवः ।
वस्वो वीरस्यापृचो या नु साधन्त नो धियो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
purvishta indropamatayah purviruta prashastayah suno hinvasya harivah |
vasvo virasyapricho ya nu sadhanta no dhiyo nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
O Indra, many are thine aids, many thy ways of guiding us,
Lord of the Bay Steeds, Hinva's Son. To a Good Hero come our prayers, which soon shall have accomplishment.

verses.sa:
तं शिशीता सुवृक्तिभिस्त्वेषं सत्वानमृग्मियम् ।
उतो नु चिद्य ओजसा शुष्णस्याण्डानि भेदति जेषत्स्वर्वतीरपो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
tam shishita suvriktibhistvesham satvanamrigmiyam |
uto nu chidya ojasa shushnasyandani bhedati jeshatsvarvatirapo nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
Inspire him with your holy hymns, the Hero bright and glorious,
Him who with might demolisheth even the brood of Susna, and winneth for us the heavenly streams.

verses.sa:
तं शिशीता स्वध्वरं सत्यं सत्वानमृत्वियम् ।
उतो नु चिद्य ओहत आण्डा शुष्णस्य भेदत्यजैः स्वर्वतीरपो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
tam shishita svadhvaram satyam satvanamritviyam |
uto nu chidya ohata anda shushnasya bhedatyajaih svarvatirapo nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
Inspire him worshipped with fair rites, the glorious Hero truly brave.
He brake in pieces Susna's brood who still expected not the stroke, and won for us the heavenly streams. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
एवेन्द्राग्निभ्यां पितृवन्नवीयो मन्धातृवदङ्गिरस्वदवाचि ।
त्रिधातुना शर्मणा पातमस्मान्वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
evendragnibhyam pitrivannaviyo mandhatrivadangirasvadavachi |
tridhatuna sharmana patamasmanvayam syama patayo rayinam ||
verses.en:
Thus have we sung anew to Indra-Agni, as sang our sires, Angirases, and Mandhatar.
Guard us with triple shelter and preserve us: may we be masters of a store of riches.

verses.sa:
अस्मा ऊ षु प्रभूतये वरुणाय मरुद्भ्योऽर्चा विदुष्टरेभ्यः ।
यो धीता मानुषाणां पश्वो गा इव रक्षति नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
asma u shu prabhutaye varunaya marudbhyo'rcha vidushtarebhyah |
yo dhita manushanam pashvo ga iva rakshati nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
To make this Varuna come forth sing thou a song unto the band of Maruts wiser than thyself,-
This Varuna who guardeth well the thoughts of men like herds of kine. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
तमू षु समना गिरा पितॄणां च मन्मभिः ।
नाभाकस्य प्रशस्तिभिर्यः सिन्धूनामुपोदये सप्तस्वसा स मध्यमो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
tamu shu samana gira pitrinam cha manmabhih |
nabhakasya prashastibhiryah sindhunamupodaye saptasvasa sa madhyamo nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
Him altogether praise I with the song and hymns our fathers sang, and with Nabhaka's eulogies,-
Him dwelling at the rivers' source, surrounded by his Sisters Seven.

verses.sa:
स क्षपः परि षस्वजे न्युस्रो मायया दधे स विश्वं परि दर्शतः ।
तस्य वेनीरनु व्रतमुषस्तिस्रो अवर्धयन्नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
sa kshapah pari shasvaje nyusro mayaya dadhe sa vishvam pari darshatah |
tasya veniranu vratamushastisro avardhayannabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
The nights he hath encompassed, and stablished the morns with magic art visible over all is he.
His dear Ones, following his Law, have prospered the Three Dawns for him.

verses.sa:
यः ककुभो निधारयः पृथिव्यामधि दर्शतः ।
स माता पूर्व्यं पदं तद्वरुणस्य सप्त्यं स हि गोपा इवेर्यो नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
yah kakubho nidharayah prithivyamadhi darshatah |
sa mata purvyam padam tadvarunasya saptyam sa hi gopa iveryo nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
He, visible o'er all the earth, stablished the quarters of the sky:
He measured out the eastern place, that is the fold of Varuna: like a strong herdsman is the God.

verses.sa:
यो धर्ता भुवनानां य उस्राणामपीच्या वेद नामानि गुह्या ।
स कविः काव्या पुरु रूपं द्यौरिव पुष्यति नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
yo dharta bhuvananam ya usranamapichya veda namani guhya |
sa kavih kavya puru rupam dyauriva pushyati nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
He who supports the worlds of life, he who well knows the hidden names mysterious of the morning beams,
He cherishes much wisdom, Sage, as heaven brings forth each varied form.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्विश्वानि काव्या चक्रे नाभिरिव श्रिता ।
त्रितं जूती सपर्यत व्रजे गावो न संयुजे युजे अश्वाँ अयुक्षत नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
yasminvishvani kavya chakre nabhiriva shrita |
tritam juti saparyata vraje gavo na samyuje yuje ashvan ayukshata nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
In whom all wisdom centres, as the nave is set within the wheel.
Haste ye to honour Trita, as kine haste to gather in the fold, even as they muster steeds to yoke.

verses.sa:
य आस्वत्क आशये विश्वा जातान्येषाम् ।
परि धामानि मर्मृशद्वरुणस्य पुरो गये विश्वे देवा अनु व्रतं नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
ya asvatka ashaye vishva jatanyesham |
pari dhamani marmrishadvarunasya puro gaye vishve deva anu vratam nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
He wraps these regions as a robe; he contemplates the tribes of Gods and all the works of mortal men.
Before the home of Varuna all the Gods follow his decree.

verses.sa:
स समुद्रो अपीच्यस्तुरो द्यामिव रोहति नि यदासु यजुर्दधे ।
स माया अर्चिना पदास्तृणान्नाकमारुहन्नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
sa samudro apichyasturo dyamiva rohati ni yadasu yajurdadhe |
sa maya archina padastrinannakamaruhannabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
He is an Ocean far-removed, yet through the heaven to him ascends the worship which these realms possess.
With his bright foot he overthrew their magic, and went up to heaven.

verses.sa:
यस्य श्वेता विचक्षणा तिस्रो भूमीरधिक्षितः ।
त्रिरुत्तराणि पप्रतुर्वरुणस्य ध्रुवं सदः स सप्तानामिरज्यति नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
yasya shveta vichakshana tisro bhumiradhikshitah |
triruttarani papraturvarunasya dhruvam sadah sa saptanamirajyati nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
Ruler, whose bright far-seeing rays, pervading all three earths, have filled the three superior realms of heaven.
Firm is the seat of Varuna: over the Seven he rules as King.

verses.sa:
यः श्वेताँ अधिनिर्णिजश्चक्रे कृष्णाँ अनु व्रता ।
स धाम पूर्व्यं ममे य स्कम्भेन वि रोदसी अजो न द्यामधारयन्नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
yah shvetan adhinirnijashchakre krishnan anu vrata |
sa dhama purvyam mame ya skambhena vi rodasi ajo na dyamadharayannabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
Who, after his decree, o'erspread the Dark Ones with a robe of light;
Who measured out the ancient seat, who pillared both the worlds apart as the Unborn supported heaven. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
अस्तभ्नाद्द्यामसुरो विश्ववेदा अमिमीत वरिमाणं पृथिव्याः ।
आसीदद्विश्वा भुवनानि सम्राड्विश्वेत्तानि वरुणस्य व्रतानि ॥
verses.rom:
astabhnaddyamasuro vishvaveda amimita varimanam prithivyah |
asidadvishva bhuvanani samradvishvettani varunasya vratani ||
verses.en:
LORD of all wealth, the Asura propped the heavens, and measured out the broad earth's wide expanses.
He, King supreme, approached all living creatures. All these are Varuna's holy operations.

verses.sa:
एवा वन्दस्व वरुणं बृहन्तं नमस्या धीरममृतस्य गोपाम् ।
स नः शर्म त्रिवरूथं वि यंसत्पातं नो द्यावापृथिवी उपस्थे ॥
verses.rom:
eva vandasva varunam brihantam namasya dhiramamritasya gopam |
sa nah sharma trivarutham vi yamsatpatam no dyavaprithivi upasthe ||
verses.en:
So humbly worship Varuna the Mighty revere the wise Guard of World Immortal.
May he vouchsafe us triply-barred protection. O Earth and Heaven, within your lap preserve us.

verses.sa:
इमां धियं शिक्षमाणस्य देव क्रतुं दक्षं वरुण सं शिशाधि ।
ययाति विश्वा दुरिता तरेम सुतर्माणमधि नावं रुहेम ॥
verses.rom:
imam dhiyam shikshamanasya deva kratum daksham varuna sam shishadhi |
yayati vishva durita tarema sutarmanamadhi navam ruhema ||
verses.en:
Sharpen this song of him who strives his utmost, sharpen, God Varuna, his strength and insight;
May we ascend the ship that bears us safely, whereby we may pass over all misfortune.

verses.sa:
आ वां ग्रावाणो अश्विना धीभिर्विप्रा अचुच्यवुः ।
नासत्या सोमपीतये नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
a vam gravano ashvina dhibhirvipra achuchyavuh |
nasatya somapitaye nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
Asvins, with songs the singer stones have made you hasten hitherward,
Nasatyas, to the Soma-draught. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
यथा वामत्रिरश्विना गीर्भिर्विप्रो अजोहवीत् ।
नासत्या सोमपीतये नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
yatha vamatrirashvina girbhirvipro ajohavit |
nasatya somapitaye nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
As the sage Atri with his hymns, O Asvins, called you eagerly,
Nasatyas, to the Soma-draught. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
एवा वामह्व ऊतये यथाहुवन्त मेधिराः ।
नासत्या सोमपीतये नभन्तामन्यके समे ॥
verses.rom:
eva vamahva utaye yathahuvanta medhirah |
nasatya somapitaye nabhantamanyake same ||
verses.en:
So have I called you to our aid, even as the wise have called of old,
Nasatyas, to the Soma-draught. Let all the others die away.

verses.sa:
इमे विप्रस्य वेधसोऽग्नेरस्तृतयज्वनः ।
गिर स्तोमास ईरते ॥
verses.rom:
ime viprasya vedhaso'gnerastritayajvanah |
gira stomasa irate ||
verses.en:
THESE songs of mine go forth as lauds of Agni, the disposing Sage,
Whose worshipper is ne'er o'erthrawn.

verses.sa:
अस्मै ते प्रतिहर्यते जातवेदो विचर्षणे ।
अग्ने जनामि सुष्टुतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
asmai te pratiharyate jatavedo vicharshane |
agne janami sushtutim ||
verses.en:
Wise Agni Jatavedas, I beget a song of praise for thee.
Who willingly receivest it.

verses.sa:
आरोका इव घेदह तिग्मा अग्ने तव त्विषः ।
दद्भिर्वनानि बप्सति ॥
verses.rom:
aroka iva ghedaha tigma agne tava tvishah |
dadbhirvanani bapsati ||
verses.en:
Thy sharpened flames, O Agni, like the gleams of light that glitter through,
Devour the forests with their teeth.

verses.sa:
हरयो धूमकेतवो वातजूता उप द्यवि ।
यतन्ते वृथगग्नयः ॥
verses.rom:
harayo dhumaketavo vatajuta upa dyavi |
yatante vrithagagnayah ||
verses.en:
Gold-coloured, bannered with the smoke, urged by the wind, aloft to heaven
Rise, lightly borne, the flames of fire.

verses.sa:
एते त्ये वृथगग्नय इद्धासः समदृक्षत ।
उषसामिव केतवः ॥
verses.rom:
ete tye vrithagagnaya iddhasah samadrikshata |
ushasamiva ketavah ||
verses.en:
These lightly kindled fiery flames are all around made visible,
Even as the gleamings of the Dawns.

verses.sa:
कृष्णा रजांसि पत्सुतः प्रयाणे जातवेदसः ।
अग्निर्यद्रोधति क्षमि ॥
verses.rom:
krishna rajamsi patsutah prayane jatavedasah |
agniryadrodhati kshami ||
verses.en:
As Jatavedas speeds along, the dust is black beneath his feet,
When Agni spreads upon the earth.

verses.sa:
धासिं कृण्वान ओषधीर्बप्सदग्निर्न वायति ।
पुनर्यन्तरुणीरपि ॥
verses.rom:
dhasim krinvana oshadhirbapsadagnirna vayati |
punaryantarunirapi ||
verses.en:
Making the plants his nourishment, Agni devours and wearies not,
Seeking the tender shrubs again.

verses.sa:
जिह्वाभिरह नन्नमदर्चिषा जञ्जणाभवन् ।
अग्निर्वनेषु रोचते ॥
verses.rom:
jihvabhiraha nannamadarchisha janjanabhavan |
agnirvaneshu rochate ||
verses.en:
Bending him down with all his tongues, he flickers with his fiery glow
Splendid is Agni in the woods.

verses.sa:
अप्स्वग्ने सधिष्टव सौषधीरनु रुध्यसे ।
गर्भे सञ्जायसे पुनः ॥
verses.rom:
apsvagne sadhishtava saushadhiranu rudhyase |
garbhe sanjayase punah ||
verses.en:
Agni, thine home is in the floods: into the plants thou forcest way,
And as their Child art born anew.

verses.sa:
उदग्ने तव तद्घृतादर्ची रोचत आहुतम् ।
निंसानं जुह्वो मुखे ॥
verses.rom:
udagne tava tadghritadarchi rochata ahutam |
nimsanam juhvo mukhe ||
verses.en:
Worshipped with offerings shines thy flame, O Agni, from the sacred oil,
With kisses on the ladle's mouth.

verses.sa:
उक्षान्नाय वशान्नाय सोमपृष्ठाय वेधसे ।
स्तोमैर्विधेमाग्नये ॥
verses.rom:
ukshannaya vashannaya somaprishthaya vedhase |
stomairvidhemagnaye ||
verses.en:
Let us serve Agni with our hymns, Disposer, fed on ox and cow,
Who bears the Soma on his back.

verses.sa:
उत त्वा नमसा वयं होतर्वरेण्यक्रतो ।
अग्ने समिद्भिरीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
uta tva namasa vayam hotarvarenyakrato |
agne samidbhirimahe ||
verses.en:
Yea, thee, O Agni, do we seek with homage and with fuel, Priest
Whose wisdom is most excellent.

verses.sa:
उत त्वा भृगुवच्छुचे मनुष्वदग्न आहुत ।
अङ्गिरस्वद्धवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
uta tva bhriguvachchhuche manushvadagna ahuta |
angirasvaddhavamahe ||
verses.en:
O worshipped with oblations, pure Agni, we call on thee as erst,
Did Bhrgu, Manus, Angiras.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह्यग्ने अग्निना विप्रो विप्रेण सन्सता ।
सखा सख्या समिध्यसे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hyagne agnina vipro viprena sansata |
sakha sakhya samidhyase ||
verses.en:
For thou, O Agni, by the fire, Sage by the Sage, Good by the Good,
Friend by the Friend, art lighted up.

verses.sa:
स त्वं विप्राय दाशुषे रयिं देहि सहस्रिणम् ।
अग्ने वीरवतीमिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvam vipraya dashushe rayim dehi sahasrinam |
agne viravatimisham ||
verses.en:
So wealth in thousands, food with store of heroes give thou to the sage,
O Agni, to the worshipper.

verses.sa:
अग्ने भ्रातः सहस्कृत रोहिदश्व शुचिव्रत ।
इमं स्तोमं जुषस्व मे ॥
verses.rom:
agne bhratah sahaskrita rohidashva shuchivrata |
imam stomam jushasva me ||
verses.en:
O Agni, Brother, made by strength, Lord of red steeds and brilliant sway,
Take pleasure in this laud of mine.

verses.sa:
उत त्वाग्ने मम स्तुतो वाश्राय प्रतिहर्यते ।
गोष्ठं गाव इवाशत ॥
verses.rom:
uta tvagne mama stuto vashraya pratiharyate |
goshtham gava ivashata ||
verses.en:
My praises, Agni, go to thee, as the cows seek the stall to meet,
The lowing calf that longs for milk.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं ता अङ्गिरस्तम विश्वाः सुक्षितयः पृथक् ।
अग्ने कामाय येमिरे ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyam ta angirastama vishvah sukshitayah prithak |
agne kamaya yemire ||
verses.en:
Agni, best Angiras, to thee all people who have pleasant homes,
Apart, have turned as to their wish.

verses.sa:
अग्निं धीभिर्मनीषिणो मेधिरासो विपश्चितः ।
अद्मसद्याय हिन्विरे ॥
verses.rom:
agnim dhibhirmanishino medhiraso vipashchitah |
admasadyaya hinvire ||
verses.en:
The sages skilled in holy song and thin. kers with their thoughts have urged
Agni to share the sacred feast.

verses.sa:
तं त्वामज्मेषु वाजिनं तन्वाना अग्ने अध्वरम् ।
वह्निं होतारमीळते ॥
verses.rom:
tam tvamajmeshu vajinam tanvana agne adhvaram |
vahnim hotaramilate ||
verses.en:
So, Agni, unto thee the Priest, Invoker, strong in forays, pray
'nose who spin out the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
पुरुत्रा हि सदृङ्ङसि विशो विश्वा अनु प्रभुः ।
समत्सु त्वा हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
purutra hi sadrinnasi visho vishva anu prabhuh |
samatsu tva havamahe ||
verses.en:
In many a place, the same in look art thou, a Prince o'er all the tribes
In battles we invoke thine aid.

verses.sa:
तमीळिष्व य आहुतोऽग्निर्विभ्राजते घृतैः ।
इमं नः शृणवद्धवम् ॥
verses.rom:
tamilishva ya ahuto'gnirvibhrajate ghritaih |
imam nah shrinavaddhavam ||
verses.en:
Pray thou to Agni, pray to him who blazes served with sacred oil:
Let him give ear to this our call.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा वयं हवामहे शृण्वन्तं जातवेदसम् ।
अग्ने घ्नन्तमप द्विषः ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva vayam havamahe shrinvantam jatavedasam |
agne ghnantamapa dvishah ||
verses.en:
We call on thee as such, as one who hears, as Jatavedas, one,
Agni! who beats away our foes.

verses.sa:
विशां राजानमद्भुतमध्यक्षं धर्मणामिमम् ।
अग्निमीळे स उ श्रवत् ॥
verses.rom:
visham rajanamadbhutamadhyaksham dharmanamimam |
agnimile sa u shravat ||
verses.en:
I pray to Agni, King of men, the Wonderful, the President
Of holy Laws: may he give ear.

verses.sa:
अग्निं विश्वायुवेपसं मर्यं न वाजिनं हितम् ।
सप्तिं न वाजयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
agnim vishvayuvepasam maryam na vajinam hitam |
saptim na vajayamasi ||
verses.en:
Him like a bridegroom, him who stirs all people, like a noble horse,
Like a fleet steed, we instigate.

verses.sa:
घ्नन्मृध्राण्यप द्विषो दहन्रक्षांसि विश्वहा ।
अग्ने तिग्मेन दीदिहि ॥
verses.rom:
ghnanmridhranyapa dvisho dahanrakshamsi vishvaha |
agne tigmena didihi ||
verses.en:
Slaying things deadly, burning up foes, Riksasas, on every side,
Shine, Agni, with thy sharpened flame.

verses.sa:
यं त्वा जनास इन्धते मनुष्वदङ्गिरस्तम ।
अग्ने स बोधि मे वचः ॥
verses.rom:
yam tva janasa indhate manushvadangirastama |
agne sa bodhi me vachah ||
verses.en:
Thou whom the people kindle even as Manus did, best Angiras!
O Agni, mark thou this my speech.

verses.sa:
यदग्ने दिविजा अस्यप्सुजा वा सहस्कृत ।
तं त्वा गीर्भिर्हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
yadagne divija asyapsuja va sahaskrita |
tam tva girbhirhavamahe ||
verses.en:
O Agni, made by strength! be thou born in the heavens or born in floods,
As such we call on thee with songs.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं घेत्ते जना इमे विश्वाः सुक्षितयः पृथक् ।
धासिं हिन्वन्त्यत्तवे ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyam ghette jana ime vishvah sukshitayah prithak |
dhasim hinvantyattave ||
verses.en:
Yea, all the people, all the folk who have good dwellings, each apart,
Send food for thee to eat thereof.

verses.sa:
ते घेदग्ने स्वाध्योऽहा विश्वा नृचक्षसः ।
तरन्तः स्याम दुर्गहा ॥
verses.rom:
te ghedagne svadhyo'ha vishva nrichakshasah |
tarantah syama durgaha ||
verses.en:
O Agni, so may we, devout, gazed at by men, throughout our days,
Pass lightly over all distress.

verses.sa:
अग्निं मन्द्रं पुरुप्रियं शीरं पावकशोचिषम् ।
हृद्भिर्मन्द्रेभिरीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
agnim mandram purupriyam shiram pavakashochisham |
hridbhirmandrebhirimahe ||
verses.en:
We venerate with cheerful hearts the cheerful Agni, dear to all,
Burning, with purifying flame.

verses.sa:
स त्वमग्ने विभावसुः सृजन्सूर्यो न रश्मिभिः ।
शर्धन्तमांसि जिघ्नसे ॥
verses.rom:
sa tvamagne vibhavasuh srijansuryo na rashmibhih |
shardhantamamsi jighnase ||
verses.en:
So thou, O Agni rich in light, beaming like Surya with thy rays
Boldly demolishest the gloom,

verses.sa:
तत्ते सहस्व ईमहे दात्रं यन्नोपदस्यति ।
त्वदग्ने वार्यं वसु ॥
verses.rom:
tatte sahasva imahe datram yannopadasyati |
tvadagne varyam vasu ||
verses.en:
We pray to thee for this thy gift, Victor the gift that faileth not,
O Agni, choicest wealth from thee.

verses.sa:
समिधाग्निं दुवस्यत घृतैर्बोधयतातिथिम् ।
आस्मिन्हव्या जुहोतन ॥
verses.rom:
samidhagnim duvasyata ghritairbodhayatatithim |
asminhavya juhotana ||
verses.en:
PAY service unto Agni with your fuel, rouse your Guest with oil:
In him present your offerings.

verses.sa:
अग्ने स्तोमं जुषस्व मे वर्धस्वानेन मन्मना ।
प्रति सूक्तानि हर्य नः ॥
verses.rom:
agne stomam jushasva me vardhasvanena manmana |
prati suktani harya nah ||
verses.en:
Agni, do thou accept my laud, be magnified by this my song:
Welcome my sweetly-spoken words.

verses.sa:
अग्निं दूतं पुरो दधे हव्यवाहमुप ब्रुवे ।
देवाँ आ सादयादिह ॥
verses.rom:
agnim dutam puro dadhe havyavahamupa bruve |
devan a sadayadiha ||
verses.en:
Agni, envoy, I place in front; the oblation-bearer I address:
Here let him seat the Deities.

verses.sa:
उत्ते बृहन्तो अर्चयः समिधानस्य दीदिवः ।
अग्ने शुक्रास ईरते ॥
verses.rom:
utte brihanto archayah samidhanasya didivah |
agne shukrasa irate ||
verses.en:
Agni, the lofty flames of' thee enkindled have gone up on high,
Thy bright flames, thou Refulgent One.

verses.sa:
उप त्वा जुह्वो मम घृताचीर्यन्तु हर्यत ।
अग्ने हव्या जुषस्व नः ॥
verses.rom:
upa tva juhvo mama ghritachiryantu haryata |
agne havya jushasva nah ||
verses.en:
Beloved! let my ladles full of sacred oil come near to thee:
Agni, accept our offerings.

verses.sa:
मन्द्रं होतारमृत्विजं चित्रभानुं विभावसुम् ।
अग्निमीळे स उ श्रवत् ॥
verses.rom:
mandram hotaramritvijam chitrabhanum vibhavasum |
agnimile sa u shravat ||
verses.en:
I worship Agni-may he hear!-the cheerful, the Invoker, Priest,
Of varied splendour, rich in light.

verses.sa:
प्रत्नं होतारमीड्यं जुष्टमग्निं कविक्रतुम् ।
अध्वराणामभिश्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
pratnam hotaramidyam jushtamagnim kavikratum |
adhvaranamabhishriyam ||
verses.en:
Ancient Invoker, meet for praise, beloved Agni, wise and strong,
The visitant of solemn rites.

verses.sa:
जुषाणो अङ्गिरस्तमेमा हव्यान्यानुषक् ।
अग्ने यज्ञं नय ऋतुथा ॥
verses.rom:
jushano angirastamema havyanyanushak |
agne yajnam naya ritutha ||
verses.en:
Agni, best Angiras, accept straightway these offerings, and guide
The seasonable sacrifice.

verses.sa:
समिधान उ सन्त्य शुक्रशोच इहा वह ।
चिकित्वान्दैव्यं जनम् ॥
verses.rom:
samidhana u santya shukrashocha iha vaha |
chikitvandaivyam janam ||
verses.en:
Excellent God, with brilliant flames, enkindled bring thou hitherward,
Knowing the way, the Heavenly Host.

verses.sa:
विप्रं होतारमद्रुहं धूमकेतुं विभावसुम् ।
यज्ञानां केतुमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
vipram hotaramadruham dhumaketum vibhavasum |
yajnanam ketumimahe ||
verses.en:
Him, Sage and Herald, void of guile, ensign of sacrifices, him
Smoke-bannered, rich in light, we seek.

verses.sa:
अग्ने नि पाहि नस्त्वं प्रति ष्म देव रीषतः ।
भिन्धि द्वेषः सहस्कृत ॥
verses.rom:
agne ni pahi nastvam prati shma deva rishatah |
bhindhi dveshah sahaskrita ||
verses.en:
O Agni, be our Guardian thou, God, against those who injure us:
Destroy our foes, thou Son of Strength.

verses.sa:
अग्निः प्रत्नेन मन्मना शुम्भानस्तन्वं स्वाम् ।
कविर्विप्रेण वावृधे ॥
verses.rom:
agnih pratnena manmana shumbhanastanvam svam |
kavirviprena vavridhe ||
verses.en:
Making his body beautiful, Agni the Sage hath waxen by
The singer and his ancient hymn.

verses.sa:
ऊर्जो नपातमा हुवेऽग्निं पावकशोचिषम् ।
अस्मिन्यज्ञे स्वध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
urjo napatama huve'gnim pavakashochisham |
asminyajne svadhvare ||
verses.en:
I invocate the Child of Strength, Agni with purifying flame,
At this well-ordered sacrifice.

verses.sa:
स नो मित्रमहस्त्वमग्ने शुक्रेण शोचिषा ।
देवैरा सत्सि बर्हिषि ॥
verses.rom:
sa no mitramahastvamagne shukrena shochisha |
devaira satsi barhishi ||
verses.en:
So Agni, rich in many friends, with fiery splendour, seat thyself
With Gods upon our sacred grass.

verses.sa:
यो अग्निं तन्वो दमे देवं मर्तः सपर्यति ।
तस्मा इद्दीदयद्वसु ॥
verses.rom:
yo agnim tanvo dame devam martah saparyati |
tasma iddidayadvasu ||
verses.en:
The mortal man who serves the God Agni within his own abode,
For him he causes wealth to shine.

verses.sa:
अग्निर्मूर्धा दिवः ककुत्पतिः पृथिव्या अयम् ।
अपां रेतांसि जिन्वति ॥
verses.rom:
agnirmurdha divah kakutpatih prithivya ayam |
apam retamsi jinvati ||
verses.en:
Agni is head and height of heaven, the Master of the earth is he:
He quickeneth the watere seed.

verses.sa:
उदग्ने शुचयस्तव शुक्रा भ्राजन्त ईरते ।
तव ज्योतींष्यर्चयः ॥
verses.rom:
udagne shuchayastava shukra bhrajanta irate |
tava jyotimshyarchayah ||
verses.en:
Upward, O Agni, rise thy flames, pure and resplendent, blazing high,
Thy lustres, fair effulgences.

verses.sa:
ईशिषे वार्यस्य हि दात्रस्याग्ने स्वर्पतिः ।
स्तोता स्यां तव शर्मणि ॥
verses.rom:
ishishe varyasya hi datrasyagne svarpatih |
stota syam tava sharmani ||
verses.en:
For, Agni, thou as Lord of Light rulest o'er choicest gifts: may I,
Thy singer, find defense in thee.

verses.sa:
त्वामग्ने मनीषिणस्त्वां हिन्वन्ति चित्तिभिः ।
त्वां वर्धन्तु नो गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne manishinastvam hinvanti chittibhih |
tvam vardhantu no girah ||
verses.en:
O Agni, they who understand stir thee to action with their thoughts:
So let our songs enhance thy might.

verses.sa:
अदब्धस्य स्वधावतो दूतस्य रेभतः सदा ।
अग्नेः सख्यं वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
adabdhasya svadhavato dutasya rebhatah sada |
agneh sakhyam vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
We ever claim the friendship of Agni, the singing messenger,
Of God-like nature, void of guile.

verses.sa:
अग्निः शुचिव्रततमः शुचिर्विप्रः शुचिः कविः ।
शुची रोचत आहुतः ॥
verses.rom:
agnih shuchivratatamah shuchirviprah shuchih kavih |
shuchi rochata ahutah ||
verses.en:
Agni who bears most holy sway, the holy Singer, holy Sage,
Shines holy when we worship him.

verses.sa:
उत त्वा धीतयो मम गिरो वर्धन्तु विश्वहा ।
अग्ने सख्यस्य बोधि नः ॥
verses.rom:
uta tva dhitayo mama giro vardhantu vishvaha |
agne sakhyasya bodhi nah ||
verses.en:
Yea, let my meditations, let my songs exalt thee evermore.
Think, Agni, of our friendly bond,

verses.sa:
यदग्ने स्यामहं त्वं त्वं वा घा स्या अहम् ।
स्युष्टे सत्या इहाशिषः ॥
verses.rom:
yadagne syamaham tvam tvam va gha sya aham |
syushte satya ihashishah ||
verses.en:
If I were thou and thou wert I, O Agni, every prayer of thine
Should have its due fulfilment here.

verses.sa:
वसुर्वसुपतिर्हि कमस्यग्ने विभावसुः ।
स्याम ते सुमतावपि ॥
verses.rom:
vasurvasupatirhi kamasyagne vibhavasuh |
syama te sumatavapi ||
verses.en:
For Excellent and Lord of wealth. art thou O Agni, rich in light:
May we enjoy thy favouring grace.

verses.sa:
अग्ने धृतव्रताय ते समुद्रायेव सिन्धवः ।
गिरो वाश्रास ईरते ॥
verses.rom:
agne dhritavrataya te samudrayeva sindhavah |
giro vashrasa irate ||
verses.en:
Agni, to thee whose laws stand fast our resonant songs of praise speed forth,
As rivers hasten to the sea.

verses.sa:
युवानं विश्पतिं कविं विश्वादं पुरुवेपसम् ।
अग्निं शुम्भामि मन्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvanam vishpatim kavim vishvadam puruvepasam |
agnim shumbhami manmabhih ||
verses.en:
Agni, the Youthful Lord of men, who stirreth much and eateth all,
The Sage, I glorify with hymns.

verses.sa:
यज्ञानां रथ्ये वयं तिग्मजम्भाय वीळवे ।
स्तोमैरिषेमाग्नये ॥
verses.rom:
yajnanam rathye vayam tigmajambhaya vilave |
stomairishemagnaye ||
verses.en:
To Agni let us haste with lauds, the Guide of sacrificial rites,
Armed with sharp teeth, the Mighty One.

verses.sa:
अयमग्ने त्वे अपि जरिता भूतु सन्त्य ।
तस्मै पावक मृळय ॥
verses.rom:
ayamagne tve api jarita bhutu santya |
tasmai pavaka mrilaya ||
verses.en:
And let this man, good Agni, be with thee the singer of thy praise:
Be gracious, Holy One, to him.

verses.sa:
धीरो ह्यस्यद्मसद्विप्रो न जागृविः सदा ।
अग्ने दीदयसि द्यवि ॥
verses.rom:
dhiro hyasyadmasadvipro na jagrivih sada |
agne didayasi dyavi ||
verses.en:
For thou art sharer of our feast, wise, ever watchful as a Sage:
Agni, thou shinest in the sky.

verses.sa:
पुराग्ने दुरितेभ्यः पुरा मृध्रेभ्यः कवे ।
प्र ण आयुर्वसो तिर ॥
verses.rom:
puragne duritebhyah pura mridhrebhyah kave |
pra na ayurvaso tira ||
verses.en:
O Agni, Sage, before our foes, before misfortunes fall on us,
Excellent Lord, prolong our lives.

verses.sa:
आ घा ये अग्निमिन्धते स्तृणन्ति बर्हिरानुषक् ।
येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥
verses.rom:
a gha ye agnimindhate strinanti barhiranushak |
yeshamindro yuva sakha ||
verses.en:
HITHERWARD! they who light flame and straightway trim the sacred grass.
Whose Friend is Indra ever young.

verses.sa:
बृहन्निदिध्म एषां भूरि शस्तं पृथुः स्वरुः ।
येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥
verses.rom:
brihannididhma esham bhuri shastam prithuh svaruh |
yeshamindro yuva sakha ||
verses.en:
High is their fuel, great their laud, wide is their splinter from the stake,
Whose Friend is Indra ever young.

verses.sa:
अयुद्ध इद्युधा वृतं शूर आजति सत्वभिः ।
येषामिन्द्रो युवा सखा ॥
verses.rom:
ayuddha idyudha vritam shura ajati satvabhih |
yeshamindro yuva sakha ||
verses.en:
Unequalled in fight the hero leads his army with the warrior chiefs.
Whose Friend is Indra ever young.

verses.sa:
आ बुन्दं वृत्रहा ददे जातः पृच्छद्वि मातरम् ।
क उग्राः के ह शृण्विरे ॥
verses.rom:
a bundam vritraha dade jatah prichchhadvi mataram |
ka ugrah ke ha shrinvire ||
verses.en:
The new-born Vrtra-slayer asked his Mother, as he seized his shaft,
Who are the fierce? Who are renowned?

verses.sa:
प्रति त्वा शवसी वदद्गिरावप्सो न योधिषत् ।
यस्ते शत्रुत्वमाचके ॥
verses.rom:
prati tva shavasi vadadgiravapso na yodhishat |
yaste shatrutvamachake ||
verses.en:
Savasi answered, He who seeks thine enmity will battle like
A stately elephant on a hill.

verses.sa:
उत त्वं मघवञ्छृणु यस्ते वष्टि ववक्षि तत् ।
यद्वीळयासि वीळु तत् ॥
verses.rom:
uta tvam maghavanchhrinu yaste vashti vavakshi tat |
yadvilayasi vilu tat ||
verses.en:
And hear, O Maghavan; to him who craves of thee thou grantest all
Whate'er thou makest firm is firm.

verses.sa:
यदाजिं यात्याजिकृदिन्द्रः स्वश्वयुरुप ।
रथीतमो रथीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadajim yatyajikridindrah svashvayurupa |
rathitamo rathinam ||
verses.en:
What time the Warrior Indra goes to battle, borne by noble steeds,
Best of all charioteers is he.

verses.sa:
वि षु विश्वा अभियुजो वज्रिन्विष्वग्यथा वृह ।
भवा नः सुश्रवस्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
vi shu vishva abhiyujo vajrinvishvagyatha vriha |
bhava nah sushravastamah ||
verses.en:
Repel, O Thunder-armed, in all directions all attacks on us:
And be our own most glorious God.

verses.sa:
अस्माकं सु रथं पुर इन्द्रः कृणोतु सातये ।
न यं धूर्वन्ति धूर्तयः ॥
verses.rom:
asmakam su ratham pura indrah krinotu sataye |
na yam dhurvanti dhurtayah ||
verses.en:
May Indra set our car in front, in foremost Place to win the spoil,
He whom the wicked injure not.

verses.sa:
वृज्याम ते परि द्विषोऽरं ते शक्र दावने ।
गमेमेदिन्द्र गोमतः ॥
verses.rom:
vrijyama te pari dvisho'ram te shakra davane |
gamemedindra gomatah ||
verses.en:
Thine enmity may we escape, and, Gakra, for thy bounty, rich
In kine, may we come near to thee

verses.sa:
शनैश्चिद्यन्तो अद्रिवोऽश्वावन्तः शतग्विनः ।
विवक्षणा अनेहसः ॥
verses.rom:
shanaishchidyanto adrivo'shvavantah shatagvinah |
vivakshana anehasah ||
verses.en:
Softly approaching, Thunder-armed wealthy by hundreds, rich in steeds,
Unrivalled, ready with our gifts.

verses.sa:
ऊर्ध्वा हि ते दिवेदिवे सहस्रा सूनृता शता ।
जरितृभ्यो विमंहते ॥
verses.rom:
urdhva hi te divedive sahasra sunrita shata |
jaritribhyo vimamhate ||
verses.en:
For thine exalted excellence gives to thy worshippers each day
Hundreds and thousands of thy boons.

verses.sa:
विद्मा हि त्वा धनंजयमिन्द्र दृळ्हा चिदारुजम् ।
आदारिणं यथा गयम् ॥
verses.rom:
vidma hi tva dhanamjayamindra drilha chidarujam |
adarinam yatha gayam ||
verses.en:
Indra, we know thee breaker-down even of strong forts, winner of spoil,
A:one who conquers wealth for us.

verses.sa:
ककुहं चित्त्वा कवे मन्दन्तु धृष्णविन्दवः ।
आ त्वा पणिं यदीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
kakuham chittva kave mandantu dhrishnavindavah |
a tva panim yadimahe ||
verses.en:
Though thou art highest, Sage and Bold let the drops cheer thee when we come
To thee as to a trafficker.

verses.sa:
यस्ते रेवाँ अदाशुरिः प्रममर्ष मघत्तये ।
तस्य नो वेद आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
yaste revan adashurih pramamarsha maghattaye |
tasya no veda a bhara ||
verses.en:
Bring unto us the treasure of the opulent man who, loth to give,
Hath slighted thee for gain of wealth.

verses.sa:
इम उ त्वा वि चक्षते सखाय इन्द्र सोमिनः ।
पुष्टावन्तो यथा पशुम् ॥
verses.rom:
ima u tva vi chakshate sakhaya indra sominah |
pushtavanto yatha pashum ||
verses.en:
Indra, these friends of ours, supplied with Soma, wait and look to thee,
As men with fodder to the herd.

verses.sa:
उत त्वाबधिरं वयं श्रुत्कर्णं सन्तमूतये ।
दूरादिह हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
uta tvabadhiram vayam shrutkarnam santamutaye |
duradiha havamahe ||
verses.en:
And thee who art not deaf, whose cars are quick to listen, for our aid,
We call to us from far away.

verses.sa:
यच्छुश्रूया इमं हवं दुर्मर्षं चक्रिया उत ।
भवेरापिर्नो अन्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
yachchhushruya imam havam durmarsham chakriya uta |
bhaverapirno antamah ||
verses.en:
When thou hast listened, make our call one which thou never wilt forget,
And be our very nearest Friend.

verses.sa:
यच्चिद्धि ते अपि व्यथिर्जगन्वांसो अमन्महि ।
गोदा इदिन्द्र बोधि नः ॥
verses.rom:
yachchiddhi te api vyathirjaganvamso amanmahi |
goda idindra bodhi nah ||
verses.en:
When even now, when we have been in trouble, we have thought of thee,
O Indra, give us gifts of kine.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा रम्भं न जिव्रयो ररभ्मा शवसस्पते ।
उश्मसि त्वा सधस्थ आ ॥
verses.rom:
a tva rambham na jivrayo rarabhma shavasaspate |
ushmasi tva sadhastha a ||
verses.en:
O Lord of Strength, we rest on thee, as old men rest upon a staff:
We long to have. thee dwell with us.

verses.sa:
स्तोत्रमिन्द्राय गायत पुरुनृम्णाय सत्वने ।
नकिर्यं वृण्वते युधि ॥
verses.rom:
stotramindraya gayata purunrimnaya satvane |
nakiryam vrinvate yudhi ||
verses.en:
To Indra sing a song of praise, Hero of mighty valour, him
Whom no one challenges to war.

verses.sa:
अभि त्वा वृषभा सुते सुतं सृजामि पीतये ।
तृम्पा व्यश्नुही मदम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi tva vrishabha sute sutam srijami pitaye |
trimpa vyashnuhi madam ||
verses.en:
Hero, the Soma being shed, I pour the juice for thee to drink:
Sate thee and finish thy carouse.

verses.sa:
मा त्वा मूरा अविष्यवो मोपहस्वान आ दभन् ।
माकीं ब्रह्मद्विषो वनः ॥
verses.rom:
ma tva mura avishyavo mopahasvana a dabhan |
makim brahmadvisho vanah ||
verses.en:
Let not the fools, or those who mock beguile thee when they seek thine aid
Love not the enemies of prayer.

verses.sa:
इह त्वा गोपरीणसा महे मन्दन्तु राधसे ।
सरो गौरो यथा पिब ॥
verses.rom:
iha tva goparinasa mahe mandantu radhase |
saro gauro yatha piba ||
verses.en:
Here let them with rich milky draught cheer thee to great munificence:
Drink as the wild-bull drinks the lake.

verses.sa:
या वृत्रहा परावति सना नवा च चुच्युवे ।
ता संसत्सु प्र वोचत ॥
verses.rom:
ya vritraha paravati sana nava cha chuchyuve |
ta samsatsu pra vochata ||
verses.en:
Proclaim in our assemblies what deeds, new and ancient, far away,
The Vrtra-slayer hath achieved.

verses.sa:
अपिबत्कद्रुवः सुतमिन्द्रः सहस्रबाह्वे ।
अत्रादेदिष्ट पौंस्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
apibatkadruvah sutamindrah sahasrabahve |
atradedishta paumsyam ||
verses.en:
In battle of a thousand arms Indra drank Kadru's Soma juice:
There he displayed his manly might.

verses.sa:
सत्यं तत्तुर्वशे यदौ विदानो अह्नवाय्यम् ।
व्यानट् तुर्वणे शमि ॥
verses.rom:
satyam tatturvashe yadau vidano ahnavayyam |
vyanat turvane shami ||
verses.en:
True undeniable strength he found in Yadu and in Turvasa,
And conquered through the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
तरणिं वो जनानां त्रदं वाजस्य गोमतः ।
समानमु प्र शंसिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
taranim vo jananam tradam vajasya gomatah |
samanamu pra shamsisham ||
verses.en:
Him have I magnified, our Lord in, common, Guardian of your folk,
Discloser of great wealth in kine;

verses.sa:
ऋभुक्षणं न वर्तव उक्थेषु तुग्र्यावृधम् ।
इन्द्रं सोमे सचा सुते ॥
verses.rom:
ribhukshanam na vartava uktheshu tugryavridham |
indram some sacha sute ||
verses.en:
Rbhuksan, not to be restrained, who strengthened Tugra's son in lauds,
Indra beside the flowing juice;

verses.sa:
यः कृन्तदिद्वि योन्यं त्रिशोकाय गिरिं पृथुम् ।
गोभ्यो गातुं निरेतवे ॥
verses.rom:
yah krintadidvi yonyam trishokaya girim prithum |
gobhyo gatum niretave ||
verses.en:
Who for Trisoka clave the hill that formed a wide receptacle,
So that the cows might issue forth.

verses.sa:
यद्दधिषे मनस्यसि मन्दानः प्रेदियक्षसि ।
मा तत्करिन्द्र मृळय ॥
verses.rom:
yaddadhishe manasyasi mandanah prediyakshasi |
ma tatkarindra mrilaya ||
verses.en:
Whate'er thy plan or purpose be, whate'er, in transport, thou wouldst do,
Do it not, Indra, but be kind.

verses.sa:
दभ्रं चिद्धि त्वावतः कृतं शृण्वे अधि क्षमि ।
जिगात्विन्द्र ते मनः ॥
verses.rom:
dabhram chiddhi tvavatah kritam shrinve adhi kshami |
jigatvindra te manah ||
verses.en:
But little hath been heard of done upon the earth by one like thee i
Let thine heart, Indra, turn to us.

verses.sa:
तवेदु ताः सुकीर्तयोऽसन्नुत प्रशस्तयः ।
यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
verses.rom:
tavedu tah sukirtayo'sannuta prashastayah |
yadindra mrilayasi nah ||
verses.en:
Thine then shall be this high renown, thine shall these lofty praises be,
When, Indra, thou art kind to us.

verses.sa:
मा न एकस्मिन्नागसि मा द्वयोरुत त्रिषु ।
वधीर्मा शूर भूरिषु ॥
verses.rom:
ma na ekasminnagasi ma dvayoruta trishu |
vadhirma shura bhurishu ||
verses.en:
Not for one trespass, not for two, O Hero, slay us, nor for three,
Nor yet for many trespasses.

verses.sa:
बिभया हि त्वावत उग्रादभिप्रभङ्गिणः ।
दस्मादहमृतीषहः ॥
verses.rom:
bibhaya hi tvavata ugradabhiprabhanginah |
dasmadahamritishahah ||
verses.en:
I fear one powerful like thee, the crusher down of enemies,
Mighty, repelling all attacks.

verses.sa:
मा सख्युः शूनमा विदे मा पुत्रस्य प्रभूवसो ।
आवृत्वद्भूतु ते मनः ॥
verses.rom:
ma sakhyuh shunama vide ma putrasya prabhuvaso |
avritvadbhutu te manah ||
verses.en:
O wealthy God, ne'er may I live to see my friend or son in need*:
Hitherward let thy heart be turned.

verses.sa:
को नु मर्या अमिथितः सखा सखायमब्रवीत् ।
जहा को अस्मदीषते ॥
verses.rom:
ko nu marya amithitah sakha sakhayamabravit |
jaha ko asmadishate ||
verses.en:
What friend, O people, unprovoked, hath ever said unto a friend,
He turns and leaves us in distress?

verses.sa:
एवारे वृषभा सुतेऽसिन्वन्भूर्यावयः ।
श्वघ्नीव निवता चरन् ॥
verses.rom:
evare vrishabha sute'sinvanbhuryavayah |
shvaghniva nivata charan ||
verses.en:
Hero, insatiate enjoy this Soma juice so near to thee,
Even as a hunter rushing down.

verses.sa:
आ त एता वचोयुजा हरी गृभ्णे सुमद्रथा ।
यदीं ब्रह्मभ्य इद्ददः ॥
verses.rom:
a ta eta vachoyuja hari gribhne sumadratha |
yadim brahmabhya iddadah ||
verses.en:
Hither I draw those Bays of thine yoked
by our hymn, with splendid car,
That thou mayst give unto the priests.

verses.sa:
भिन्धि विश्वा अप द्विषः परि बाधो जही मृधः ।
वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥
verses.rom:
bhindhi vishva apa dvishah pari badho jahi mridhah |
vasu sparham tada bhara ||
verses.en:
Drive all our enemies away, smite down the foes who press around,
And bring the wealth for which we long:

verses.sa:
यद्वीळाविन्द्र यत्स्थिरे यत्पर्शाने पराभृतम् ।
वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥
verses.rom:
yadvilavindra yatsthire yatparshane parabhritam |
vasu sparham tada bhara ||
verses.en:
O Indra, that which is concealed in strong firm place precipitous:
Bring us the wealth for which we long

verses.sa:
यस्य ते विश्वमानुषो भूरेर्दत्तस्य वेदति ।
वसु स्पार्हं तदा भर ॥
verses.rom:
yasya te vishvamanusho bhurerdattasya vedati |
vasu sparham tada bhara ||
verses.en:
Great riches which the world of men shall recognize as sent by thou:
Bring us the wealth for which we long.

verses.sa:
त्वावतः पुरूवसो वयमिन्द्र प्रणेतः ।
स्मसि स्थातर्हरीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvavatah puruvaso vayamindra pranetah |
smasi sthatarharinam ||
verses.en:
WE, Indra, Lord of ample wealth, our Guide, depend on one like thee,
Thou driver of the Tawny Steeds.

verses.sa:
त्वां हि सत्यमद्रिवो विद्म दातारमिषाम् ।
विद्म दातारं रयीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi satyamadrivo vidma dataramisham |
vidma dataram rayinam ||
verses.en:
For, Hurler of the Bolt, we know thee true, the giver of our food,
We know the giver of our wealth.

verses.sa:
आ यस्य ते महिमानं शतमूते शतक्रतो ।
गीर्भिर्गृणन्ति कारवः ॥
verses.rom:
a yasya te mahimanam shatamute shatakrato |
girbhirgrinanti karavah ||
verses.en:
O thou whose majesty the bards celebrate with their songs, thou Lord,
Of hundred powers and hundred aids.

verses.sa:
सुनीथो घा स मर्त्यो यं मरुतो यमर्यमा ।
मित्रः पान्त्यद्रुहः ॥
verses.rom:
sunitho gha sa martyo yam maruto yamaryama |
mitrah pantyadruhah ||
verses.en:
Fair guidance hath the mortal man whom Aryaman, the Marut host,
And Mitra, void of guile, protect.

verses.sa:
दधानो गोमदश्ववत्सुवीर्यमादित्यजूत एधते ।
सदा राया पुरुस्पृहा ॥
verses.rom:
dadhano gomadashvavatsuviryamadityajuta edhate |
sada raya puruspriha ||
verses.en:
Kine, steeds, and hero strength he gains, and prospers, by the Adityas sped,
Ever in wealth which all desire.

verses.sa:
तमिन्द्रं दानमीमहे शवसानमभीर्वम् ।
ईशानं राय ईमहे ॥
verses.rom:
tamindram danamimahe shavasanamabhirvam |
ishanam raya imahe ||
verses.en:
We pray to Indra for his gift, to him the Fearless and the Strong,
We pray to him the Lord of wealth.

verses.sa:
तस्मिन्हि सन्त्यूतयो विश्वा अभीरवः सचा ।
तमा वहन्तु सप्तयः पुरूवसुं मदाय हरयः सुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasminhi santyutayo vishva abhiravah sacha |
tama vahantu saptayah puruvasum madaya harayah sutam ||
verses.en:
For verily combined in him are all the fearless powers of aid.
Him, rich in wealth, let swift Steeds bring to us, his Bays, to Soma juice for his carouse:

verses.sa:
यस्ते मदो वरेण्यो य इन्द्र वृत्रहन्तमः ।
य आददिः स्वर्नृभिर्यः पृतनासु दुष्टरः ॥
verses.rom:
yaste mado varenyo ya indra vritrahantamah |
ya adadih svarnribhiryah pritanasu dushtarah ||
verses.en:
Yea, that most excellent carouse, Indra, which slays most enemies,
With Heroes wins the light of heaven, and is invincible in war:

verses.sa:
यो दुष्टरो विश्ववार श्रवाय्यो वाजेष्वस्ति तरुता ।
स नः शविष्ठ सवना वसो गहि गमेम गोमति व्रजे ॥
verses.rom:
yo dushtaro vishvavara shravayyo vajeshvasti taruta |
sa nah shavishtha savana vaso gahi gamema gomati vraje ||
verses.en:
Which merits fame, all-bountiful! and, unsubdued, hath victory in deeds of might.
So come to our libations, Strongest! Excellent! May we obtain a stall of kine.

verses.sa:
गव्यो षु णो यथा पुराश्वयोत रथया ।
वरिवस्य महामह ॥
verses.rom:
gavyo shu no yatha purashvayota rathaya |
varivasya mahamaha ||
verses.en:
Responding to our wish for cows, for steeds, and chariots, as of old,
Be gracious, Greatest of the Great

verses.sa:
नहि ते शूर राधसोऽन्तं विन्दामि सत्रा ।
दशस्या नो मघवन्नू चिदद्रिवो धियो वाजेभिराविथ ॥
verses.rom:
nahi te shura radhaso'ntam vindami satra |
dashasya no maghavannu chidadrivo dhiyo vajebhiravitha ||
verses.en:
For, Hero, nowhere can I find the bounds of thy munificence.
Still do thou favour us, O Bolt-armed Maghavan: with strength hast thou rewarded hymns.

verses.sa:
य ऋष्वः श्रावयत्सखा विश्वेत्स वेद जनिमा पुरुष्टुतः ।
तं विश्वे मानुषा युगेन्द्रं हवन्ते तविषं यतस्रुचः ॥
verses.rom:
ya rishvah shravayatsakha vishvetsa veda janima purushtutah |
tam vishve manusha yugendram havante tavisham yatasruchah ||
verses.en:
High, glorifier of his friend, he knows all generations, he whom many praise.
All races of mankind with ladies lifted up invoke that Mighty Indra's aid.

verses.sa: स नो वाजेष्वविता पुरूवसुः पुरस्थाता मघवा वृत्रहा भुवत् ॥
verses.rom: sa no vajeshvavita puruvasuh purasthata maghava vritraha bhuvat ||
verses.en: Be he our Champion and Protector in great deeds, rich in all wealth, the Vrtra-slayer, Maghavan.

verses.sa:
अभि वो वीरमन्धसो मदेषु गाय गिरा महा विचेतसम् ।
इन्द्रं नाम श्रुत्यं शाकिनं वचो यथा ॥
verses.rom:
abhi vo viramandhaso madeshu gaya gira maha vichetasam |
indram nama shrutyam shakinam vacho yatha ||
verses.en:
In the wild raptures of the juice sing to your Hero with high laud, to him the Wise,
To Indra, glorious in his name, the Mighty One, even as the hymn alloweth it.

verses.sa:
ददी रेक्णस्तन्वे ददिर्वसु ददिर्वाजेषु पुरुहूत वाजिनम् ।
नूनमथ ॥
verses.rom:
dadi reknastanve dadirvasu dadirvajeshu puruhuta vajinam |
nunamatha ||
verses.en:
Thou givest wealth to me myself, thou givest treasure, Excellent! and the strong steed,
O Much-invoked, in deeds of might, yea, even now.

verses.sa:
विश्वेषामिरज्यन्तं वसूनां सासह्वांसं चिदस्य वर्पसः ।
कृपयतो नूनमत्यथ ॥
verses.rom:
vishveshamirajyantam vasunam sasahvamsam chidasya varpasah |
kripayato nunamatyatha ||
verses.en:
Him, Sovran Ruler of all precious things, who even hath power o'er this fair form of his,
As now it taketh shape, and afterward,

verses.sa:
महः सु वो अरमिषे स्तवामहे मीळ्हुषे अरंगमाय जग्मये ।
यज्ञेभिर्गीर्भिर्विश्वमनुषां मरुतामियक्षसि गाये त्वा नमसा गिरा ॥
verses.rom:
mahah su vo aramishe stavamahe milhushe aramgamaya jagmaye |
yajnebhirgirbhirvishvamanusham marutamiyakshasi gaye tva namasa gira ||
verses.en:
We praise, so that the Mighty One may speed to you, Pourer of bounties, Traveller, prepared to go.
Thou favourest the Maruts known to all, by song and sacrifice. With song and praise I sing to thee.

verses.sa:
ये पातयन्ते अज्मभिर्गिरीणां स्नुभिरेषाम् ।
यज्ञं महिष्वणीनां सुम्नं तुविष्वणीनां प्राध्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
ye patayante ajmabhirgirinam snubhiresham |
yajnam mahishvaninam sumnam tuvishvaninam pradhvare ||
verses.en:
We in the sacrifice perform their will whose voice is lifted high,
The worship of those Thundering Ones who o'er the ridges of these mountains fly in troops.

verses.sa:
प्रभङ्गं दुर्मतीनामिन्द्र शविष्ठा भर ।
रयिमस्मभ्यं युज्यं चोदयन्मते ज्येष्ठं चोदयन्मते ॥
verses.rom:
prabhangam durmatinamindra shavishtha bhara |
rayimasmabhyam yujyam chodayanmate jyeshtham chodayanmate ||
verses.en:
O Indra, Mightiest, bring us that which crushes men of evil minds,
Wealth suited to our needs, O Stirrer of the thought, best wealth, O thou who stirrest thought.

verses.sa:
सनितः सुसनितरुग्र चित्र चेतिष्ठ सूनृत ।
प्रासहा सम्राट् सहुरिं सहन्तं भुज्युं वाजेषु पूर्व्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
sanitah susanitarugra chitra chetishtha sunrita |
prasaha samrat sahurim sahantam bhujyum vajeshu purvyam ||
verses.en:
O Winner, noble winner, strong, wondrous, most splendid, excellent,
Sole Lord of victory, bring all-overpowering wealth, joy-giving, chief in deeds of might.

verses.sa:
आ स एतु य ईवदाँ अदेवः पूर्तमाददे ।
यथा चिद्वशो अश्व्यः पृथुश्रवसि कानीतेऽस्या व्युष्याददे ॥
verses.rom:
a sa etu ya ivadan adevah purtamadade |
yatha chidvasho ashvyah prithushravasi kanite'sya vyushyadade ||
verses.en:
Now let the godless man approach who hath received reward so great
As Vasa, Asvya, when this light of morning dawned, received from Prthusravas, from Kanita's son.

verses.sa:
षष्टिं सहस्राश्व्यस्यायुतासनमुष्ट्रानां विंशतिं शता ।
दश श्यावीनां शता दश त्र्यरुषीणां दश गवां सहस्रा ॥
verses.rom:
shashtim sahasrashvyasyayutasanamushtranam vimshatim shata |
dasha shyavinam shata dasha tryarushinam dasha gavam sahasra ||
verses.en:
Steeds sixty thousand and ten thousand kine, and twenty hundred camels I obtained;
Ten hundred brown in hue, and other ten red in three spots: in all, ten thousand kine.

verses.sa:
दश श्यावा ऋधद्रयो वीतवारास आशवः ।
मथ्रा नेमिं नि वावृतुः ॥
verses.rom:
dasha shyava ridhadrayo vitavarasa ashavah |
mathra nemim ni vavrituh ||
verses.en:
Ten browns that make my wealth increase, fleet steeds whose tails are long and fair,
Turn with swift whirl my chariot wheel;

verses.sa:
दानासः पृथुश्रवसः कानीतस्य सुराधसः ।
