रथं हिरण्ययं ददन्मंहिष्ठः सूरिरभूद्वर्षिष्ठमकृत श्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
danasah prithushravasah kanitasya suradhasah |
ratham hiranyayam dadanmamhishthah surirabhudvarshishthamakrita shravah ||
verses.en:
The gifts which Prthusravas gave, Kanita's son munificent.
He gave a chariot wrought of gold: the prince was passing bountiful, and won himself most lofty fame.

verses.sa:
आ नो वायो महे तने याहि मखाय पाजसे ।
वयं हि ते चकृमा भूरि दावने सद्यश्चिन्महि दावने ॥
verses.rom:
a no vayo mahe tane yahi makhaya pajase |
vayam hi te chakrima bhuri davane sadyashchinmahi davane ||
verses.en:
Come thou to this great rite of ours, Vayu! to give us vigorous light.
We have served thee that thou mightest give much to us, yea, mightest quickly give great wealth.

verses.sa:
यो अश्वेभिर्वहते वस्त उस्रास्त्रिः सप्त सप्ततीनाम् ।
एभिः सोमेभिः सोमसुद्भिः सोमपा दानाय शुक्रपूतपाः ॥
verses.rom:
yo ashvebhirvahate vasta usrastrih sapta saptatinam |
ebhih somebhih somasudbhih somapa danaya shukraputapah ||
verses.en:
Who with thrice seven times seventy horses comes to us, invested with the rays of morn,
Through these our Soma-draughts and those who press, to give, drinker of pure bright Soma Juice.

verses.sa:
यो म इमं चिदु त्मनामन्दच्चित्रं दावने ।
अरट्वे अक्षे नहुषे सुकृत्वनि सुकृत्तराय सुक्रतुः ॥
verses.rom:
yo ma imam chidu tmanamandachchitram davane |
aratve akshe nahushe sukritvani sukrittaraya sukratuh ||
verses.en:
Who hath inclined this glorious one, bounteous himself, to give me gifts.
Borne on firm chariot with the prosperous Nahup, wise, to a man yet more devout.

verses.sa:
उचथ्ये वपुषि यः स्वराळुत वायो घृतस्नाः ।
अश्वेषितं रजेषितं शुनेषितं प्राज्म तदिदं नु तत् ॥
verses.rom:
uchathye vapushi yah svaraluta vayo ghritasnah |
ashveshitam rajeshitam shuneshitam prajma tadidam nu tat ||
verses.en:
Sole Lord in beauty meet for praise, O Vayu, dropping fatness down,
Hurried along by steeds, by camels, and by hounds, spreads forth thy train: even this it is.

verses.sa:
अध प्रियमिषिराय षष्टिं सहस्रासनम् ।
अश्वानामिन्न वृष्णाम् ॥
verses.rom:
adha priyamishiraya shashtim sahasrasanam |
ashvanaminna vrishnam ||
verses.en:
So, as a prize dear to the strong, the sixty thousand have I gained,
Bulls that resemble vigorous steeds.

verses.sa: गावो न यूथमुप यन्ति वध्रय उप मा यन्ति वध्रयः ॥
verses.rom: gavo na yuthamupa yanti vadhraya upa ma yanti vadhrayah ||
verses.en: To me come oxen like a herd, yea, unto me the oxen come.

verses.sa:
अध यच्चारथे गणे शतमुष्ट्राँ अचिक्रदत् ।
अध श्वित्नेषु विंशतिं शता ॥
verses.rom:
adha yachcharathe gane shatamushtran achikradat |
adha shvitneshu vimshatim shata ||
verses.en:
And in the grazing herd he made a hundred camels bleat for me,
And twenty hundred mid the white.

verses.sa:
शतं दासे बल्बूथे विप्रस्तरुक्ष आ ददे ।
ते ते वायविमे जना मदन्तीन्द्रगोपा मदन्ति देवगोपाः ॥
verses.rom:
shatam dase balbuthe viprastaruksha a dade |
te te vayavime jana madantindragopa madanti devagopah ||
verses.en:
A hundred has the sage received, Dasa Balbutha's and Taruksa's gifts.
These are thy people, Vayu, who rejoice with Indra for their guard, rejoice with Gods for guards.

verses.sa:
अध स्या योषणा मही प्रतीची वशमश्व्यम् ।
अधिरुक्मा वि नीयते ॥
verses.rom:
adha sya yoshana mahi pratichi vashamashvyam |
adhirukma vi niyate ||
verses.en:
And now to Vasa Asvya here this stately woman is led forth,
Adorned with ornaments of gold.

verses.sa:
महि वो महतामवो वरुण मित्र दाशुषे ।
यमादित्या अभि द्रुहो रक्षथा नेमघं नशदनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
mahi vo mahatamavo varuna mitra dashushe |
yamaditya abhi druho rakshatha nemagham nashadanehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
GREAT help ye give the worshipper, Varuna, Mitra, Mighty Ones!
No sorrow ever reaches him whom ye, Adityas, keep from harm. Yours are incomparable aids, and good the succour they afford.

verses.sa:
विदा देवा अघानामादित्यासो अपाकृतिम् ।
पक्षा वयो यथोपरि व्यस्मे शर्म यच्छतानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
vida deva aghanamadityaso apakritim |
paksha vayo yathopari vyasme sharma yachchhatanehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
O Gods, Adityas, well ye know the way to keep all woes afar.
As the birds spread their sheltering wings, spread your protection over us.

verses.sa:
व्यस्मे अधि शर्म तत्पक्षा वयो न यन्तन ।
विश्वानि विश्ववेदसो वरूथ्या मनामहेऽनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
vyasme adhi sharma tatpaksha vayo na yantana |
vishvani vishvavedaso varuthya manamahe'nehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
As the birds spread their sheltering wings let your protection cover us.
We mean all shelter and defense, ye who have all things for your own.

verses.sa:
यस्मा अरासत क्षयं जीवातुं च प्रचेतसः ।
मनोर्विश्वस्य घेदिम आदित्या राय ईशतेऽनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
yasma arasata kshayam jivatum cha prachetasah |
manorvishvasya ghedima aditya raya ishate'nehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
To whomsoever they, Most Wise, have given a home and means of life,
O'er the whole riches of this man they, the Adityas, have control.

verses.sa:
परि णो वृणजन्नघा दुर्गाणि रथ्यो यथा ।
स्यामेदिन्द्रस्य शर्मण्यादित्यानामुतावस्यनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
pari no vrinajannagha durgani rathyo yatha |
syamedindrasya sharmanyadityanamutavasyanehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
As drivers of the car avoid ill roads, let sorrows pass us by.
May we be under Indra's guard, in the Adityas' favouring grace.

verses.sa:
परिह्वृतेदना जनो युष्मादत्तस्य वायति ।
देवा अदभ्रमाश वो यमादित्या अहेतनानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
parihvritedana jano yushmadattasya vayati |
deva adabhramasha vo yamaditya ahetananehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
For verily men sink and faint through loss of wealth which ye have given.
Much hath he gained from you, O Gods, whom ye, Adityas, have approached.

verses.sa:
न तं तिग्मं चन त्यजो न द्रासदभि तं गुरु ।
यस्मा उ शर्म सप्रथ आदित्यासो अराध्वमनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
na tam tigmam chana tyajo na drasadabhi tam guru |
yasma u sharma sapratha adityaso aradhvamanehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
On him shall no fierce anger fall, no sore distress shall visit him,
To whom, Adityas, ye have lent your shelter that extendeth far.

verses.sa:
युष्मे देवा अपि ष्मसि युध्यन्त इव वर्मसु ।
यूयं महो न एनसो यूयमर्भादुरुष्यतानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
yushme deva api shmasi yudhyanta iva varmasu |
yuyam maho na enaso yuyamarbhadurushyatanehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
Resting in you, O Gods, we are like men who fight in coats of mail.
Ye guard us from each great offence, ye guard us from each lighter fault.

verses.sa:
अदितिर्न उरुष्यत्वदितिः शर्म यच्छतु ।
माता मित्रस्य रेवतोऽर्यम्णो वरुणस्य चानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
aditirna urushyatvaditih sharma yachchhatu |
mata mitrasya revato'ryamno varunasya chanehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
May Aditi defend us, may Aditi guard and shelter us,
Mother of wealthy Mitra and of Aryaman and Varuna.

verses.sa:
यद्देवाः शर्म शरणं यद्भद्रं यदनातुरम् ।
त्रिधातु यद्वरूथ्यं तदस्मासु वि यन्तनानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
yaddevah sharma sharanam yadbhadram yadanaturam |
tridhatu yadvaruthyam tadasmasu vi yantananehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
The shelter, Gods, that is secure, auspicious, free from malady,
A sure protection, triply strong, even that do ye extend to us.

verses.sa:
आदित्या अव हि ख्यताधि कूलादिव स्पशः ।
सुतीर्थमर्वतो यथानु नो नेषथा सुगमनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
aditya ava hi khyatadhi kuladiva spashah |
sutirthamarvato yathanu no neshatha sugamanehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
Look down on us, Adityas, as a guide exploring from the bank.
Lead us to pleasant ways as men lead horses to an easy ford.

verses.sa:
नेह भद्रं रक्षस्विने नावयै नोपया उत ।
गवे च भद्रं धेनवे वीराय च श्रवस्यतेऽनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
neha bhadram rakshasvine navayai nopaya uta |
gave cha bhadram dhenave viraya cha shravasyate'nehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
Ill be it for the demons' friend to find us or come near to us.
But for the milch-cow be it well, and for the man who strives for fame.

verses.sa:
यदाविर्यदपीच्यं देवासो अस्ति दुष्कृतम् ।
त्रिते तद्विश्वमाप्त्य आरे अस्मद्दधातनानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
yadaviryadapichyam devaso asti dushkritam |
trite tadvishvamaptya are asmaddadhatananehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
Each evil deed made manifest, and that which is concealed, O Gods,
The whole thereof remove from us to Trita Aptya far away.

verses.sa:
यच्च गोषु दुष्वप्न्यं यच्चास्मे दुहितर्दिवः ।
त्रिताय तद्विभावर्याप्त्याय परा वहानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
yachcha goshu dushvapnyam yachchasme duhitardivah |
tritaya tadvibhavaryaptyaya para vahanehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
Daughter of Heaven, the dream that bodes evil to us or to our kine,
Remove, O Lady of the Light, to Trita Aptya far away.

verses.sa:
निष्कं वा घा कृणवते स्रजं वा दुहितर्दिवः ।
त्रिते दुष्वप्न्यं सर्वमाप्त्ये परि दद्मस्यनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
nishkam va gha krinavate srajam va duhitardivah |
trite dushvapnyam sarvamaptye pari dadmasyanehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
Even if, O Child of Heaven, it make a garland or a chain of gold,
The whole bad dream, whate'er it be, to Trita Aptya we consign.

verses.sa:
तदन्नाय तदपसे तं भागमुपसेदुषे ।
त्रिताय च द्विताय चोषो दुष्वप्न्यं वहानेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
tadannaya tadapase tam bhagamupasedushe |
tritaya cha dvitaya chosho dushvapnyam vahanehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
To him whose food and work is this, who comes to take his share therein,
To Trita, and to Dvita, Dawn! bear thou the evil dream away.

verses.sa:
यथा कलां यथा शफं यथ ऋणं संनयामसि ।*
एवा दुष्वप्न्यं सर्वमाप्त्ये सं नयामस्यनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
yatha kalam yatha shapham yatha rinam samnayamasi |*
eva dushvapnyam sarvamaptye sam nayamasyanehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
As we collect the utmost debt, even the eighth and sixteenth part,
So unto Aptya we transfer together all the evil dream.

verses.sa:
अजैष्माद्यासनाम चाभूमानागसो वयम् ।
उषो यस्माद्दुष्वप्न्यादभैष्माप तदुच्छत्वनेहसो व ऊतयः सुऊतयो व ऊतयः ॥
verses.rom:
ajaishmadyasanama chabhumanagaso vayam |
usho yasmaddushvapnyadabhaishmapa taduchchhatvanehaso va utayah suutayo va utayah ||
verses.en:
Now have we conquered and obtained, and from our trespasses are free.
Shine thou away the evil dream, O Dawn, whereof we are afraid. Yours are incomparable aids, and good the succour they afford.

verses.sa:
स्वादोरभक्षि वयसः सुमेधाः स्वाध्यो वरिवोवित्तरस्य ।
विश्वे यं देवा उत मर्त्यासो मधु ब्रुवन्तो अभि संचरन्ति ॥
verses.rom:
svadorabhakshi vayasah sumedhah svadhyo varivovittarasya |
vishve yam deva uta martyaso madhu bruvanto abhi samcharanti ||
verses.en:
WISELY have I enjoyed the savoury viand, religious-thoughted, best to find out treasure,
The food to which all Deities and mortals, calling it meath, gather themselves together.

verses.sa:
अन्तश्च प्रागा अदितिर्भवास्यवयाता हरसो दैव्यस्य ।
इन्दविन्द्रस्य सख्यं जुषाणः श्रौष्टीव धुरमनु राय ऋध्याः ॥
verses.rom:
antashcha praga aditirbhavasyavayata haraso daivyasya |
indavindrasya sakhyam jushanah shraushtiva dhuramanu raya ridhyah ||
verses.en:
Thou shalt be Aditi as thou hast entered within, appeaser of celestial anger.
Indu, enjoying Indra's friendship, bring us - as a swift steed the car - forward to riches.

verses.sa:
अपाम सोमममृता अभूमागन्म ज्योतिरविदाम देवान् ।
किं नूनमस्मान्कृणवदरातिः किमु धूर्तिरमृत मर्त्यस्य ॥
verses.rom:
apama somamamrita abhumaganma jyotiravidama devan |
kim nunamasmankrinavadaratih kimu dhurtiramrita martyasya ||
verses.en:
We have drunk Soma and become immortal; we have attained the light, the Gods discovered.
Now what may foeman's malice do to harm us? What, O Immortal, mortal man's deception?

verses.sa:
शं नो भव हृद आ पीत इन्दो पितेव सोम सूनवे सुशेवः ।
सखेव सख्य उरुशंस धीरः प्र ण आयुर्जीवसे सोम तारीः ॥
verses.rom:
sham no bhava hrida a pita indo piteva soma sunave sushevah |
sakheva sakhya urushamsa dhirah pra na ayurjivase soma tarih ||
verses.en:
Absorbed into the heart, be sweet, O Indu, as a kind father to his son, O Soma,
As a wise Friend to friend: do thou, wide-ruler, O Soma, lengthen out our days for living.

verses.sa:
इमे मा पीता यशस उरुष्यवो रथं न गावः समनाह पर्वसु ।
ते मा रक्षन्तु विस्रसश्चरित्रादुत मा स्रामाद्यवयन्त्विन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
ime ma pita yashasa urushyavo ratham na gavah samanaha parvasu |
te ma rakshantu visrasashcharitraduta ma sramadyavayantvindavah ||
verses.en:
These glorious drops that give me freedom have I drunk. Closely they knit my joints as straps secure a car.
Let them protect my foot from slipping on the way: yea, let the drops I drink preserve me from disease.

verses.sa:
अग्निं न मा मथितं सं दिदीपः प्र चक्षय कृणुहि वस्यसो नः ।
अथा हि ते मद आ सोम मन्ये रेवाँ इव प्र चरा पुष्टिमच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
agnim na ma mathitam sam didipah pra chakshaya krinuhi vasyaso nah |
atha hi te mada a soma manye revan iva pra chara pushtimachchha ||
verses.en:
Make me shine bright like fire produced by friction: give us a clearer sight and make us better.
For in carouse I think of thee, O Soma, Shall I, as a rich man, attain to comfort?

verses.sa:
इषिरेण ते मनसा सुतस्य भक्षीमहि पित्र्यस्येव रायः ।
सोम राजन्प्र ण आयूंषि तारीरहानीव सूर्यो वासराणि ॥
verses.rom:
ishirena te manasa sutasya bhakshimahi pitryasyeva rayah |
soma rajanpra na ayumshi tarirahaniva suryo vasarani ||
verses.en:
May we enjoy with an enlivened spirit the juice thou givest, like ancestral riches.
O Soma, King, prolong thou our existence as Surya makes the shining days grow longer.

verses.sa:
सोम राजन्मृळया नः स्वस्ति तव स्मसि व्रत्यास्तस्य विद्धि ।
अलर्ति दक्ष उत मन्युरिन्दो मा नो अर्यो अनुकामं परा दाः ॥
verses.rom:
soma rajanmrilaya nah svasti tava smasi vratyastasya viddhi |
alarti daksha uta manyurindo ma no aryo anukamam para dah ||
verses.en:
King Soma, favour us and make us prosper: we are thy devotees; of this be mindful.
Spirit and power are fresh in us, O Indu give us not up unto our foeman's pleasure.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि नस्तन्वः सोम गोपा गात्रेगात्रे निषसत्था नृचक्षाः ।
यत्ते वयं प्रमिनाम व्रतानि स नो मृळ सुषखा देव वस्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi nastanvah soma gopa gatregatre nishasattha nrichakshah |
yatte vayam praminama vratani sa no mrila sushakha deva vasyah ||
verses.en:
For thou hast settled in each joint, O Soma, aim of men's eyes and guardian of our bodies.
When we offend against thine holy statutes, as a kind Friend, God, best of all, be gracious.

verses.sa:
ऋदूदरेण सख्या सचेय यो मा न रिष्येद्धर्यश्व पीतः ।
अयं यः सोमो न्यधाय्यस्मे तस्मा इन्द्रं प्रतिरमेम्यायुः ॥
verses.rom:
ridudarena sakhya sacheya yo ma na rishyeddharyashva pitah |
ayam yah somo nyadhayyasme tasma indram pratiramemyayuh ||
verses.en:
May I be with the Friend whose heart is tender, who, Lord of Bays! when quaffed will never harm me-
This Soma now deposited within me. For this, I pray for longer life to Indra.

verses.sa:
अप त्या अस्थुरनिरा अमीवा निरत्रसन्तमिषीचीरभैषुः ।
आ सोमो अस्माँ अरुहद्विहाया अगन्म यत्र प्रतिरन्त आयुः ॥
verses.rom:
apa tya asthuranira amiva niratrasantamishichirabhaishuh |
a somo asman aruhadvihaya aganma yatra pratiranta ayuh ||
verses.en:
Our maladies have lost their strength and vanished: they feared, and passed away into the darkness.
Soma hath risen in us, exceeding mighty, and we are come where men prolong existence.

verses.sa:
यो न इन्दुः पितरो हृत्सु पीतोऽमर्त्यो मर्त्याँ आविवेश ।
तस्मै सोमाय हविषा विधेम मृळीके अस्य सुमतौ स्याम ॥
verses.rom:
yo na induh pitaro hritsu pito'martyo martyan avivesha |
tasmai somaya havisha vidhema mrilike asya sumatau syama ||
verses.en:
Fathers, that Indu which our hearts have drunken, Immortal in himself, hath entered mortals.
So let us serve this Soma with oblation, and rest securely in his grace and favour.

verses.sa:
त्वं सोम पितृभिः संविदानोऽनु द्यावापृथिवी आ ततन्थ ।
तस्मै त इन्दो हविषा विधेम वयं स्याम पतयो रयीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam soma pitribhih samvidano'nu dyavaprithivi a tatantha |
tasmai ta indo havisha vidhema vayam syama patayo rayinam ||
verses.en:
Associate with the Fathers thou, O Soma, hast spread thyself abroad through earth and heaven.
So with oblation let us serve thee, Indu, and so let us become the lords of riches,

verses.sa:
त्रातारो देवा अधि वोचता नो मा नो निद्रा ईशत मोत जल्पिः ।
वयं सोमस्य विश्वह प्रियासः सुवीरासो विदथमा वदेम ॥
verses.rom:
trataro deva adhi vochata no ma no nidra ishata mota jalpih |
vayam somasya vishvaha priyasah suviraso vidathama vadema ||
verses.en:
Give us your blessing, O ye Gods' preservers. Never may sleep or idle talk control us.
But evermore may we, as friends of Soma, speak to the synod with brave sons around us.

verses.sa:
त्वं नः सोम विश्वतो वयोधास्त्वं स्वर्विदा विशा नृचक्षाः ।
त्वं न इन्द ऊतिभिः सजोषाः पाहि पश्चातादुत वा पुरस्तात् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam nah soma vishvato vayodhastvam svarvida visha nrichakshah |
tvam na inda utibhih sajoshah pahi pashchataduta va purastat ||
verses.en:
On all sides,. Soma, thou art our life-giver: aim of all eyes, light-finder, come within us.
Indu, of one accord with thy protections both from behind and from before preserve us.

verses.sa:
अभि प्र वः सुराधसमिन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे ।
यो जरितृभ्यो मघवा पुरूवसुः सहस्रेणेव शिक्षति ॥
verses.rom:
abhi pra vah suradhasamindramarcha yatha vide |
yo jaritribhyo maghava puruvasuh sahasreneva shikshati ||
verses.en:
TO you will I sing Indra's praise who gives good gifts as well we know;
The praise of Maghavan who, rich in treasure, aids his singers with wealth thousand fold.

verses.sa:
शतानीकेव प्र जिगाति धृष्णुया हन्ति वृत्राणि दाशुषे ।
गिरेरिव प्र रसा अस्य पिन्विरे दत्राणि पुरुभोजसः ॥
verses.rom:
shatanikeva pra jigati dhrishnuya hanti vritrani dashushe |
gireriva pra rasa asya pinvire datrani purubhojasah ||
verses.en:
As with a hundred hosts, he rushes boldly on, and for the offerer slays his foes.
As from a mountain flow the water-brooks, thus flow his gifts who feedeth many a one.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा सुतास इन्दवो मदा य इन्द्र गिर्वणः ।
आपो न वज्रिन्नन्वोक्यं सरः पृणन्ति शूर राधसे ॥
verses.rom:
a tva sutasa indavo mada ya indra girvanah |
apo na vajrinnanvokyam sarah prinanti shura radhase ||
verses.en:
The drops effused, the gladdening draughts, O Indra, Lover of the Son
As waters seek the lake where they are wont to rest, fill thee, for bounty, Thunderer.

verses.sa:
अनेहसं प्रतरणं विवक्षणं मध्वः स्वादिष्ठमीं पिब ।
आ यथा मन्दसानः किरासि नः प्र क्षुद्रेव त्मना धृषत् ॥
verses.rom:
anehasam prataranam vivakshanam madhvah svadishthamim piba |
a yatha mandasanah kirasi nah pra kshudreva tmana dhrishat ||
verses.en:
The matchless draught that strengthens and gives eloquence, the sweetest of the meath drink thou,
That in thy joy thou may scatter thy gifts o'er us, plenteously, even as the dust.

verses.sa:
आ न स्तोममुप द्रवद्धियानो अश्वो न सोतृभिः ।
यं ते स्वधावन्स्वदयन्ति धेनव इन्द्र कण्वेषु रातयः ॥
verses.rom:
a na stomamupa dravaddhiyano ashvo na sotribhih |
yam te svadhavansvadayanti dhenava indra kanveshu ratayah ||
verses.en:
Come quickly to our laud, urged on by Soma-pressers like a horse-
Laud, Godlike Indra, which milch-kine make sweet for thee: with Kanva's sons are gifts for thee.

verses.sa:
उग्रं न वीरं नमसोप सेदिम विभूतिमक्षितावसुम् ।
उद्रीव वज्रिन्नवतो न सिञ्चते क्षरन्तीन्द्र धीतयः ॥
verses.rom:
ugram na viram namasopa sedima vibhutimakshitavasum |
udriva vajrinnavato na sinchate ksharantindra dhitayah ||
verses.en:
With homage have we sought thee as a Hero, strong, preeminent, with unfailing wealth.
O Thunderer, as a plenteous spring pours forth its stream, so, Indra, flow our songs to thee.

verses.sa:
यद्ध नूनं यद्वा यज्ञे यद्वा पृथिव्यामधि ।
अतो नो यज्ञमाशुभिर्महेमत उग्र उग्रेभिरा गहि ॥
verses.rom:
yaddha nunam yadva yajne yadva prithivyamadhi |
ato no yajnamashubhirmahemata ugra ugrebhira gahi ||
verses.en:
If now thou art at sacrifice, or if thou art upon the earth,
Come thence, high-thoughted! to our sacrifice with the Swift, come, Mighty with the Mighty Ones.

verses.sa:
अजिरासो हरयो ये त आशवो वाता इव प्रसक्षिणः ।
येभिरपत्यं मनुषः परीयसे येभिर्विश्वं स्वर्दृशे ॥
verses.rom:
ajiraso harayo ye ta ashavo vata iva prasakshinah |
yebhirapatyam manushah pariyase yebhirvishvam svardrishe ||
verses.en:
The active, fleet-foot, tawny Coursers that are thine are swift to victory, like the Wind,
Wherewith thou goest round to visit Manus' seed, wherewith all heaven is visible.

verses.sa:
एतावतस्त ईमह इन्द्र सुम्नस्य गोमतः ।
यथा प्रावो मघवन्मेध्यातिथिं यथा नीपातिथिं धने ॥
verses.rom:
etavatasta imaha indra sumnasya gomatah |
yatha pravo maghavanmedhyatithim yatha nipatithim dhane ||
verses.en:
Indra, from thee so great we crave prosperity in wealth of kine,
As, Maghavan, thou favouredst Medhyatithi, and, in the fight, Nipatithi.

verses.sa:
यथा कण्वे मघवन्त्रसदस्यवि यथा पक्थे दशव्रजे ।
यथा गोशर्ये असनोरृजिश्वनीन्द्र गोमद्धिरण्यवत् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha kanve maghavantrasadasyavi yatha pakthe dashavraje |
yatha gosharye asanorrijishvanindra gomaddhiranyavat ||
verses.en:
As, Maghavan, to Kanva, Trasadasyu, and to Paktha and Dasavraja;
As, Indra, to Gosarya and Rjisvan, thou vouchsafedst wealth in kine and gold.

verses.sa:
प्र सु श्रुतं सुराधसमर्चा शक्रमभिष्टये ।
यः सुन्वते स्तुवते काम्यं वसु सहस्रेणेव मंहते ॥
verses.rom:
pra su shrutam suradhasamarcha shakramabhishtaye |
yah sunvate stuvate kamyam vasu sahasreneva mamhate ||
verses.en:
SAKRA I praise, to win his aid, far-famed, exceeding bountiful,
Who gives, as 'twere in thousands, precious wealth to him who sheds the juice and worships him.

verses.sa:
शतानीका हेतयो अस्य दुष्टरा इन्द्रस्य समिषो महीः ।
गिरिर्न भुज्मा मघवत्सु पिन्वते यदीं सुता अमन्दिषुः ॥
verses.rom:
shatanika hetayo asya dushtara indrasya samisho mahih |
girirna bhujma maghavatsu pinvate yadim suta amandishuh ||
verses.en:
Arrows with hundred points, unconquerable, are this Indra's mighty arms in war.
He streams on liberal worshippers like a hill with springs, when juices poured have gladdened him.

verses.sa:
यदीं सुतास इन्दवोऽभि प्रियममन्दिषुः ।
आपो न धायि सवनं म आ वसो दुघा इवोप दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
yadim sutasa indavo'bhi priyamamandishuh |
apo na dhayi savanam ma a vaso dugha ivopa dashushe ||
verses.en:
What time the flowing Soma-drops have gladdened with their taste the Friend,
Like water, gracious Lord! were my libations made, like milch-kine to the worshipper.

verses.sa:
अनेहसं वो हवमानमूतये मध्वः क्षरन्ति धीतयः ।
आ त्वा वसो हवमानास इन्दव उप स्तोत्रेषु दधिरे ॥
verses.rom:
anehasam vo havamanamutaye madhvah ksharanti dhitayah |
a tva vaso havamanasa indava upa stotreshu dadhire ||
verses.en:
To him the peerless, who is calling you to give you aid, forth flow the drops of pleasant meath.
The Soma-drops which call on thee, O gracious Lord, have brought thee to our hymn of praise.

verses.sa:
आ नः सोमे स्वध्वर इयानो अत्यो न तोशते ।
यं ते स्वदावन्स्वदन्ति गूर्तयः पौरे छन्दयसे हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
a nah some svadhvara iyano atyo na toshate |
yam te svadavansvadanti gurtayah paure chhandayase havam ||
verses.en:
He rushes hurrying like a steed to Soma that adorns our rite,
Which hymns make sweet to thee, lover of pleasant food. The call to Paura thou dost love.

verses.sa:
प्र वीरमुग्रं विविचिं धनस्पृतं विभूतिं राधसो महः ।
उद्रीव वज्रिन्नवतो वसुत्वना सदा पीपेथ दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
pra viramugram vivichim dhanaspritam vibhutim radhaso mahah |
udriva vajrinnavato vasutvana sada pipetha dashushe ||
verses.en:
Praise the strong, grasping Hero, winner of the spoil, ruling supreme o'er mighty wealth.
Like a full spring, O Thunderer, from thy store hast thou poured on the worshipper evermore.

verses.sa:
यद्ध नूनं परावति यद्वा पृथिव्यां दिवि ।
युजान इन्द्र हरिभिर्महेमत ऋष्व ऋष्वेभिरा गहि ॥
verses.rom:
yaddha nunam paravati yadva prithivyam divi |
yujana indra haribhirmahemata rishva rishvebhira gahi ||
verses.en:
Now whether thou be far away, or in the heavens, or on the earth,
O Indra, mighty- thoughted, harnessing thy Bays, come Lofty with the Lofty Ones.

verses.sa:
रथिरासो हरयो ये ते अस्रिध ओजो वातस्य पिप्रति ।
येभिर्नि दस्युं मनुषो निघोषयो येभिः स्वः परीयसे ॥
verses.rom:
rathiraso harayo ye te asridha ojo vatasya piprati |
yebhirni dasyum manusho nighoshayo yebhih svah pariyase ||
verses.en:
The Bays who draw thy chariot, Steeds who injure none, surpass the wind's impetuous strength-
With whom thou silencest the enemy of man, with whom thou goest round the sky.

verses.sa:
एतावतस्ते वसो विद्याम शूर नव्यसः ।
यथा प्राव एतशं कृत्व्ये धने यथा वशं दशव्रजे ॥
verses.rom:
etavataste vaso vidyama shura navyasah |
yatha prava etasham kritvye dhane yatha vasham dashavraje ||
verses.en:
O gracious Hero, may we learn anew to know thee as thou art:
As in decisive fight thou holpest Etasa, or Vasa 'gainst Dasavraja,

verses.sa:
यथा कण्वे मघवन्मेधे अध्वरे दीर्घनीथे दमूनसि ।
यथा गोशर्ये असिषासो अद्रिवो मयि गोत्रं हरिश्रियम् ॥
verses.rom:
yatha kanve maghavanmedhe adhvare dirghanithe damunasi |
yatha gosharye asishaso adrivo mayi gotram harishriyam ||
verses.en:
As, Maghavan, to Kanva at the sacred feast, to Dirghanitha thine home-friend,
As to Gosarya thou, Stone-darter, gavest wealth, give me a gold-bright stall of kine.

verses.sa:
यथा मनौ सांवरणौ सोममिन्द्रापिबः सुतम् ।
नीपातिथौ मघवन्मेध्यातिथौ पुष्टिगौ श्रुष्टिगौ सचा ॥
verses.rom:
yatha manau samvaranau somamindrapibah sutam |
nipatithau maghavanmedhyatithau pushtigau shrushtigau sacha ||
verses.en:
As with Manu Samvarani, Indra, thou drankest Soma juice,
And, Maghavan, with Nipatithi, Medbyatithi, with Pustigu and Srustigu,-

verses.sa:
पार्षद्वाणः प्रस्कण्वं समसादयच्छयानं जिव्रिमुद्धितम् ।
सहस्राण्यसिषासद्गवामृषिस्त्वोतो दस्यवे वृकः ॥
verses.rom:
parshadvanah praskanvam samasadayachchhayanam jivrimuddhitam |
sahasranyasishasadgavamrishistvoto dasyave vrikah ||
verses.en:
The son of Prsadvana was Praskaniva's host, who lay decrepit and forlorn.
Aided by thee the Rsi Dasyavevrka strove to obtain thousands of kine.

verses.sa:
य उक्थेभिर्न विन्धते चिकिद्य ऋषिचोदनः ।
इन्द्रं तमच्छा वद नव्यस्या मत्यरिष्यन्तं न भोजसे ॥
verses.rom:
ya ukthebhirna vindhate chikidya rishichodanah |
indram tamachchha vada navyasya matyarishyantam na bhojase ||
verses.en:
Call hither with thy newest song Indra who lacks not hymns of praise,
Him who observes and knows, inspirer of the sage, him who seems eager to enjoy.

verses.sa:
यस्मा अर्कं सप्तशीर्षाणमानृचुस्त्रिधातुमुत्तमे पदे ।
स त्विमा विश्वा भुवनानि चिक्रददादिज्जनिष्ट पौंस्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasma arkam saptashirshanamanrichustridhatumuttame pade |
sa tvima vishva bhuvanani chikradadadijjanishta paumsyam ||
verses.en:
He unto whom they sang the seven-headed hymn, three-parted, in the loftiest place,
He sent his thunder down on all these living things, and so displayed heroic might.

verses.sa:
यो नो दाता वसूनामिन्द्रं तं हूमहे वयम् ।
विद्मा ह्यस्य सुमतिं नवीयसीं गमेम गोमति व्रजे ॥
verses.rom:
yo no data vasunamindram tam humahe vayam |
vidma hyasya sumatim naviyasim gamema gomati vraje ||
verses.en:
We invocate that Indra who bestoweth precious things on us.
Now do we know his newest favour; may we gain a stable that is full of kine.

verses.sa:
यस्मै त्वं वसो दानाय शिक्षसि स रायस्पोषमश्नुते ।
तं त्वा वयं मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः सुतावन्तो हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
yasmai tvam vaso danaya shikshasi sa rayasposhamashnute |
tam tva vayam maghavannindra girvanah sutavanto havamahe ||
verses.en:
He whom thou aidest, gracious Lord, to give again, obtains great wealth to nourish him.
We with our Soma ready, Lover of the Song! call, Indra Maghavan, on thee.

verses.sa:
कदा चन स्तरीरसि नेन्द्र सश्चसि दाशुषे ।
उपोपेन्नु मघवन्भूय इन्नु ते दानं देवस्य पृच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
kada chana starirasi nendra sashchasi dashushe |
upopennu maghavanbhuya innu te danam devasya prichyate ||
verses.en:
Ne'er art thou fruitless, Indra ne'er dost thou desert the worshipper
But now, O Maghavan, thy bounty as a God is poured forth ever more and more.

verses.sa:
प्र यो ननक्षे अभ्योजसा क्रिविं वधैः शुष्णं निघोषयन् ।
यदेदस्तम्भीत्प्रथयन्नमूं दिवमादिज्जनिष्ट पार्थिवः ॥
verses.rom:
pra yo nanakshe abhyojasa krivim vadhaih shushnam nighoshayan |
yadedastambhitprathayannamum divamadijjanishta parthivah ||
verses.en:
He who hath. overtaken Krvi with his might, and silenced Susna with deathbolts,
When he supported yonder heaven and spread it out, then first the son of earth was born.

verses.sa:
यस्यायं विश्व आर्यो दासः शेवधिपा अरिः ।
तिरश्चिदर्ये रुशमे परीरवि तुभ्येत्सो अज्यते रयिः ॥
verses.rom:
yasyayam vishva aryo dasah shevadhipa arih |
tirashchidarye rushame pariravi tubhyetso ajyate rayih ||
verses.en:
Good Lord of wealth is he to whom all Aryas, Dasas here belong.
Directly unto thee, the pious Rusama Paviru, is that wealth brought nigh.

verses.sa:
तुरण्यवो मधुमन्तं घृतश्चुतं विप्रासो अर्कमानृचुः ।
अस्मे रयिः पप्रथे वृष्ण्यं शवोऽस्मे सुवानास इन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
turanyavo madhumantam ghritashchutam vipraso arkamanrichuh |
asme rayih paprathe vrishnyam shavo'sme suvanasa indavah ||
verses.en:
In zealous haste the singers have sung forth a song distilling oil and rich in sweets.
Riches have spread among us and heroic strength, with us are flowing Soma-drops.

verses.sa:
यथा मनौ विवस्वति सोमं शक्रापिबः सुतम् ।
यथा त्रिते छन्द इन्द्र जुजोषस्यायौ मादयसे सचा ॥
verses.rom:
yatha manau vivasvati somam shakrapibah sutam |
yatha trite chhanda indra jujoshasyayau madayase sacha ||
verses.en:
As, Sakra, thou with Manu called Vivasvan drankest Soma juice,
As, Indra, thou didst love the hymn by Trita's side, so dost thou joy with Ayu now.

verses.sa:
पृषध्रे मेध्ये मातरिश्वनीन्द्र सुवाने अमन्दथाः ।
यथा सोमं दशशिप्रे दशोण्ये स्यूमरश्मावृजूनसि ॥
verses.rom:
prishadhre medhye matarishvanindra suvane amandathah |
yatha somam dashashipre dashonye syumarashmavrijunasi ||
verses.en:
As thou with Matarisvan, Medhya, Prsadhra, hast cheered thee Indra, with pressed juice,
Drunk Soma with Rjunas, Syumarasmi, by Dasonya's Dasasipra's side.

verses.sa:
य उक्था केवला दधे यः सोमं धृषितापिबत् ।
यस्मै विष्णुस्त्रीणि पदा विचक्रम उप मित्रस्य धर्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ya uktha kevala dadhe yah somam dhrishitapibat |
yasmai vishnustrini pada vichakrama upa mitrasya dharmabhih ||
verses.en:
'Tis he who made the lauds his own and boldly drank the Soma juice,
He to whom Visnu came striding his three wide steps, as Mitra's statutes ordered it.

verses.sa:
यस्य त्वमिन्द्र स्तोमेषु चाकनो वाजे वाजिञ्छतक्रतो ।
तं त्वा वयं सुदुघामिव गोदुहो जुहूमसि श्रवस्यवः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya tvamindra stomeshu chakano vaje vajinchhatakrato |
tam tva vayam sudughamiva goduho juhumasi shravasyavah ||
verses.en:
In whose laud thou didst joy, Indra, at the great deed, O Satakratu, Mighty One!
Seeking renown we call thee as the milkers call the cow who yields abundant milk.

verses.sa:
यो नो दाता स नः पिता महाँ उग्र ईशानकृत् ।
अयामन्नुग्रो मघवा पुरूवसुर्गोरश्वस्य प्र दातु नः ॥
verses.rom:
yo no data sa nah pita mahan ugra ishanakrit |
ayamannugro maghava puruvasurgorashvasya pra datu nah ||
verses.en:
He is our Sire who gives to us, Great, Mighty, ruling as he wills.
Unsought, may he the Strong, Rich, Lord of ample wealth, give us of horses and of kine.

verses.sa:
यस्मै त्वं वसो दानाय मंहसे स रायस्पोषमिन्वति ।
वसूयवो वसुपतिं शतक्रतुं स्तोमैरिन्द्रं हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
yasmai tvam vaso danaya mamhase sa rayasposhaminvati |
vasuyavo vasupatim shatakratum stomairindram havamahe ||
verses.en:
He to whom thou, Good Lord, givest that he may give increases wealth that nourishes.
Eager for wealth we call on Indra, Lord of wealth, on Satakratu with our lauds.

verses.sa:
कदा चन प्र युच्छस्युभे नि पासि जन्मनी ।
तुरीयादित्य हवनं त इन्द्रियमा तस्थावमृतं दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
kada chana pra yuchchhasyubhe ni pasi janmani |
turiyaditya havanam ta indriyama tasthavamritam divi ||
verses.en:
Never art thou neglectful: thou guardest both races with thy care.
The call on Indra, fourth Aditya! is thine own. Amrta is stablished in the heavens.

verses.sa:
यस्मै त्वं मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः शिक्षो शिक्षसि दाशुषे ।
अस्माकं गिर उत सुष्टुतिं वसो कण्ववच्छृणुधी हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasmai tvam maghavannindra girvanah shiksho shikshasi dashushe |
asmakam gira uta sushtutim vaso kanvavachchhrinudhi havam ||
verses.en:
The offerer whom thou, Indra, Lover of the Song, liberal Maghavan, favourest,-
As at the call of Kanva so, O gracious Lord, hear, thou our songs and eulogy.

verses.sa:
अस्तावि मन्म पूर्व्यं ब्रह्मेन्द्राय वोचत ।
पूर्वीरृतस्य बृहतीरनूषत स्तोतुर्मेधा असृक्षत ॥
verses.rom:
astavi manma purvyam brahmendraya vochata |
purvirritasya brihatiranushata stoturmedha asrikshata ||
verses.en:
Sung is the song of ancient time: to Indra have ye said the prayer.
They have sung many a Brhati of sacrifice, poured forth the worshipper's many thoughts.

verses.sa:
समिन्द्रो रायो बृहतीरधूनुत सं क्षोणी समु सूर्यम् ।
सं शुक्रासः शुचयः सं गवाशिरः सोमा इन्द्रममन्दिषुः ॥
verses.rom:
samindro rayo brihatiradhunuta sam kshoni samu suryam |
sam shukrasah shuchayah sam gavashirah soma indramamandishuh ||
verses.en:
Indra hath tossed together mighty stores of wealth, and both the worlds, yea, and the Sun.
Pure, brightly-shining, mingled with the milk, the draughts of Soma have made Indra glad.

verses.sa:
उपमं त्वा मघोनां ज्येष्ठं च वृषभाणाम् ।
पूर्भित्तमं मघवन्निन्द्र गोविदमीशानं राय ईमहे ॥
verses.rom:
upamam tva maghonam jyeshtham cha vrishabhanam |
purbhittamam maghavannindra govidamishanam raya imahe ||
verses.en:
As highest of the Maghavans, preeminent among the Bulls,
Best breaker-down of forts, kine-winner, Lord of wealth, we seek thee, Indra Maghavan.

verses.sa:
य आयुं कुत्समतिथिग्वमर्दयो वावृधानो दिवेदिवे ।
तं त्वा वयं हर्यश्वं शतक्रतुं वाजयन्तो हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
ya ayum kutsamatithigvamardayo vavridhano divedive |
tam tva vayam haryashvam shatakratum vajayanto havamahe ||
verses.en:
Thou who subduedst Ayu, Kutsa, Atithigva, waxing daily in thy might,
As such, rousing thy power, we invocate thee now, thee Satakratu, Lord of Bays.

verses.sa:
आ नो विश्वेषां रसं मध्वः सिञ्चन्त्वद्रयः ।
ये परावति सुन्विरे जनेष्वा ये अर्वावतीन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
a no vishvesham rasam madhvah sinchantvadrayah |
ye paravati sunvire janeshva ye arvavatindavah ||
verses.en:
The pressing-stones shall pour for us the essence of the meath of all,
Drops that have been pressed out afar among the folk, and those that have been pressed near us.

verses.sa:
विश्वा द्वेषांसि जहि चाव चा कृधि विश्वे सन्वन्त्वा वसु ।
शीष्टेषु चित्ते मदिरासो अंशवो यत्रा सोमस्य तृम्पसि ॥
verses.rom:
vishva dveshamsi jahi chava cha kridhi vishve sanvantva vasu |
shishteshu chitte madiraso amshavo yatra somasya trimpasi ||
verses.en:
Repel all enmities and keep them far away: let all win treasure for their own.
Even among Sistas are the stalks that make thee glad, where thou with Soma satest thee.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र नेदीय एदिहि मितमेधाभिरूतिभिः ।
आ शंतम शंतमाभिरभिष्टिभिरा स्वापे स्वापिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
indra nediya edihi mitamedhabhirutibhih |
a shamtama shamtamabhirabhishtibhira svape svapibhih ||
verses.en:
Come, Indra, very near to us with aids of firmly-based resolve;
Come, most auspicious, with thy most auspicious help, good Kinsman, with good kinsmen, come!

verses.sa:
आजितुरं सत्पतिं विश्वचर्षणिं कृधि प्रजास्वाभगम् ।
प्र सू तिरा शचीभिर्ये त उक्थिनः क्रतुं पुनत आनुषक् ॥
verses.rom:
ajituram satpatim vishvacharshanim kridhi prajasvabhagam |
pra su tira shachibhirye ta ukthinah kratum punata anushak ||
verses.en:
Bless thou with progeny the chief of men, the lord of heroes, victor in the fray.
Aid with thy powers the men who sing thee lauds and keep their spirits ever pure and bright.

verses.sa:
यस्ते साधिष्ठोऽवसे ते स्याम भरेषु ते ।
वयं होत्राभिरुत देवहूतिभिः ससवांसो मनामहे ॥
verses.rom:
yaste sadhishtho'vase te syama bhareshu te |
vayam hotrabhiruta devahutibhih sasavamso manamahe ||
verses.en:
May we be such in battle as are surest to obtain thy grace:
With holy offerings and invocations of the Gods, we mean, that we may win the spoil.

verses.sa:
अहं हि ते हरिवो ब्रह्म वाजयुराजिं यामि सदोतिभिः ।
त्वामिदेव तममे समश्वयुर्गव्युरग्रे मथीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
aham hi te harivo brahma vajayurajim yami sadotibhih |
tvamideva tamame samashvayurgavyuragre mathinam ||
verses.en:
Thine, Lord of Bays, am I. Prayer longeth for the spoil. Still with thy help I seek the fight.
So, at the raiders' head, I, craving steeds and kine, unite myself with thee alone.

verses.sa:
एतत्त इन्द्र वीर्यं गीर्भिर्गृणन्ति कारवः ।
ते स्तोभन्त ऊर्जमावन्घृतश्चुतं पौरासो नक्षन्धीतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
etatta indra viryam girbhirgrinanti karavah |
te stobhanta urjamavanghritashchutam pauraso nakshandhitibhih ||
verses.en:
INDRA, the poets with their hymns extol this hero might of thine:
They strengthened, loud in song, thy power that droppeth oil. With hymns the Pauras came to thee.

verses.sa:
नक्षन्त इन्द्रमवसे सुकृत्यया येषां सुतेषु मन्दसे ।
यथा संवर्ते अमदो यथा कृश एवास्मे इन्द्र मत्स्व ॥
verses.rom:
nakshanta indramavase sukrityaya yesham suteshu mandase |
yatha samvarte amado yatha krisha evasme indra matsva ||
verses.en:
Through piety they came to Indra for his aid, they whose libations give thee joy.
As thou with, Krsa and Samvarta hast rejoiced, so, Indra, be thou glad with us.

verses.sa:
आ नो विश्वे सजोषसो देवासो गन्तनोप नः ।
वसवो रुद्रा अवसे न आ गमञ्छृण्वन्तु मरुतो हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
a no vishve sajoshaso devaso gantanopa nah |
vasavo rudra avase na a gamanchhrinvantu maruto havam ||
verses.en:
Agreeing in your spirit, all ye Deities, come nigh to us.
Vasus and Rudras shall come near to give us aid, and Maruts listen to our call.

verses.sa:
पूषा विष्णुर्हवनं मे सरस्वत्यवन्तु सप्त सिन्धवः ।
आपो वातः पर्वतासो वनस्पतिः शृणोतु पृथिवी हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
pusha vishnurhavanam me sarasvatyavantu sapta sindhavah |
apo vatah parvataso vanaspatih shrinotu prithivi havam ||
verses.en:
May Pusan, Visnu, and Sarasvati befriend, and the Seven Streams, this call of mine:
May Waters, Wind, the Mountains, and the Forest-Lord, and Earth give ear unto my cry.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र राधो अस्ति ते माघोनं मघवत्तम ।
तेन नो बोधि सधमाद्यो वृधे भगो दानाय वृत्रहन् ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra radho asti te maghonam maghavattama |
tena no bodhi sadhamadyo vridhe bhago danaya vritrahan ||
verses.en:
Indra, with thine own bounteous gift, most liberal of the Mighty Ones,
Be our boon benefactor, Vrtra-slayer, be our feast-companion for our weal.

verses.sa:
आजिपते नृपते त्वमिद्धि नो वाज आ वक्षि सुक्रतो ।
वीती होत्राभिरुत देववीतिभिः ससवांसो वि शृण्विरे ॥
verses.rom:
ajipate nripate tvamiddhi no vaja a vakshi sukrato |
viti hotrabhiruta devavitibhih sasavamso vi shrinvire ||
verses.en:
Leader of heroes, Lord of battle, lead thou us to combat, thou Most Sapient One.
High fame is theirs who win by invocations, feasts and entertainment of the Gods.

verses.sa:
सन्ति ह्यर्य आशिष इन्द्र आयुर्जनानाम् ।
अस्मान्नक्षस्व मघवन्नुपावसे धुक्षस्व पिप्युषीमिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
santi hyarya ashisha indra ayurjananam |
asmannakshasva maghavannupavase dhukshasva pipyushimisham ||
verses.en:
Our hopes rest on the Faithful One: in Indra is the people's life.
O Maghavan, come nigh that thou mayst give us aid: make plenteous food stream forth for us.

verses.sa:
वयं त इन्द्र स्तोमेभिर्विधेम त्वमस्माकं शतक्रतो ।
महि स्थूरं शशयं राधो अह्रयं प्रस्कण्वाय नि तोशय ॥
verses.rom:
vayam ta indra stomebhirvidhema tvamasmakam shatakrato |
mahi sthuram shashayam radho ahrayam praskanvaya ni toshaya ||
verses.en:
Thee would we worship, Indra, with our songs of praise: O Satakratu, be thou ours.
Pour down upon Praskanva bounty vast and firm, exuberant, that shall never fail.

verses.sa:
भूरीदिन्द्रस्य वीर्यं व्यख्यमभ्यायति ।
राधस्ते दस्यवे वृक ॥
verses.rom:
bhuridindrasya viryam vyakhyamabhyayati |
radhaste dasyave vrika ||
verses.en:
GREAT, verily, is Indra's might. I have beheld, and hither comes
Thy bounty, Dasyave-vrka!

verses.sa:
शतं श्वेतास उक्षणो दिवि तारो न रोचन्ते ।
मह्ना दिवं न तस्तभुः ॥
verses.rom:
shatam shvetasa ukshano divi taro na rochante |
mahna divam na tastabhuh ||
verses.en:
A hundred oxen white of hue are shining like the stars in heaven,
So tall, they seem to prop the sky.

verses.sa:
शतं वेणूञ्छतं शुनः शतं चर्माणि म्लातानि ।
शतं मे बल्बजस्तुका अरुषीणां चतुःशतम् ॥
verses.rom:
shatam venunchhatam shunah shatam charmani mlatani |
shatam me balbajastuka arushinam chatuhshatam ||
verses.en:
Bamboos a hundred, a hundred dogs, a hundred skins of beasts well-tanned,
A hundred tufts of Balbaja, four hundred red-hued mares are mine.

verses.sa:
सुदेवा स्थ काण्वायना वयोवयो विचरन्तः ।
अश्वासो न चङ्क्रमत ॥
verses.rom:
sudeva stha kanvayana vayovayo vicharantah |
ashvaso na chankramata ||
verses.en:
Blest by the Gods, Kinvayanas! be ye who spread through life on life:
Like horses have ye stridden forth.

verses.sa:
आदित्साप्तस्य चर्किरन्नानूनस्य महि श्रवः ।
श्यावीरतिध्वसन्पथश्चक्षुषा चन संनशे ॥
verses.rom:
aditsaptasya charkirannanunasya mahi shravah |
shyaviratidhvasanpathashchakshusha chana samnashe ||
verses.en:
Then men extolled the team of seven not yet full-grown, its fame is great.
The dark mares rushed along the paths, so that no eye could follow them.

verses.sa:
प्रति ते दस्यवे वृक राधो अदर्श्यह्रयम् ।
द्यौर्न प्रथिना शवः ॥
verses.rom:
prati te dasyave vrika radho adarshyahrayam |
dyaurna prathina shavah ||
verses.en:
THY bounty, Dasyave-vrka, exhaustless hath displayed itself:
Its fulness is as broad as heaven.

verses.sa:
दश मह्यं पौतक्रतः सहस्रा दस्यवे वृकः ।
नित्याद्रायो अमंहत ॥
verses.rom:
dasha mahyam pautakratah sahasra dasyave vrikah |
nityadrayo amamhata ||
verses.en:
Ten thousand Dasyave-vrka, the son of Putakrata, hath
From his own wealth bestowed on me.

verses.sa:
शतं मे गर्दभानां शतमूर्णावतीनाम् ।
शतं दासाँ अति स्रजः ॥
verses.rom:
shatam me gardabhanam shatamurnavatinam |
shatam dasan ati srajah ||
verses.en:
A hundred asses hath he given, a hundred head of fleecy sheep,
A hundred slaves, and wreaths besides.

verses.sa:
तत्रो अपि प्राणीयत पूतक्रतायै व्यक्ता ।
अश्वानामिन्न यूथ्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatro api praniyata putakratayai vyakta |
ashvanaminna yuthyam ||
verses.en:
There also was a mare led forth, picked out for Putakrata's sake,
Not of the horses of the herd.

verses.sa:
अचेत्यग्निश्चिकितुर्हव्यवाट् स सुमद्रथः ।
अग्निः शुक्रेण शोचिषा बृहत्सूरो अरोचत दिवि सूर्यो अरोचत ॥
verses.rom:
achetyagnishchikiturhavyavat sa sumadrathah |
agnih shukrena shochisha brihatsuro arochata divi suryo arochata ||
verses.en:
Observant Agni hath appeared, oblation-bearer with his car.
Agni with his resplendent flame hath shone on high as shines the Sun, hath shone like Surya in the heavens.

verses.sa:
युवं देवा क्रतुना पूर्व्येण युक्ता रथेन तविषं यजत्रा ।
आगच्छतं नासत्या शचीभिरिदं तृतीयं सवनं पिबाथः ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam deva kratuna purvyena yukta rathena tavisham yajatra |
agachchhatam nasatya shachibhiridam tritiyam savanam pibathah ||
verses.en:
ENDOWED, O Gods, with your primeval wisdom, come quickly with your chariot, O ye Holy.
Come with your mighty powers, O ye Nasatyas; come hither, drink ye this the third libation.

verses.sa:
युवां देवास्त्रय एकादशासः सत्याः सत्यस्य ददृशे पुरस्तात् ।
अस्माकं यज्ञं सवनं जुषाणा पातं सोममश्विना दीद्यग्नी ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam devastraya ekadashasah satyah satyasya dadrishe purastat |
asmakam yajnam savanam jushana patam somamashvina didyagni ||
verses.en:
The truthful Deities, the Three-and-Thirty, saw you approach before the Ever-Truthful.
Accepting this our worship and libation, O Asvins bright with fire, drink ye the Soma.

verses.sa:
पनाय्यं तदश्विना कृतं वां वृषभो दिवो रजसः पृथिव्याः ।
सहस्रं शंसा उत ये गविष्टौ सर्वाँ इत्ताँ उप याता पिबध्यै ॥
verses.rom:
panayyam tadashvina kritam vam vrishabho divo rajasah prithivyah |
sahasram shamsa uta ye gavishtau sarvan ittan upa yata pibadhyai ||
verses.en:
Asvins, that work of yours deserves our wonder,-the Bull of heaven and earth and air's mid region;
Yea, and your thousand promises in battle, -to all of these come near and drink beside us.

verses.sa:
अयं वां भागो निहितो यजत्रेमा गिरो नासत्योप यातम् ।
पिबतं सोमं मधुमन्तमस्मे प्र दाश्वांसमवतं शचीभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vam bhago nihito yajatrema giro nasatyopa yatam |
pibatam somam madhumantamasme pra dashvamsamavatam shachibhih ||
verses.en:
Here is your portion laid for you, ye Holy: come to these songs of ours, O ye Nasatyas.
Drink among us the Soma full of sweetness, and with your powers assist the man who worships.

verses.sa:
यमृत्विजो बहुधा कल्पयन्तः सचेतसो यज्ञमिमं वहन्ति ।
यो अनूचानो ब्राह्मणो युक्त आसीत्का स्वित्तत्र यजमानस्य संवित् ॥
verses.rom:
yamritvijo bahudha kalpayantah sachetaso yajnamimam vahanti |
yo anuchano brahmano yukta asitka svittatra yajamanasya samvit ||
verses.en:
HE whom the priests in sundry ways arranging the sacrifice, of one accord, bring hither,
Who was appointed as a learned Brahman, what is the sacrificer's knowledge of him?

verses.sa:
एक एवाग्निर्बहुधा समिद्ध एकः सूर्यो विश्वमनु प्रभूतः ।
एकैवोषाः सर्वमिदं वि भात्येकं वा इदं वि बभूव सर्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
eka evagnirbahudha samiddha ekah suryo vishvamanu prabhutah |
ekaivoshah sarvamidam vi bhatyekam va idam vi babhuva sarvam ||
verses.en:
Kindled in many a spot, still One is Agni; Silrya is One though high o'er all he shineth.
Illumining this All, still One is Usas. That which is One hath into All developed.

verses.sa:
ज्योतिष्मन्तं केतुमन्तं त्रिचक्रं सुखं रथं सुषदं भूरिवारम् ।
चित्रामघा यस्य योगेऽधिजज्ञे तं वां हुवे अति रिक्तं पिबध्यै ॥
verses.rom:
jyotishmantam ketumantam trichakram sukham ratham sushadam bhurivaram |
chitramagha yasya yoge'dhijajne tam vam huve ati riktam pibadhyai ||
verses.en:
The chariot bright and radiant, treasure-laden, three-wheeled, with easy seat, and lightly rolling,
Which She of Wondrous Wealth was born to harness,-this car of yours I call. Drink what remaineth.

verses.sa:
इमानि वां भागधेयानि सिस्रत इन्द्रावरुणा प्र महे सुतेषु वाम् ।
यज्ञेयज्ञे ह सवना भुरण्यथो यत्सुन्वते यजमानाय शिक्षथः ॥
verses.rom:
imani vam bhagadheyani sisrata indravaruna pra mahe suteshu vam |
yajneyajne ha savana bhuranyatho yatsunvate yajamanaya shikshathah ||
verses.en:
IN offerings poured to you, O Indra-Varuna, these shares of yours stream forth to glorify your state.
Ye haste to the libations at each sacrifice when ye assist the worshipper who sheds the juice.

verses.sa:
निष्षिध्वरीरोषधीराप आस्तामिन्द्रावरुणा महिमानमाशत ।
या सिस्रतू रजसः पारे अध्वनो ययोः शत्रुर्नकिरादेव ओहते ॥
verses.rom:
nishshidhvariroshadhirapa astamindravaruna mahimanamashata |
ya sisratu rajasah pare adhvano yayoh shatrurnakiradeva ohate ||
verses.en:
The waters and the plants, O Indra-Varuna, had efficacious vigour, and attained to might:
Ye who have gone beyond the path of middle air,-no godless man is worthy to be called your foe.

verses.sa:
सत्यं तदिन्द्रावरुणा कृशस्य वां मध्व ऊर्मिं दुहते सप्त वाणीः ।
ताभिर्दाश्वांसमवतं शुभस्पती यो वामदब्धो अभि पाति चित्तिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
satyam tadindravaruna krishasya vam madhva urmim duhate sapta vanih |
tabhirdashvamsamavatam shubhaspati yo vamadabdho abhi pati chittibhih ||
verses.en:
True is your Krsa's word, Indra and Varuna: The seven holy voices pour a wave of meath.
For their sake, Lords of splendour! aid the pious man who, unbewildered, keeps you ever in his thoughts.

verses.sa:
घृतप्रुषः सौम्या जीरदानवः सप्त स्वसारः सदन ऋतस्य ।
या ह वामिन्द्रावरुणा घृतश्चुतस्ताभिर्धत्तं यजमानाय शिक्षतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ghritaprushah saumya jiradanavah sapta svasarah sadana ritasya |
ya ha vamindravaruna ghritashchutastabhirdhattam yajamanaya shikshatam ||
verses.en:
Dropping oil, sweet with Soma, pouring forth their stream, are the Seven Sisters in the seat of sacrifice.
These, dropping oil, are yours, O Indra-Varuna: with these enrich with gifts and help the worshipper.

verses.sa:
अवोचाम महते सौभगाय सत्यं त्वेषाभ्यां महिमानमिन्द्रियम् ।
अस्मान्स्विन्द्रावरुणा घृतश्चुतस्त्रिभिः साप्तेभिरवतं शुभस्पती ॥
verses.rom:
avochama mahate saubhagaya satyam tveshabhyam mahimanamindriyam |
asmansvindravaruna ghritashchutastribhih saptebhiravatam shubhaspati ||
verses.en:
To our great happiness have we ascribed to these Two Bright Ones truthfulness, great strength, and majesty.
O Lords of splendour, aid us through the Three-times-Seven, as we pour holy oil, O Indra-Varuna.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रावरुणा यदृषिभ्यो मनीषां वाचो मतिं श्रुतमदत्तमग्रे ।
यानि स्थानान्यसृजन्त धीरा यज्ञं तन्वानास्तपसाभ्यपश्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
indravaruna yadrishibhyo manisham vacho matim shrutamadattamagre |
yani sthananyasrijanta dhira yajnam tanvanastapasabhyapashyam ||
verses.en:
What ye in time of old Indra and Varuna, gave Rsis revelation, thought, and power of song,
And places which the wise made, weaving sacrifice,-these through my spirit's fervid glow have I beheld.,

verses.sa:
इन्द्रावरुणा सौमनसमदृप्तं रायस्पोषं यजमानेषु धत्तम् ।
प्रजां पुष्टिं भूतिमस्मासु धत्तं दीर्घायुत्वाय प्र तिरतं न आयुः ॥
verses.rom:
indravaruna saumanasamadriptam rayasposham yajamaneshu dhattam |
prajam pushtim bhutimasmasu dhattam dirghayutvaya pra tiratam na ayuh ||
verses.en: O Indra-Varuna, grant to the worshippers cheerfulness void of pride, and wealth to nourish them.

verses.sa:
अग्न आ याह्यग्निभिर्होतारं त्वा वृणीमहे ।
आ त्वामनक्तु प्रयता हविष्मती यजिष्ठं बर्हिरासदे ॥
verses.rom:
agna a yahyagnibhirhotaram tva vrinimahe |
a tvamanaktu prayata havishmati yajishtham barhirasade ||
verses.en:
AGNI, come hither with thy fires; we choose thee as Invoking Priest.
Let the extended ladle full of oil balm thee, best Priest, to sit on sacred grass.

verses.sa:
अच्छा हि त्वा सहसः सूनो अङ्गिरः स्रुचश्चरन्त्यध्वरे ।
ऊर्जो नपातं घृतकेशमीमहेऽग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
achchha hi tva sahasah suno angirah sruchashcharantyadhvare |
urjo napatam ghritakeshamimahe'gnim yajneshu purvyam ||
verses.en:
For unto thee, O Angiras, O Son of Strength, move ladles in the sacrifice.
To Agni, Child of Force, whose locks drop oil, we seek, foremost in sacrificial rites.

verses.sa:
अग्ने कविर्वेधा असि होता पावक यक्ष्यः ।
मन्द्रो यजिष्ठो अध्वरेष्वीड्यो विप्रेभिः शुक्र मन्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
agne kavirvedha asi hota pavaka yakshyah |
mandro yajishtho adhvareshvidyo viprebhih shukra manmabhih ||
verses.en:
Agni, thou art Disposer, Sage, Herald, bright God! and worshipful,
Best offerer, cheerful, to be praised in holy rites, pure Lord! by singers with their hymns.

verses.sa:
अद्रोघमा वहोशतो यविष्ठ्य देवाँ अजस्र वीतये ।
अभि प्रयांसि सुधिता वसो गहि मन्दस्व धीतिभिर्हितः ॥
verses.rom:
adroghama vahoshato yavishthya devan ajasra vitaye |
abhi prayamsi sudhita vaso gahi mandasva dhitibhirhitah ||
verses.en:
Most Youthful and Eternal, bring the longing Gods to me, the guileless, for the feast.
Come, Vasu, to the banquet that is well-prepared: rejoice thee, gracious, with our songs.

verses.sa:
त्वमित्सप्रथा अस्यग्ने त्रातरृतस्कविः ।
त्वां विप्रासः समिधान दीदिव आ विवासन्ति वेधसः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamitsapratha asyagne tratarritaskavih |
tvam viprasah samidhana didiva a vivasanti vedhasah ||
verses.en:
Famed art thou, Agni, far and wide, Preserver, righteous, and a Sage.
The holy singers, O refulgent kindled God! arrangers, call on thee to come -

verses.sa:
शोचा शोचिष्ठ दीदिहि विशे मयो रास्व स्तोत्रे महाँ असि ।
देवानां शर्मन्मम सन्तु सूरयः शत्रूषाहः स्वग्नयः ॥
verses.rom:
shocha shochishtha didihi vishe mayo rasva stotre mahan asi |
devanam sharmanmama santu surayah shatrushahah svagnayah ||
verses.en:
Shine, Most Resplendent! blaze, send bliss unto the folk, and to thy worshipper
Great art thou.
So may my princes, with good fires, subduing foes, rest in the keeping of the Gods.

verses.sa:
यथा चिद्वृद्धमतसमग्ने संजूर्वसि क्षमि ।
एवा दह मित्रमहो यो अस्मध्रुग्दुर्मन्मा कश्च वेनति ॥
verses.rom:
yatha chidvriddhamatasamagne samjurvasi kshami |
eva daha mitramaho yo asmadhrugdurmanma kashcha venati ||
verses.en:
O Agni, as thou burnest down to earth even high-grown underwood,
So, bright as Mitra is, burn him who injures us, him who plots ill against thy friend.

verses.sa:
मा नो मर्ताय रिपवे रक्षस्विने माघशंसाय रीरधः ।
अस्रेधद्भिस्तरणिभिर्यविष्ठ्य शिवेभिः पाहि पायुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
ma no martaya ripave rakshasvine maghashamsaya riradhah |
asredhadbhistaranibhiryavishthya shivebhih pahi payubhih ||
verses.en:
Give us not as a prey to mortal enemy, nor to the wicked friend of fiends.
With conquering guards, auspicious, unassailable, protect us, O Most Youthful God.

verses.sa:
पाहि नो अग्न एकया पाह्युत द्वितीयया ।
पाहि गीर्भिस्तिसृभिरूर्जां पते पाहि चतसृभिर्वसो ॥
verses.rom:
pahi no agna ekaya pahyuta dvitiyaya |
pahi girbhistisribhirurjam pate pahi chatasribhirvaso ||
verses.en:
Protect us, Agni, through the first, protect us through the second hymn,
Protect us through three hymns, O Lord of Power and Might, through four hymns, Vasu, guard thou us.

verses.sa:
पाहि विश्वस्माद्रक्षसो अराव्णः प्र स्म वाजेषु नोऽव ।
त्वामिद्धि नेदिष्ठं देवतातय आपिं नक्षामहे वृधे ॥
verses.rom:
pahi vishvasmadrakshaso aravnah pra sma vajeshu no'va |
tvamiddhi nedishtham devatataya apim nakshamahe vridhe ||
verses.en:
Preserve us from each fiend who brings the Gods no gift, preserve thou us in deeds of strength:
For we possess in thee the nearest Friend of all, for service of the Gods and weal.

verses.sa:
आ नो अग्ने वयोवृधं रयिं पावक शंस्यम् ।
रास्वा च न उपमाते पुरुस्पृहं सुनीती स्वयशस्तरम् ॥
verses.rom:
a no agne vayovridham rayim pavaka shamsyam |
rasva cha na upamate puruspriham suniti svayashastaram ||
verses.en:
O Holy Agni, give us wealth renowned with men and strengthening life.
Bestow on us, O Helper, that which many crave, more glorious still by righteousness;

verses.sa:
येन वंसाम पृतनासु शर्धतस्तरन्तो अर्य आदिशः ।
स त्वं नो वर्ध प्रयसा शचीवसो जिन्वा धियो वसुविदः ॥
verses.rom:
yena vamsama pritanasu shardhatastaranto arya adishah |
sa tvam no vardha prayasa shachivaso jinva dhiyo vasuvidah ||
verses.en:
Wherewith we may o'ercome our rivals in the war, o'erpowering the foe's designs.
So wax thou by our food, O Excellent in strength. Quicken our thoughts that find out wealth.

verses.sa:
शिशानो वृषभो यथाग्निः शृङ्गे दविध्वत् ।
तिग्मा अस्य हनवो न प्रतिधृषे सुजम्भः सहसो यहुः ॥
verses.rom:
shishano vrishabho yathagnih shringe davidhvat |
tigma asya hanavo na pratidhrishe sujambhah sahaso yahuh ||
verses.en:
Agni is even as a bull who whets and brandishes his horns.
Well-sharpened are his jaws which may not be withstood: the Child of Strength hath powerful teeth.

verses.sa:
नहि ते अग्ने वृषभ प्रतिधृषे जम्भासो यद्वितिष्ठसे ।
स त्वं नो होतः सुहुतं हविष्कृधि वंस्वा नो वार्या पुरु ॥
verses.rom:
nahi te agne vrishabha pratidhrishe jambhaso yadvitishthase |
sa tvam no hotah suhutam havishkridhi vamsva no varya puru ||
verses.en:
Not to be stayed, O Bull, O Agni, are thy teeth when thou art spreading far and wide.
Make our oblations duly offered up, O Priest, and give us store of precious things.

verses.sa:
शेषे वनेषु मात्रोः सं त्वा मर्तास इन्धते ।
अतन्द्रो हव्या वहसि हविष्कृत आदिद्देवेषु राजसि ॥
verses.rom:
sheshe vaneshu matroh sam tva martasa indhate |
atandro havya vahasi havishkrita adiddeveshu rajasi ||
verses.en:
Thou liest in the wood: from both thy Mothers mortals kindle thee.
Unweariedly thou bearest up the offerer's gifts, then shinest bright among the Gods.

verses.sa:
सप्त होतारस्तमिदीळते त्वाग्ने सुत्यजमह्रयम् ।
भिनत्स्यद्रिं तपसा वि शोचिषा प्राग्ने तिष्ठ जनाँ अति ॥
verses.rom:
sapta hotarastamidilate tvagne sutyajamahrayam |
bhinatsyadrim tapasa vi shochisha pragne tishtha janan ati ||
verses.en:
And so the seven priests, O Agni, worship thee, Free-giver, Everlasting One.
Thou cleavest through the rock with heat and fervent glow. Agni, rise up above the men.

verses.sa:
अग्निमग्निं वो अध्रिगुं हुवेम वृक्तबर्हिषः ।
अग्निं हितप्रयसः शश्वतीष्वा होतारं चर्षणीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnimagnim vo adhrigum huvema vriktabarhishah |
agnim hitaprayasah shashvatishva hotaram charshaninam ||
verses.en:
For you let us whose grass is trimmed call Agni, Agni, restless God.
Let us whose food is offered call to all the tribes Agni the Invoking Priest of men.

verses.sa:
केतेन शर्मन्सचते सुषामण्यग्ने तुभ्यं चिकित्वना ।
इषण्यया नः पुरुरूपमा भर वाजं नेदिष्ठमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
ketena sharmansachate sushamanyagne tubhyam chikitvana |
ishanyaya nah pururupama bhara vajam nedishthamutaye ||
verses.en:
Agni, with noble psalm that tells his wish he dwells, thinking on thee who guardest him.
Speedily bring us strength of many varied sorts to be most near to succour us.

verses.sa:
अग्ने जरितर्विश्पतिस्तेपानो देव रक्षसः ।
अप्रोषिवान्गृहपतिर्महाँ असि दिवस्पायुर्दुरोणयुः ॥
verses.rom:
agne jaritarvishpatistepano deva rakshasah |
aproshivangrihapatirmahan asi divaspayurduronayuh ||
verses.en:
Agni, Praise-singer! Lord of men, God burner-up of Raksasas,
Mighty art thou, the ever-present Household-Lord, Home-friend and Guardian from the sky.

verses.sa:
मा नो रक्ष आ वेशीदाघृणीवसो मा यातुर्यातुमावताम् ।
परोगव्यूत्यनिरामप क्षुधमग्ने सेध रक्षस्विनः ॥
verses.rom:
ma no raksha a veshidaghrinivaso ma yaturyatumavatam |
parogavyutyaniramapa kshudhamagne sedha rakshasvinah ||
verses.en:
Let no fiend come among us, O thou rich in light, no spell of those who deal in spells.
To distant pastures drive faint hunger: far away, O Agni, chase the demons' friends.

verses.sa:
उभयं शृणवच्च न इन्द्रो अर्वागिदं वचः ।
सत्राच्या मघवा सोमपीतये धिया शविष्ठ आ गमत् ॥
verses.rom:
ubhayam shrinavachcha na indro arvagidam vachah |
satrachya maghava somapitaye dhiya shavishtha a gamat ||
verses.en:
BOTH boons,-may Indra, hitherward turned, listen to this prayer of ours,
And mightiest Maghavan with thought inclined to us come near to drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
तं हि स्वराजं वृषभं तमोजसे धिषणे निष्टतक्षतुः ।
उतोपमानां प्रथमो नि षीदसि सोमकामं हि ते मनः ॥
verses.rom:
tam hi svarajam vrishabham tamojase dhishane nishtatakshatuh |
utopamanam prathamo ni shidasi somakamam hi te manah ||
verses.en:
For him, strong, independent Ruler, Heaven and Earth have fashioned forth for power and might.
Thou seatest thee as first among thy peers in place, for thy soul longs for Soma juice.

verses.sa:
आ वृषस्व पुरूवसो सुतस्येन्द्रान्धसः ।
विद्मा हि त्वा हरिवः पृत्सु सासहिमधृष्टं चिद्दधृष्वणिम् ॥
verses.rom:
a vrishasva puruvaso sutasyendrandhasah |
vidma hi tva harivah pritsu sasahimadhrishtam chiddadhrishvanim ||
verses.en:
Fill thyself full, O Lord of wealth, O Indra, with the juice we shed.
We know thee, Lord of Bay Steeds victor in the fight, vanquishing e'en the invincible.

verses.sa:
अप्रामिसत्य मघवन्तथेदसदिन्द्र क्रत्वा यथा वशः ।
सनेम वाजं तव शिप्रिन्नवसा मक्षू चिद्यन्तो अद्रिवः ॥
verses.rom:
apramisatya maghavantathedasadindra kratva yatha vashah |
sanema vajam tava shiprinnavasa makshu chidyanto adrivah ||
verses.en:
Changeless in truth, O Maghavan Indra, let it be as thou in wisdom willest it.
May we, O fair of check, win booty with thine aid, O Thunderer, swiftly seeking it.

verses.sa:
शग्ध्यू षु शचीपत इन्द्र विश्वाभिरूतिभिः ।
भगं न हि त्वा यशसं वसुविदमनु शूर चरामसि ॥
verses.rom:
shagdhyu shu shachipata indra vishvabhirutibhih |
bhagam na hi tva yashasam vasuvidamanu shura charamasi ||
verses.en:
Indra, with all thy saving helps give us assistance, Lord of power.
For after thee we follow even as glorious bliss, thee, Hero, finder-out of wealth.

verses.sa:
पौरो अश्वस्य पुरुकृद्गवामस्युत्सो देव हिरण्ययः ।
नकिर्हि दानं परिमर्धिषत्त्वे यद्यद्यामि तदा भर ॥
verses.rom:
pauro ashvasya purukridgavamasyutso deva hiranyayah |
nakirhi danam parimardhishattve yadyadyami tada bhara ||
verses.en:
Increaser of our steeds and multiplying kine, a golden well, O God, art thou,
For no one may impair the gifts laid up in thee. Bring me whatever thing I ask.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह्येहि चेरवे विदा भगं वसुत्तये ।
उद्वावृषस्व मघवन्गविष्टय उदिन्द्राश्वमिष्टये ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hyehi cherave vida bhagam vasuttaye |
udvavrishasva maghavangavishtaya udindrashvamishtaye ||
verses.en:
For thou,-come to the worshipper!-wilt find great wealth to make us rich.
Fill thyself full, O Maghavan, for gain of kine, full, Indra, for the gain of steeds.

verses.sa:
त्वं पुरू सहस्राणि शतानि च यूथा दानाय मंहसे ।
आ पुरंदरं चकृम विप्रवचस इन्द्रं गायन्तोऽवसे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam puru sahasrani shatani cha yutha danaya mamhase |
a puramdaram chakrima vipravachasa indram gayanto'vase ||
verses.en:
Thou as thy gift bestowest many hundred herds, yea, many thousands dost thou give.
With singers' hymns have we brought the Fort-render near, singing to Indra for his grace.

verses.sa:
अविप्रो वा यदविधद्विप्रो वेन्द्र ते वचः ।
स प्र ममन्दत्त्वाया शतक्रतो प्राचामन्यो अहंसन ॥
verses.rom:
avipro va yadavidhadvipro vendra te vachah |
sa pra mamandattvaya shatakrato prachamanyo ahamsana ||
verses.en:
Whether the simple or the sage, Indra, have offered praise to thee,
He Satakratu! by his love hath gladdened thee, ambitious! ever pressing on!

verses.sa:
उग्रबाहुर्म्रक्षकृत्वा पुरंदरो यदि मे शृणवद्धवम् ।
वसूयवो वसुपतिं शतक्रतुं स्तोमैरिन्द्रं हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
ugrabahurmrakshakritva puramdaro yadi me shrinavaddhavam |
vasuyavo vasupatim shatakratum stomairindram havamahe ||
verses.en:
If he the Strong of arm, the breaker-down of forts, the great Destroyer, hear my call,
We, seeking riches cry to Indra, Lord of wealth, to Satakratu with our lauds.

verses.sa:
न पापासो मनामहे नारायासो न जळ्हवः ।
यदिन्न्विन्द्रं वृषणं सचा सुते सखायं कृणवामहै ॥
verses.rom:
na papaso manamahe narayaso na jalhavah |
yadinnvindram vrishanam sacha sute sakhayam krinavamahai ||
verses.en:
We count not then as sinners, nor as niggardly or foolish men,
When with the Soma juice which we have shed we make Indra, the Mighty One, our Friend.

verses.sa:
उग्रं युयुज्म पृतनासु सासहिमृणकातिमदाभ्यम् ।
वेदा भृमं चित्सनिता रथीतमो वाजिनं यमिदू नशत् ॥
verses.rom:
ugram yuyujma pritanasu sasahimrinakatimadabhyam |
veda bhrimam chitsanita rathitamo vajinam yamidu nashat ||
verses.en:
Him have we yoked in fight, the powerful Conqueror, debt-claimer, not to be deceived.
Best charioteer, the Victor marks each fault, he knows the strong to whom he will come near.

verses.sa:
यत इन्द्र भयामहे ततो नो अभयं कृधि ।
मघवञ्छग्धि तव तन्न ऊतिभिर्वि द्विषो वि मृधो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
yata indra bhayamahe tato no abhayam kridhi |
maghavanchhagdhi tava tanna utibhirvi dvisho vi mridho jahi ||
verses.en:
Indra, give us security from that whereof we are afraid.
Help us, O Maghavan, let thy succour give us this: drive away foes and enemies.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि राधस्पते राधसो महः क्षयस्यासि विधतः ।
तं त्वा वयं मघवन्निन्द्र गिर्वणः सुतावन्तो हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi radhaspate radhaso mahah kshayasyasi vidhatah |
tam tva vayam maghavannindra girvanah sutavanto havamahe ||
verses.en:
For thou, O liberal Lord of bounty, strengthenest his ample home who worships thee.
So Indra, Maghavan, thou Lover of the Song, we with pressed Soma call on thee,

verses.sa:
इन्द्र स्पळुत वृत्रहा परस्पा नो वरेण्यः ।
स नो रक्षिषच्चरमं स मध्यमं स पश्चात्पातु नः पुरः ॥
verses.rom:
indra spaluta vritraha paraspa no varenyah |
sa no rakshishachcharamam sa madhyamam sa pashchatpatu nah purah ||
verses.en:
Indra is Vrtra-slayer, guard, our best defender from the foe.
May he preserve our last and middlemost, and keep watch from behind us and before.

verses.sa:
त्वं नः पश्चादधरादुत्तरात्पुर इन्द्र नि पाहि विश्वतः ।
आरे अस्मत्कृणुहि दैव्यं भयमारे हेतीरदेवीः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam nah pashchadadharaduttaratpura indra ni pahi vishvatah |
are asmatkrinuhi daivyam bhayamare hetiradevih ||
verses.en:
Defend us from behind, below, above, in front, on all sides, Indra, shield us well.
Keep far away from us the terror sent from heaven: keep impious weapons far away.

verses.sa:
अद्याद्या श्वःश्व इन्द्र त्रास्व परे च नः ।
विश्वा च नो जरितॄन्सत्पते अहा दिवा नक्तं च रक्षिषः ॥
verses.rom:
adyadya shvahshva indra trasva pare cha nah |
vishva cha no jaritrinsatpate aha diva naktam cha rakshishah ||
verses.en:
Protect us, Indra, each to-day, each morrow, and each following day.
Our singers, through all days, shalt thou, Lord of the brave, keep safely both by day and night.

verses.sa:
प्रभङ्गी शूरो मघवा तुवीमघः सम्मिश्लो वीर्याय कम् ।
उभा ते बाहू वृषणा शतक्रतो नि या वज्रं मिमिक्षतुः ॥
verses.rom:
prabhangi shuro maghava tuvimaghah sammishlo viryaya kam |
ubha te bahu vrishana shatakrato ni ya vajram mimikshatuh ||
verses.en:
A crushing Warrior, passing rich is Maghavan, endowed with all heroic might.
Thine arms, O Satakratu, are exceeding strong, arms which have grasped the thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
प्रो अस्मा उपस्तुतिं भरता यज्जुजोषति ।
उक्थैरिन्द्रस्य माहिनं वयो वर्धन्ति सोमिनो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.rom:
pro asma upastutim bharata yajjujoshati |
ukthairindrasya mahinam vayo vardhanti somino bhadra indrasya ratayah ||
verses.en:
OFFER ye up as praise to him that wherein Indra takes delight.
The Soma-bringers magnify Indra's great energy with hymns. Good are the gifts that Indra gives.

verses.sa:
अयुजो असमो नृभिरेकः कृष्टीरयास्यः ।
पूर्वीरति प्र वावृधे विश्वा जातान्योजसा भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.rom:
ayujo asamo nribhirekah krishtirayasyah |
purvirati pra vavridhe vishva jatanyojasa bhadra indrasya ratayah ||
verses.en:
Sole among chiefs, companionless, impetuous, and peerless, he
Hath waxen great o'er many folk, yea., over all things born, in might.

verses.sa:
अहितेन चिदर्वता जीरदानुः सिषासति ।
प्रवाच्यमिन्द्र तत्तव वीर्याणि करिष्यतो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.rom:
ahitena chidarvata jiradanuh sishasati |
pravachyamindra tattava viryani karishyato bhadra indrasya ratayah ||
verses.en:
Lord of swift bounty, he will win e'en with a steed of worthless sort.
This, Indra, must be told of thee who wilt perform heroic deeds.

verses.sa:
आ याहि कृणवाम त इन्द्र ब्रह्माणि वर्धना ।
येभिः शविष्ठ चाकनो भद्रमिह श्रवस्यते भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.rom:
a yahi krinavama ta indra brahmani vardhana |
yebhih shavishtha chakano bhadramiha shravasyate bhadra indrasya ratayah ||
verses.en:
Come to us hither: let us pay devotions that enhance thy might,
For which, Most Potent! thou wouldst fain bless the man here who strives for fame.

verses.sa:
धृषतश्चिद्धृषन्मनः कृणोषीन्द्र यत्त्वम् ।
तीव्रैः सोमैः सपर्यतो नमोभिः प्रतिभूषतो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.rom:
dhrishatashchiddhrishanmanah krinoshindra yattvam |
tivraih somaih saparyato namobhih pratibhushato bhadra indrasya ratayah ||
verses.en:
For thou, O Indra, makest yet more bold the spirit of the bold
Who with strong Soma serveth thee, still ready with his reverent prayers.

verses.sa:
अव चष्ट ऋचीषमोऽवताँ इव मानुषः ।
जुष्ट्वी दक्षस्य सोमिनः सखायं कृणुते युजं भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.rom:
ava chashta richishamo'vatan iva manushah |
jushtvi dakshasya sominah sakhayam krinute yujam bhadra indrasya ratayah ||
verses.en:
Worthy of song, he looketh down as a man looketh into wells.
Pleased with the Soma-bringer's skill he maketh him his mate and friend.

verses.sa:
विश्वे त इन्द्र वीर्यं देवा अनु क्रतुं ददुः ।
भुवो विश्वस्य गोपतिः पुरुष्टुत भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.rom:
vishve ta indra viryam deva anu kratum daduh |
bhuvo vishvasya gopatih purushtuta bhadra indrasya ratayah ||
verses.en:
In strength and wisdom all the Gods, Indra, have yielded unto thee.
Be thou the Guard of all, O thou whom many praise.

verses.sa:
गृणे तदिन्द्र ते शव उपमं देवतातये ।
यद्धंसि वृत्रमोजसा शचीपते भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.rom:
grine tadindra te shava upamam devatataye |
yaddhamsi vritramojasa shachipate bhadra indrasya ratayah ||
verses.en:
Praised, Indra, is this might of thine, best for the service of the Gods,
That thou with power dost slay Vrtra, O Lord of Strength.

verses.sa:
समनेव वपुष्यतः कृणवन्मानुषा युगा ।
विदे तदिन्द्रश्चेतनमध श्रुतो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.rom:
samaneva vapushyatah krinavanmanusha yuga |
vide tadindrashchetanamadha shruto bhadra indrasya ratayah ||
verses.en:
He makes the races of mankind like synods of the Beauteous One.
Indra knows this his manifest deed, and is renowned.

verses.sa:
उज्जातमिन्द्र ते शव उत्त्वामुत्तव क्रतुम् ।
भूरिगो भूरि वावृधुर्मघवन्तव शर्मणि भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.rom:
ujjatamindra te shava uttvamuttava kratum |
bhurigo bhuri vavridhurmaghavantava sharmani bhadra indrasya ratayah ||
verses.en:
Thy might, O Indra, at its birth, thee also, and thy mental power,
In thy care, Maghavan rich in kine! they have increased exceedingly.

verses.sa:
अहं च त्वं च वृत्रहन्सं युज्याव सनिभ्य आ ।
अरातीवा चिदद्रिवोऽनु नौ शूर मंसते भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.rom:
aham cha tvam cha vritrahansam yujyava sanibhya a |
arativa chidadrivo'nu nau shura mamsate bhadra indrasya ratayah ||
verses.en:
O Vrtra-slayer, thou and I will both combine for winning spoil.
Even malignity will consent, O Bolt-armed Hero, unto us.

verses.sa:
सत्यमिद्वा उ तं वयमिन्द्रं स्तवाम नानृतम् ।
महाँ असुन्वतो वधो भूरि ज्योतींषि सुन्वतो भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ॥
verses.rom:
satyamidva u tam vayamindram stavama nanritam |
mahan asunvato vadho bhuri jyotimshi sunvato bhadra indrasya ratayah ||
verses.en:
Let us extol this Indra as truthful and never as untrue.
Dire is his death who pours no gifts great light hath he who offers them. Good are the gifts that Indra gives.

verses.sa:
स पूर्व्यो महानां वेनः क्रतुभिरानजे ।
यस्य द्वारा मनुष्पिता देवेषु धिय आनजे ॥
verses.rom:
sa purvyo mahanam venah kratubhiranaje |
yasya dvara manushpita deveshu dhiya anaje ||
verses.en:
WITH powers of Mighty Ones hath he, Ancient, Beloved, been equipped,
Through whom the Father Manu made prayers efficacious with the Gods.

verses.sa:
दिवो मानं नोत्सदन्सोमपृष्ठासो अद्रयः ।
उक्था ब्रह्म च शंस्या ॥
verses.rom:
divo manam notsadansomaprishthaso adrayah |
uktha brahma cha shamsya ||
verses.en:
Him, Maker of the sky, let stones wet with the Soma ne'er forsake,
Nor hymns and prayer that must be said.

verses.sa:
स विद्वाँ अङ्गिरोभ्य इन्द्रो गा अवृणोदप ।
स्तुषे तदस्य पौंस्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa vidvan angirobhya indro ga avrinodapa |
stushe tadasya paumsyam ||
verses.en:
Indra who knew full well disclosed the kine to the Angirases.
This his great deed must be extolled.

verses.sa:
स प्रत्नथा कविवृध इन्द्रो वाकस्य वक्षणिः ।
शिवो अर्कस्य होमन्यस्मत्रा गन्त्ववसे ॥
verses.rom:
sa pratnatha kavivridha indro vakasya vakshanih |
shivo arkasya homanyasmatra gantvavase ||
verses.en:
Indra, promoter of the song, the sage's Strengthener as of old,
Shall come to bless and succour us at presentation of this laud.

verses.sa:
आदू नु ते अनु क्रतुं स्वाहा वरस्य यज्यवः ।
श्वात्रमर्का अनूषतेन्द्र गोत्रस्य दावने ॥
verses.rom:
adu nu te anu kratum svaha varasya yajyavah |
shvatramarka anushatendra gotrasya davane ||
verses.en:
Now after their desire's intent the pious singers with the cry
Of Hail! have sung loud hymns to thee, Indra, to gain a stall of kine.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रे विश्वानि वीर्या कृतानि कर्त्वानि च ।
यमर्का अध्वरं विदुः ॥
verses.rom:
indre vishvani virya kritani kartvani cha |
yamarka adhvaram viduh ||
verses.en:
With Indra rest all deeds of might, deeds done and yet to be performed,
Whom singers know devoid of guile.

verses.sa:
यत्पाञ्चजन्यया विशेन्द्रे घोषा असृक्षत ।
अस्तृणाद्बर्हणा विपोऽर्यो मानस्य स क्षयः ॥
verses.rom:
yatpanchajanyaya vishendre ghosha asrikshata |
astrinadbarhana vipo'ryo manasya sa kshayah ||
verses.en:
When the Five Tribes with all their men to Indra have sent out their voice,
And when the priest hath strewn much grass, this is the Friend's own dwelling place.

verses.sa:
इयमु ते अनुष्टुतिश्चकृषे तानि पौंस्या ।
प्रावश्चक्रस्य वर्तनिम् ॥
verses.rom:
iyamu te anushtutishchakrishe tani paumsya |
pravashchakrasya vartanim ||
verses.en:
This praise is verily thine own: thou hast performed these manly deeds,
And sped the wheel upon its way.

verses.sa:
अस्य वृष्णो व्योदन उरु क्रमिष्ट जीवसे ।
यवं न पश्व आ ददे ॥
verses.rom:
asya vrishno vyodana uru kramishta jivase |
yavam na pashva a dade ||
verses.en:
At the o'er flowing of this Steer, boldly he strode for life, and took
Soma as cattle take their corn.

verses.sa:
तद्दधाना अवस्यवो युष्माभिर्दक्षपितरः ।
स्याम मरुत्वतो वृधे ॥
verses.rom:
taddadhana avasyavo yushmabhirdakshapitarah |
syama marutvato vridhe ||
verses.en:
Receiving this and craving help, we, who with you are Daksa's sons,
Would fain exalt the Maruts' Lord.

verses.sa:
बळृत्वियाय धाम्न ऋक्वभिः शूर नोनुमः ।
जेषामेन्द्र त्वया युजा ॥
verses.rom:
balritviyaya dhamna rikvabhih shura nonumah |
jeshamendra tvaya yuja ||
verses.en:
Yea, Hero, with the singers we sing.to the duly-coming Band.
Allied with thee may we prevail.

verses.sa:
अस्मे रुद्रा मेहना पर्वतासो वृत्रहत्ये भरहूतौ सजोषाः ।
यः शंसते स्तुवते धायि पज्र इन्द्रज्येष्ठा अस्माँ अवन्तु देवाः ॥
verses.rom:
asme rudra mehana parvataso vritrahatye bharahutau sajoshah |
yah shamsate stuvate dhayi pajra indrajyeshtha asman avantu devah ||
verses.en:
With us are raining Rudras, clouds accordant in call to battle, at the death of Vrtra,
The strong assigned to him who sings and praises. May Gods with Indra at their head protect us.

verses.sa:
उत्त्वा मन्दन्तु स्तोमाः कृणुष्व राधो अद्रिवः ।
अव ब्रह्मद्विषो जहि ॥
verses.rom:
uttva mandantu stomah krinushva radho adrivah |
ava brahmadvisho jahi ||
verses.en:
MAY our hymns give thee great delight. Display thy bounty, Thunderer.
Drive off the enemies of prayer.

verses.sa:
पदा पणीँरराधसो नि बाधस्व महाँ असि ।
नहि त्वा कश्चन प्रति ॥
verses.rom:
pada paninraradhaso ni badhasva mahan asi |
nahi tva kashchana prati ||
verses.en:
Crush with thy foot the niggard churls who bring no gifts. Mighty art thou
There is not one to equal thee.

verses.sa:
त्वमीशिषे सुतानामिन्द्र त्वमसुतानाम् ।
त्वं राजा जनानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvamishishe sutanamindra tvamasutanam |
tvam raja jananam ||
verses.en:
Thou art the Lord of Soma pressed, Soma impressed is also thine.
Thou art the Sovran of the folk.

verses.sa:
एहि प्रेहि क्षयो दिव्याघोषञ्चर्षणीनाम् ।
ओभे पृणासि रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
ehi prehi kshayo divyaghoshancharshaninam |
obhe prinasi rodasi ||
verses.en:
Come, go thou forth, dwelling in heaven and listening to the prayers of men:
Thou fillest both the heavens and earth.

verses.sa:
त्यं चित्पर्वतं गिरिं शतवन्तं सहस्रिणम् ।
वि स्तोतृभ्यो रुरोजिथ ॥
verses.rom:
tyam chitparvatam girim shatavantam sahasrinam |
vi stotribhyo rurojitha ||
verses.en:
Even that hill with rocky heights, with hundreds, thousands, held within.
Thou for thy worshippers brakest through.

verses.sa:
वयमु त्वा दिवा सुते वयं नक्तं हवामहे ।
अस्माकं काममा पृण ॥
verses.rom:
vayamu tva diva sute vayam naktam havamahe |
asmakam kamama prina ||
verses.en:
We call on thee both night and day to taste the flowing Soma juice:
Do thou fulfil our heart's desire.

verses.sa:
क्व स्य वृषभो युवा तुविग्रीवो अनानतः ।
ब्रह्मा कस्तं सपर्यति ॥
verses.rom:
kva sya vrishabho yuva tuvigrivo ananatah |
brahma kastam saparyati ||
verses.en:
Where is that ever-youthful Steer, strong. necked and never yet bent down?
What Brahman ministers to him?

verses.sa:
कस्य स्वित्सवनं वृषा जुजुष्वाँ अव गच्छति ।
इन्द्रं क उ स्विदा चके ॥
verses.rom:
kasya svitsavanam vrisha jujushvan ava gachchhati |
indram ka u svida chake ||
verses.en:
To whose libation doth the Steer, betake him with delight therein?
Who takes delight in Indra now?

verses.sa:
कं ते दाना असक्षत वृत्रहन्कं सुवीर्या ।
उक्थे क उ स्विदन्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
kam te dana asakshata vritrahankam suvirya |
ukthe ka u svidantamah ||
verses.en:
Whom, Vrtra-slayer, have thy gift and hero powers accompanied?
Who is thy dearest in the laud?

verses.sa:
अयं ते मानुषे जने सोमः पूरुषु सूयते ।
तस्येहि प्र द्रवा पिब ॥
verses.rom:
ayam te manushe jane somah purushu suyate |
tasyehi pra drava piba ||
verses.en:
For thee among mankind, among the Purus is this Soma shed.
Hasten thou hither: drink thereof.

verses.sa:
अयं ते शर्यणावति सुषोमायामधि प्रियः ।
आर्जीकीये मदिन्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam te sharyanavati sushomayamadhi priyah |
arjikiye madintamah ||
verses.en:
This, growing by Soma and by Saryanavan, dear to thee,
In Arjikiya, cheers thee best.

verses.sa:
तमद्य राधसे महे चारुं मदाय घृष्वये ।
एहीमिन्द्र द्रवा पिब ॥
verses.rom:
tamadya radhase mahe charum madaya ghrishvaye |
ehimindra drava piba ||
verses.en:
Hasten thou hitherward, and drink this for munificence to-day,
Delightful for thine eager draught.

verses.sa:
यदिन्द्र प्रागपागुदङ्न्यग्वा हूयसे नृभिः ।
आ याहि तूयमाशुभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yadindra pragapagudannyagva huyase nribhih |
a yahi tuyamashubhih ||
verses.en:
THOUGH, Indra, thou art called by men from east and west, from north and south,
Come hither quickly with fleet steeds

verses.sa:
यद्वा प्रस्रवणे दिवो मादयासे स्वर्णरे ।
यद्वा समुद्रे अन्धसः ॥
verses.rom:
yadva prasravane divo madayase svarnare |
yadva samudre andhasah ||
verses.en:
If in the effluence of heaven, rich in its light, thou takest joy,
Or in the sea in Soma juice.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा गीर्भिर्महामुरुं हुवे गामिव भोजसे ।
इन्द्र सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
a tva girbhirmahamurum huve gamiva bhojase |
indra somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
With songs I call thee, Great and Wide, even as a cow to profit us,
Indra, to drink the Soma-draught.

verses.sa:
आ त इन्द्र महिमानं हरयो देव ते महः ।
रथे वहन्तु बिभ्रतः ॥
verses.rom:
a ta indra mahimanam harayo deva te mahah |
rathe vahantu bibhratah ||
verses.en:
Hither, O Indra, let thy Bays bear up and, bring upon thy car
Thy glory, God! and majesty.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र गृणीष उ स्तुषे महाँ उग्र ईशानकृत् ।
एहि नः सुतं पिब ॥
verses.rom:
indra grinisha u stushe mahan ugra ishanakrit |
ehi nah sutam piba ||
verses.en:
Thou, Indra, wouldst be sung and praised as great, strong, lordly in thy deeds
Come hither, drink our Soma juice.

verses.sa:
सुतावन्तस्त्वा वयं प्रयस्वन्तो हवामहे ।
इदं नो बर्हिरासदे ॥
verses.rom:
sutavantastva vayam prayasvanto havamahe |
idam no barhirasade ||
verses.en:
We who have shed the Soma and prepared the feast are calling thee.
To sit on this our sacred grass.

verses.sa:
यच्चिद्धि शश्वतामसीन्द्र साधारणस्त्वम् ।
तं त्वा वयं हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
yachchiddhi shashvatamasindra sadharanastvam |
tam tva vayam havamahe ||
verses.en:
As, Indra, thou art evermore the common Lord of all alike,
As such we invocate thee now.

verses.sa:
इदं ते सोम्यं मध्वधुक्षन्नद्रिभिर्नरः ।
जुषाण इन्द्र तत्पिब ॥
verses.rom:
idam te somyam madhvadhukshannadribhirnarah |
jushana indra tatpiba ||
verses.en:
The men with stones have milked for thee this nectar of the Soma juice:
Indra, be pleased with it, and drink.

verses.sa:
विश्वाँ अर्यो विपश्चितोऽति ख्यस्तूयमा गहि ।
अस्मे धेहि श्रवो बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
vishvan aryo vipashchito'ti khyastuyama gahi |
asme dhehi shravo brihat ||
verses.en:
Neglect all pious men with skill in sacred song: come hitherward,
With speed, and give us high renown.

verses.sa:
दाता मे पृषतीनां राजा हिरण्यवीनाम् ।
मा देवा मघवा रिषत् ॥
verses.rom:
data me prishatinam raja hiranyavinam |
ma deva maghava rishat ||
verses.en:
Gods, may the mighty rest unharmed, the King who gives me spotted kine,
Kine decked with golden ornaments.

verses.sa:
सहस्रे पृषतीनामधि श्चन्द्रं बृहत्पृथु ।
शुक्रं हिरण्यमा ददे ॥
verses.rom:
sahasre prishatinamadhi shchandram brihatprithu |
shukram hiranyama dade ||
verses.en:
Beside a thousand spotted kine I have received a gift of gold,
Pure, brilliant, and exceeding great.

verses.sa:
नपातो दुर्गहस्य मे सहस्रेण सुराधसः ।
श्रवो देवेष्वक्रत ॥
verses.rom:
napato durgahasya me sahasrena suradhasah |
shravo deveshvakrata ||
verses.en:
Durgaha's grandsons, giving me a thousand kine, munificent,
Have won renown among the Gods.

verses.sa:
तरोभिर्वो विदद्वसुमिन्द्रं सबाध ऊतये ।
बृहद्गायन्तः सुतसोमे अध्वरे हुवे भरं न कारिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
tarobhirvo vidadvasumindram sabadha utaye |
brihadgayantah sutasome adhvare huve bharam na karinam ||
verses.en:
LOUD singing at the sacred rite where Soma flows we priests invoke
With haste, that he may help, as the bard's Cherisher, Indra who findeth wealth for you.

verses.sa:
न यं दुध्रा वरन्ते न स्थिरा मुरो मदे सुशिप्रमन्धसः ।
य आदृत्या शशमानाय सुन्वते दाता जरित्र उक्थ्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
na yam dudhra varante na sthira muro made sushipramandhasah |
ya adritya shashamanaya sunvate data jaritra ukthyam ||
verses.en:
Whom with fair helm, in rapture of the juice, the firm resistless slayers hinder not:
