Giver of glorious wealth to him who sing a his praise, honouring him who toils and pours:

verses.sa:
यः शक्रो मृक्षो अश्व्यो यो वा कीजो हिरण्ययः ।
स ऊर्वस्य रेजयत्यपावृतिमिन्द्रो गव्यस्य वृत्रहा ॥
verses.rom:
yah shakro mriksho ashvyo yo va kijo hiranyayah |
sa urvasya rejayatyapavritimindro gavyasya vritraha ||
verses.en:
Sakra, who like a curry-comb for horses or a golden goad,
Indra, the Vrtra-slayer, urges eagerly the opening of the stall of kine:

verses.sa:
निखातं चिद्यः पुरुसम्भृतं वसूदिद्वपति दाशुषे ।
वज्री सुशिप्रो हर्यश्व इत्करदिन्द्रः क्रत्वा यथा वशत् ॥
verses.rom:
nikhatam chidyah purusambhritam vasudidvapati dashushe |
vajri sushipro haryashva itkaradindrah kratva yatha vashat ||
verses.en:
Who for the worshipper scatters forth ample wealth, even though buried, piled in heaps:
May Indra, Lord of Bay Steeds, fair-helmed Thunderer, act at his pleasure, as he lists.

verses.sa:
यद्वावन्थ पुरुष्टुत पुरा चिच्छूर नृणाम् ।
वयं तत्त इन्द्र सं भरामसि यज्ञमुक्थं तुरं वचः ॥
verses.rom:
yadvavantha purushtuta pura chichchhura nrinam |
vayam tatta indra sam bharamasi yajnamuktham turam vachah ||
verses.en:
Hero whom many praise, what thou hast longed for, oven of old, from men.
All that we offer unto thee, O Indra, now, sacrifice, laud, effectual speech.

verses.sa:
सचा सोमेषु पुरुहूत वज्रिवो मदाय द्युक्ष सोमपाः ।
त्वमिद्धि ब्रह्मकृते काम्यं वसु देष्ठः सुन्वते भुवः ॥
verses.rom:
sacha someshu puruhuta vajrivo madaya dyuksha somapah |
tvamiddhi brahmakrite kamyam vasu deshthah sunvate bhuvah ||
verses.en:
To Soma, Much-invoked, Bolt-armed! for thy carouse, Celestial, Soma-drinker come.
Thou to the man who- prays and pours the juice hast been best giver of delightful wealth.

verses.sa:
वयमेनमिदा ह्योऽपीपेमेह वज्रिणम् ।
तस्मा उ अद्य समना सुतं भरा नूनं भूषत श्रुते ॥
verses.rom:
vayamenamida hyo'pipemeha vajrinam |
tasma u adya samana sutam bhara nunam bhushata shrute ||
verses.en:
Here, verily, yesterday we let the Thunder-wielder drink his fill.
So in like manner offer him the juice today. Now range you by the Glorious One.

verses.sa:
वृकश्चिदस्य वारण उरामथिरा वयुनेषु भूषति ।
सेमं न स्तोमं जुजुषाण आ गहीन्द्र प्र चित्रया धिया ॥
verses.rom:
vrikashchidasya varana uramathira vayuneshu bhushati |
semam na stomam jujushana a gahindra pra chitraya dhiya ||
verses.en:
Even the wolf, the savage beast that rends the sheep, follows the path of his decrees.
So graciously accepting, Indra, this our praise, with wondrous thought come forth to us.

verses.sa:
कदू न्वस्याकृतमिन्द्रस्यास्ति पौंस्यम् ।
केनो नु कं श्रोमतेन न शुश्रुवे जनुषः परि वृत्रहा ॥
verses.rom:
kadu nvasyakritamindrasyasti paumsyam |
keno nu kam shromatena na shushruve janushah pari vritraha ||
verses.en:
What manly deed of vigour now remains that Indra hath not done?
Who hath not heard his glorious title and his fame, the Vrtra-slayer from his birth?

verses.sa:
कदू महीरधृष्टा अस्य तविषीः कदु वृत्रघ्नो अस्तृतम् ।
इन्द्रो विश्वान्बेकनाटाँ अहर्दृश उत क्रत्वा पणीँरभि ॥
verses.rom:
kadu mahiradhrishta asya tavishih kadu vritraghno astritam |
indro vishvanbekanatan ahardrisha uta kratva paninrabhi ||
verses.en:
'How great his power resistless! how invincible the Vrtra-slayer's matchless might!
Indra excels all usurers who see the day, excels all traffickers in strength.

verses.sa:
वयं घा ते अपूर्व्येन्द्र ब्रह्माणि वृत्रहन् ।
पुरूतमासः पुरुहूत वज्रिवो भृतिं न प्र भरामसि ॥
verses.rom:
vayam gha te apurvyendra brahmani vritrahan |
purutamasah puruhuta vajrivo bhritim na pra bharamasi ||
verses.en:
O Indra, Vrtra-slayer, we, thy very constant worshippers,
Bring prayers ne'er heard before to thee, O Much-invoked, O Thunder-armed, to be thy mead.

verses.sa:
पूर्वीश्चिद्धि त्वे तुविकूर्मिन्नाशसो हवन्त इन्द्रोतयः ।
तिरश्चिदर्यः सवना वसो गहि शविष्ठ श्रुधि मे हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
purvishchiddhi tve tuvikurminnashaso havanta indrotayah |
tirashchidaryah savana vaso gahi shavishtha shrudhi me havam ||
verses.en:
O thou of mighty acts, the aids that are in thee call forward many an eager hope.
Past the drink-offerings, Vasu, even of the good, hear my call, Strongest God, and come.

verses.sa:
वयं घा ते त्वे इद्विन्द्र विप्रा अपि ष्मसि ।
नहि त्वदन्यः पुरुहूत कश्चन मघवन्नस्ति मर्डिता ॥
verses.rom:
vayam gha te tve idvindra vipra api shmasi |
nahi tvadanyah puruhuta kashchana maghavannasti mardita ||
verses.en:
Verily, Indra, we are thine, we worshippers depend on thee.
For there is none but only thou to show us race, O Maghavan, thou much invoked.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अस्या अमतेरुत क्षुधोऽभिशस्तेरव स्पृधि ।
त्वं न ऊती तव चित्रया धिया शिक्षा शचिष्ठ गातुवित् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no asya amateruta kshudho'bhishasterava spridhi |
tvam na uti tava chitraya dhiya shiksha shachishtha gatuvit ||
verses.en:
From this our misery and famine set us free, from this dire curse deliver us.
Succour us with thine help and with thy wondrous thought. Most Mighty, finder of the way.

verses.sa:
सोम इद्वः सुतो अस्तु कलयो मा बिभीतन ।
अपेदेष ध्वस्मायति स्वयं घैषो अपायति ॥
verses.rom:
soma idvah suto astu kalayo ma bibhitana |
apedesha dhvasmayati svayam ghaisho apayati ||
verses.en:
Now let your Soma juice be poured; be not afraid, O Kali's sons.
This darkening sorrow goes away; yea, of itself it vanishes.

verses.sa:
त्यान्नु क्षत्रियाँ अव आदित्यान्याचिषामहे ।
सुमृळीकाँ अभिष्टये ॥
verses.rom:
tyannu kshatriyan ava adityanyachishamahe |
sumrilikan abhishtaye ||
verses.en:
Now pray we to these Ksatriyas, to the Adityas for their aid,
These who are gracious to assist.

verses.sa:
मित्रो नो अत्यंहतिं वरुणः पर्षदर्यमा ।
आदित्यासो यथा विदुः ॥
verses.rom:
mitro no atyamhatim varunah parshadaryama |
adityaso yatha viduh ||
verses.en:
May Mitra bear us oer distress, and Varuna and Aryaman,
Yea, the Adityas, as they know.

verses.sa:
तेषां हि चित्रमुक्थ्यं वरूथमस्ति दाशुषे ।
आदित्यानामरंकृते ॥
verses.rom:
tesham hi chitramukthyam varuthamasti dashushe |
adityanamaramkrite ||
verses.en:
For wonderful and meet for praise is these Adityas' saving help
To him who offers and prepares.

verses.sa:
महि वो महतामवो वरुण मित्रार्यमन् ।
अवांस्या वृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
mahi vo mahatamavo varuna mitraryaman |
avamsya vrinimahe ||
verses.en:
The mighty aid of you, the Great, Varuna, Mitra, Aryarnan,
We claim to be our sure defence.

verses.sa:
जीवान्नो अभि धेतनादित्यासः पुरा हथात् ।
कद्ध स्थ हवनश्रुतः ॥
verses.rom:
jivanno abhi dhetanadityasah pura hathat |
kaddha stha havanashrutah ||
verses.en:
Guard us, Adityas, still alive, before the deadly weapon strike:
Are ye not they who hear our call?

verses.sa:
यद्वः श्रान्ताय सुन्वते वरूथमस्ति यच्छर्दिः ।
तेना नो अधि वोचत ॥
verses.rom:
yadvah shrantaya sunvate varuthamasti yachchhardih |
tena no adhi vochata ||
verses.en:
What sheltering defense ye have for him who toils in pouring gifts,
Graciously bless ye us therewith.

verses.sa:
अस्ति देवा अंहोरुर्वस्ति रत्नमनागसः ।
आदित्या अद्भुतैनसः ॥
verses.rom:
asti deva amhorurvasti ratnamanagasah |
aditya adbhutainasah ||
verses.en:
Adityas, Gods, from sorrow there is freedom; for the sinless, wealth,
O ye in whom no fault is seen.

verses.sa:
मा नः सेतुः सिषेदयं महे वृणक्तु नस्परि ।
इन्द्र इद्धि श्रुतो वशी ॥
verses.rom:
ma nah setuh sishedayam mahe vrinaktu naspari |
indra iddhi shruto vashi ||
verses.en:
Let not this fetter bind us fast: may he release us for success;
For strong is Indra and renowned.

verses.sa:
मा नो मृचा रिपूणां वृजिनानामविष्यवः ।
देवा अभि प्र मृक्षत ॥
verses.rom:
ma no mricha ripunam vrijinanamavishyavah |
deva abhi pra mrikshata ||
verses.en:
O Gods who fain would lend your aid, destroy not us as ye destroy
Your enemies who go astray.

verses.sa:
उत त्वामदिते मह्यहं देव्युप ब्रुवे ।
सुमृळीकामभिष्टये ॥
verses.rom:
uta tvamadite mahyaham devyupa bruve |
sumrilikamabhishtaye ||
verses.en:
And thee too, O Great Aditi, thee also, Goddess, I address,
Thee very gracious to assist.

verses.sa:
पर्षि दीने गभीर आँ उग्रपुत्रे जिघांसतः ।
माकिस्तोकस्य नो रिषत् ॥
verses.rom:
parshi dine gabhira an ugraputre jighamsatah |
makistokasya no rishat ||
verses.en:
Save us in depth and shallow from the foe, thbu Mother of Strong Sons
Let no one of our seed be harmed.

verses.sa:
अनेहो न उरुव्रज उरूचि वि प्रसर्तवे ।
कृधि तोकाय जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
aneho na uruvraja uruchi vi prasartave |
kridhi tokaya jivase ||
verses.en:
Far-spread! wide-ruling! grant that we, unharmed by envy, may expand
Grant that our progeny may live.

verses.sa:
ये मूर्धानः क्षितीनामदब्धासः स्वयशसः ।
व्रता रक्षन्ते अद्रुहः ॥
verses.rom:
ye murdhanah kshitinamadabdhasah svayashasah |
vrata rakshante adruhah ||
verses.en:
Those who, the Princes of the folk, in native glory, ne'er deceived,
Maintain their statutes, void of guilt-

verses.sa:
ते न आस्नो वृकाणामादित्यासो मुमोचत ।
स्तेनं बद्धमिवादिते ॥
verses.rom:
te na asno vrikanamadityaso mumochata |
stenam baddhamivadite ||
verses.en:
As such, from mouth of ravening wolves, O ye Adityas, rescue us,
Like a bound thief, O Aditi.

verses.sa:
अपो षु ण इयं शरुरादित्या अप दुर्मतिः ।
अस्मदेत्वजघ्नुषी ॥
verses.rom:
apo shu na iyam sharuraditya apa durmatih |
asmadetvajaghnushi ||
verses.en:
Adityas, let this arrow, yea, let this malignity depart
From us or e'er it strike us dead.

verses.sa:
शश्वद्धि वः सुदानव आदित्या ऊतिभिर्वयम् ।
पुरा नूनं बुभुज्महे ॥
verses.rom:
shashvaddhi vah sudanava aditya utibhirvayam |
pura nunam bubhujmahe ||
verses.en:
Fori Bountiful Adityas, we have evermore enjoyed your help,
Both now and in die days of old.

verses.sa:
शश्वन्तं हि प्रचेतसः प्रतियन्तं चिदेनसः ।
देवाः कृणुथ जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
shashvantam hi prachetasah pratiyantam chidenasah |
devah krinutha jivase ||
verses.en:
To every one, O ye Most Wise, who turneth even from sin to you,
Ye Gods vouchsafe that he may live.

verses.sa:
तत्सु नो नव्यं सन्यस आदित्या यन्मुमोचति ।
बन्धाद्बद्धमिवादिते ॥
verses.rom:
tatsu no navyam sanyasa aditya yanmumochati |
bandhadbaddhamivadite ||
verses.en:
May this new mercy profit us, which, ye Adityas, frees like one,
Bound from his bonds, O Aditi.

verses.sa:
नास्माकमस्ति तत्तर आदित्यासो अतिष्कदे ।
यूयमस्मभ्यं मृळत ॥
verses.rom:
nasmakamasti tattara adityaso atishkade |
yuyamasmabhyam mrilata ||
verses.en:
O ye Adityas, this your might is not to be despised by us:
So be ye graciously inclined.

verses.sa:
मा नो हेतिर्विवस्वत आदित्याः कृत्रिमा शरुः ।
पुरा नु जरसो वधीत् ॥
verses.rom:
ma no hetirvivasvata adityah kritrima sharuh |
pura nu jaraso vadhit ||
verses.en:
Let not Vivasvan's weapon nor the shaft, Adityas, wrought with skill,
Destroy us ere old age be nigh.

verses.sa:
वि षु द्वेषो व्यंहतिमादित्यासो वि संहितम् ।
विष्वग्वि वृहता रपः ॥
verses.rom:
vi shu dvesho vyamhatimadityaso vi samhitam |
vishvagvi vrihata rapah ||
verses.en:
On every side dispel all sin, Adityas, all hostility,
Indigence, and combined attack.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा रथं यथोतये सुम्नाय वर्तयामसि ।
तुविकूर्मिमृतीषहमिन्द्र शविष्ठ सत्पते ॥
verses.rom:
a tva ratham yathotaye sumnaya vartayamasi |
tuvikurmimritishahamindra shavishtha satpate ||
verses.en:
EVEN as a car to give us aid, we draw thee hither for our bliss,
Strong in thy deeds, checking assault, Lord, Mightiest Indra, of the brave!

verses.sa:
तुविशुष्म तुविक्रतो शचीवो विश्वया मते ।
आ पप्राथ महित्वना ॥
verses.rom:
tuvishushma tuvikrato shachivo vishvaya mate |
a papratha mahitvana ||
verses.en:
Great in thy power and wisdom, Strong, with thought that comprehendeth all
Thou hast filled full with majesty.

verses.sa:
यस्य ते महिना महः परि ज्मायन्तमीयतुः ।
हस्ता वज्रं हिरण्ययम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasya te mahina mahah pari jmayantamiyatuh |
hasta vajram hiranyayam ||
verses.en:
Thou very Mighty One, whose hands by virtue of thy greatness grasp,
The golden bolt that breaks its way.

verses.sa:
विश्वानरस्य वस्पतिमनानतस्य शवसः ।
एवैश्च चर्षणीनामूती हुवे रथानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishvanarasya vaspatimananatasya shavasah |
evaishcha charshaninamuti huve rathanam ||
verses.en:
Your Lord of might that ne'er hath bent, that ruleth over all mankind,
I call, that he, as he is wont, may aid the chariots and the men.

verses.sa:
अभिष्टये सदावृधं स्वर्मीळ्हेषु यं नरः ।
नाना हवन्त ऊतये ॥
verses.rom:
abhishtaye sadavridham svarmilheshu yam narah |
nana havanta utaye ||
verses.en:
Whom, ever furthering, in frays that win the light, in both the hosts
Men call to succour and to help.

verses.sa:
परोमात्रमृचीषममिन्द्रमुग्रं सुराधसम् ।
ईशानं चिद्वसूनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
paromatramrichishamamindramugram suradhasam |
ishanam chidvasunam ||
verses.en:
Indra, the Strong, the measureless, worthy of praise, Most Bountiful,
Sole Ruler even over wealth.

verses.sa:
तंतमिद्राधसे मह इन्द्रं चोदामि पीतये ।
यः पूर्व्यामनुष्टुतिमीशे कृष्टीनां नृतुः ॥
verses.rom:
tamtamidradhase maha indram chodami pitaye |
yah purvyamanushtutimishe krishtinam nrituh ||
verses.en:
Him, for his ample bounty, him, this Indra do I urge to drink,
Who, as his praise was sung of old, the Dancer, is the Lord of men.

verses.sa:
न यस्य ते शवसान सख्यमानंश मर्त्यः ।
नकिः शवांसि ते नशत् ॥
verses.rom:
na yasya te shavasana sakhyamanamsha martyah |
nakih shavamsi te nashat ||
verses.en:
Thou Mighty One, whose friendship none of mortals ever hath obtained
None will attain unto thy might.

verses.sa:
त्वोतासस्त्वा युजाप्सु सूर्ये महद्धनम् ।
जयेम पृत्सु वज्रिवः ॥
verses.rom:
tvotasastva yujapsu surye mahaddhanam |
jayema pritsu vajrivah ||
verses.en:
Aided by thee, with thee allied, in frays for water and for sun,
Bolt-armed! may we win ample spoil.

verses.sa:
तं त्वा यज्ञेभिरीमहे तं गीर्भिर्गिर्वणस्तम ।
इन्द्र यथा चिदाविथ वाजेषु पुरुमाय्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam tva yajnebhirimahe tam girbhirgirvanastama |
indra yatha chidavitha vajeshu purumayyam ||
verses.en:
So seek we thee with sacrifice and songs, chief Lover of the Song,
As, in our battles Indra, thou to Purumayya gavest help.

verses.sa:
यस्य ते स्वादु सख्यं स्वाद्वी प्रणीतिरद्रिवः ।
यज्ञो वितन्तसाय्यः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya te svadu sakhyam svadvi pranitiradrivah |
yajno vitantasayyah ||
verses.en:
O Thunderer, thou whose friendship and whose onward guidance both are sweet,
Thy sacrifice must be prepared.

verses.sa:
उरु णस्तन्वे तन उरु क्षयाय नस्कृधि ।
उरु णो यन्धि जीवसे ॥
verses.rom:
uru nastanve tana uru kshayaya naskridhi |
uru no yandhi jivase ||
verses.en:
To us, ourselves, give ample room, give for our dwelling ample room
Give ample room to us to live.

verses.sa:
उरुं नृभ्य उरुं गव उरुं रथाय पन्थाम् ।
देववीतिं मनामहे ॥
verses.rom:
urum nribhya urum gava urum rathaya pantham |
devavitim manamahe ||
verses.en:
We count the banquet of the Gods a spacious pathway for the men,
And for the cattle, and the car.

verses.sa:
उप मा षड्द्वाद्वा नरः सोमस्य हर्ष्या ।
तिष्ठन्ति स्वादुरातयः ॥
verses.rom:
upa ma shaddvadva narah somasya harshya |
tishthanti svaduratayah ||
verses.en:
Six men, yea, two and two, made glad with Soma juice, come near to me
With offerings pleasant to the taste.

verses.sa:
ऋज्राविन्द्रोत आ ददे हरी ऋक्षस्य सूनवि ।
आश्वमेधस्य रोहिता ॥
verses.rom:
rijravindrota a dade hari rikshasya sunavi |
ashvamedhasya rohita ||
verses.en:
Two brown-hued steeds, Indrota's gift, two bays from Rksa's son were mine,
From Asvamedha's son two red.

verses.sa:
सुरथाँ आतिथिग्वे स्वभीशूँरार्क्षे ।
आश्वमेधे सुपेशसः ॥
verses.rom:
surathan atithigve svabhishunrarkshe |
ashvamedhe supeshasah ||
verses.en:
From Atithigva good car-steeds; from Arksa rein-obeying steeds,
From Asvamedha beauteous ones.

verses.sa:
षळश्वाँ आतिथिग्व इन्द्रोते वधूमतः ।
सचा पूतक्रतौ सनम् ॥
verses.rom:
shalashvan atithigva indrote vadhumatah |
sacha putakratau sanam ||
verses.en:
Indrota, Atithigva's son, gave me six horses matched with mares
And Patakratu gave besides.

verses.sa:
ऐषु चेतद्वृषण्वत्यन्तरृज्रेष्वरुषी ।
स्वभीशुः कशावती ॥
verses.rom:
aishu chetadvrishanvatyantarrijreshvarushi |
svabhishuh kashavati ||
verses.en:
Marked above all, amid the brown, is the red mare Vrsanvati,
Obedient to the rein and whip.

verses.sa:
न युष्मे वाजबन्धवो निनित्सुश्चन मर्त्यः ।
अवद्यमधि दीधरत् ॥
verses.rom:
na yushme vajabandhavo ninitsushchana martyah |
avadyamadhi didharat ||
verses.en:
O bound to me by deeds of might, not even the man who loves to blame.
Hath found a single fault in you.

verses.sa:
प्रप्र वस्त्रिष्टुभमिषं मन्दद्वीरायेन्दवे ।
धिया वो मेधसातये पुरंध्या विवासति ॥
verses.rom:
prapra vastrishtubhamisham mandadvirayendave |
dhiya vo medhasataye puramdhya vivasati ||
verses.en:
I SEND you forth the song of praise for Indu, hero-gladdener.
With hymn and plenty he invites you to complete the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
नदं व ओदतीनां नदं योयुवतीनाम् ।
पतिं वो अघ्न्यानां धेनूनामिषुध्यसि ॥
verses.rom:
nadam va odatinam nadam yoyuvatinam |
patim vo aghnyanam dhenunamishudhyasi ||
verses.en:
Thou wishest for thy kine a bull, for those who long for his approach,
For those who turn away from him, lord of thy cows whom none may kill.

verses.sa:
ता अस्य सूददोहसः सोमं श्रीणन्ति पृश्नयः ।
जन्मन्देवानां विशस्त्रिष्वा रोचने दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
ta asya sudadohasah somam shrinanti prishnayah |
janmandevanam vishastrishva rochane divah ||
verses.en:
The dappled kine who stream with milk prepare his draught of Soma juice:
Clans in the birth-place of the Gods, in the three luminous realms of heaven.

verses.sa:
अभि प्र गोपतिं गिरेन्द्रमर्च यथा विदे ।
सूनुं सत्यस्य सत्पतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
abhi pra gopatim girendramarcha yatha vide |
sunum satyasya satpatim ||
verses.en:
Praise, even as he is known, with song Indra the guardian of the kine,
The Son of Truth, Lord of the brave.

verses.sa:
आ हरयः ससृज्रिरेऽरुषीरधि बर्हिषि ।
यत्राभि संनवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
a harayah sasrijrire'rushiradhi barhishi |
yatrabhi samnavamahe ||
verses.en:
Hither his Bay Steeds have been sent, red Steeds are on the sacred grass,,
Where we in concert sing our songs.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय गाव आशिरं दुदुह्रे वज्रिणे मधु ।
यत्सीमुपह्वरे विदत् ॥
verses.rom:
indraya gava ashiram duduhre vajrine madhu |
yatsimupahvare vidat ||
verses.en:
For Indra Thunder-armed the kine have yielded mingled milk and meath,
What time he found them in the vault.

verses.sa:
उद्यद्ब्रध्नस्य विष्टपं गृहमिन्द्रश्च गन्वहि ।
मध्वः पीत्वा सचेवहि त्रिः सप्त सख्युः पदे ॥
verses.rom:
udyadbradhnasya vishtapam grihamindrashcha ganvahi |
madhvah pitva sachevahi trih sapta sakhyuh pade ||
verses.en:
When I and Indra mount on high up to the Bright One's place and home,
We, having drunk of meath, will reach his seat whose Friends are three times seven.

verses.sa:
अर्चत प्रार्चत प्रियमेधासो अर्चत ।
अर्चन्तु पुत्रका उत पुरं न धृष्ण्वर्चत ॥
verses.rom:
archata prarchata priyamedhaso archata |
archantu putraka uta puram na dhrishnvarchata ||
verses.en:
Sing, sing ye forth your songs of praise, ye Briyamedhas, sing your songs:
Yea, let young children sing their lauds as a strong castle praise ye him.

verses.sa:
अव स्वराति गर्गरो गोधा परि सनिष्वणत् ।
पिङ्गा परि चनिष्कददिन्द्राय ब्रह्मोद्यतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ava svarati gargaro godha pari sanishvanat |
pinga pari chanishkadadindraya brahmodyatam ||
verses.en:
Now loudly let the viol sound, the lute send out its voice with might,
Shrill be the music of the string. To Indra is the hymn up-raised.

verses.sa:
आ यत्पतन्त्येन्यः सुदुघा अनपस्फुरः ।
अपस्फुरं गृभायत सोममिन्द्राय पातवे ॥
verses.rom:
a yatpatantyenyah sudugha anapasphurah |
apasphuram gribhayata somamindraya patave ||
verses.en:
When hither speed the dappled cows, unflinching, easy to be milked,
Seize quickly, as it bursts away, the Soma juice for Indra's drink.

verses.sa:
अपादिन्द्रो अपादग्निर्विश्वे देवा अमत्सत ।
वरुण इदिह क्षयत्तमापो अभ्यनूषत वत्सं संशिश्वरीरिव ॥
verses.rom:
apadindro apadagnirvishve deva amatsata |
varuna idiha kshayattamapo abhyanushata vatsam samshishvaririva ||
verses.en:
Indra hath drunk, Agni hath drunk. all Deities have drunk their fill.
Here Varuna shall have his home, to whom the floods have sung aloud as mother kine unto their calves.

verses.sa:
सुदेवो असि वरुण यस्य ते सप्त सिन्धवः ।
अनुक्षरन्ति काकुदं सूर्म्यं सुषिरामिव ॥
verses.rom:
sudevo asi varuna yasya te sapta sindhavah |
anuksharanti kakudam surmyam sushiramiva ||
verses.en:
Thou, Varuna, to whom belong Seven Rivers, art a glorious God.
The waters flow into thy throat as 'twere a pipe with ample mouth.

verses.sa:
यो व्यतीँरफाणयत्सुयुक्ताँ उप दाशुषे ।
तक्वो नेता तदिद्वपुरुपमा यो अमुच्यत ॥
verses.rom:
yo vyatinraphanayatsuyuktan upa dashushe |
takvo neta tadidvapurupama yo amuchyata ||
verses.en:
He who hath made the fleet steeds spring, well-harnessed, to the worshipper,
He, the swift Guide, is that fair form that loosed the horses near at hand.

verses.sa:
अतीदु शक्र ओहत इन्द्रो विश्वा अति द्विषः ।
भिनत्कनीन ओदनं पच्यमानं परो गिरा ॥
verses.rom:
atidu shakra ohata indro vishva ati dvishah |
bhinatkanina odanam pachyamanam paro gira ||
verses.en:
Indra, the very Mighty, holds his enemies in utter scorn.
He, far away, and yet a child, cleft the cloud smitten by his voice.

verses.sa:
अर्भको न कुमारकोऽधि तिष्ठन्नवं रथम् ।
स पक्षन्महिषं मृगं पित्रे मात्रे विभुक्रतुम् ॥
verses.rom:
arbhako na kumarako'dhi tishthannavam ratham |
sa pakshanmahisham mrigam pitre matre vibhukratum ||
verses.en:
He, yet a boy exceeding small, mounted his newly-fashioned car.
He for his Mother and his Sire cooked the wild mighty buffalo.

verses.sa:
आ तू सुशिप्र दम्पते रथं तिष्ठा हिरण्ययम् ।
अध द्युक्षं सचेवहि सहस्रपादमरुषं स्वस्तिगामनेहसम् ॥
verses.rom:
a tu sushipra dampate ratham tishtha hiranyayam |
adha dyuksham sachevahi sahasrapadamarusham svastigamanehasam ||
verses.en:
Lord of the home, fair-helmeted, ascend thy chariot wrought of gold.
We will attend the Heavenly One, the thousand-footed, red of hue, matchless, who blesses where he goes.

verses.sa:
तं घेमित्था नमस्विन उप स्वराजमासते ।
अर्थं चिदस्य सुधितं यदेतव आवर्तयन्ति दावने ॥
verses.rom:
tam ghemittha namasvina upa svarajamasate |
artham chidasya sudhitam yadetava avartayanti davane ||
verses.en:
With reverence they come hitherward to him as to. a Sovran lord,
That they may bring him near for this man's good success, to prosper and bestow his gifts.

verses.sa:
अनु प्रत्नस्यौकसः प्रियमेधास एषाम् ।
पूर्वामनु प्रयतिं वृक्तबर्हिषो हितप्रयस आशत ॥
verses.rom:
anu pratnasyaukasah priyamedhasa esham |
purvamanu prayatim vriktabarhisho hitaprayasa ashata ||
verses.en:
The Priyamedhas have observed the offering of the men of old,
Of ancient custom, while they strewed the sacred grass, and spread their sacrificial food.

verses.sa:
यो राजा चर्षणीनां याता रथेभिरध्रिगुः ।
विश्वासां तरुता पृतनानां ज्येष्ठो यो वृत्रहा गृणे ॥
verses.rom:
yo raja charshaninam yata rathebhiradhriguh |
vishvasam taruta pritananam jyeshtho yo vritraha grine ||
verses.en:
HE who, as Sovran Lord of men, moves with his chariots unrestrained,
The Vrtra-slayer vanquisher, of fighting hosts, preeminent, is praised with song.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं तं शुम्भ पुरुहन्मन्नवसे यस्य द्विता विधर्तरि ।
हस्ताय वज्रः प्रति धायि दर्शतो महो दिवे न सूर्यः ॥
verses.rom:
indram tam shumbha puruhanmannavase yasya dvita vidhartari |
hastaya vajrah prati dhayi darshato maho dive na suryah ||
verses.en:
Honour that Indra, Puruhanman! for his aid, in whose sustaining hand of old,
The splendid bolt of thunder was deposited, as the great Sun was set in heaven.

verses.sa:
नकिष्टं कर्मणा नशद्यश्चकार सदावृधम् ।
इन्द्रं न यज्ञैर्विश्वगूर्तमृभ्वसमधृष्टं धृष्ण्वोजसम् ॥
verses.rom:
nakishtam karmana nashadyashchakara sadavridham |
indram na yajnairvishvagurtamribhvasamadhrishtam dhrishnvojasam ||
verses.en:
No one by deed attains to him who works and strengthens evermore:
No, not by sacrifice, to Indra. praised o all, resistless, daring, bold in might.

verses.sa:
अषाळ्हमुग्रं पृतनासु सासहिं यस्मिन्महीरुरुज्रयः ।
सं धेनवो जायमाने अनोनवुर्द्यावः क्षामो अनोनवुः ॥
verses.rom:
ashalhamugram pritanasu sasahim yasminmahirurujrayah |
sam dhenavo jayamane anonavurdyavah kshamo anonavuh ||
verses.en:
The potent Conqueror, invincible in war, him at whose birth the Mighty Ones,
The Kine who spread afar, sent their loud voices out, heavens, earths seat their loud voices out,

verses.sa:
यद्द्याव इन्द्र ते शतं शतं भूमीरुत स्युः ।
न त्वा वज्रिन्सहस्रं सूर्या अनु न जातमष्ट रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
yaddyava indra te shatam shatam bhumiruta syuh |
na tva vajrinsahasram surya anu na jatamashta rodasi ||
verses.en:
O Indra, if a hundred heavens and if a hundred earths were thine-
No, not a thousand Suns could match thee at thy birth, not both the worlds, O Thunderer.

verses.sa:
आ पप्राथ महिना वृष्ण्या वृषन्विश्वा शविष्ठ शवसा ।
अस्माँ अव मघवन्गोमति व्रजे वज्रिञ्चित्राभिरूतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
a papratha mahina vrishnya vrishanvishva shavishtha shavasa |
asman ava maghavangomati vraje vajrinchitrabhirutibhih ||
verses.en:
Thou, Hero, hast performed thy hero deeds with might, yea, all with strength, O Strongest One.
Maghavan, help us to a stable full of kine, O Thunderer, with wondrous aids.

verses.sa:
न सीमदेव आपदिषं दीर्घायो मर्त्यः ।
एतग्वा चिद्य एतशा युयोजते हरी इन्द्रो युयोजते ॥
verses.rom:
na simadeva apadisham dirghayo martyah |
etagva chidya etasha yuyojate hari indro yuyojate ||
verses.en:
Let not a godless mortal gain this food, O thou whose life is long!
But one who yokes the bright-hued steeds, the Etasas, even Indra yoker of the Bays.

verses.sa:
तं वो महो महाय्यमिन्द्रं दानाय सक्षणिम् ।
यो गाधेषु य आरणेषु हव्यो वाजेष्वस्ति हव्यः ॥
verses.rom:
tam vo maho mahayyamindram danaya sakshanim |
yo gadheshu ya araneshu havyo vajeshvasti havyah ||
verses.en:
Urge ye the Conqueror to give, your Indra greatly to be praised,
To be invoked in shallow waters and in depths, to be invoked in deeds of might.

verses.sa:
उदू षु णो वसो महे मृशस्व शूर राधसे ।
उदू षु मह्यै मघवन्मघत्तय उदिन्द्र श्रवसे महे ॥
verses.rom:
udu shu no vaso mahe mrishasva shura radhase |
udu shu mahyai maghavanmaghattaya udindra shravase mahe ||
verses.en:
O Vasu, O thou Hero, raise us up to ample opulence.
Raise us to gain of mighty wealth, O Maghavan, O Indra, to sublime renown.

verses.sa:
त्वं न इन्द्र ऋतयुस्त्वानिदो नि तृम्पसि ।
मध्ये वसिष्व तुविनृम्णोर्वोर्नि दासं शिश्नथो हथैः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam na indra ritayustvanido ni trimpasi |
madhye vasishva tuvinrimnorvorni dasam shishnatho hathaih ||
verses.en:
Indra, thou justifiest us, and tramplest down thy slanderers.
Guard thyself, valiant Hero, in thy vital parts: strike down the Dasa with thy blows.

verses.sa:
अन्यव्रतममानुषमयज्वानमदेवयुम् ।
अव स्वः सखा दुधुवीत पर्वतः सुघ्नाय दस्युं पर्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
anyavratamamanushamayajvanamadevayum |
ava svah sakha dudhuvita parvatah sughnaya dasyum parvatah ||
verses.en:
The man who brings no sacrifice, inhuman, godless, infidel,
Him let his friend the mountain cast to rapid death, the mountain cast the Dasyu down.

verses.sa:
त्वं न इन्द्रासां हस्ते शविष्ठ दावने ।
धानानां न सं गृभायास्मयुर्द्विः सं गृभायास्मयुः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam na indrasam haste shavishtha davane |
dhananam na sam gribhayasmayurdvih sam gribhayasmayuh ||
verses.en:
O Mightiest Indra, loving us, gather thou up, as grains of corn,
Within thine hand, of these their kine, to give away, yea, gather twice as loving us.

verses.sa:
सखायः क्रतुमिच्छत कथा राधाम शरस्य ।
उपस्तुतिं भोजः सूरिर्यो अह्रयः ॥
verses.rom:
sakhayah kratumichchhata katha radhama sharasya |
upastutim bhojah suriryo ahrayah ||
verses.en:
O my companions, wish for power. How may we perfect Sara's praise,
The liberal princely patron, never to be harmed?

verses.sa:
भूरिभिः समह ऋषिभिर्बर्हिष्मद्भि स्तविष्यसे ।
यदित्थमेकमेकमिच्छर वत्सान्पराददः ॥
verses.rom:
bhuribhih samaha rishibhirbarhishmadbhi stavishyase |
yaditthamekamekamichchhara vatsanparadadah ||
verses.en:
By many a sage whose grass is trimmed thou art continually praised,
That thou, O Sara, hast bestowed here one and here another calf.

verses.sa:
कर्णगृह्या मघवा शौरदेव्यो वत्सं नस्त्रिभ्य आनयत् ।
अजां सूरिर्न धातवे ॥
verses.rom:
karnagrihya maghava shauradevyo vatsam nastribhya anayat |
ajam surirna dhatave ||
verses.en:
The noble, Suradeva's son, hath brought a calf, led by the car to three of us.
As a chief brings a goat to milk.

verses.sa:
त्वं नो अग्ने महोभिः पाहि विश्वस्या अरातेः ।
उत द्विषो मर्त्यस्य ॥
verses.rom:
tvam no agne mahobhih pahi vishvasya arateh |
uta dvisho martyasya ||
verses.en:
O AGNI, with thy mighty wealth guard us from all malignity,
Yea, from all hate of mortal man.

verses.sa:
नहि मन्युः पौरुषेय ईशे हि वः प्रियजात ।
त्वमिदसि क्षपावान् ॥
verses.rom:
nahi manyuh paurusheya ishe hi vah priyajata |
tvamidasi kshapavan ||
verses.en:
For over thee, O Friend from birth, the wrath of man hath no control:
Nay, Guardian of the earth art thou.

verses.sa:
स नो विश्वेभिर्देवेभिरूर्जो नपाद्भद्रशोचे ।
रयिं देहि विश्ववारम् ॥
verses.rom:
sa no vishvebhirdevebhirurjo napadbhadrashoche |
rayim dehi vishvavaram ||
verses.en:
As such, with all the Gods, O Son of Strength, auspicious in thy flame.
Give us wealth bringing all things good.

verses.sa:
न तमग्ने अरातयो मर्तं युवन्त रायः ।
यं त्रायसे दाश्वांसम् ॥
verses.rom:
na tamagne aratayo martam yuvanta rayah |
yam trayase dashvamsam ||
verses.en:
Malignities stay not from wealth the mortal man whom, Agni, thou
Protectest while he offers gifts.

verses.sa:
यं त्वं विप्र मेधसातावग्ने हिनोषि धनाय ।
स तवोती गोषु गन्ता ॥
verses.rom:
yam tvam vipra medhasatavagne hinoshi dhanaya |
sa tavoti goshu ganta ||
verses.en:
Sage Agni, be whom thou dost urge, in worship of the Gods, to wealth,
With thine assistance winneth kine.

verses.sa:
त्वं रयिं पुरुवीरमग्ने दाशुषे मर्ताय ।
प्र णो नय वस्यो अच्छ ॥
verses.rom:
tvam rayim puruviramagne dashushe martaya |
pra no naya vasyo achchha ||
verses.en:
Riches with many heroes thou hast for the man who offers gifts:
Lead thou us on to higher bliss.

verses.sa:
उरुष्या णो मा परा दा अघायते जातवेदः ।
दुराध्ये मर्ताय ॥
verses.rom:
urushya no ma para da aghayate jatavedah |
duradhye martaya ||
verses.en:
Save us, O Jatavedas, nor abandon us to him who sins,
Unto the evil-hearted man.

verses.sa:
अग्ने माकिष्टे देवस्य रातिमदेवो युयोत ।
त्वमीशिषे वसूनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
agne makishte devasya ratimadevo yuyota |
tvamishishe vasunam ||
verses.en:
O Agni, let no godless man avert thy bounty as a God:
Over all treasures thou art Lord.

verses.sa:
स नो वस्व उप मास्यूर्जो नपान्माहिनस्य ।
सखे वसो जरितृभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
sa no vasva upa masyurjo napanmahinasya |
sakhe vaso jaritribhyah ||
verses.en:
So, Son of Strength, thou aidest us to what is great and excellent.
Those, Vasu! Friend! who sing thy praise.

verses.sa:
अच्छा नः शीरशोचिषं गिरो यन्तु दर्शतम् ।
अच्छा यज्ञासो नमसा पुरूवसुं पुरुप्रशस्तमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
achchha nah shirashochisham giro yantu darshatam |
achchha yajnaso namasa puruvasum puruprashastamutaye ||
verses.en:
Let our songs come anear to him beauteous and bright with piercing flame
Our offerings, with our homage, to the
Lord of wealth, to him whom many praise, for help:

verses.sa:
अग्निं सूनुं सहसो जातवेदसं दानाय वार्याणाम् ।
द्विता यो भूदमृतो मर्त्येष्वा होता मन्द्रतमो विशि ॥
verses.rom:
agnim sunum sahaso jatavedasam danaya varyanam |
dvita yo bhudamrito martyeshva hota mandratamo vishi ||
verses.en:
To Agni Jatavedas, to the Son of Strength, that he may give us precious gifts,
Immortal, from of old Priest among mortal men, the most delightful in the house.

verses.sa:
अग्निं वो देवयज्ययाग्निं प्रयत्यध्वरे ।
अग्निं धीषु प्रथममग्निमर्वत्यग्निं क्षैत्राय साधसे ॥
verses.rom:
agnim vo devayajyayagnim prayatyadhvare |
agnim dhishu prathamamagnimarvatyagnim kshaitraya sadhase ||
verses.en:
Agni, made yours by sacrifice, Agni, while holy rites advance;
Agni, the first in songs, first with the warrior steed; Agni to win the land for us.

verses.sa:
अग्निरिषां सख्ये ददातु न ईशे यो वार्याणाम् ।
अग्निं तोके तनये शश्वदीमहे वसुं सन्तं तनूपाम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnirisham sakhye dadatu na ishe yo varyanam |
agnim toke tanaye shashvadimahe vasum santam tanupam ||
verses.en:
May Agni who is Lord of wealth vouchsafe us food for friendship sake.
Agni we ever seek for seed and progeny, the Vasu who protects our lives.

verses.sa:
अग्निमीळिष्वावसे गाथाभिः शीरशोचिषम् ।
अग्निं राये पुरुमीळ्ह श्रुतं नरोऽग्निं सुदीतये छर्दिः ॥
verses.rom:
agnimilishvavase gathabhih shirashochisham |
agnim raye purumilha shrutam naro'gnim suditaye chhardih ||
verses.en:
Solicit with your chants, for help, Agni the God with piercing flame,
For riches famous Agni, Purumilha and ye men! Agni to light our dwelling well.

verses.sa:
अग्निं द्वेषो योतवै नो गृणीमस्यग्निं शं योश्च दातवे ।
विश्वासु विक्ष्ववितेव हव्यो भुवद्वस्तुरृषूणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
agnim dvesho yotavai no grinimasyagnim sham yoshcha datave |
vishvasu vikshvaviteva havyo bhuvadvasturrishunam ||
verses.en:
Agni we laud that he may keep our foes afar, Agni to give us health and strength.
Let him as Guardian be invoked in all the tribes, the lighter-up of glowing brands.

verses.sa:
हविष्कृणुध्वमा गमदध्वर्युर्वनते पुनः ।
विद्वाँ अस्य प्रशासनम् ॥
verses.rom:
havishkrinudhvama gamadadhvaryurvanate punah |
vidvan asya prashasanam ||
verses.en:
PREPARE oblation: let him come; and let the minister serve again
Who knows the ordering thereof,

verses.sa:
नि तिग्ममभ्यंशुं सीदद्धोता मनावधि ।
जुषाणो अस्य सख्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
ni tigmamabhyamshum sidaddhota manavadhi |
jushano asya sakhyam ||
verses.en:
Rejoicing in his friendship, let the priest be seated over man,
Beside the shoot of active power.

verses.sa:
अन्तरिच्छन्ति तं जने रुद्रं परो मनीषया ।
गृभ्णन्ति जिह्वया ससम् ॥
verses.rom:
antarichchhanti tam jane rudram paro manishaya |
gribhnanti jihvaya sasam ||
verses.en:
Him, glowing bright beyond all thought, they seek among the race of man;
With him for tongue they seize the food.

verses.sa:
जाम्यतीतपे धनुर्वयोधा अरुहद्वनम् ।
दृषदं जिह्वयावधीत् ॥
verses.rom:
jamyatitape dhanurvayodha aruhadvanam |
drishadam jihvayavadhit ||
verses.en:
He hath inflamed the twofold plain: lifegiving, he hath climbed the wood,
And with his tongue hath struck the rock.

verses.sa:
चरन्वत्सो रुशन्निह निदातारं न विन्दते ।
वेति स्तोतव अम्ब्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
charanvatso rushanniha nidataram na vindate |
veti stotava ambyam ||
verses.en:
Wandering here the radiant Calf finds none to fetter him, and seeks
The Mother to declare his praise.

verses.sa:
उतो न्वस्य यन्महदश्वावद्योजनं बृहद् ।
दामा रथस्य ददृशे ॥
verses.rom:
uto nvasya yanmahadashvavadyojanam brihad |
dama rathasya dadrishe ||
verses.en:
And now that great and mighty team, the team of horses that are his,
And traces of his car, are seen.

verses.sa:
दुहन्ति सप्तैकामुप द्वा पञ्च सृजतः ।
तीर्थे सिन्धोरधि स्वरे ॥
verses.rom:
duhanti saptaikamupa dva pancha srijatah |
tirthe sindhoradhi svare ||
verses.en:
The seven milk a single cow; the two set other five to work,
On the stream's loud-resounding bank.

verses.sa:
आ दशभिर्विवस्वत इन्द्रः कोशमचुच्यवीत् ।
खेदया त्रिवृता दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
a dashabhirvivasvata indrah koshamachuchyavit |
khedaya trivrita divah ||
verses.en:
Entreated by Vivasvan's ten, Indra cast down the water-jar
With threefold hammer from the sky.

verses.sa:
परि त्रिधातुरध्वरं जूर्णिरेति नवीयसी ।
मध्वा होतारो अञ्जते ॥
verses.rom:
pari tridhaturadhvaram jurnireti naviyasi |
madhva hotaro anjate ||
verses.en:
Three times the newly-kindled flame proceeds around the sacrifice:
The priests anoint it with the meath.

verses.sa:
सिञ्चन्ति नमसावतमुच्चाचक्रं परिज्मानम् ।
नीचीनबारमक्षितम् ॥
verses.rom:
sinchanti namasavatamuchchachakram parijmanam |
nichinabaramakshitam ||
verses.en:
With reverence they drain the fount that circles with its wheel above,
Exhaustless, with the mouth below.

verses.sa:
अभ्यारमिदद्रयो निषिक्तं पुष्करे मधु ।
अवतस्य विसर्जने ॥
verses.rom:
abhyaramidadrayo nishiktam pushkare madhu |
avatasya visarjane ||
verses.en:
The pressing-stones are set at work: the meath is poured into the tank,
At the out-shedding of the fount.

verses.sa:
गाव उपावतावतं मही यज्ञस्य रप्सुदा ।
उभा कर्णा हिरण्यया ॥
verses.rom:
gava upavatavatam mahi yajnasya rapsuda |
ubha karna hiranyaya ||
verses.en:
Ye cows, protect the fount: the two Mighty Ones bless the sacrifice.
The handles twain are wrought of gold.

verses.sa:
आ सुते सिञ्चत श्रियं रोदस्योरभिश्रियम् ।
रसा दधीत वृषभम् ॥
verses.rom:
a sute sinchata shriyam rodasyorabhishriyam |
rasa dadhita vrishabham ||
verses.en:
Pour on the juice the ornament which reaches both the heaven and earth
Supply the liquid to the Bull.

verses.sa:
ते जानत स्वमोक्यं सं वत्सासो न मातृभिः ।
मिथो नसन्त जामिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
te janata svamokyam sam vatsaso na matribhih |
mitho nasanta jamibhih ||
verses.en:
These know their own abiding-place: like calves beside the mother cows
They meet together with their kin.

verses.sa:
उप स्रक्वेषु बप्सतः कृण्वते धरुणं दिवि ।
इन्द्रे अग्ना नमः स्वः ॥
verses.rom:
upa srakveshu bapsatah krinvate dharunam divi |
indre agna namah svah ||
verses.en:
Devouring in their greedy jaws, they make sustaining food in heaven,
To Indra, Agni light and prayer.

verses.sa:
अधुक्षत्पिप्युषीमिषमूर्जं सप्तपदीमरिः ।
सूर्यस्य सप्त रश्मिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
adhukshatpipyushimishamurjam saptapadimarih |
suryasya sapta rashmibhih ||
verses.en:
The Pious One milked out rich food, sustenance dealt in portions seven,
Together with the Sun's seven rays.

verses.sa:
सोमस्य मित्रावरुणोदिता सूर आ ददे ।
तदातुरस्य भेषजम् ॥
verses.rom:
somasya mitravarunodita sura a dade |
tadaturasya bheshajam ||
verses.en:
I took some Soma when the Sun rose up, O Mitra, Varuna.
That is the sick man's medicine.

verses.sa:
उतो न्वस्य यत्पदं हर्यतस्य निधान्यम् ।
परि द्यां जिह्वयातनत् ॥
verses.rom:
uto nvasya yatpadam haryatasya nidhanyam |
pari dyam jihvayatanat ||
verses.en:
From where oblations must be laid, which is the Well-beloved's home,
He with his tongue hath compassed heaven.

verses.sa:
उदीराथामृतायते युञ्जाथामश्विना रथम् ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
udirathamritayate yunjathamashvina ratham |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
ROUSE ye for him who keeps the Law, yoke your steeds, Asvins, to your car
Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa:
निमिषश्चिज्जवीयसा रथेना यातमश्विना ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
nimishashchijjaviyasa rathena yatamashvina |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
Come, Asvins, with your car more swift than is the twinkling of an eye
Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa:
उप स्तृणीतमत्रये हिमेन घर्ममश्विना ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
upa strinitamatraye himena gharmamashvina |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
Asvins, ye overlaid with cold the fiery pit for Atri's sake:
Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa:
कुह स्थः कुह जग्मथुः कुह श्येनेव पेतथुः ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
kuha sthah kuha jagmathuh kuha shyeneva petathuh |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
Where are ye? whither are ye gone? whither, like falcons, have ye flown?
Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa:
यदद्य कर्हि कर्हि चिच्छुश्रूयातमिमं हवम् ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
yadadya karhi karhi chichchhushruyatamimam havam |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
If ye at any time this day are listening to this my call,
Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa:
अश्विना यामहूतमा नेदिष्ठं याम्याप्यम् ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina yamahutama nedishtham yamyapyam |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
The Asvins, fust to hear our prayer, for closest kinship I approach:
Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa:
अवन्तमत्रये गृहं कृणुतं युवमश्विना ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
avantamatraye griham krinutam yuvamashvina |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
For Atri ye, O Asvins, made a dwelling place to shield him well,
Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa:
वरेथे अग्निमातपो वदते वल्ग्वत्रये ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
varethe agnimatapo vadate valgvatraye |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
Ye warded off the fervent heat for Atri when he sweetly spake:
Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa:
प्र सप्तवध्रिराशसा धारामग्नेरशायत ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
pra saptavadhrirashasa dharamagnerashayata |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
Erst Saptavadbri by his prayer obtained the trenchant edge of fire:
Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa:
इहा गतं वृषण्वसू शृणुतं म इमं हवम् ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
iha gatam vrishanvasu shrinutam ma imam havam |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
Come hither, O ye Lords of wealth, and listen to this call of mine:
Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa:
किमिदं वां पुराणवज्जरतोरिव शस्यते ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
kimidam vam puranavajjaratoriva shasyate |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
What is this praise told forth of you as Elders in the ancient way?
Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa:
समानं वां सजात्यं समानो बन्धुरश्विना ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
samanam vam sajatyam samano bandhurashvina |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
One common brotherhood is yours, Asvins your kindred is the same:
Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa:
यो वां रजांस्यश्विना रथो वियाति रोदसी ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
yo vam rajamsyashvina ratho viyati rodasi |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
This is your chariot, Asvins, which speeds through the regions, earth and heaven
Let your protecting aid be near.

verses.sa:
आ नो गव्येभिरश्व्यैः सहस्रैरुप गच्छतम् ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
a no gavyebhirashvyaih sahasrairupa gachchhatam |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
Approach ye hitherward to us with thousands both of steeds and kine:
Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa:
मा नो गव्येभिरश्व्यैः सहस्रेभिरति ख्यतम् ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
ma no gavyebhirashvyaih sahasrebhirati khyatam |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
Pass us not by, remember us with thousands both of kine aud steeds:
Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa:
अरुणप्सुरुषा अभूदकर्ज्योतिरृतावरी ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
arunapsurusha abhudakarjyotirritavari |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
The purple-tinted Dawn hath risen, and true to Law hath made the light
Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa:
अश्विना सु विचाकशद्वृक्षं परशुमाँ इव ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
ashvina su vichakashadvriksham parashuman iva |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
He looked upon the Asvins, as an axe armed man upon a tree:
Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa:
पुरं न धृष्णवा रुज कृष्णया बाधितो विशा ।
अन्ति षद्भूतु वामवः ॥
verses.rom:
puram na dhrishnava ruja krishnaya badhito visha |
anti shadbhutu vamavah ||
verses.en:
By the black band encompassed round, break it down, bold one, like a fort.
Let your protecting help be near.

verses.sa:
विशोविशो वो अतिथिं वाजयन्तः पुरुप्रियम् ।
अग्निं वो दुर्यं वच स्तुषे शूषस्य मन्मभिः ॥
verses.rom:
vishovisho vo atithim vajayantah purupriyam |
agnim vo duryam vacha stushe shushasya manmabhih ||
verses.en:
EXERTING all our strength with thoughts of power we glorify in speech
Agni your dear familiar Friend, the darling Guest in every home.

verses.sa:
यं जनासो हविष्मन्तो मित्रं न सर्पिरासुतिम् ।
प्रशंसन्ति प्रशस्तिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
yam janaso havishmanto mitram na sarpirasutim |
prashamsanti prashastibhih ||
verses.en:
Whom, served with sacrificial oil like Mitra, men presenting gifts
Eulogize with their songs of praise

verses.sa:
पन्यांसं जातवेदसं यो देवतात्युद्यता ।
हव्यान्यैरयद्दिवि ॥
verses.rom:
panyamsam jatavedasam yo devatatyudyata |
havyanyairayaddivi ||
verses.en:
Much-lauded Jatavedas, him who bears oblations up to heaven
Prepared in service of the Gods.

verses.sa:
आगन्म वृत्रहन्तमं ज्येष्ठमग्निमानवम् ।
यस्य श्रुतर्वा बृहन्नार्क्षो अनीक एधते ॥
verses.rom:
aganma vritrahantamam jyeshthamagnimanavam |
yasya shrutarva brihannarksho anika edhate ||
verses.en:
To noblest Agni, Friend of man, best Vrtra-slayer, are we come,
Him in whose presence Rksa's son, mighty Srutarvan, waxes great;

verses.sa:
अमृतं जातवेदसं तिरस्तमांसि दर्शतम् ।
घृताहवनमीड्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
amritam jatavedasam tirastamamsi darshatam |
ghritahavanamidyam ||
verses.en:
To deathless Jatavedas, meet for praise, adored, with sacred oil,
Visible through the gloom of night

verses.sa:
सबाधो यं जना इमेऽग्निं हव्येभिरीळते ।
जुह्वानासो यतस्रुचः ॥
verses.rom:
sabadho yam jana ime'gnim havyebhirilate |
juhvanaso yatasruchah ||
verses.en:
Even Agni whom these priestly men worship with sacrificial gifts,
With lifted ladles offering them.

verses.sa:
इयं ते नव्यसी मतिरग्ने अधाय्यस्मदा ।
मन्द्र सुजात सुक्रतोऽमूर दस्मातिथे ॥
verses.rom:
iyam te navyasi matiragne adhayyasmada |
mandra sujata sukrato'mura dasmatithe ||
verses.en:
O Agni, this our newest hymn hath been addressed from us to thee,
O cheerful Guest, well-born, most wise, worker of wonders, ne'er deceived.

verses.sa:
सा ते अग्ने शंतमा चनिष्ठा भवतु प्रिया ।
तया वर्धस्व सुष्टुतः ॥
verses.rom:
sa te agne shamtama chanishtha bhavatu priya |
taya vardhasva sushtutah ||
verses.en:
Agni, may it be dear to thee, most grateful, and exceeding sweet:
Grow mightier, eulogized therewith.

verses.sa:
सा द्युम्नैर्द्युम्निनी बृहदुपोप श्रवसि श्रवः ।
दधीत वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
verses.rom:
sa dyumnairdyumnini brihadupopa shravasi shravah |
dadhita vritraturye ||
verses.en:
Splendid with splendours may it be, and in the battle with the foe
Add loftier glory to thy fame.

verses.sa:
अश्वमिद्गां रथप्रां त्वेषमिन्द्रं न सत्पतिम् ।
यस्य श्रवांसि तूर्वथ पन्यम्पन्यं च कृष्टयः ॥
verses.rom:
ashvamidgam rathapram tveshamindram na satpatim |
yasya shravamsi turvatha panyampanyam cha krishtayah ||
verses.en:
Steed, cow, a lord of heroes, bright like Indra, who shall fill the car.
Whose high renown ye celebrate, and people praise each glorious deed.

verses.sa:
यं त्वा गोपवनो गिरा चनिष्ठदग्ने अङ्गिरः ।
स पावक श्रुधी हवम् ॥
verses.rom:
yam tva gopavano gira chanishthadagne angirah |
sa pavaka shrudhi havam ||
verses.en:
Thou whom Gopavana made glad with song, O Agni Angiras,
Hear this my call, thou Holy One.

verses.sa:
यं त्वा जनास ईळते सबाधो वाजसातये ।
स बोधि वृत्रतूर्ये ॥
verses.rom:
yam tva janasa ilate sabadho vajasataye |
sa bodhi vritraturye ||
verses.en:
Thou whom the priestly folk implore to aid the gathering of the spoil,
Such be thou in the fight with foes.

verses.sa:
अहं हुवान आर्क्षे श्रुतर्वणि मदच्युति ।
शर्धांसीव स्तुकाविनां मृक्षा शीर्षा चतुर्णाम् ॥
verses.rom:
aham huvana arkshe shrutarvani madachyuti |
shardhamsiva stukavinam mriksha shirsha chaturnam ||
verses.en:
I, called to him who reels with joy, Srutarvan, Rksa's son, shall stroke
The heads of four presented steeds, like the long wool of fleecy rams.

verses.sa:
मां चत्वार आशवः शविष्ठस्य द्रवित्नवः ।
सुरथासो अभि प्रयो वक्षन्वयो न तुग्र्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
mam chatvara ashavah shavishthasya dravitnavah |
surathaso abhi prayo vakshanvayo na tugryam ||
verses.en:
Four coursers with a splendid car, Savistha's horses, fleet of foot,
Shall bring me to the sacred feast, as flying steeds brought Tugra's son.

verses.sa:
सत्यमित्त्वा महेनदि परुष्ण्यव देदिशम् ।
नेमापो अश्वदातरः शविष्ठादस्ति मर्त्यः ॥
verses.rom:
satyamittva mahenadi parushnyava dedisham |
nemapo ashvadatarah shavishthadasti martyah ||
verses.en:
The very truth do I declare to thee, Parusni, mighty flood.
Waters! no man is there who gives more horses than Savistha gives.

verses.sa:
युक्ष्वा हि देवहूतमाँ अश्वाँ अग्ने रथीरिव ।
नि होता पूर्व्यः सदः ॥
verses.rom:
yukshva hi devahutaman ashvan agne rathiriva |
ni hota purvyah sadah ||
verses.en:
YOKE, Agni, as a charioteer, thy steeds who best invite the Gods:
As ancient Herald seat thyself.

verses.sa:
उत नो देव देवाँ अच्छा वोचो विदुष्टरः ।
श्रद्विश्वा वार्या कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
uta no deva devan achchha vocho vidushtarah |
shradvishva varya kridhi ||
verses.en:
And, God, as skilfullest of all, call for us hitherward the Gods:
Give all our wishes sure effect.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह यद्यविष्ठ्य सहसः सूनवाहुत ।
ऋतावा यज्ञियो भुवः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam ha yadyavishthya sahasah sunavahuta |
ritava yajniyo bhuvah ||
verses.en:
For thou, Most Youthful, Son of Strength, thou to whom sacrifice is paid,
Art holy, faithful to the Law.

verses.sa:
अयमग्निः सहस्रिणो वाजस्य शतिनस्पतिः ।
मूर्धा कवी रयीणाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ayamagnih sahasrino vajasya shatinaspatih |
murdha kavi rayinam ||
verses.en:
This Agni, Lord of wealth and spoil hundredfold, thousand fold, is head
And chief of riches and a Sage.

verses.sa:
तं नेमिमृभवो यथा नमस्व सहूतिभिः ।
नेदीयो यज्ञमङ्गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
tam nemimribhavo yatha namasva sahutibhih |
nediyo yajnamangirah ||
verses.en:
As craftsmen bend the felly, so bend at our general call: come nigh,
Angiras, to the sacrifice.

verses.sa:
तस्मै नूनमभिद्यवे वाचा विरूप नित्यया ।
वृष्णे चोदस्व सुष्टुतिम् ॥
verses.rom:
tasmai nunamabhidyave vacha virupa nityaya |
vrishne chodasva sushtutim ||
verses.en:
Now, O Virupa, rouse for him, Strong God who shines at early morn,
Fair praise with voice that ceases not.

verses.sa:
कमु ष्विदस्य सेनयाग्नेरपाकचक्षसः ।
पणिं गोषु स्तरामहे ॥
verses.rom:
kamu shvidasya senayagnerapakachakshasah |
panim goshu staramahe ||
verses.en:
With missile of this Agni, his who looks afar, will we lay low
The thief in combat for the kine.

verses.sa:
मा नो देवानां विशः प्रस्नातीरिवोस्राः ।
कृशं न हासुरघ्न्याः ॥
verses.rom:
ma no devanam vishah prasnatirivosrah |
krisham na hasuraghnyah ||
verses.en:
Let not the Companies of Gods fail us, like Dawns that float away,
Like cows who leave the niggardly.

verses.sa:
मा नः समस्य दूढ्यः परिद्वेषसो अंहतिः ।
ऊर्मिर्न नावमा वधीत् ॥
verses.rom:
ma nah samasya dudhyah paridveshaso amhatih |
urmirna navama vadhit ||
verses.en:
Let not the sinful tyranny of any fiercely hating foe
Smite us, as billows smite a ship.

verses.sa:
नमस्ते अग्न ओजसे गृणन्ति देव कृष्टयः ।
अमैरमित्रमर्दय ॥
verses.rom:
namaste agna ojase grinanti deva krishtayah |
amairamitramardaya ||
verses.en:
O Agni, God, the people sing reverent praise to thee for strength:
With terrors trouble thou the foe.

verses.sa:
कुवित्सु नो गविष्टयेऽग्ने संवेषिषो रयिम् ।
उरुकृदुरु णस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
kuvitsu no gavishtaye'gne samveshisho rayim |
urukriduru naskridhi ||
verses.en:
Wilt thou not, Agni, lend us aid in winning cattle, winning wealth?
Maker of room, make room for us.

verses.sa:
मा नो अस्मिन्महाधने परा वर्ग्भारभृद्यथा ।
संवर्गं सं रयिं जय ॥
verses.rom:
ma no asminmahadhane para vargbharabhridyatha |
samvargam sam rayim jaya ||
verses.en:
In this great battle cast us not aside as one who bears a load:
Snatch up the wealth and win it all.

verses.sa:
अन्यमस्मद्भिया इयमग्ने सिषक्तु दुच्छुना ।
वर्धा नो अमवच्छवः ॥
verses.rom:
anyamasmadbhiya iyamagne sishaktu duchchhuna |
vardha no amavachchhavah ||
verses.en:
O Agni, let this plague pursue and fright another and not us:
Make our impetuous strength more strong.

verses.sa:
यस्याजुषन्नमस्विनः शमीमदुर्मखस्य वा ।
तं घेदग्निर्वृधावति ॥
verses.rom:
yasyajushannamasvinah shamimadurmakhasya va |
tam ghedagnirvridhavati ||
verses.en:
The reverent or unwearied man whose holy labour he accepts,
Him Agni favours with success.

verses.sa:
परस्या अधि संवतोऽवराँ अभ्या तर ।
यत्राहमस्मि ताँ अव ॥
verses.rom:
parasya adhi samvato'varan abhya tara |
yatrahamasmi tan ava ||
verses.en:
Abandoning the foeman's host pass hither to this company:
Assist the men with whom I stand.

verses.sa:
विद्मा हि ते पुरा वयमग्ने पितुर्यथावसः ।
अधा ते सुम्नमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
vidma hi te pura vayamagne pituryathavasah |
adha te sumnamimahe ||
verses.en:
As we have known thy gracious help, as of a Father, long ago,
So now we pray to thee for bliss.

verses.sa:
इमं नु मायिनं हुव इन्द्रमीशानमोजसा ।
मरुत्वन्तं न वृञ्जसे ॥
verses.rom:
imam nu mayinam huva indramishanamojasa |
marutvantam na vrinjase ||
verses.en:
NOT to forsake me, I invoke this Indra girt by Maruts,
Lord Of magic power who rules with might.

verses.sa:
अयमिन्द्रो मरुत्सखा वि वृत्रस्याभिनच्छिरः ।
वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ॥
verses.rom:
ayamindro marutsakha vi vritrasyabhinachchhirah |
vajrena shataparvana ||
verses.en:
This Indra with his Marut Friends clave into pieces Vrtra's bead
With hundred-knotted thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
वावृधानो मरुत्सखेन्द्रो वि वृत्रमैरयत् ।
सृजन्समुद्रिया अपः ॥
verses.rom:
vavridhano marutsakhendro vi vritramairayat |
srijansamudriya apah ||
verses.en:
Indra, with Marut Friends grown strong, hath rent asunder Vrtra, and
Released the waters of the sea.

verses.sa:
अयं ह येन वा इदं स्वर्मरुत्वता जितम् ।
इन्द्रेण सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
ayam ha yena va idam svarmarutvata jitam |
indrena somapitaye ||
verses.en:
This is that Indra who, begirt by Maruts, won the light of heaven
That he might drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
मरुत्वन्तमृजीषिणमोजस्वन्तं विरप्शिनम् ।
इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
marutvantamrijishinamojasvantam virapshinam |
indram girbhirhavamahe ||
verses.en:
Mighty, impetuous, begirt by Maruts, him who loudly roars,
Indra we invocate with songs.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रं प्रत्नेन मन्मना मरुत्वन्तं हवामहे ।
अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
indram pratnena manmana marutvantam havamahe |
asya somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Indra begirt by Maruts we invoke after the ancient plan,
That he may drink the Soma juice.

verses.sa:
मरुत्वाँ इन्द्र मीढ्वः पिबा सोमं शतक्रतो ।
अस्मिन्यज्ञे पुरुष्टुत ॥
verses.rom:
marutvan indra midhvah piba somam shatakrato |
asminyajne purushtuta ||
verses.en:
O liberal Indra, Marut-girt, much-lauded Satakratu, drink
The Soma at this sacrifice.

verses.sa:
तुभ्येदिन्द्र मरुत्वते सुताः सोमासो अद्रिवः ।
हृदा हूयन्त उक्थिनः ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyedindra marutvate sutah somaso adrivah |
hrida huyanta ukthinah ||
verses.en:
To thee, O Indra, Marut-girt, these Soma juices, Thunderer!
Are offered from the heart with lauds.

verses.sa:
पिबेदिन्द्र मरुत्सखा सुतं सोमं दिविष्टिषु ।
वज्रं शिशान ओजसा ॥
verses.rom:
pibedindra marutsakha sutam somam divishtishu |
vajram shishana ojasa ||
verses.en:
Drink, Indra, with thy Marut Friends, pressed Soma at the morning rites,
Whetting thy thunderbolt with strength.

verses.sa:
उत्तिष्ठन्नोजसा सह पीत्वी शिप्रे अवेपयः ।
सोममिन्द्र चमू सुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
uttishthannojasa saha pitvi shipre avepayah |
somamindra chamu sutam ||
verses.en:
Arising in thy might, thy jaws thou shookest, Indra, having quaffed
The Soma which the mortar pressed.

verses.sa:
अनु त्वा रोदसी उभे क्रक्षमाणमकृपेताम् ।
इन्द्र यद्दस्युहाभवः ॥
verses.rom:
anu tva rodasi ubhe krakshamanamakripetam |
indra yaddasyuhabhavah ||
verses.en:
Indra, both worlds complained to thee when uttering thy fearful roar,
What time thou smotest Dasyus dead.

verses.sa:
वाचमष्टापदीमहं नवस्रक्तिमृतस्पृशम् ।
इन्द्रात्परि तन्वं ममे ॥
verses.rom:
vachamashtapadimaham navasraktimritasprisham |
indratpari tanvam mame ||
verses.en:
From Indra have I measured out a song eight-footed with nine parts,
Delicate, faithful. to the Law.

verses.sa:
जज्ञानो नु शतक्रतुर्वि पृच्छदिति मातरम् ।
क उग्राः के ह शृण्विरे ॥
verses.rom:
jajnano nu shatakraturvi prichchhaditi mataram |
ka ugrah ke ha shrinvire ||
verses.en:
SCARCELY was Satakratu, born when of his Mother he inquired,
Who are the mighty? Who are famed?

verses.sa:
आदीं शवस्यब्रवीदौर्णवाभमहीशुवम् ।
ते पुत्र सन्तु निष्टुरः ॥
verses.rom:
adim shavasyabravidaurnavabhamahishuvam |
te putra santu nishturah ||
verses.en:
Then Savassi declared to him Aurnavabha, Ahisuva:
Son, these be they thou must o'erthrow

verses.sa:
समित्तान्वृत्रहाखिदत्खे अराँ इव खेदया ।
प्रवृद्धो दस्युहाभवत् ॥
verses.rom:
samittanvritrahakhidatkhe aran iva khedaya |
pravriddho dasyuhabhavat ||
verses.en:
The Vrtra-slayer smote them all as spokes are hammered into naves:
The Dasyu-killer waxed in might.

verses.sa:
एकया प्रतिधापिबत्साकं सरांसि त्रिंशतम् ।
इन्द्रः सोमस्य काणुका ॥
verses.rom:
ekaya pratidhapibatsakam saramsi trimshatam |
indrah somasya kanuka ||
verses.en:
Then Indra at a single draught drank the contents of thirty pails,
Pails that were filled with Soma juice.

verses.sa:
अभि गन्धर्वमतृणदबुध्नेषु रजस्स्वा ।
इन्द्रो ब्रह्मभ्य इद्वृधे ॥
verses.rom:
abhi gandharvamatrinadabudhneshu rajassva |
indro brahmabhya idvridhe ||
verses.en:
Indra in groundless realms of space pierced the Gandharva through, that he
Might make Brahmans' strength increase.

verses.sa:
निराविध्यद्गिरिभ्य आ धारयत्पक्वमोदनम् ।
इन्द्रो बुन्दं स्वाततम् ॥
verses.rom:
niravidhyadgiribhya a dharayatpakvamodanam |
indro bundam svatatam ||
verses.en:
Down from the mountains Indra shot hither his well-directed shaft:
He gained the ready brew of rice.

verses.sa:
शतब्रध्न इषुस्तव सहस्रपर्ण एक इत् ।
यमिन्द्र चकृषे युजम् ॥
verses.rom:
shatabradhna ishustava sahasraparna eka it |
yamindra chakrishe yujam ||
verses.en:
One only is that shaft of thine, with thousand feathers, hundred barbs,
Which, Indra, thou hast made thy friend.

verses.sa:
तेन स्तोतृभ्य आ भर नृभ्यो नारिभ्यो अत्तवे ।
सद्यो जात ऋभुष्ठिर ॥
verses.rom:
tena stotribhya a bhara nribhyo naribhyo attave |
sadyo jata ribhushthira ||
verses.en:
Strong as the Gbhus at thy birth, therewith to those who praise thee, men,
And women, bring thou food to eat.

verses.sa:
एता च्यौत्नानि ते कृता वर्षिष्ठानि परीणसा ।
हृदा वीड्वधारयः ॥
verses.rom:
eta chyautnani te krita varshishthani parinasa |
hrida vidvadharayah ||
verses.en:
By thee these exploits were achieved, the mightiest deeds, abundantly:
Firm in thy heart thou settest them.

verses.sa:
विश्वेत्ता विष्णुराभरदुरुक्रमस्त्वेषितः ।
शतं महिषान्क्षीरपाकमोदनं वराहमिन्द्र एमुषम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishvetta vishnurabharadurukramastveshitah |
shatam mahishankshirapakamodanam varahamindra emusham ||
verses.en:
All these things Visnu brought, the Lord of ample stride whom thou hadst sent-
A hundred buffaloes, a brew of rice and milk: and Indra, slew the ravening boar

verses.sa:
तुविक्षं ते सुकृतं सूमयं धनुः साधुर्बुन्दो हिरण्ययः ।
उभा ते बाहू रण्या सुसंस्कृत ऋदूपे चिदृदूवृधा ॥
verses.rom:
tuviksham te sukritam sumayam dhanuh sadhurbundo hiranyayah |
ubha te bahu ranya susamskrita ridupe chidriduvridha ||
verses.en:
Most deadly is thy bow, successful, fashioned well: good is thine arrow, decked with gold.
Warlike and well equipped thine arms are, which increase sweetness for him who drinks the sweet.

verses.sa:
पुरोळाशं नो अन्धस इन्द्र सहस्रमा भर ।
शता च शूर गोनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
purolasham no andhasa indra sahasrama bhara |
shata cha shura gonam ||
verses.en:
BRING us a thousand, Indra, as our guerdon for the Soma juice:
Hundreds of kine, O Hero, bring.

verses.sa:
आ नो भर व्यञ्जनं गामश्वमभ्यञ्जनम् ।
सचा मना हिरण्यया ॥
verses.rom:
a no bhara vyanjanam gamashvamabhyanjanam |
sacha mana hiranyaya ||
verses.en:
Bring cattle, bring us ornament, bring us embellishment and steeds,
Give us, besides, two rings of gold.

verses.sa:
उत नः कर्णशोभना पुरूणि धृष्णवा भर ।
त्वं हि शृण्विषे वसो ॥
verses.rom:
uta nah karnashobhana puruni dhrishnava bhara |
tvam hi shrinvishe vaso ||
verses.en:
And, Bold One, bring in ample store rich jewels to adorn this ear,
For thou, Good Lord, art far renowned.

verses.sa:
नकीं वृधीक इन्द्र ते न सुषा न सुदा उत ।
नान्यस्त्वच्छूर वाघतः ॥
verses.rom:
nakim vridhika indra te na susha na suda uta |
nanyastvachchhura vaghatah ||
verses.en:
None other is there for the priest, Hero! but thou, to give him gifts,
To win much spoil and prosper him.

verses.sa:
नकीमिन्द्रो निकर्तवे न शक्रः परिशक्तवे ।
विश्वं शृणोति पश्यति ॥
verses.rom:
nakimindro nikartave na shakrah parishaktave |
vishvam shrinoti pashyati ||
verses.en:
Indra can never be brought low, Sakra can never be subdued:
He heareth and beholdeth all.

verses.sa:
स मन्युं मर्त्यानामदब्धो नि चिकीषते ।
पुरा निदश्चिकीषते ॥
verses.rom:
sa manyum martyanamadabdho ni chikishate |
pura nidashchikishate ||
verses.en:
He spieth out the wrath of man, he who can never be deceived:
Ere blame can come he marketh it.

verses.sa:
क्रत्व इत्पूर्णमुदरं तुरस्यास्ति विधतः ।
वृत्रघ्नः सोमपाव्नः ॥
verses.rom:
kratva itpurnamudaram turasyasti vidhatah |
vritraghnah somapavnah ||
verses.en:
He hath his stomach full of might, the Vrtra-slayer, Conqueror,
The Soma-drinker, ordering all.

verses.sa:
त्वे वसूनि संगता विश्वा च सोम सौभगा ।
सुदात्वपरिह्वृता ॥
verses.rom:
tve vasuni samgata vishva cha soma saubhaga |
sudatvaparihvrita ||
verses.en:
In thee all treasures are combined, Soma all blessed things in thee,
Uninjured, easy to bestow.

verses.sa:
त्वामिद्यवयुर्मम कामो गव्युर्हिरण्ययुः ।
त्वामश्वयुरेषते ॥
verses.rom:
tvamidyavayurmama kamo gavyurhiranyayuh |
tvamashvayureshate ||
verses.en:
To thee speeds forth my hope that craves the gift of corn, and kine and gold,
Yea, craving horses, speeds to thee.

verses.sa:
तवेदिन्द्राहमाशसा हस्ते दात्रं चना ददे ।
दिनस्य वा मघवन्सम्भृतस्य वा पूर्धि यवस्य काशिना ॥
verses.rom:
tavedindrahamashasa haste datram chana dade |
dinasya va maghavansambhritasya va purdhi yavasya kashina ||
verses.en:
Indra, through hope in thee alone even this sickle do I grasp.
Fill my hand, Maghavan, with all that it can hold of barley cut or gathered up.

verses.sa:
अयं कृत्नुरगृभीतो विश्वजिदुद्भिदित्सोमः ।
ऋषिर्विप्रः काव्येन ॥
verses.rom:
ayam kritnuragribhito vishvajidudbhiditsomah |
rishirviprah kavyena ||
verses.en:
THIS here is Soma, ne'er restrained, active, all-conquering bursting forth,
Rsi and Sage by sapience,

verses.sa:
अभ्यूर्णोति यन्नग्नं भिषक्ति विश्वं यत्तुरम् ।
प्रेमन्धः ख्यन्निः श्रोणो भूत् ॥
verses.rom:
abhyurnoti yannagnam bhishakti vishvam yatturam |
premandhah khyannih shrono bhut ||
verses.en:
All that is bare he covers o'er, all that is sick he medicines;
The blind man sees, the cripple walks.

verses.sa:
त्वं सोम तनूकृद्भ्यो द्वेषोभ्योऽन्यकृतेभ्यः ।
उरु यन्तासि वरूथम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam soma tanukridbhyo dveshobhyo'nyakritebhyah |
uru yantasi varutham ||
verses.en:
Thou, Soma, givest wide defense against the hate of alien men,
Hatreds that waste and weaken us.

verses.sa:
त्वं चित्ती तव दक्षैर्दिव आ पृथिव्या ऋजीषिन् ।
यावीरघस्य चिद्द्वेषः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam chitti tava dakshairdiva a prithivya rijishin |
yaviraghasya chiddveshah ||
verses.en:
Thou by thine insight and thy skill, Impetuous One, from heaven and earth
Drivest the sinner's enmity.

verses.sa:
अर्थिनो यन्ति चेदर्थं गच्छानिद्ददुषो रातिम् ।
ववृज्युस्तृष्यतः कामम् ॥
verses.rom:
arthino yanti chedartham gachchhaniddadusho ratim |
vavrijyustrishyatah kamam ||
verses.en:
When to their task they come with zeal, may they obtain the Giver's grace,
And satisfy his wish who thirsts.

verses.sa:
विदद्यत्पूर्व्यं नष्टमुदीमृतायुमीरयत् ।
प्रेमायुस्तारीदतीर्णम् ॥
verses.rom:
vidadyatpurvyam nashtamudimritayumirayat |
premayustaridatirnam ||
verses.en:
So may he find what erst was lost, so may be speed the pious man,
And lengthen his remaining life.

verses.sa:
सुशेवो नो मृळयाकुरदृप्तक्रतुरवातः ।
भवा नः सोम शं हृदे ॥
verses.rom:
sushevo no mrilayakuradriptakraturavatah |
bhava nah soma sham hride ||
verses.en:
Gracious, displaying tender love, unconquered, gentle in thy thoughts,
Be sweet, O Soma, to our heart.

verses.sa:
मा नः सोम सं वीविजो मा वि बीभिषथा राजन् ।
मा नो हार्दि त्विषा वधीः ॥
verses.rom:
ma nah soma sam vivijo ma vi bibhishatha rajan |
ma no hardi tvisha vadhih ||
verses.en:
O Soma, terrify us not; strike us not with alarm, O King:
Wound not our heart with dazzling flame.

verses.sa:
अव यत्स्वे सधस्थे देवानां दुर्मतीरीक्षे ।
राजन्नप द्विषः सेध मीढ्वो अप स्रिधः सेध ॥
verses.rom:
ava yatsve sadhasthe devanam durmatirikshe |
rajannapa dvishah sedha midhvo apa sridhah sedha ||
verses.en:
When in my dwelling-place I see the wicked enemies of Gods,
King, chase their hatred far away, thou Bounteous One, dispel our foes.

verses.sa:
नह्यन्यं बळाकरं मर्डितारं शतक्रतो ।
त्वं न इन्द्र मृळय ॥
verses.rom:
nahyanyam balakaram marditaram shatakrato |
tvam na indra mrilaya ||
verses.en:
O Sarakratu! truely I have made none else my Comforter.
Indra; be gracious unto us.

verses.sa:
यो नः शश्वत्पुराविथामृध्रो वाजसातये ।
स त्वं न इन्द्र मृळय ॥
verses.rom:
yo nah shashvatpuravithamridhro vajasataye |
sa tvam na indra mrilaya ||
verses.en:
Thou who hast ever aided us kindly of old to win the spoil,
As such, O Indra, favour us.

verses.sa:
किमङ्ग रध्रचोदनः सुन्वानस्यावितेदसि ।
कुवित्स्विन्द्र णः शकः ॥
verses.rom:
kimanga radhrachodanah sunvanasyavitedasi |
kuvitsvindra nah shakah ||
verses.en:
What now? As prompter of the poor thou helpest him who sheds the juice.
Wilt thou not, Indra, strengthen us?

verses.sa:
इन्द्र प्र णो रथमव पश्चाच्चित्सन्तमद्रिवः ।
पुरस्तादेनं मे कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
indra pra no rathamava pashchachchitsantamadrivah |
purastadenam me kridhi ||
verses.en:
O Indra, help our chariot on, yea, Thunderer, though it lag behind:
Give this my car the foremost place.

verses.sa:
हन्तो नु किमाससे प्रथमं नो रथं कृधि ।
उपमं वाजयु श्रवः ॥
verses.rom:
hanto nu kimasase prathamam no ratham kridhi |
upamam vajayu shravah ||
verses.en:
Ho there! why sittest thou at case? Make thou my chariot to be first
And bring the fame of victory near.

verses.sa:
अवा नो वाजयुं रथं सुकरं ते किमित्परि ।
अस्मान्सु जिग्युषस्कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
ava no vajayum ratham sukaram te kimitpari |
asmansu jigyushaskridhi ||
verses.en:
Assist our car that seeks the prize. What can be easier for thee?
So make thou us victorious.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र दृह्यस्व पूरसि भद्रा त एति निष्कृतम् ।
इयं धीरृत्वियावती ॥
verses.rom:
indra drihyasva purasi bhadra ta eti nishkritam |
iyam dhirritviyavati ||
verses.en:
Indra, be firm: a fort art thou. To thine appointed place proceeds
The auspicious hymn in season due.

verses.sa:
मा सीमवद्य आ भागुर्वी काष्ठा हितं धनम् ।
अपावृक्ता अरत्नयः ॥
verses.rom:
ma simavadya a bhagurvi kashtha hitam dhanam |
apavrikta aratnayah ||
verses.en:
Let not our portion be disgrace. Broad is the course, the prize is set,
The barriers are opened wide.

verses.sa:
तुरीयं नाम यज्ञियं यदा करस्तदुश्मसि ।
आदित्पतिर्न ओहसे ॥
verses.rom:
turiyam nama yajniyam yada karastadushmasi |
aditpatirna ohase ||
verses.en:
This thing we wish. that thou mayst take thy fourth, thy sacrificial name.
So art thou held to be our Lord.

verses.sa:
अवीवृधद्वो अमृता अमन्दीदेकद्यूर्देवा उत याश्च देवीः ।
तस्मा उ राधः कृणुत प्रशस्तं प्रातर्मक्षू धियावसुर्जगम्यात् ॥
verses.rom:
avivridhadvo amrita amandidekadyurdeva uta yashcha devih |
tasma u radhah krinuta prashastam pratarmakshu dhiyavasurjagamyat ||
verses.en:
Ekadyu hath exalted you, Immortals: both Goddesses and Gods hath he delighted.
Bestow upon him bounty meet for praises. May he, enriched with prayer, come soon and early.

verses.sa:
आ तू न इन्द्र क्षुमन्तं चित्रं ग्राभं सं गृभाय ।
महाहस्ती दक्षिणेन ॥
verses.rom:
a tu na indra kshumantam chitram grabham sam gribhaya |
mahahasti dakshinena ||
verses.en:
INDRA, God of the mighty arm, gather for us with thy right hand
Manifold and nutritious spoil.

verses.sa:
विद्मा हि त्वा तुविकूर्मिं तुविदेष्णं तुवीमघम् ।
तुविमात्रमवोभिः ॥
verses.rom:
vidma hi tva tuvikurmim tuvideshnam tuvimagham |
tuvimatramavobhih ||
verses.en:
We know thee mighty in thy deeds, of mighty bounty, mighty wealth,
Mighty in measure, prompt to aid.

verses.sa:
नहि त्वा शूर देवा न मर्तासो दित्सन्तम् ।
भीमं न गां वारयन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
nahi tva shura deva na martaso ditsantam |
bhimam na gam varayante ||
verses.en:
Hero, when thou art fain to give, neither may Gods nor mortal men
Restrain thee like a fearful Bull.

verses.sa:
एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवामेशानं वस्वः स्वराजम् ।
न राधसा मर्धिषन्नः ॥
verses.rom:
eto nvindram stavameshanam vasvah svarajam |
na radhasa mardhishannah ||
verses.en:
Come, let us glorify Indra, Lord supreme of wealth, Self-ruling King:
In bounty may he harm us not.

verses.sa:
प्र स्तोषदुप गासिषच्छ्रवत्साम गीयमानम् ।
अभि राधसा जुगुरत् ॥
verses.rom:
pra stoshadupa gasishachchhravatsama giyamanam |
abhi radhasa jugurat ||
verses.en:
Let prelude sound and following chant so let him hear the Saman sung,
And with his bounty answer us.

verses.sa:
आ नो भर दक्षिणेनाभि सव्येन प्र मृश ।
इन्द्र मा नो वसोर्निर्भाक् ॥
verses.rom:
a no bhara dakshinenabhi savyena pra mrisha |
indra ma no vasornirbhak ||
verses.en:
O Indra, with thy right hand bring, and with thy left remember us.
Let us not lose our share of wealth.

verses.sa:
उप क्रमस्वा भर धृषता धृष्णो जनानाम् ।
अदाशूष्टरस्य वेदः ॥
verses.rom:
upa kramasva bhara dhrishata dhrishno jananam |
adashushtarasya vedah ||
verses.en:
Come nigh, O Bold One, boldly bring hither the riches of the churl
Who giveth least of all the folk.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र य उ नु ते अस्ति वाजो विप्रेभिः सनित्वः ।
अस्माभिः सु तं सनुहि ॥
verses.rom:
indra ya u nu te asti vajo viprebhih sanitvah |
asmabhih su tam sanuhi ||
verses.en:
Indra, the booty which thou hast with holy singers to receive,
Even that booty win with us.

verses.sa:
सद्योजुवस्ते वाजा अस्मभ्यं विश्वश्चन्द्राः ।
वशैश्च मक्षू जरन्ते ॥
verses.rom:
sadyojuvaste vaja asmabhyam vishvashchandrah |
vashaishcha makshu jarante ||
verses.en:
Indra, thy swiftly-coming spoil, the booty which rejoices all,
Sounds quick in concert with our hopes.

verses.sa:
आ प्र द्रव परावतोऽर्वावतश्च वृत्रहन् ।
मध्वः प्रति प्रभर्मणि ॥
verses.rom:
a pra drava paravato'rvavatashcha vritrahan |
madhvah prati prabharmani ||
verses.en:
HASTE forward to us from afar, or, Vrtra-slayer, from anear,
To meet the offering to the meath.

verses.sa:
तीव्राः सोमास आ गहि सुतासो मादयिष्णवः ।
पिबा दधृग्यथोचिषे ॥
verses.rom:
tivrah somasa a gahi sutaso madayishnavah |
piba dadhrigyathochishe ||
verses.en:
Strong are the Soma-draughts; come nigh: the juices fill thee with delight:
Drink boldly even as thou art wont'.

verses.sa:
इषा मन्दस्वादु तेऽरं वराय मन्यवे ।
भुवत्त इन्द्र शं हृदे ॥
verses.rom:
isha mandasvadu te'ram varaya manyave |
bhuvatta indra sham hride ||
verses.en:
Joy, Indra, in the strengthening food et it content thy wish and thought,
And be delightful to thine heart.

verses.sa:
आ त्वशत्रवा गहि न्युक्थानि च हूयसे ।
उपमे रोचने दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
a tvashatrava gahi nyukthani cha huyase |
upame rochane divah ||
verses.en:
Come to us thou who hast no foe: we call thee down to hymns of praise,
In heaven's sublimest realm of light.

verses.sa:
तुभ्यायमद्रिभिः सुतो गोभिः श्रीतो मदाय कम् ।
प्र सोम इन्द्र हूयते ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyayamadribhih suto gobhih shrito madaya kam |
pra soma indra huyate ||
verses.en:
This Soma here expressed with stones and dressed with milk for thy carouse,
Indra, is offered up to thee.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र श्रुधि सु मे हवमस्मे सुतस्य गोमतः ।
वि पीतिं तृप्तिमश्नुहि ॥
verses.rom:
indra shrudhi su me havamasme sutasya gomatah |
vi pitim triptimashnuhi ||
verses.en:
Graciously, Indra, hear my call. Come and obtain the draught, and sate
Thyself with juices blent with milk.

verses.sa:
य इन्द्र चमसेष्वा सोमश्चमूषु ते सुतः ।
पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे ॥
verses.rom:
ya indra chamaseshva somashchamushu te sutah |
pibedasya tvamishishe ||
verses.en:
The Soma, Indra, which is shed in chalices and vats for thee,
Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof.

verses.sa:
यो अप्सु चन्द्रमा इव सोमश्चमूषु ददृशे ।
पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे ॥
verses.rom:
yo apsu chandrama iva somashchamushu dadrishe |
pibedasya tvamishishe ||
verses.en:
The Soma seen within the mats, as in the flood the Moon is seen,
Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof.

verses.sa:
यं ते श्येनः पदाभरत्तिरो रजांस्यस्पृतम् ।
पिबेदस्य त्वमीशिषे ॥
verses.rom:
yam te shyenah padabharattiro rajamsyaspritam |
pibedasya tvamishishe ||
verses.en:
That which the Hawk brought in his claw, inviolate, through the air to thee,
Drink thou, for thou art Lord thereof.

verses.sa:
देवानामिदवो महत्तदा वृणीमहे वयम् ।
वृष्णामस्मभ्यमूतये ॥
verses.rom:
devanamidavo mahattada vrinimahe vayam |
vrishnamasmabhyamutaye ||
verses.en:
WE choose unto ourselves that high protection of the Mighty Gods
That it may help and succour us.

verses.sa:
ते नः सन्तु युजः सदा वरुणो मित्रो अर्यमा ।
वृधासश्च प्रचेतसः ॥
verses.rom:
te nah santu yujah sada varuno mitro aryama |
vridhasashcha prachetasah ||
verses.en:
May they be ever our allies, Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman,
Far-seeing Gods who prosper us.

verses.sa:
अति नो विष्पिता पुरु नौभिरपो न पर्षथ ।
यूयमृतस्य रथ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
ati no vishpita puru naubhirapo na parshatha |
yuyamritasya rathyah ||
verses.en:
Ye furtherers of holy Law, transport us safe o'er many woes,
As over water-floods in ships.

verses.sa:
वामं नो अस्त्वर्यमन्वामं वरुण शंस्यम् ।
वामं ह्यावृणीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
vamam no astvaryamanvamam varuna shamsyam |
vamam hyavrinimahe ||
verses.en:
Dear wealth be Aryaman to us, Varuna dear wealth meet for praise:
Dear wealth we choose unto ourselves.

verses.sa:
वामस्य हि प्रचेतस ईशानाशो रिशादसः ।
नेमादित्या अघस्य यत् ॥
verses.rom:
vamasya hi prachetasa ishanasho rishadasah |
nemaditya aghasya yat ||
verses.en:
For Sovrans of dear wealth are ye, Adityas, not of sinner's wealth,
Ye sapient Gods who slay the foe.

verses.sa:
वयमिद्वः सुदानवः क्षियन्तो यान्तो अध्वन्ना ।
देवा वृधाय हूमहे ॥
verses.rom:
vayamidvah sudanavah kshiyanto yanto adhvanna |
deva vridhaya humahe ||
verses.en:
We in our homes, ye Baunteous Ones, and while we journey on the road,
Invoke you, Gods, to prosper us.

verses.sa:
अधि न इन्द्रैषां विष्णो सजात्यानाम् ।
इता मरुतो अश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
adhi na indraisham vishno sajatyanam |
ita maruto ashvina ||
verses.en:
Regard us, Indra, Visnu, here, ye Asvins and the Marut host,
Us who are kith and kin to you.

verses.sa:
प्र भ्रातृत्वं सुदानवोऽध द्विता समान्या ।
मातुर्गर्भे भरामहे ॥
verses.rom:
pra bhratritvam sudanavo'dha dvita samanya |
maturgarbhe bharamahe ||
verses.en:
Ye Bounteous Ones, from time of old we here set forth our brotherhood,
Our kinship in. the Mother's womb.

verses.sa:
यूयं हि ष्ठा सुदानव इन्द्रज्येष्ठा अभिद्यवः ।
अधा चिद्व उत ब्रुवे ॥
verses.rom:
yuyam hi shtha sudanava indrajyeshtha abhidyavah |
adha chidva uta bruve ||
verses.en:
Then come with Indra for your chief, as early day, ye Bounteous Gods
Yea, 1 address you now for this.

verses.sa:
प्रेष्ठं वो अतिथिं स्तुषे मित्रमिव प्रियम् ।
अग्निं रथं न वेद्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
preshtham vo atithim stushe mitramiva priyam |
agnim ratham na vedyam ||
verses.en:
AGNI, your dearest Guest, I laud, him who is loving as a friend,
Who brings us riches like a car.

verses.sa:
कविमिव प्रचेतसं यं देवासो अध द्विता ।
नि मर्त्येष्वादधुः ॥
verses.rom:
kavimiva prachetasam yam devaso adha dvita |
ni martyeshvadadhuh ||
verses.en:
Whom as a far-foreseeing Sage the Gods have, from the olden time,
Established among mortal men.

verses.sa:
त्वं यविष्ठ दाशुषो नॄँः पाहि शृणुधी गिरः ।
रक्षा तोकमुत त्मना ॥
verses.rom:
tvam yavishtha dashusho nrinh pahi shrinudhi girah |
raksha tokamuta tmana ||
verses.en:
Do thou, Most Youthful God, protect the men who offer, hear their songs,
And of thyself preserve their seed.

verses.sa:
कया ते अग्ने अङ्गिर ऊर्जो नपादुपस्तुतिम् ।
वराय देव मन्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
kaya te agne angira urjo napadupastutim |
varaya deva manyave ||
verses.en:
What is the praise wherewith, O God, Aigiras, Agni, Son of Strength,
We, after thine own wish and thought,

verses.sa:
दाशेम कस्य मनसा यज्ञस्य सहसो यहो ।
कदु वोच इदं नमः ॥
verses.rom:
dashema kasya manasa yajnasya sahaso yaho |
kadu vocha idam namah ||
verses.en:
May serve thee, O thou Child of Power, and with what sacrifice's plan?
What prayer shall I now speak to thee?

verses.sa:
अधा त्वं हि नस्करो विश्वा अस्मभ्यं सुक्षितीः ।
वाजद्रविणसो गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
adha tvam hi naskaro vishva asmabhyam sukshitih |
vajadravinaso girah ||
verses.en:
Our God, make all of us to dwell in happy habitations, and
Reward our songs with spoil and wealth.

verses.sa:
कस्य नूनं परीणसो धियो जिन्वसि दम्पते ।
गोषाता यस्य ते गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
kasya nunam parinaso dhiyo jinvasi dampate |
goshata yasya te girah ||
verses.en:
Lord of the house, what plenty fills the songs which thou inspirest now,
Thou whose hymn helps to win the kine?

verses.sa:
तं मर्जयन्त सुक्रतुं पुरोयावानमाजिषु ।
स्वेषु क्षयेषु वाजिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam marjayanta sukratum puroyavanamajishu |
sveshu kshayeshu vajinam ||
verses.en:
Him Wise and Strong they glorify, the foremost Champion in the fray,
And mighty in his dwelling-place.

verses.sa:
क्षेति क्षेमेभिः साधुभिर्नकिर्यं घ्नन्ति हन्ति यः ।
अग्ने सुवीर एधते ॥
verses.rom:
ksheti kshemebhih sadhubhirnakiryam ghnanti hanti yah |
agne suvira edhate ||
verses.en:
Agni, he dwells in rest and peace who smites and no one smites again:
With hero sons he prospers well

verses.sa:
आ मे हवं नासत्याश्विना गच्छतं युवम् ।
मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
a me havam nasatyashvina gachchhatam yuvam |
madhvah somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
To this mine invocation, O ye Asvins, ye Nasatyas, come,
To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa:
इमं मे स्तोममश्विनेमं मे शृणुतं हवम् ।
मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
imam me stomamashvinemam me shrinutam havam |
madhvah somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
This laud of mine, ye Asvins Twain, and this mine invitation hear,
To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa:
अयं वां कृष्णो अश्विना हवते वाजिनीवसू ।
मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vam krishno ashvina havate vajinivasu |
madhvah somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Here Krsna is invoking you, O Asvins, Lords of ample wealth.
To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa:
शृणुतं जरितुर्हवं कृष्णस्य स्तुवतो नरा ।
मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
shrinutam jariturhavam krishnasya stuvato nara |
madhvah somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
List, Heroes, to the singer's call, the call of Krsna lauding you,
To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa:
छर्दिर्यन्तमदाभ्यं विप्राय स्तुवते नरा ।
मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
chhardiryantamadabhyam vipraya stuvate nara |
madhvah somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Chiefs, to the sage who sings your praise grant an inviolable home,
To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa:
गच्छतं दाशुषो गृहमित्था स्तुवतो अश्विना ।
मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
gachchhatam dashusho grihamittha stuvato ashvina |
madhvah somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Come to the worshipper's abode, Asvins, who here is lauding you,
To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa:
युञ्जाथां रासभं रथे वीड्वङ्गे वृषण्वसू ।
मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
yunjatham rasabham rathe vidvange vrishanvasu |
madhvah somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Yoke to the firmly jointed car the ass which draws you, Lords of wealth.
To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa:
त्रिवन्धुरेण त्रिवृता रथेना यातमश्विना ।
मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
trivandhurena trivrita rathena yatamashvina |
madhvah somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
Come hither, Asvins, on your car of triple form with triple seat,
To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa:
नू मे गिरो नासत्याश्विना प्रावतं युवम् ।
मध्वः सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
nu me giro nasatyashvina pravatam yuvam |
madhvah somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
O Asvins, O Nasatyas, now accept with favouring grace my songs,
To drink the savoury Soma juice.

verses.sa:
उभा हि दस्रा भिषजा मयोभुवोभा दक्षस्य वचसो बभूवथुः ।
ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ubha hi dasra bhishaja mayobhuvobha dakshasya vachaso babhuvathuh |
ta vam vishvako havate tanukrithe ma no vi yaushtam sakhya mumochatam ||
verses.en:
YE Twain are wondrous strong, well-skilled in arts that heal, both bringers of delight, ye both won Daksa's praise.
Visvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.

verses.sa:
कथा नूनं वां विमना उप स्तवद्युवं धियं ददथुर्वस्यइष्टये ।
ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
verses.rom:
katha nunam vam vimana upa stavadyuvam dhiyam dadathurvasyaishtaye |
ta vam vishvako havate tanukrithe ma no vi yaushtam sakhya mumochatam ||
verses.en:
How shall he praise you now who is distraught in mind? Ye Twain give wisdom for the gainof what is good.
Visvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.

verses.sa:
युवं हि ष्मा पुरुभुजेममेधतुं विष्णाप्वे ददथुर्वस्यइष्टये ।
ता वां विश्वको हवते तनूकृथे मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yuvam hi shma purubhujemamedhatum vishnapve dadathurvasyaishtaye |
ta vam vishvako havate tanukrithe ma no vi yaushtam sakhya mumochatam ||
verses.en:
Already have ye Twain, possessors of great wealth, prospered Visnapu thus for gain of what is good.
Visvaka calls on you as such to save his life. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.

verses.sa:
उत त्यं वीरं धनसामृजीषिणं दूरे चित्सन्तमवसे हवामहे ।
यस्य स्वादिष्ठा सुमतिः पितुर्यथा मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
verses.rom:
uta tyam viram dhanasamrijishinam dure chitsantamavase havamahe |
yasya svadishtha sumatih pituryatha ma no vi yaushtam sakhya mumochatam ||
verses.en:
And that Impetuous Hero, winner of the spoil, though he is far away, we call to succour us,
