Whose gracious favour, like a father's, is most sweet. Break ye not off our friendship, come and set me free.

verses.sa:
ऋतेन देवः सविता शमायत ऋतस्य शृङ्गमुर्विया वि पप्रथे ।
ऋतं सासाह महि चित्पृतन्यतो मा नो वि यौष्टं सख्या मुमोचतम् ॥
verses.rom:
ritena devah savita shamayata ritasya shringamurviya vi paprathe |
ritam sasaha mahi chitpritanyato ma no vi yaushtam sakhya mumochatam ||
verses.en:
About the holy Law toils Savitar the God the horn of holy Law hath he spread far and wide.
The holy Law hath quelled even mighty men of war. Break ye not off our ftiendship, come and act me free.

verses.sa:
द्युम्नी वां स्तोमो अश्विना क्रिविर्न सेक आ गतम् ।
मध्वः सुतस्य स दिवि प्रियो नरा पातं गौराविवेरिणे ॥
verses.rom:
dyumni vam stomo ashvina krivirna seka a gatam |
madhvah sutasya sa divi priyo nara patam gauraviverine ||
verses.en:
SPLENDID, O Asvins, is your praise. Come fountain-like, to pour the stream.
Of the sweet juice effused-dear is it, Chiefs, in heaven-drink like two wild bulls at a pool.

verses.sa:
पिबतं घर्मं मधुमन्तमश्विना बर्हिः सीदतं नरा ।
ता मन्दसाना मनुषो दुरोण आ नि पातं वेदसा वयः ॥
verses.rom:
pibatam gharmam madhumantamashvina barhih sidatam nara |
ta mandasana manusho durona a ni patam vedasa vayah ||
verses.en:
Drink the libation rich in sweets, O Asvins Twain: sit. Heroes, on the sacred grass.
Do ye with joyful heart in the abode of man preserve his life by means of wealth.

verses.sa:
आ वां विश्वाभिरूतिभिः प्रियमेधा अहूषत ।
ता वर्तिर्यातमुप वृक्तबर्हिषो जुष्टं यज्ञं दिविष्टिषु ॥
verses.rom:
a vam vishvabhirutibhih priyamedha ahushata |
ta vartiryatamupa vriktabarhisho jushtam yajnam divishtishu ||
verses.en:
The Priyamedhas bid you come with all the succours that are yours.
Come to his house whose holy grass is trimmed, to dear sacrifice at the morning rites.

verses.sa:
पिबतं सोमं मधुमन्तमश्विना बर्हिः सीदतं सुमत् ।
ता वावृधाना उप सुष्टुतिं दिवो गन्तं गौराविवेरिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
pibatam somam madhumantamashvina barhih sidatam sumat |
ta vavridhana upa sushtutim divo gantam gauraviverinam ||
verses.en:
Drink ye the Soma rich in meath, ye Asvins Twain: sit gladly on the sacred grass.
So, waxen mighty, to our eulogy from heaven come ye as wild-bulls to the pool.

verses.sa:
आ नूनं यातमश्विनाश्वेभिः प्रुषितप्सुभिः ।
दस्रा हिरण्यवर्तनी शुभस्पती पातं सोममृतावृधा ॥
verses.rom:
a nunam yatamashvinashvebhih prushitapsubhih |
dasra hiranyavartani shubhaspati patam somamritavridha ||
verses.en:
Come to us, O ye Asvins, now with steeds of many a varied hue,
Ye Lords of splendour, wondrous, borne on paths of gold, drink Soma, ye who strengthen Law.

verses.sa:
वयं हि वां हवामहे विपन्यवो विप्रासो वाजसातये ।
ता वल्गू दस्रा पुरुदंससा धियाश्विना श्रुष्ट्या गतम् ॥
verses.rom:
vayam hi vam havamahe vipanyavo vipraso vajasataye |
ta valgu dasra purudamsasa dhiyashvina shrushtya gatam ||
verses.en:
For we the priestly singers, fain to hymn your praise, invoke you for the gain of strength.
So, wondrous, fair, and famed for great deeds come to us, through our hymn, Asvins, when ye hear.

verses.sa:
तं वो दस्ममृतीषहं वसोर्मन्दानमन्धसः ।
अभि वत्सं न स्वसरेषु धेनव इन्द्रं गीर्भिर्नवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
tam vo dasmamritishaham vasormandanamandhasah |
abhi vatsam na svasareshu dhenava indram girbhirnavamahe ||
verses.en:
As cows low to their calves in stalls, so with our songs we glorify
This Indra, even your Wondrous God who checks attack, who joys in the delicious juice.

verses.sa:
द्युक्षं सुदानुं तविषीभिरावृतं गिरिं न पुरुभोजसम् ।
क्षुमन्तं वाजं शतिनं सहस्रिणं मक्षू गोमन्तमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
dyuksham sudanum tavishibhiravritam girim na purubhojasam |
kshumantam vajam shatinam sahasrinam makshu gomantamimahe ||
verses.en:
Celestial, bounteous Giver, girt about with might, rich, mountain-like, in precious things,
Him swift we seek. for foodful booty rich in kine, brought hundredfold and thousandfold.

verses.sa:
न त्वा बृहन्तो अद्रयो वरन्त इन्द्र वीळवः ।
यद्दित्ससि स्तुवते मावते वसु नकिष्टदा मिनाति ते ॥
verses.rom:
na tva brihanto adrayo varanta indra vilavah |
yadditsasi stuvate mavate vasu nakishtada minati te ||
verses.en:
Indra, the strong and lofty hills are powerless to bar thy way.
None stay that act of thine when thou wouldst fain give wealth to one like me who sings thy praise.

verses.sa:
योद्धासि क्रत्वा शवसोत दंसना विश्वा जाताभि मज्मना ।
आ त्वायमर्क ऊतये ववर्तति यं गोतमा अजीजनन् ॥
verses.rom:
yoddhasi kratva shavasota damsana vishva jatabhi majmana |
a tvayamarka utaye vavartati yam gotama ajijanan ||
verses.en:
A Warrior thou by strength, wisdom, and wondrous deed, in might excellest all that is.
Hither may this our hymn attract thee to our help, the hymn which Gotamas have made.

verses.sa:
प्र हि रिरिक्ष ओजसा दिवो अन्तेभ्यस्परि ।
न त्वा विव्याच रज इन्द्र पार्थिवमनु स्वधां ववक्षिथ ॥
verses.rom:
pra hi ririksha ojasa divo antebhyaspari |
na tva vivyacha raja indra parthivamanu svadham vavakshitha ||
verses.en:
For in thy might thou stretchest out beyond the boundaries of heaven.
The earthly region, Indra, comprehends thee not. After thy Godhead hast thou waxed.

verses.sa:
नकिः परिष्टिर्मघवन्मघस्य ते यद्दाशुषे दशस्यसि ।
अस्माकं बोध्युचथस्य चोदिता मंहिष्ठो वाजसातये ॥
verses.rom:
nakih parishtirmaghavanmaghasya te yaddashushe dashasyasi |
asmakam bodhyuchathasya chodita mamhishtho vajasataye ||
verses.en:
When, Maghavan, thou honourest the worshipper, no one is there to stay thy wealth.
Most liberal Giver thou, do thou inspire our song of praise, that we may win the spoil.

verses.sa:
बृहदिन्द्राय गायत मरुतो वृत्रहन्तमम् ।
येन ज्योतिरजनयन्नृतावृधो देवं देवाय जागृवि ॥
verses.rom:
brihadindraya gayata maruto vritrahantamam |
yena jyotirajanayannritavridho devam devaya jagrivi ||
verses.en:
To Indra sing the lofty hymn, Maruts that slays the Vrtras best.
Whereby the Holy Ones created for the God the light divine that ever wakes.

verses.sa:
अपाधमदभिशस्तीरशस्तिहाथेन्द्रो द्युम्न्याभवत् ।
देवास्त इन्द्र सख्याय येमिरे बृहद्भानो मरुद्गण ॥
verses.rom:
apadhamadabhishastirashastihathendro dyumnyabhavat |
devasta indra sakhyaya yemire brihadbhano marudgana ||
verses.en:
Indra who quells the curse blew curses far away, and then in splendour came to us.
Indra, refulgent with thy Marut host! the Gods strove eagerly to win thy love.

verses.sa:
प्र व इन्द्राय बृहते मरुतो ब्रह्मार्चत ।
वृत्रं हनति वृत्रहा शतक्रतुर्वज्रेण शतपर्वणा ॥
verses.rom:
pra va indraya brihate maruto brahmarchata |
vritram hanati vritraha shatakraturvajrena shataparvana ||
verses.en:
Sing to your lofty Indra, sing, Maruts, a holy hymn of praise.
Let Satakratu, Vrtra-slayer, kill the foe with hundred-knotted thunderbolt.

verses.sa:
अभि प्र भर धृषता धृषन्मनः श्रवश्चित्ते असद्बृहत् ।
अर्षन्त्वापो जवसा वि मातरो हनो वृत्रं जया स्वः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi pra bhara dhrishata dhrishanmanah shravashchitte asadbrihat |
arshantvapo javasa vi mataro hano vritram jaya svah ||
verses.en:
Aim and fetch boldly forth, O thou whose heart is bold: great glory will be thine thereby.
In rapid torrent let the mother waters spread. Slay Vrtra, win the light of heaven.

verses.sa:
यज्जायथा अपूर्व्य मघवन्वृत्रहत्याय ।
तत्पृथिवीमप्रथयस्तदस्तभ्ना उत द्याम् ॥
verses.rom:
yajjayatha apurvya maghavanvritrahatyaya |
tatprithivimaprathayastadastabhna uta dyam ||
verses.en:
When thou, unequalled Maghavan, wast born to smite the Vrtras dead,
Thou spreadest out the spacious earth and didst support and prop the heavens.

verses.sa:
तत्ते यज्ञो अजायत तदर्क उत हस्कृतिः ।
तद्विश्वमभिभूरसि यज्जातं यच्च जन्त्वम् ॥
verses.rom:
tatte yajno ajayata tadarka uta haskritih |
tadvishvamabhibhurasi yajjatam yachcha jantvam ||
verses.en:
There was the sacrifice produced for thee, the laud, and song of joy,
Thou in thy might surpassest all, all that now is and yet shall be.

verses.sa:
आमासु पक्वमैरय आ सूर्यं रोहयो दिवि ।
घर्मं न सामन्तपता सुवृक्तिभिर्जुष्टं गिर्वणसे बृहत् ॥
verses.rom:
amasu pakvamairaya a suryam rohayo divi |
gharmam na samantapata suvriktibhirjushtam girvanase brihat ||
verses.en:
Raw kine thou filledst with ripe milk. Thou madest Surya rise to heaven.,
Heat him as milk is heated with pure Sama hymns, great joy to him who loves the song.

verses.sa:
आ नो विश्वासु हव्य इन्द्रः समत्सु भूषतु ।
उप ब्रह्माणि सवनानि वृत्रहा परमज्या ऋचीषमः ॥
verses.rom:
a no vishvasu havya indrah samatsu bhushatu |
upa brahmani savanani vritraha paramajya richishamah ||
verses.en:
MAY Indra, who in every fight must be invoked, be near to us.
May the most mighty Vrtra-slayer, meet for praise, come to libations and to hymns.

verses.sa:
त्वं दाता प्रथमो राधसामस्यसि सत्य ईशानकृत् ।
तुविद्युम्नस्य युज्या वृणीमहे पुत्रस्य शवसो महः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam data prathamo radhasamasyasi satya ishanakrit |
tuvidyumnasya yujya vrinimahe putrasya shavaso mahah ||
verses.en:
Thou art the best of all in sending bounteous gifts, true art thou, lordly in thine act.
We claim alliance with the very Glorious One, yea, with the Mighty Son of Strength.

verses.sa:
ब्रह्मा त इन्द्र गिर्वणः क्रियन्ते अनतिद्भुता ।
इमा जुषस्व हर्यश्व योजनेन्द्र या ते अमन्महि ॥
verses.rom:
brahma ta indra girvanah kriyante anatidbhuta |
ima jushasva haryashva yojanendra ya te amanmahi ||
verses.en:
Prayers unsurpassed are offered up to thee the Lover of the Song.
Indra, Lord of Bay Steeds, accept these fitting hymns, hymns which we have thought out for thee.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि सत्यो मघवन्ननानतो वृत्रा भूरि न्यृञ्जसे ।
स त्वं शविष्ठ वज्रहस्त दाशुषेऽर्वाञ्चं रयिमा कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi satyo maghavannananato vritra bhuri nyrinjase |
sa tvam shavishtha vajrahasta dashushe'rvancham rayima kridhi ||
verses.en:
For thou, O Maghavan, art truthful, ne'er subdued and bringest many a Vrtra low.
As such, O Mightiest Lord, Wielder of Thunder, send wealth hither to the worshipper.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्र यशा अस्यृजीषी शवसस्पते ।
त्वं वृत्राणि हंस्यप्रतीन्येक इदनुत्ता चर्षणीधृता ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindra yasha asyrijishi shavasaspate |
tvam vritrani hamsyapratinyeka idanutta charshanidhrita ||
verses.en:
O Indra, thou art far-renowned, impetuous, O Lord of Strength.
Alone thou slayest with the guardian of mankind resistless never-conquered foes.

verses.sa:
तमु त्वा नूनमसुर प्रचेतसं राधो भागमिवेमहे ।
महीव कृत्तिः शरणा त इन्द्र प्र ते सुम्ना नो अश्नवन् ॥
verses.rom:
tamu tva nunamasura prachetasam radho bhagamivemahe |
mahiva krittih sharana ta indra pra te sumna no ashnavan ||
verses.en:
As such we seek thee now, O Asura, thee most wise, craving thy bounty as our share.
Thy sheltering defense is like a mighty cloak. So may thy glories reach to us.

verses.sa:
कन्या वारवायती सोममपि स्रुताविदत् ।
अस्तं भरन्त्यब्रवीदिन्द्राय सुनवै त्वा शक्राय सुनवै त्वा ॥
verses.rom:
kanya varavayati somamapi srutavidat |
astam bharantyabravidindraya sunavai tva shakraya sunavai tva ||
verses.en:
DOWN to the stream a maiden came, and found the Soma by the way.
Bearing it to her home she said, For Indra will I press thee out, for Sakra will I press thee out.

verses.sa:
असौ य एषि वीरको गृहंगृहं विचाकशद् ।
इमं जम्भसुतं पिब धानावन्तं करम्भिणमपूपवन्तमुक्थिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
asau ya eshi virako grihamgriham vichakashad |
imam jambhasutam piba dhanavantam karambhinamapupavantamukthinam ||
verses.en:
Thou roaming yonder, little man, beholding every house in turn,
Drink thou this Soma pressed with teeth, accompanied with grain and curds, with cake of meal and song of praise.

verses.sa:
आ चन त्वा चिकित्सामोऽधि चन त्वा नेमसि ।
शनैरिव शनकैरिवेन्द्रायेन्दो परि स्रव ॥
verses.rom:
a chana tva chikitsamo'dhi chana tva nemasi |
shanairiva shanakairivendrayendo pari srava ||
verses.en:
Fain would we learn to know thee well, nor yet can we attain to thee.
Still slowly and in gradual drops, O Indu, unto Indra flow.

verses.sa:
कुविच्छकत्कुवित्करत्कुविन्नो वस्यसस्करत् ।
कुवित्पतिद्विषो यतीरिन्द्रेण संगमामहै ॥
verses.rom:
kuvichchhakatkuvitkaratkuvinno vasyasaskarat |
kuvitpatidvisho yatirindrena samgamamahai ||
verses.en:
Will he not help and work for us? Will he not make us wealthier?
Shall we not, hostile to our lord, unite ourselves to Indra now?

verses.sa:
इमानि त्रीणि विष्टपा तानीन्द्र वि रोहय ।
शिरस्ततस्योर्वरामादिदं म उपोदरे ॥
verses.rom:
imani trini vishtapa tanindra vi rohaya |
shirastatasyorvaramadidam ma upodare ||
verses.en:
O Indra, cause to sprout again three places, these which I declare,-
My father's head, his cultured field, and this the part below my waist.

verses.sa:
असौ च या न उर्वरादिमां तन्वं मम ।
अथो ततस्य यच्छिरः सर्वा ता रोमशा कृधि ॥
verses.rom:
asau cha ya na urvaradimam tanvam mama |
atho tatasya yachchhirah sarva ta romasha kridhi ||
verses.en:
Make all of these grow crops of hair, you cultivated field of ours,
My body, and my father's head.

verses.sa:
खे रथस्य खेऽनसः खे युगस्य शतक्रतो ।
अपालामिन्द्र त्रिष्पूत्व्यकृणोः सूर्यत्वचम् ॥
verses.rom:
khe rathasya khe'nasah khe yugasya shatakrato |
apalamindra trishputvyakrinoh suryatvacham ||
verses.en:
Cleansing Apala, Indra! thrice, thou gavest sunlike skin to her,
Drawn, Satakratu! through the hole of car, of wagon, and of yoke.

verses.sa:
पान्तमा वो अन्धस इन्द्रमभि प्र गायत ।
विश्वासाहं शतक्रतुं मंहिष्ठं चर्षणीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
pantama vo andhasa indramabhi pra gayata |
vishvasaham shatakratum mamhishtham charshaninam ||
verses.en:
INVITE ye Indra with a song to drink your draught of Soma juice,
All-conquering Satakratu, most munificent of all who live.

verses.sa:
पुरुहूतं पुरुष्टुतं गाथान्यं सनश्रुतम् ।
इन्द्र इति ब्रवीतन ॥
verses.rom:
puruhutam purushtutam gathanyam sanashrutam |
indra iti bravitana ||
verses.en:
Lauded by many, much-invoked, leader of song, renowned of old:
His name is Indra, tell it forth.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र इन्नो महानां दाता वाजानां नृतुः ।
महाँ अभिज्ञ्वा यमत् ॥
verses.rom:
indra inno mahanam data vajanam nrituh |
mahan abhijnva yamat ||
verses.en:
Indra the Dancer be to us the giver of abundant strength:
May he, the mighty, bring it near.

verses.sa:
अपादु शिप्र्यन्धसः सुदक्षस्य प्रहोषिणः ।
इन्दोरिन्द्रो यवाशिरः ॥
verses.rom:
apadu shipryandhasah sudakshasya prahoshinah |
indorindro yavashirah ||
verses.en:
Indra whose jaws are strong hath drunk of worshipping Sudaksa's draught,
The Soma juice with barley mixt.

verses.sa:
तम्वभि प्रार्चतेन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ।
तदिद्ध्यस्य वर्धनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tamvabhi prarchatendram somasya pitaye |
tadiddhyasya vardhanam ||
verses.en:
Call Indra loudly with your songs of praise to drink the Soma juice.
For this is what augments his strength.

verses.sa:
अस्य पीत्वा मदानां देवो देवस्यौजसा ।
विश्वाभि भुवना भुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
asya pitva madanam devo devasyaujasa |
vishvabhi bhuvana bhuvat ||
verses.en:
When he hath drank its gladdening drops, the God with vigour of a God
Hath far surpassed all things that are.

verses.sa:
त्यमु वः सत्रासाहं विश्वासु गीर्ष्वायतम् ।
आ च्यावयस्यूतये ॥
verses.rom:
tyamu vah satrasaham vishvasu girshvayatam |
a chyavayasyutaye ||
verses.en:
Thou speedest down to succour us this ever-conquering God of yours,
Him who is drawn to all our songs

verses.sa:
युध्मं सन्तमनर्वाणं सोमपामनपच्युतम् ।
नरमवार्यक्रतुम् ॥
verses.rom:
yudhmam santamanarvanam somapamanapachyutam |
naramavaryakratum ||
verses.en:
The Warrior not to he restrained, the Soma-drinker ne'er o'erthrown,
The Chieftain of resistless might.

verses.sa:
शिक्षा ण इन्द्र राय आ पुरु विद्वाँ ऋचीषम ।
अवा नः पार्ये धने ॥
verses.rom:
shiksha na indra raya a puru vidvan richishama |
ava nah parye dhane ||
verses.en:
O Indra, send us riches, thou Omniscient, worthy of our praise:
Help us in the decisive fray.

verses.sa:
अतश्चिदिन्द्र ण उपा याहि शतवाजया ।
इषा सहस्रवाजया ॥
verses.rom:
atashchidindra na upa yahi shatavajaya |
isha sahasravajaya ||
verses.en:
Even thence, O 1ndra, come to us with food that gives a hundred powers,
With food that gives a thousand powers.

verses.sa:
अयाम धीवतो धियोऽर्वद्भिः शक्र गोदरे ।
जयेम पृत्सु वज्रिवः ॥
verses.rom:
ayama dhivato dhiyo'rvadbhih shakra godare |
jayema pritsu vajrivah ||
verses.en:
We sought the wisdom of the wise. Sakra, Kine-giver, Thunder-armed!
May we with steeds o'ercome in fight.

verses.sa:
वयमु त्वा शतक्रतो गावो न यवसेष्वा ।
उक्थेषु रणयामसि ॥
verses.rom:
vayamu tva shatakrato gavo na yavaseshva |
uktheshu ranayamasi ||
verses.en:
We make thee, Satakratu, find enjoyment in the songs we sing.
Like cattle in the pasture lands.

verses.sa:
विश्वा हि मर्त्यत्वनानुकामा शतक्रतो ।
अगन्म वज्रिन्नाशसः ॥
verses.rom:
vishva hi martyatvananukama shatakrato |
aganma vajrinnashasah ||
verses.en:
For, Satakratu, Thunder-armed, all that we craved, as men are wont,
All that we hoped, have we attained.

verses.sa:
त्वे सु पुत्र शवसोऽवृत्रन्कामकातयः ।
न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
tve su putra shavaso'vritrankamakatayah |
na tvamindrati richyate ||
verses.en:
Those, Son of Strength, are come to thee who cherish wishes in their hearts
O Indra, none excelleth thee.

verses.sa:
स नो वृषन्सनिष्ठया सं घोरया द्रवित्न्वा ।
धियाविड्ढि पुरंध्या ॥
verses.rom:
sa no vrishansanishthaya sam ghoraya dravitnva |
dhiyaviddhi puramdhya ||
verses.en:
So, Hero, guard us with thy care, with thy most liberal providence,
Speedy, and terrible to foes.

verses.sa:
यस्ते नूनं शतक्रतविन्द्र द्युम्नितमो मदः ।
तेन नूनं मदे मदेः ॥
verses.rom:
yaste nunam shatakratavindra dyumnitamo madah |
tena nunam made madeh ||
verses.en:
O Satakratu Indra, now rejoice with that carouse of thine
Which is most splendid of them all

verses.sa:
यस्ते चित्रश्रवस्तमो य इन्द्र वृत्रहन्तमः ।
य ओजोदातमो मदः ॥
verses.rom:
yaste chitrashravastamo ya indra vritrahantamah |
ya ojodatamo madah ||
verses.en:
Even, Indra, that carouse which slays the Vrtras best, most widely famed,
Best giver of thy power and might.

verses.sa:
विद्मा हि यस्ते अद्रिवस्त्वादत्तः सत्य सोमपाः ।
विश्वासु दस्म कृष्टिषु ॥
verses.rom:
vidma hi yaste adrivastvadattah satya somapah |
vishvasu dasma krishtishu ||
verses.en:
For that which is thy gift we know, true Soma-drinker, Thunder-armed,
Mighty One, amid all the folk.

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय मद्वने सुतं परि ष्टोभन्तु नो गिरः ।
अर्कमर्चन्तु कारवः ॥
verses.rom:
indraya madvane sutam pari shtobhantu no girah |
arkamarchantu karavah ||
verses.en:
For Indra, Lover of Carouse, loud be our songs about the juice:
Let poets sing the song of praise.

verses.sa:
यस्मिन्विश्वा अधि श्रियो रणन्ति सप्त संसदः ।
इन्द्रं सुते हवामहे ॥
verses.rom:
yasminvishva adhi shriyo rananti sapta samsadah |
indram sute havamahe ||
verses.en:
We summon Indra to the draught, in whom all glories rest, in whom
The seven communities rejoice.

verses.sa:
त्रिकद्रुकेषु चेतनं देवासो यज्ञमत्नत ।
तमिद्वर्धन्तु नो गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
trikadrukeshu chetanam devaso yajnamatnata |
tamidvardhantu no girah ||
verses.en:
At the Trikadrukas the Gods span sacrifice that stirs the mind:
Let our songs aid and prosper it.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा विशन्त्विन्दवः समुद्रमिव सिन्धवः ।
न त्वामिन्द्राति रिच्यते ॥
verses.rom:
a tva vishantvindavah samudramiva sindhavah |
na tvamindrati richyate ||
verses.en:
Let the drops pass within thee as the rivers flow into the sea:
O Indra, naught excelleth thee.

verses.sa:
विव्यक्थ महिना वृषन्भक्षं सोमस्य जागृवे ।
य इन्द्र जठरेषु ते ॥
verses.rom:
vivyaktha mahina vrishanbhaksham somasya jagrive |
ya indra jathareshu te ||
verses.en:
Thou, wakeful Hero, by thy might hast taken food of Soma juice,
Which, Indra, is within thee now.

verses.sa:
अरं त इन्द्र कुक्षये सोमो भवतु वृत्रहन् ।
अरं धामभ्य इन्दवः ॥
verses.rom:
aram ta indra kukshaye somo bhavatu vritrahan |
aram dhamabhya indavah ||
verses.en:
O Indra, Vrtra-slayer, let Soma be ready for thy maw,
The drops be ready for thy forms.

verses.sa:
अरमश्वाय गायति श्रुतकक्षो अरं गवे ।
अरमिन्द्रस्य धाम्ने ॥
verses.rom:
aramashvaya gayati shrutakaksho aram gave |
aramindrasya dhamne ||
verses.en:
Now Srutakaksa sings his song that cattle and the steed may come,
That Indra's very self may come.

verses.sa:
अरं हि ष्म सुतेषु णः सोमेष्विन्द्र भूषसि ।
अरं ते शक्र दावने ॥
verses.rom:
aram hi shma suteshu nah someshvindra bhushasi |
aram te shakra davane ||
verses.en:
Here, Indra, thou art ready by our Soma juices shed for thee,
Sakra, at hand that thou mayst give.

verses.sa:
पराकात्ताच्चिदद्रिवस्त्वां नक्षन्त नो गिरः ।
अरं गमाम ते वयम् ॥
verses.rom:
parakattachchidadrivastvam nakshanta no girah |
aram gamama te vayam ||
verses.en:
Even from far away our songs reach thee, O Caster of the Stone:
May we come very close to thee.

verses.sa:
एवा ह्यसि वीरयुरेवा शूर उत स्थिरः ।
एवा ते राध्यं मनः ॥
verses.rom:
eva hyasi virayureva shura uta sthirah |
eva te radhyam manah ||
verses.en:
For so thou art the hero's Friend, a Hero, too, art thou, and strong:
So may thine heart be won to us.

verses.sa:
एवा रातिस्तुवीमघ विश्वेभिर्धायि धातृभिः ।
अधा चिदिन्द्र मे सचा ॥
verses.rom:
eva ratistuvimagha vishvebhirdhayi dhatribhih |
adha chidindra me sacha ||
verses.en:
So hath the offering, wealthiest Lord, been paid by all the worshippers:
So dwell thou, Indra, even with me.

verses.sa:
मो षु ब्रह्मेव तन्द्रयुर्भुवो वाजानां पते ।
मत्स्वा सुतस्य गोमतः ॥
verses.rom:
mo shu brahmeva tandrayurbhuvo vajanam pate |
matsva sutasya gomatah ||
verses.en:
Be not thou like a sloth fed priest, O Lord of spoil and wealth: rejoice
In the pressed Soma blent with milk.

verses.sa:
मा न इन्द्राभ्यादिशः सूरो अक्तुष्वा यमन् ।
त्वा युजा वनेम तत् ॥
verses.rom:
ma na indrabhyadishah suro aktushva yaman |
tva yuja vanema tat ||
verses.en:
O Indra, let not ill designs surround us in the sunbeams' light:
This may we gain with thee for Friend.

verses.sa:
त्वयेदिन्द्र युजा वयं प्रति ब्रुवीमहि स्पृधः ।
त्वमस्माकं तव स्मसि ॥
verses.rom:
tvayedindra yuja vayam prati bruvimahi spridhah |
tvamasmakam tava smasi ||
verses.en:
With thee to help us, Indra, let us answer all our enemies:
For thou art ours and we are thine.

verses.sa:
त्वामिद्धि त्वायवोऽनुनोनुवतश्चरान् ।
सखाय इन्द्र कारवः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamiddhi tvayavo'nunonuvatashcharan |
sakhaya indra karavah ||
verses.en:
Indra, the poets and thy friends, faithful to thee, shall loudly sing
Thy praises as they follow thee.

verses.sa:
उद्घेदभि श्रुतामघं वृषभं नर्यापसम् ।
अस्तारमेषि सूर्य ॥
verses.rom:
udghedabhi shrutamagham vrishabham naryapasam |
astarameshi surya ||

verses.sa:
नव यो नवतिं पुरो बिभेद बाह्वोजसा ।
अहिं च वृत्रहावधीत् ॥
verses.rom:
nava yo navatim puro bibheda bahvojasa |
ahim cha vritrahavadhit ||

verses.sa:
स न इन्द्रः शिवः सखाश्वावद्गोमद्यवमत् ।
उरुधारेव दोहते ॥
verses.rom:
sa na indrah shivah sakhashvavadgomadyavamat |
urudhareva dohate ||

verses.sa:
यदद्य कच्च वृत्रहन्नुदगा अभि सूर्य ।
सर्वं तदिन्द्र ते वशे ॥
verses.rom:
yadadya kachcha vritrahannudaga abhi surya |
sarvam tadindra te vashe ||

verses.sa:
यद्वा प्रवृद्ध सत्पते न मरा इति मन्यसे ।
उतो तत्सत्यमित्तव ॥
verses.rom:
yadva pravriddha satpate na mara iti manyase |
uto tatsatyamittava ||

verses.sa:
ये सोमासः परावति ये अर्वावति सुन्विरे ।
सर्वाँस्ताँ इन्द्र गच्छसि ॥
verses.rom:
ye somasah paravati ye arvavati sunvire |
sarvanstan indra gachchhasi ||

verses.sa:
तमिन्द्रं वाजयामसि महे वृत्राय हन्तवे ।
स वृषा वृषभो भुवत् ॥
verses.rom:
tamindram vajayamasi mahe vritraya hantave |
sa vrisha vrishabho bhuvat ||

verses.sa:
इन्द्रः स दामने कृत ओजिष्ठः स मदे हितः ।
द्युम्नी श्लोकी स सोम्यः ॥
verses.rom:
indrah sa damane krita ojishthah sa made hitah |
dyumni shloki sa somyah ||

verses.sa:
गिरा वज्रो न सम्भृतः सबलो अनपच्युतः ।
ववक्ष ऋष्वो अस्तृतः ॥
verses.rom:
gira vajro na sambhritah sabalo anapachyutah |
vavaksha rishvo astritah ||

verses.sa:
दुर्गे चिन्नः सुगं कृधि गृणान इन्द्र गिर्वणः ।
त्वं च मघवन्वशः ॥
verses.rom:
durge chinnah sugam kridhi grinana indra girvanah |
tvam cha maghavanvashah ||

verses.sa:
यस्य ते नू चिदादिशं न मिनन्ति स्वराज्यम् ।
न देवो नाध्रिगुर्जनः ॥
verses.rom:
yasya te nu chidadisham na minanti svarajyam |
na devo nadhrigurjanah ||

verses.sa:
अधा ते अप्रतिष्कुतं देवी शुष्मं सपर्यतः ।
उभे सुशिप्र रोदसी ॥
verses.rom:
adha te apratishkutam devi shushmam saparyatah |
ubhe sushipra rodasi ||

verses.sa:
त्वमेतदधारयः कृष्णासु रोहिणीषु च ।
परुष्णीषु रुशत्पयः ॥
verses.rom:
tvametadadharayah krishnasu rohinishu cha |
parushnishu rushatpayah ||

verses.sa:
वि यदहेरध त्विषो विश्वे देवासो अक्रमुः ।
विदन्मृगस्य ताँ अमः ॥
verses.rom:
vi yadaheradha tvisho vishve devaso akramuh |
vidanmrigasya tan amah ||

verses.sa:
आदु मे निवरो भुवद्वृत्रहादिष्ट पौंस्यम् ।
अजातशत्रुरस्तृतः ॥
verses.rom:
adu me nivaro bhuvadvritrahadishta paumsyam |
ajatashatrurastritah ||

verses.sa:
श्रुतं वो वृत्रहन्तमं प्र शर्धं चर्षणीनाम् ।
आ शुषे राधसे महे ॥
verses.rom:
shrutam vo vritrahantamam pra shardham charshaninam |
a shushe radhase mahe ||

verses.sa:
अया धिया च गव्यया पुरुणामन्पुरुष्टुत ।
यत्सोमेसोम आभवः ॥
verses.rom:
aya dhiya cha gavyaya purunamanpurushtuta |
yatsomesoma abhavah ||

verses.sa:
बोधिन्मना इदस्तु नो वृत्रहा भूर्यासुतिः ।
शृणोतु शक्र आशिषम् ॥
verses.rom:
bodhinmana idastu no vritraha bhuryasutih |
shrinotu shakra ashisham ||

verses.sa:
कया त्वं न ऊत्याभि प्र मन्दसे वृषन् ।
कया स्तोतृभ्य आ भर ॥
verses.rom:
kaya tvam na utyabhi pra mandase vrishan |
kaya stotribhya a bhara ||

verses.sa:
कस्य वृषा सुते सचा नियुत्वान्वृषभो रणत् ।
वृत्रहा सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
kasya vrisha sute sacha niyutvanvrishabho ranat |
vritraha somapitaye ||

verses.sa:
अभी षु णस्त्वं रयिं मन्दसानः सहस्रिणम् ।
प्रयन्ता बोधि दाशुषे ॥
verses.rom:
abhi shu nastvam rayim mandasanah sahasrinam |
prayanta bodhi dashushe ||

verses.sa:
पत्नीवन्तः सुता इम उशन्तो यन्ति वीतये ।
अपां जग्मिर्निचुम्पुणः ॥
verses.rom:
patnivantah suta ima ushanto yanti vitaye |
apam jagmirnichumpunah ||

verses.sa:
इष्टा होत्रा असृक्षतेन्द्रं वृधासो अध्वरे ।
अच्छावभृथमोजसा ॥
verses.rom:
ishta hotra asrikshatendram vridhaso adhvare |
achchhavabhrithamojasa ||

verses.sa:
इह त्या सधमाद्या हरी हिरण्यकेश्या ।
वोळ्हामभि प्रयो हितम् ॥
verses.rom:
iha tya sadhamadya hari hiranyakeshya |
volhamabhi prayo hitam ||

verses.sa:
तुभ्यं सोमाः सुता इमे स्तीर्णं बर्हिर्विभावसो ।
स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्रमा वह ॥
verses.rom:
tubhyam somah suta ime stirnam barhirvibhavaso |
stotribhya indrama vaha ||

verses.sa:
आ ते दक्षं वि रोचना दधद्रत्ना वि दाशुषे ।
स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्रमर्चत ॥
verses.rom:
a te daksham vi rochana dadhadratna vi dashushe |
stotribhya indramarchata ||

verses.sa:
आ ते दधामीन्द्रियमुक्था विश्वा शतक्रतो ।
स्तोतृभ्य इन्द्र मृळय ॥
verses.rom:
a te dadhamindriyamuktha vishva shatakrato |
stotribhya indra mrilaya ||

verses.sa:
भद्रम्भद्रं न आ भरेषमूर्जं शतक्रतो ।
यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
verses.rom:
bhadrambhadram na a bhareshamurjam shatakrato |
yadindra mrilayasi nah ||

verses.sa:
स नो विश्वान्या भर सुवितानि शतक्रतो ।
यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
verses.rom:
sa no vishvanya bhara suvitani shatakrato |
yadindra mrilayasi nah ||

verses.sa:
त्वामिद्वृत्रहन्तम सुतावन्तो हवामहे ।
यदिन्द्र मृळयासि नः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamidvritrahantama sutavanto havamahe |
yadindra mrilayasi nah ||

verses.sa:
उप नो हरिभिः सुतं याहि मदानां पते ।
उप नो हरिभिः सुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
upa no haribhih sutam yahi madanam pate |
upa no haribhih sutam ||

verses.sa:
द्विता यो वृत्रहन्तमो विद इन्द्रः शतक्रतुः ।
उप नो हरिभिः सुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
dvita yo vritrahantamo vida indrah shatakratuh |
upa no haribhih sutam ||

verses.sa:
त्वं हि वृत्रहन्नेषां पाता सोमानामसि ।
उप नो हरिभिः सुतम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi vritrahannesham pata somanamasi |
upa no haribhih sutam ||

verses.sa:
इन्द्र इषे ददातु न ऋभुक्षणमृभुं रयिम् ।
वाजी ददातु वाजिनम् ॥
verses.rom:
indra ishe dadatu na ribhukshanamribhum rayim |
vaji dadatu vajinam ||

prose.en:
1. SURYA, thou mountest up to meet the Hero famous for his wealth,
Who hurls the bolt and works for man

2. Him who with might of both his arms brake nine-and-ninety castles down,
Slew Vrtra and smote Ahi dead.

3. This Indra is our gracious Friend. He sends us in a full broad stream
Riches in horses, kine, and corn.

4. Whatever, Vrtra-slayer! thou, Surya, hast risen upon to-day,
That, Indra, all is in thy power.

5. When, Mighty One, Lord of the brave, thou thinkest thus, I shall not die,
That thought of thine is true indeed.

6. Thou, Indra, goest unto all Soma libations shed for thee,
Both far away and near at hand.

7. We make this Indra very strong to strike the mighty Vrtra dead:
A vigorous Hero shall he be.

8. Indra was made for giving, set, most mighty, o'er the joyous draught.
Bright, meet for Soma, famed in song.

9. By song as 'twere, the powerful bolt which none may parry was prepared
Lofty, invincible he grew.

10. Indra, Song-lover, lauded, make even in the wilds fair ways for us,
Whenever, Maghavan, thou wilt.

11. Thou whose commandment and behest of sovran sway none disregards,
Neither audacious man nor God.

12. And both these Goddesses, Earth, Heaven, Lord of the beauteous helm! revere
Thy might which no one may resist.

13. Thou in the black cows and the red and in the cows with spotted skin
This white milk hast deposited.

14. When in their terror all the Gods shrank from the Dragon's furious might,
Fear of the monster fell on them.

15. Then he was my Defender, then, Invincible, whose foe is not,
The Vrtra-slayer showed his might.

16. Him your best Vrtra-slayer, him the famous Champion of mankind
I urge to great munificence,

17. To come, Much-lauded! Many-named with this same thought that longs for milk,
Whene'er the Soma juice is shed.

18. Much-honoured by libations, may the Vrtra-slayer wake for us:
May Sakra listen to our prayers.

19. O Hero, with that aid dost thou delight us, with what succour bring
Riches to those who worship thee?

20. With whose libation joys the Strong, the Hero with his team who quells
The foe, to drink the Soma juice?

21. Rejoicing in thy spirit bring thousand fold opulence to us:
Enrich thy votary with gifts.

22. These juices with their wedded wives flow to enjoyment lovingly:
To waters speeds the restless one.

23. Presented strengthening gifts have sent Indra away at sacrifice,
With might, onto the cleansing bath.

24. These two who share his feast, Bay Steeds with golden manes, shall bring him to
The banquet that is laid for him.

25. For thee, O Lord of Light, are shed these Soma-drops, and grass is strewn
Bring Indra to his worshippers.

26. May Indra give thee skill, and lights of heaven, wealth to his votary
And priests who praise him: laud ye him.

27. O Satakratu, wondrous strength and all our lauds I bring to thee:
Be gracious to thy worshippers.

28. Bring to us all things excellent, O Satakratu, food and strength:
For, Indra, thou art kind to us.
2§ O Satakratu, bring to us all blessings, all felicity:
Fbr, Indra, thou art kind to us.

30. Bearing the Soma juice we call, best Vrtra-slayer, unto thee:
For, Indra, thou art kind to us.

31. Come, Lord of rapturous, joys, to our libation with thy Bay Steeds, come
To our libation with thy Steeds.

32. Known as best Vrtra-slayer erst, as Indra Satakratu, come
With Bay Steeds to the juice we shed.

33. O Vrtra-slayer, thou art he who drinks these drops of Soma: come
With Bay Steeds to the juice we shed.

34. May Indra give, to aid us, wealth handy that rules the Skilful Ones:
Yea, may the Strong give potent wealth.

verses.sa:
गौर्धयति मरुतां श्रवस्युर्माता मघोनाम् ।
युक्ता वह्नी रथानाम् ॥
verses.rom:
gaurdhayati marutam shravasyurmata maghonam |
yukta vahni rathanam ||
verses.en:
THE Cow, the famous Mother of the wealthy Maruts, pours her milk:
Both horses of the cars are yoked,-

verses.sa:
यस्या देवा उपस्थे व्रता विश्वे धारयन्ते ।
सूर्यामासा दृशे कम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasya deva upasthe vrata vishve dharayante |
suryamasa drishe kam ||
verses.en:
She in whose bosom all the Gods, and Sun and Moon for men to see,
Maintain their everlasting Laws.

verses.sa:
तत्सु नो विश्वे अर्य आ सदा गृणन्ति कारवः ।
मरुतः सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
tatsu no vishve arya a sada grinanti karavah |
marutah somapitaye ||
verses.en:
This all the pious sing to us, and sacred poets evermore:
The Maruts to the Soma-draught

verses.sa:
अस्ति सोमो अयं सुतः पिबन्त्यस्य मरुतः ।
उत स्वराजो अश्विना ॥
verses.rom:
asti somo ayam sutah pibantyasya marutah |
uta svarajo ashvina ||
verses.en:
Here is the Soma ready pressed of this the Maruts drink, of this
Self-luminous the Asvins drink.

verses.sa:
पिबन्ति मित्रो अर्यमा तना पूतस्य वरुणः ।
त्रिषधस्थस्य जावतः ॥
verses.rom:
pibanti mitro aryama tana putasya varunah |
trishadhasthasya javatah ||
verses.en:
Of this, moreover, purified, set in three places, procreant,
Drink Varuna, Mitra, Aryaman.

verses.sa:
उतो न्वस्य जोषमाँ इन्द्रः सुतस्य गोमतः ।
प्रातर्होतेव मत्सति ॥
verses.rom:
uto nvasya joshaman indrah sutasya gomatah |
pratarhoteva matsati ||
verses.en:
And Indra, like the Herald Priest, desirous of the milky juice,
At early morn will quaff thereof.

verses.sa:
कदत्विषन्त सूरयस्तिर आप इव स्रिधः ।
अर्षन्ति पूतदक्षसः ॥
verses.rom:
kadatvishanta surayastira apa iva sridhah |
arshanti putadakshasah ||
verses.en:
When have the Princes gleamed and shone through waters as through troops of foes'?
When hasten they whose might is pure?

verses.sa:
कद्वो अद्य महानां देवानामवो वृणे ।
त्मना च दस्मवर्चसाम् ॥
verses.rom:
kadvo adya mahanam devanamavo vrine |
tmana cha dasmavarchasam ||
verses.en:
What favour do I claim this day of you
great Deities, you who are
Wondrously splendid in yourselves?

verses.sa:
आ ये विश्वा पार्थिवानि पप्रथन्रोचना दिवः ।
मरुतः सोमपीतये ॥
verses.rom:
a ye vishva parthivani paprathanrochana divah |
marutah somapitaye ||
verses.en:
1 call, to drink the Soma, those Maruts who spread all realms of earth
And luminous regions of the sky.

verses.sa:
त्यान्नु पूतदक्षसो दिवो वो मरुतो हुवे ।
अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
tyannu putadakshaso divo vo maruto huve |
asya somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
You, even such, pure in your might, you, O ye Maruts, I invoke
From heaven to drink this Soma juice.

verses.sa:
त्यान्नु ये वि रोदसी तस्तभुर्मरुतो हुवे ।
अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
tyannu ye vi rodasi tastabhurmaruto huve |
asya somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
The Maruts, those who have sustained and propped the heavens and earth apart,
I call to drink this Soma juice.

verses.sa:
त्यं नु मारुतं गणं गिरिष्ठां वृषणं हुवे ।
अस्य सोमस्य पीतये ॥
verses.rom:
tyam nu marutam ganam girishtham vrishanam huve |
asya somasya pitaye ||
verses.en:
That vigorous band of Maruts that abideth in the mountains, I
Invoke to drink this Soma juice.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा गिरो रथीरिवास्थुः सुतेषु गिर्वणः ।
अभि त्वा समनूषतेन्द्र वत्सं न मातरः ॥
verses.rom:
a tva giro rathirivasthuh suteshu girvanah |
abhi tva samanushatendra vatsam na matarah ||
verses.en:
SONG-LOVER! like a charioteer come songs to thee when Soma flows.
O Indra, they have called to thee as mother-kine unto their calves.

verses.sa:
आ त्वा शुक्रा अचुच्यवुः सुतास इन्द्र गिर्वणः ।
पिबा त्वस्यान्धस इन्द्र विश्वासु ते हितम् ॥
verses.rom:
a tva shukra achuchyavuh sutasa indra girvanah |
piba tvasyandhasa indra vishvasu te hitam ||
verses.en:
Bright juices hitherward have sped thee, Indra, Lover of the Song.
Drink, Indra, of this flowing sap: in every house 'tis set for thee.

verses.sa:
पिबा सोमं मदाय कमिन्द्र श्येनाभृतं सुतम् ।
त्वं हि शश्वतीनां पती राजा विशामसि ॥
verses.rom:
piba somam madaya kamindra shyenabhritam sutam |
tvam hi shashvatinam pati raja vishamasi ||
verses.en:
Drink Soma to inspirit thee, juice, Indra, which the Falcon brought:
For thou art King and Sovran Lord of all the families of men.

verses.sa:
श्रुधी हवं तिरश्च्या इन्द्र यस्त्वा सपर्यति ।
सुवीर्यस्य गोमतो रायस्पूर्धि महाँ असि ॥
verses.rom:
shrudhi havam tirashchya indra yastva saparyati |
suviryasya gomato rayaspurdhi mahan asi ||
verses.en:
O Indra, hear Tirasci's call, the call of him who serveth thee.
Satisfy him with wealth of kine and valiant offspring: Great art thou.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र यस्ते नवीयसीं गिरं मन्द्रामजीजनत् ।
चिकित्विन्मनसं धियं प्रत्नामृतस्य पिप्युषीम् ॥
verses.rom:
indra yaste naviyasim giram mandramajijanat |
chikitvinmanasam dhiyam pratnamritasya pipyushim ||
verses.en:
For he, O Indra, hath produced for thee the newest gladdening song,
A hymn that springs from careful thought, ancient, and full of sacred truth.

verses.sa:
तमु ष्टवाम यं गिर इन्द्रमुक्थानि वावृधुः ।
पुरूण्यस्य पौंस्या सिषासन्तो वनामहे ॥
verses.rom:
tamu shtavama yam gira indramukthani vavridhuh |
purunyasya paumsya sishasanto vanamahe ||
verses.en:
That Indra will we laud whom songs and hymns of praise have magnified.
Striving to win, we celebrate his many deeds of hero might.

verses.sa:
एतो न्विन्द्रं स्तवाम शुद्धं शुद्धेन साम्ना ।
शुद्धैरुक्थैर्वावृध्वांसं शुद्ध आशीर्वान्ममत्तु ॥
verses.rom:
eto nvindram stavama shuddham shuddhena samna |
shuddhairukthairvavridhvamsam shuddha ashirvanmamattu ||
verses.en:
Come now and let us glorify pure Indra with pure Sama hymns.
Let the pure milky draught delight him strengthened by pure songs of praise.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र शुद्धो न आ गहि शुद्धः शुद्धाभिरूतिभिः ।
शुद्धो रयिं नि धारय शुद्धो ममद्धि सोम्यः ॥
verses.rom:
indra shuddho na a gahi shuddhah shuddhabhirutibhih |
shuddho rayim ni dharaya shuddho mamaddhi somyah ||
verses.en:
O Indra, come thou pure to us, with pure assistance, pure thyself.
Pure, send thou riches down to us, and, meet for Soma, pure, be glad.

verses.sa:
इन्द्र शुद्धो हि नो रयिं शुद्धो रत्नानि दाशुषे ।
शुद्धो वृत्राणि जिघ्नसे शुद्धो वाजं सिषाससि ॥
verses.rom:
indra shuddho hi no rayim shuddho ratnani dashushe |
shuddho vritrani jighnase shuddho vajam sishasasi ||
verses.en:
O Indra, pure, vouchsafe us wealth, and, pure, enrich the worshipper.
Pure, thou dost strike the Vrtras dead, and strivest, pure, to win the spoil.

verses.sa:
अस्मा उषास आतिरन्त याममिन्द्राय नक्तमूर्म्याः सुवाचः ।
अस्मा आपो मातरः सप्त तस्थुर्नृभ्यस्तराय सिन्धवः सुपाराः ॥
verses.rom:
asma ushasa atiranta yamamindraya naktamurmyah suvachah |
asma apo matarah sapta tasthurnribhyastaraya sindhavah suparah ||
verses.en:
FOR him the Mornings made their courses longer, and Nights with pleasant voices spake to Indra.
For him the Floods stood still, the Seven Mothers, Streams easy for the heroes to pass over.

verses.sa:
अतिविद्धा विथुरेणा चिदस्त्रा त्रिः सप्त सानु संहिता गिरीणाम् ।
न तद्देवो न मर्त्यस्तुतुर्याद्यानि प्रवृद्धो वृषभश्चकार ॥
verses.rom:
atividdha vithurena chidastra trih sapta sanu samhita girinam |
na taddevo na martyastuturyadyani pravriddho vrishabhashchakara ||
verses.en:
The Darter penetrated, though in trouble, thrice-seven close-pressed ridges of the mountains.
Neither might God nor mortal man accomplish what the Strong Hero wrought in full-grown vigour.

verses.sa:
इन्द्रस्य वज्र आयसो निमिश्ल इन्द्रस्य बाह्वोर्भूयिष्ठमोजः ।
शीर्षन्निन्द्रस्य क्रतवो निरेक आसन्नेषन्त श्रुत्या उपाके ॥
verses.rom:
indrasya vajra ayaso nimishla indrasya bahvorbhuyishthamojah |
shirshannindrasya kratavo nireka asanneshanta shrutya upake ||
verses.en:
The mightiest force is Indra's bolt of iron when firmly grasped in both the arms of Indra.
His head and mouth have powers that pass all others, and all his people hasten near to listen.

verses.sa:
मन्ये त्वा यज्ञियं यज्ञियानां मन्ये त्वा च्यवनमच्युतानाम् ।
मन्ये त्वा सत्वनामिन्द्र केतुं मन्ये त्वा वृषभं चर्षणीनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
manye tva yajniyam yajniyanam manye tva chyavanamachyutanam |
manye tva satvanamindra ketum manye tva vrishabham charshaninam ||
verses.en:
1 count thee as the Holiest of the Holy, the caster-down of what hath ne'er been shaken.
I count thee as the Banner of the heroes, I count thee as the Chief of all men living.

verses.sa:
आ यद्वज्रं बाह्वोरिन्द्र धत्से मदच्युतमहये हन्तवा उ ।
प्र पर्वता अनवन्त प्र गावः प्र ब्रह्माणो अभिनक्षन्त इन्द्रम् ॥
verses.rom:
a yadvajram bahvorindra dhatse madachyutamahaye hantava u |
pra parvata anavanta pra gavah pra brahmano abhinakshanta indram ||
verses.en:
What time, O Indra, in thine arms thou tookest thy wildly rushing bolt to Slay the Dragon,
The mountains roared, the cattle loudly bellowed, the Brahmans with their hymns drew nigh to Indra.

verses.sa:
तमु ष्टवाम य इमा जजान विश्वा जातान्यवराण्यस्मात् ।
इन्द्रेण मित्रं दिधिषेम गीर्भिरुपो नमोभिर्वृषभं विशेम ॥
verses.rom:
tamu shtavama ya ima jajana vishva jatanyavaranyasmat |
indrena mitram didhishema girbhirupo namobhirvrishabham vishema ||
verses.en:
Let us praise him who made these worlds and creatures, all things that after him sprang into being.
May we win Mitra with our songs, and Indra, and. wait upon our Lord with adoration.

verses.sa:
वृत्रस्य त्वा श्वसथादीषमाणा विश्वे देवा अजहुर्ये सखायः ।
मरुद्भिरिन्द्र सख्यं ते अस्त्वथेमा विश्वाः पृतना जयासि ॥
verses.rom:
vritrasya tva shvasathadishamana vishve deva ajahurye sakhayah |
marudbhirindra sakhyam te astvathema vishvah pritana jayasi ||
verses.en:
Flying in terror from the snort of Vrtra, all Deities who were thy friends forsook thee.
So, Indra, be thy friendship with the Maruts: in all these battles thou shalt be the victor.

verses.sa:
त्रिः षष्टिस्त्वा मरुतो वावृधाना उस्रा इव राशयो यज्ञियासः ।
उप त्वेमः कृधि नो भागधेयं शुष्मं त एना हविषा विधेम ॥
verses.rom:
trih shashtistva maruto vavridhana usra iva rashayo yajniyasah |
upa tvemah kridhi no bhagadheyam shushmam ta ena havisha vidhema ||
verses.en:
Thrice-sixty Maruts, waxing strong, were with thee, like piles of beaming light, worthy of worship.
We come to thee: grant us a happy portion. Let us adore thy might with this oblation.

verses.sa:
तिग्ममायुधं मरुतामनीकं कस्त इन्द्र प्रति वज्रं दधर्ष ।
अनायुधासो असुरा अदेवाश्चक्रेण ताँ अप वप ऋजीषिन् ॥
verses.rom:
tigmamayudham marutamanikam kasta indra prati vajram dadharsha |
anayudhaso asura adevashchakrena tan apa vapa rijishin ||
verses.en:
A sharpened weapon is the host of Maruts. Who, Indra, dares withstand thy bolt of thunder?
Weaponless are the Asuras, the godless: scatter them with thy wheel, Impetuous Hero.

verses.sa:
मह उग्राय तवसे सुवृक्तिं प्रेरय शिवतमाय पश्वः ।
गिर्वाहसे गिर इन्द्राय पूर्वीर्धेहि तन्वे कुविदङ्ग वेदत् ॥
verses.rom:
maha ugraya tavase suvriktim preraya shivatamaya pashvah |
girvahase gira indraya purvirdhehi tanve kuvidanga vedat ||
verses.en:
To him the Strong and Mighty, most auspicious, send up the beauteous hymn for sake of cattle.
Lay oa his body many songs for Indra invoked with song, for will not he regard. them?

verses.sa:
उक्थवाहसे विभ्वे मनीषां द्रुणा न पारमीरया नदीनाम् ।
नि स्पृश धिया तन्वि श्रुतस्य जुष्टतरस्य कुविदङ्ग वेदत् ॥
verses.rom:
ukthavahase vibhve manisham druna na paramiraya nadinam |
ni sprisha dhiya tanvi shrutasya jushtatarasya kuvidanga vedat ||
verses.en:
To him, the Mighty, who accepts laudation, send forth thy thought as by a boat o'er rivers,
Stir with thy hymn the body of the Famous and Dearest One, for will not he regard it?

verses.sa:
तद्विविड्ढि यत्त इन्द्रो जुजोषत्स्तुहि सुष्टुतिं नमसा विवास ।
उप भूष जरितर्मा रुवण्यः श्रावया वाचं कुविदङ्ग वेदत् ॥
verses.rom:
tadvividdhi yatta indro jujoshatstuhi sushtutim namasa vivasa |
upa bhusha jaritarma ruvanyah shravaya vacham kuvidanga vedat ||
verses.en:
Serve him with gifts of thine which Indra welcomes: praise with fair praise, invite him with thine homage.
Draw near, O singer, and refrain from outcry. Make thy voice heard, for will not he regard it?

verses.sa:
अव द्रप्सो अंशुमतीमतिष्ठदियानः कृष्णो दशभिः सहस्रैः ।
आवत्तमिन्द्रः शच्या धमन्तमप स्नेहितीर्नृमणा अधत्त ॥
verses.rom:
ava drapso amshumatimatishthadiyanah krishno dashabhih sahasraih |
avattamindrah shachya dhamantamapa snehitirnrimana adhatta ||
verses.en:
The Black Drop sank in Amsumati's bosom, advancing with ten thousand round about it.
Indra with might longed for it as it panted: the hero-hearted laid aside his weapons.

verses.sa:
द्रप्समपश्यं विषुणे चरन्तमुपह्वरे नद्यो अंशुमत्याः ।
नभो न कृष्णमवतस्थिवांसमिष्यामि वो वृषणो युध्यताजौ ॥
verses.rom:
drapsamapashyam vishune charantamupahvare nadyo amshumatyah |
nabho na krishnamavatasthivamsamishyami vo vrishano yudhyatajau ||
verses.en:
1 saw the Drop in the far distance moving, on the slope bank of Amsumati's river,
Like a black cloud that sank into the water. Heroes, I send you forth. Go, fight in battle.

verses.sa:
अध द्रप्सो अंशुमत्या उपस्थेऽधारयत्तन्वं तित्विषाणः ।
विशो अदेवीरभ्याचरन्तीर्बृहस्पतिना युजेन्द्रः ससाहे ॥
verses.rom:
adha drapso amshumatya upasthe'dharayattanvam titvishanah |
visho adevirabhyacharantirbrihaspatina yujendrah sasahe ||
verses.en:
And then the Drop in Amsumati's bosom, splendid with light, assumed its proper body;
And Indra, with Brhaspati to aid him, conquered the godless tribes that came against him.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यत्सप्तभ्यो जायमानोऽशत्रुभ्यो अभवः शत्रुरिन्द्र ।
गूळ्हे द्यावापृथिवी अन्वविन्दो विभुमद्भ्यो भुवनेभ्यो रणं धाः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam ha tyatsaptabhyo jayamano'shatrubhyo abhavah shatrurindra |
gulhe dyavaprithivi anvavindo vibhumadbhyo bhuvanebhyo ranam dhah ||
verses.en:
Then, at thy birth, thou wast the foeman, Indra, of those the seven who ne'er had met a rival.
The hidden Pair, the Heaven and Earth, thou foundest, and to the mighty worlds thou gavest pleasure.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यदप्रतिमानमोजो वज्रेण वज्रिन्धृषितो जघन्थ ।
त्वं शुष्णस्यावातिरो वधत्रैस्त्वं गा इन्द्र शच्येदविन्दः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam ha tyadapratimanamojo vajrena vajrindhrishito jaghantha |
tvam shushnasyavatiro vadhatraistvam ga indra shachyedavindah ||
verses.en:
So, Thunder-armed! thou with thy bolt of thunder didst boldly smite that power which none might equal;
With weapons broughtest low the might of Susna, and, Indra, foundest by thy strength the cattle.

verses.sa:
त्वं ह त्यद्वृषभ चर्षणीनां घनो वृत्राणां तविषो बभूथ ।
त्वं सिन्धूँरसृजस्तस्तभानान्त्वमपो अजयो दासपत्नीः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam ha tyadvrishabha charshaninam ghano vritranam tavisho babhutha |
tvam sindhunrasrijastastabhanantvamapo ajayo dasapatnih ||
verses.en:
Then wast thou, Chieftain of all living mortals, the very mighty slayer of the Vrtras.
Then didst thou set the obstructed rivers flowing, and win the floods that were enthralled by Dasas.

verses.sa:
स सुक्रतू रणिता यः सुतेष्वनुत्तमन्युर्यो अहेव रेवान् ।
य एक इन्नर्यपांसि कर्ता स वृत्रहा प्रतीदन्यमाहुः ॥
verses.rom:
sa sukratu ranita yah suteshvanuttamanyuryo aheva revan |
ya eka innaryapamsi karta sa vritraha pratidanyamahuh ||
verses.en:
Most wise is he, rejoicing in libations, splendid as day, resistless in his anger.
He only doth great deeds, the only Hero, sole Vrtra-slayer he, with none beside him.

verses.sa:
स वृत्रहेन्द्रश्चर्षणीधृत्तं सुष्टुत्या हव्यं हुवेम ।
स प्राविता मघवा नोऽधिवक्ता स वाजस्य श्रवस्यस्य दाता ॥
verses.rom:
sa vritrahendrashcharshanidhrittam sushtutya havyam huvema |
sa pravita maghava no'dhivakta sa vajasya shravasyasya data ||
verses.en:
Indra is Vrtra's slayer, man's sustainer: he must be called; with fair praise let us call him.
Maghavan is our Helper, our Protector, giver of spoil and wealth to make us famous.

verses.sa:
स वृत्रहेन्द्र ऋभुक्षाः सद्यो जज्ञानो हव्यो बभूव ।
कृण्वन्नपांसि नर्या पुरूणि सोमो न पीतो हव्यः सखिभ्यः ॥
verses.rom:
sa vritrahendra ribhukshah sadyo jajnano havyo babhuva |
krinvannapamsi narya puruni somo na pito havyah sakhibhyah ||
verses.en:
This Indra, Vrtra-slayer, this Rbhuksan, even at his birth, was meet for invocation.
Doer of many deeds for man's advantage, like Soma quaffed, for friends we must invoke him.

verses.sa:
या इन्द्र भुज आभरः स्वर्वाँ असुरेभ्यः ।
स्तोतारमिन्मघवन्नस्य वर्धय ये च त्वे वृक्तबर्हिषः ॥
verses.rom:
ya indra bhuja abharah svarvan asurebhyah |
stotaraminmaghavannasya vardhaya ye cha tve vriktabarhishah ||
verses.en:
O INDRA, Lord of Light, what joys thou broughtest from the Asuras,
Prosper therewith, O Maghavan, him who lauds that deed, and those whose grass is trimmed for thee.

verses.sa:
यमिन्द्र दधिषे त्वमश्वं गां भागमव्ययम् ।
यजमाने सुन्वति दक्षिणावति तस्मिन्तं धेहि मा पणौ ॥
verses.rom:
yamindra dadhishe tvamashvam gam bhagamavyayam |
yajamane sunvati dakshinavati tasmintam dhehi ma panau ||
verses.en:
The unwasting share of steeds and kine which, Indra, thou hast fast secured,
Grant to the worshipper who presses Soma and gives guerdon, not unto the churl.

verses.sa:
य इन्द्र सस्त्यव्रतोऽनुष्वापमदेवयुः ।
स्वैः ष एवैर्मुमुरत्पोष्यं रयिं सनुतर्धेहि तं ततः ॥
verses.rom:
ya indra sastyavrato'nushvapamadevayuh |
svaih sha evairmumuratposhyam rayim sanutardhehi tam tatah ||
verses.en:
The riteless, godless man who sleeps, O Indra, his unbroken steep,-
May he by following his own devices die. Hide from him wealth that nourishes.

verses.sa:
यच्छक्रासि परावति यदर्वावति वृत्रहन् ।
अतस्त्वा गीर्भिर्द्युगदिन्द्र केशिभिः सुतावाँ आ विवासति ॥
verses.rom:
yachchhakrasi paravati yadarvavati vritrahan |
atastva girbhirdyugadindra keshibhih sutavan a vivasati ||
verses.en:
Whether, O Sakra, thou be far, or, Vrtra-slayer, near at hand,
Thence by heaven-reaching songs he who hath pressed the juice invites thee with thy long-maned Steeds.

verses.sa:
यद्वासि रोचने दिवः समुद्रस्याधि विष्टपि ।
यत्पार्थिवे सदने वृत्रहन्तम यदन्तरिक्ष आ गहि ॥
verses.rom:
yadvasi rochane divah samudrasyadhi vishtapi |
yatparthive sadane vritrahantama yadantariksha a gahi ||
verses.en:
Whether thou art in heaven's bright sphere, or in the basin of the sea;
Whether, chief Vrtra-slayer, in some place on earth, or in the firmament, approach.

verses.sa:
स नः सोमेषु सोमपाः सुतेषु शवसस्पते ।
मादयस्व राधसा सूनृतावतेन्द्र राया परीणसा ॥
verses.rom:
sa nah someshu somapah suteshu shavasaspate |
madayasva radhasa sunritavatendra raya parinasa ||
verses.en:
Thou Soma-drinker, Lord of Strength, beside our flowing Soma juice
Delight us with thy bounty rich in pleasantness, O Indra, with abundant wealth.

verses.sa:
मा न इन्द्र परा वृणग्भवा नः सधमाद्यः ।
त्वं न ऊती त्वमिन्न आप्यं मा न इन्द्र परा वृणक् ॥
verses.rom:
ma na indra para vrinagbhava nah sadhamadyah |
tvam na uti tvaminna apyam ma na indra para vrinak ||
verses.en:
O Indra, turn us not away: be the companion of our feast.
For thou art our protection, yea, thou art our kin: O Indra, turn us not away.

verses.sa:
अस्मे इन्द्र सचा सुते नि षदा पीतये मधु ।
कृधी जरित्रे मघवन्नवो महदस्मे इन्द्र सचा सुते ॥
verses.rom:
asme indra sacha sute ni shada pitaye madhu |
kridhi jaritre maghavannavo mahadasme indra sacha sute ||
verses.en:
Sit down with us, O Indra, sit beside the juice to drink the meath.
Show forth great favour to the Singer, Maghavan; Indra, with us, beside the juice.

verses.sa:
न त्वा देवास आशत न मर्त्यासो अद्रिवः ।
विश्वा जातानि शवसाभिभूरसि न त्वा देवास आशत ॥
verses.rom:
na tva devasa ashata na martyaso adrivah |
vishva jatani shavasabhibhurasi na tva devasa ashata ||
verses.en:
O Caster of the Stone, nor Gods nor mortals have attained to thee.
Thou in thy might surpassest all that hath been made: the Gods have not attained to thee.

verses.sa:
विश्वाः पृतना अभिभूतरं नरं सजूस्ततक्षुरिन्द्रं जजनुश्च राजसे ।
क्रत्वा वरिष्ठं वर आमुरिमुतोग्रमोजिष्ठं तवसं तरस्विनम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishvah pritana abhibhutaram naram sajustatakshurindram jajanushcha rajase |
kratva varishtham vara amurimutogramojishtham tavasam tarasvinam ||
verses.en:
Of one accord they made and formed for kingship Indra, the Hero who in all encounters overcometh,
Most eminent for power, destroyer in the conflict, fierce and exceeding strong, stalwart and full of vigour.

verses.sa:
समीं रेभासो अस्वरन्निन्द्रं सोमस्य पीतये ।
स्वर्पतिं यदीं वृधे धृतव्रतो ह्योजसा समूतिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
samim rebhaso asvarannindram somasya pitaye |
svarpatim yadim vridhe dhritavrato hyojasa samutibhih ||
verses.en:
Bards joined in song to Indra so that he might drink the Soma juice,
The Lord of Light, that he whose laws stand fast might aid with power and with the help he gives.

verses.sa:
नेमिं नमन्ति चक्षसा मेषं विप्रा अभिस्वरा ।
सुदीतयो वो अद्रुहोऽपि कर्णे तरस्विनः समृक्वभिः ॥
verses.rom:
nemim namanti chakshasa mesham vipra abhisvara |
suditayo vo adruho'pi karne tarasvinah samrikvabhih ||
verses.en:
The holy sages form a ring, looking and singing to the Ram.
Inciters, full of vigour, not to he deceived, are with the chanters, nigh to bear.

verses.sa:
तमिन्द्रं जोहवीमि मघवानमुग्रं सत्रा दधानमप्रतिष्कुतं शवांसि ।
मंहिष्ठो गीर्भिरा च यज्ञियो ववर्तद्राये नो विश्वा सुपथा कृणोतु वज्री ॥
verses.rom:
tamindram johavimi maghavanamugram satra dadhanamapratishkutam shavamsi |
mamhishtho girbhira cha yajniyo vavartadraye no vishva supatha krinotu vajri ||
verses.en:
Loudly I call that Indra, Maghavan the Mighty, who evermore possesses power, ever resistless.
Holy, most liberal, may he lead us on to riches, and, Thunder-armed, make all our pathways pleasant for us.

verses.sa:
त्वं पुर इन्द्र चिकिदेना व्योजसा शविष्ठ शक्र नाशयध्यै ।
त्वद्विश्वानि भुवनानि वज्रिन्द्यावा रेजेते पृथिवी च भीषा ॥
verses.rom:
tvam pura indra chikidena vyojasa shavishtha shakra nashayadhyai |
tvadvishvani bhuvanani vajrindyava rejete prithivi cha bhisha ||
verses.en:
Thou knowest well, O Sakra, thou Most Potent, with thy strength, Indra, to destroy these castles.
Before thee, Thunder-armed! all beings tremble: the heavens and earth before thee shake with terror,

verses.sa:
तन्म ऋतमिन्द्र शूर चित्र पात्वपो न वज्रिन्दुरिताति पर्षि भूरि ।
कदा न इन्द्र राय आ दशस्येर्विश्वप्स्न्यस्य स्पृहयाय्यस्य राजन् ॥
verses.rom:
tanma ritamindra shura chitra patvapo na vajrinduritati parshi bhuri |
kada na indra raya a dashasyervishvapsnyasya sprihayayyasya rajan ||
verses.en:
May thy truth, Indra, Wondrous Hero be my guard: bear me o'er much woe, Thunderer! as over floods.
When, Indra, wilt thou honour us with opulence, all-nourishing and much-to-be. desired, O King?

verses.sa:
इन्द्राय साम गायत विप्राय बृहते बृहत् ।
धर्मकृते विपश्चिते पनस्यवे ॥
verses.rom:
indraya sama gayata vipraya brihate brihat |
dharmakrite vipashchite panasyave ||
verses.en:
To Indra sing a Sama hymn, a lofty song to Lofty Sage,
To him who guards the Law, inspired, and fain for praise.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्राभिभूरसि त्वं सूर्यमरोचयः ।
विश्वकर्मा विश्वदेवो महाँ असि ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindrabhibhurasi tvam suryamarochayah |
vishvakarma vishvadevo mahan asi ||
verses.en:
Thou, Indra, art the Conqueror: thou gavest splendour to the Sun.
Maker of all things, thou art Mighty and All-God.

verses.sa:
विभ्राजञ्ज्योतिषा स्वरगच्छो रोचनं दिवः ।
देवास्त इन्द्र सख्याय येमिरे ॥
verses.rom:
vibhrajanjyotisha svaragachchho rochanam divah |
devasta indra sakhyaya yemire ||
verses.en:
Radiant with light thou wentest to the sky, the luminous realm of heaven.
ne Deities, Indra strove to win thee for their Friend.

verses.sa:
एन्द्र नो गधि प्रियः सत्राजिदगोह्यः ।
गिरिर्न विश्वतस्पृथुः पतिर्दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
endra no gadhi priyah satrajidagohyah |
girirna vishvatasprithuh patirdivah ||
verses.en:
Come unto us, O Indra, dear, still conquering, unconcealable,
Vast as a mountain spread on all sides, Lord of Heaven.

verses.sa:
अभि हि सत्य सोमपा उभे बभूथ रोदसी ।
इन्द्रासि सुन्वतो वृधः पतिर्दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
abhi hi satya somapa ubhe babhutha rodasi |
indrasi sunvato vridhah patirdivah ||
verses.en:
O truthful Soma-drinker, thou art mightier than both the worlds.
Thou strengthenest him who pours libation, Lord of Heaven.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि शश्वतीनामिन्द्र दर्ता पुरामसि ।
हन्ता दस्योर्मनोर्वृधः पतिर्दिवः ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi shashvatinamindra darta puramasi |
hanta dasyormanorvridhah patirdivah ||
verses.en:
For thou art he, O Indra, who stormeth all castles of the foe,
Slayer of Dasyus, man's Supporter, Lord of Heaven.

verses.sa:
अधा हीन्द्र गिर्वण उप त्वा कामान्महः ससृज्महे ।
उदेव यन्त उदभिः ॥
verses.rom:
adha hindra girvana upa tva kamanmahah sasrijmahe |
udeva yanta udabhih ||
verses.en:
Now have we, Indra, Friend of Song, sent our great wishes forth to thee,
Coming like floods that follow floods.

verses.sa:
वार्ण त्वा यव्याभिर्वर्धन्ति शूर ब्रह्माणि ।
वावृध्वांसं चिदद्रिवो दिवेदिवे ॥
verses.rom:
varna tva yavyabhirvardhanti shura brahmani |
vavridhvamsam chidadrivo divedive ||
verses.en:
As rivers swell the ocean, so, Hero, our prayers increase thy might,
Though of thyself, O Thunderer, waxing day by day.

verses.sa:
युञ्जन्ति हरी इषिरस्य गाथयोरौ रथ उरुयुगे ।
इन्द्रवाहा वचोयुजा ॥
verses.rom:
yunjanti hari ishirasya gathayorau ratha uruyuge |
indravaha vachoyuja ||
verses.en:
With holy song may bind to the broad wide-yoked car the Bay Steeds of the rapid God,
Bearers of Indra, yoked by word.

verses.sa:
त्वं न इन्द्रा भरँ ओजो नृम्णं शतक्रतो विचर्षणे ।
आ वीरं पृतनाषहम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam na indra bharan ojo nrimnam shatakrato vicharshane |
a viram pritanashaham ||
verses.en:
O Indra, bring great strength to us, bring valour, Satakratu, thou most active, bring
A hero conquering in war.

verses.sa:
त्वं हि नः पिता वसो त्वं माता शतक्रतो बभूविथ ।
अधा ते सुम्नमीमहे ॥
verses.rom:
tvam hi nah pita vaso tvam mata shatakrato babhuvitha |
adha te sumnamimahe ||
verses.en:
For, gracious Satakratu, thou hast ever been a Mother and a Sire to us,
So now for bliss we pray to thee.

verses.sa:
त्वां शुष्मिन्पुरुहूत वाजयन्तमुप ब्रुवे शतक्रतो ।
स नो रास्व सुवीर्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
tvam shushminpuruhuta vajayantamupa bruve shatakrato |
sa no rasva suviryam ||
verses.en:
To thee, Strong, Much-invoked, who showest forth thy strength, O Satakratu, do I speak:
So grant thou us heroic strength.

verses.sa:
त्वामिदा ह्यो नरोऽपीप्यन्वज्रिन्भूर्णयः ।
स इन्द्र स्तोमवाहसामिह श्रुध्युप स्वसरमा गहि ॥
verses.rom:
tvamida hyo naro'pipyanvajrinbhurnayah |
sa indra stomavahasamiha shrudhyupa svasarama gahi ||
verses.en:
O THUNDERER, zealous worshippers gave thee drink this time yesterday.
So, Indra, listen here to those who bring the laud: come near unto our dwelling place.

verses.sa:
मत्स्वा सुशिप्र हरिवस्तदीमहे त्वे आ भूषन्ति वेधसः ।
तव श्रवांस्युपमान्युक्थ्या सुतेष्विन्द्र गिर्वणः ॥
verses.rom:
matsva sushipra harivastadimahe tve a bhushanti vedhasah |
tava shravamsyupamanyukthya suteshvindra girvanah ||
verses.en:
Lord of Bay Steeds, fair-helmed, rejoice thee: this we crave. Here the disposers wait on thee.
Thy loftiest glories claim our lauds beside the juice, O Indra, Lover of the Song.

verses.sa:
श्रायन्त इव सूर्यं विश्वेदिन्द्रस्य भक्षत ।
वसूनि जाते जनमान ओजसा प्रति भागं न दीधिम ॥
verses.rom:
shrayanta iva suryam vishvedindrasya bhakshata |
vasuni jate janamana ojasa prati bhagam na didhima ||
verses.en:
Turning, as 'twere, to meet the Sun, enjoy from Indra all good things.
When he who will be born is born with power we look to treasures as our heritage.

verses.sa:
अनर्शरातिं वसुदामुप स्तुहि भद्रा इन्द्रस्य रातयः ।
सो अस्य कामं विधतो न रोषति मनो दानाय चोदयन् ॥
verses.rom:
anarsharatim vasudamupa stuhi bhadra indrasya ratayah |
so asya kamam vidhato na roshati mano danaya chodayan ||
verses.en:
Praise him who sends us wealth, whose bounties injure none: good are the gifts which Indra. grants.
He is not worth with one who satisfies his wish: he turns his mind to giving boons.

verses.sa:
त्वमिन्द्र प्रतूर्तिष्वभि विश्वा असि स्पृधः ।
अशस्तिहा जनिता विश्वतूरसि त्वं तूर्य तरुष्यतः ॥
verses.rom:
tvamindra praturtishvabhi vishva asi spridhah |
ashastiha janita vishvaturasi tvam turya tarushyatah ||
verses.en:
Thou in thy battles, Indra, art subduer of all hostile bands.
Father art thou, all-conquering, cancelling the curse, thou victor of the vanquisher.

verses.sa:
अनु ते शुष्मं तुरयन्तमीयतुः क्षोणी शिशुं न मातरा ।
विश्वास्ते स्पृधः श्नथयन्त मन्यवे वृत्रं यदिन्द्र तूर्वसि ॥
verses.rom:
anu te shushmam turayantamiyatuh kshoni shishum na matara |
vishvaste spridhah shnathayanta manyave vritram yadindra turvasi ||
verses.en:
The Earth and Heaven clung close to thy victorious might as to their calf two mother-cows.
When thou attackest Vrtra all the hostile bands shrink and faint, Indra, at thy wrath.

verses.sa:
इत ऊती वो अजरं प्रहेतारमप्रहितम् ।
आशुं जेतारं हेतारं रथीतममतूर्तं तुग्र्यावृधम् ॥
verses.rom:
ita uti vo ajaram prahetaramaprahitam |
ashum jetaram hetaram rathitamamaturtam tugryavridham ||
verses.en:
Bring to your aid the Eternal One, who shoots and none may shoot at him,
Inciter, swift, victorious, best of Charioteers. Tugrya's unvanquished Strengthener;

verses.sa:
इष्कर्तारमनिष्कृतं सहस्कृतं शतमूतिं शतक्रतुम् ।
समानमिन्द्रमवसे हवामहे वसवानं वसूजुवम् ॥
verses.rom:
ishkartaramanishkritam sahaskritam shatamutim shatakratum |
samanamindramavase havamahe vasavanam vasujuvam ||
verses.en:
Arranger of things unarranged, e'en Satakratu, source of might,
Indra, the Friend of all, for succour we invoke, Guardian of treasure, sending wealth.

verses.sa:
अयं त एमि तन्वा पुरस्ताद्विश्वे देवा अभि मा यन्ति पश्चात् ।
यदा मह्यं दीधरो भागमिन्द्रादिन्मया कृणवो वीर्याणि ॥
verses.rom:
ayam ta emi tanva purastadvishve deva abhi ma yanti pashchat |
yada mahyam didharo bhagamindradinmaya krinavo viryani ||
verses.en:
I MOVE before thee here present in person, and all the Deities follow behind me.
When, Indra, thou securest me my portion, with me thou shalt perform heroic actions.

verses.sa:
दधामि ते मधुनो भक्षमग्रे हितस्ते भागः सुतो अस्तु सोमः ।
असश्च त्वं दक्षिणतः सखा मेऽधा वृत्राणि जङ्घनाव भूरि ॥
verses.rom:
dadhami te madhuno bhakshamagre hitaste bhagah suto astu somah |
asashcha tvam dakshinatah sakha me'dha vritrani janghanava bhuri ||
verses.en:
The food of meath in foremost place I give thee, thy Soma shall be pressed, thy share appointed.
Thou on my right shalt be my friend and comrade: then shall we two smite dead full many a foeman.

verses.sa:
प्र सु स्तोमं भरत वाजयन्त इन्द्राय सत्यं यदि सत्यमस्ति ।
नेन्द्रो अस्तीति नेम उ त्व आह क ईं ददर्श कमभि ष्टवाम ॥
verses.rom:
pra su stomam bharata vajayanta indraya satyam yadi satyamasti |
nendro astiti nema u tva aha ka im dadarsha kamabhi shtavama ||
verses.en:
Striving for strength bring forth a laud to Indra, a truthful hymn if he in truth existeth.
One and another say, There is no Indra. Who hath beheld him? Whom then shall we honour?

verses.sa:
अयमस्मि जरितः पश्य मेह विश्वा जातान्यभ्यस्मि मह्ना ।
ऋतस्य मा प्रदिशो वर्धयन्त्यादर्दिरो भुवना दर्दरीमि ॥
verses.rom:
ayamasmi jaritah pashya meha vishva jatanyabhyasmi mahna |
ritasya ma pradisho vardhayantyadardiro bhuvana dardarimi ||
verses.en:
Here am I, look upon me here, O singer. All that existeth 1 surpass in greatness.
The Holy Law's commandments make me mighty. Rending with strength I rend the worlds asunder.

verses.sa:
आ यन्मा वेना अरुहन्नृतस्यँ एकमासीनं हर्यतस्य पृष्ठे ।
मनश्चिन्मे हृद आ प्रत्यवोचदचिक्रदञ्छिशुमन्तः सखायः ॥
verses.rom:
a yanma vena aruhannritasyan ekamasinam haryatasya prishthe |
manashchinme hrida a pratyavochadachikradanchhishumantah sakhayah ||
verses.en:
When the Law's lovers mounted and approached me as 1 sate lone upon the dear sky's summit.
Then spake my spirit to the heart within me, My friends have cried unto me with their children.

verses.sa:
विश्वेत्ता ते सवनेषु प्रवाच्या या चकर्थ मघवन्निन्द्र सुन्वते ।
पारावतं यत्पुरुसम्भृतं वस्वपावृणोः शरभाय ऋषिबन्धवे ॥
verses.rom:
vishvetta te savaneshu pravachya ya chakartha maghavannindra sunvate |
paravatam yatpurusambhritam vasvapavrinoh sharabhaya rishibandhave ||
verses.en:
All these thy deeds must be declared at Soma-feasts, wrought, Indra, Bounteous Lord, for him who sheds the juice,
When thou didst open wealth heaped up by many, brought from far away to Sarablia, the Rsi's kin.

verses.sa:
प्र नूनं धावता पृथङ्नेह यो वो अवावरीत् ।
नि षीं वृत्रस्य मर्मणि वज्रमिन्द्रो अपीपतत् ॥
verses.rom:
pra nunam dhavata prithanneha yo vo avavarit |
ni shim vritrasya marmani vajramindro apipatat ||
verses.en:
Now run ye forth your several ways: he is not here who kept you back.
For hath not Indra sunk his bolt deep down in Vrtra's vital part?

verses.sa:
मनोजवा अयमान आयसीमतरत्पुरम् ।
दिवं सुपर्णो गत्वाय सोमं वज्रिण आभरत् ॥
verses.rom:
manojava ayamana ayasimataratpuram |
divam suparno gatvaya somam vajrina abharat ||
verses.en:
On-rushing with the speed of thought within the iron fort he pressed:
The Falcon went to heaven and brought the Soma to the Thunderer.

verses.sa:
समुद्रे अन्तः शयत उद्ना वज्रो अभीवृतः ।
भरन्त्यस्मै संयतः पुरःप्रस्रवणा बलिम् ॥
verses.rom:
samudre antah shayata udna vajro abhivritah |
bharantyasmai samyatah purahprasravana balim ||
verses.en:
Deep in the ocean lies the bolt with waters compassed round about,
And in continuous onward flow the floods their tribute bring to it.

verses.sa:
यद्वाग्वदन्त्यविचेतनानि राष्ट्री देवानां निषसाद मन्द्रा ।
चतस्र ऊर्जं दुदुहे पयांसि क्व स्विदस्याः परमं जगाम ॥
verses.rom:
yadvagvadantyavichetanani rashtri devanam nishasada mandra |
chatasra urjam duduhe payamsi kva svidasyah paramam jagama ||
verses.en:
When, uttering words which no one comprehended, Vak, Queen of Gods, the Gladdener, was seated,
The heaven's four regions drew forth drink and vigour: now whither hath her noblest portion vanished?

verses.sa:
देवीं वाचमजनयन्त देवास्तां विश्वरूपाः पशवो वदन्ति ।
सा नो मन्द्रेषमूर्जं दुहाना धेनुर्वागस्मानुप सुष्टुतैतु ॥
verses.rom:
devim vachamajanayanta devastam vishvarupah pashavo vadanti |
sa no mandreshamurjam duhana dhenurvagasmanupa sushtutaitu ||
verses.en:
The Deities generated Vak the Goddess, and animals of every figure speak her.
May she, the Gladdener, yielding food and vigour, the Milch-cow Vak, approach us meetly lauded.

verses.sa:
सखे विष्णो वितरं वि क्रमस्व द्यौर्देहि लोकं वज्राय विष्कभे ।
हनाव वृत्रं रिणचाव सिन्धूनिन्द्रस्य यन्तु प्रसवे विसृष्टाः ॥
verses.rom:
sakhe vishno vitaram vi kramasva dyaurdehi lokam vajraya vishkabhe |
hanava vritram rinachava sindhunindrasya yantu prasave visrishtah ||
verses.en:
Step forth with wider stride, my comrade Visnu; make room, Dyaus, for the leaping of the lightning.
Let us slay Vrtra, let us free the rivers let them flow loosed at the command of Indra.

verses.sa:
ऋधगित्था स मर्त्यः शशमे देवतातये ।
यो नूनं मित्रावरुणावभिष्टय आचक्रे हव्यदातये ॥
verses.rom:
ridhagittha sa martyah shashame devatataye |
yo nunam mitravarunavabhishtaya achakre havyadataye ||
verses.en:
YEA, specially that mortal man hath toiled for service of the Gods,
Who quickly hath brought near Mitra and Varuna. to share his sacrificial gifts.

verses.sa:
वर्षिष्ठक्षत्रा उरुचक्षसा नरा राजाना दीर्घश्रुत्तमा ।
ता बाहुता न दंसना रथर्यतः साकं सूर्यस्य रश्मिभिः ॥
verses.rom:
varshishthakshatra uruchakshasa nara rajana dirghashruttama |
ta bahuta na damsana ratharyatah sakam suryasya rashmibhih ||
verses.en:
Supreme in sovran power, far-sighted, Chiefs and Kings, most swift to hear from far away,
Both, wondrously, set them in motion as with arms, in company with Surya's beams.

verses.sa:
प्र यो वां मित्रावरुणाजिरो दूतो अद्रवत् ।
अयःशीर्षा मदेरघुः ॥
verses.rom:
pra yo vam mitravarunajiro duto adravat |
ayahshirsha maderaghuh ||
verses.en: The rapid messenger who runs before you, Mitra-Varuna, with iron head, swift to the draught,

verses.sa:
न यः सम्पृच्छे न पुनर्हवीतवे न संवादाय रमते ।
तस्मान्नो अद्य समृतेरुरुष्यतं बाहुभ्यां न उरुष्यतम् ॥
verses.rom:
na yah samprichchhe na punarhavitave na samvadaya ramate |
tasmanno adya samriterurushyatam bahubhyam na urushyatam ||
verses.en:
He whom no man may question, none may summon back, who stands not still for colloquy,-
From hostile clash with him keep ye us safe this day: keep us in safety with your arms.

verses.sa:
प्र मित्राय प्रार्यम्णे सचथ्यमृतावसो ।
वरूथ्यं वरुणे छन्द्यं वच स्तोत्रं राजसु गायत ॥
verses.rom:
pra mitraya praryamne sachathyamritavaso |
varuthyam varune chhandyam vacha stotram rajasu gayata ||
verses.en:
To Aryaman and Mitra sing a reverent song, O pious one,
A pleasant hymn that shall protect to Varuna: sing forth a laud unto the Kings.

verses.sa:
ते हिन्विरे अरुणं जेन्यं वस्वेकं पुत्रं तिसॄणाम् ।
ते धामान्यमृता मर्त्यानामदब्धा अभि चक्षते ॥
verses.rom:
te hinvire arunam jenyam vasvekam putram tisrinam |
te dhamanyamrita martyanamadabdha abhi chakshate ||
verses.en:
The true, Red Treasure they have sent, one only Son born of the Three.
They, the Immortal Ones, never deceived, survey the families of mortal men.

verses.sa:
आ मे वचांस्युद्यता द्युमत्तमानि कर्त्वा ।
उभा यातं नासत्या सजोषसा प्रति हव्यानि वीतये ॥
verses.rom:
a me vachamsyudyata dyumattamani kartva |
ubha yatam nasatya sajoshasa prati havyani vitaye ||
verses.en:
My songs are lifted up, and acts most splendid are to be performed.
Come hither, ye Nasatyas, with accordant mind, to meet and to enjoy my gifts.

verses.sa:
रातिं यद्वामरक्षसं हवामहे युवाभ्यां वाजिनीवसू ।
प्राचीं होत्रां प्रतिरन्तावितं नरा गृणाना जमदग्निना ॥
verses.rom:
ratim yadvamarakshasam havamahe yuvabhyam vajinivasu |
prachim hotram pratirantavitam nara grinana jamadagnina ||
verses.en:
Lords of great wealth, when we invoke your bounty which no demon checks,
Both of you, furthering our eastward-offered praise, come, Chiefs whom Jamadagni lauds!

verses.sa:
आ नो यज्ञं दिविस्पृशं वायो याहि सुमन्मभिः ।
अन्तः पवित्र उपरि श्रीणानोऽयं शुक्रो अयामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
a no yajnam divisprisham vayo yahi sumanmabhih |
antah pavitra upari shrinano'yam shukro ayami te ||
verses.en:
Come, Vayu, drawn by fair hymns, to our sacrifice that reaches heaven.
Poured on the middle of the straining cloth, and cooked, this bright drink hath been offered chalice.

verses.sa:
वेत्यध्वर्युः पथिभी रजिष्ठैः प्रति हव्यानि वीतये ।
अधा नियुत्व उभयस्य नः पिब शुचिं सोमं गवाशिरम् ॥
verses.rom:
vetyadhvaryuh pathibhi rajishthaih prati havyani vitaye |
adha niyutva ubhayasya nah piba shuchim somam gavashiram ||
verses.en:
He comes by straightest paths, as ministering Priest, to taste the sacrificial gifts.
Then, Lord of harnessed teams I drink of the twofold draught, bright Soma mingled with the milk.

verses.sa:
बण्महाँ असि सूर्य बळादित्य महाँ असि ।
महस्ते सतो महिमा पनस्यतेऽद्धा देव महाँ असि ॥
verses.rom:
banmahan asi surya baladitya mahan asi |
mahaste sato mahima panasyate'ddha deva mahan asi ||
verses.en:
Verily, Surya, thou art great; truly, Aditya, thou art great.
As thou art great indeed, thy greatness is admired: yea, verily, thou, God, art great.

verses.sa:
बट् सूर्य श्रवसा महाँ असि सत्रा देव महाँ असि ।
मह्ना देवानामसुर्यः पुरोहितो विभु ज्योतिरदाभ्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
bat surya shravasa mahan asi satra deva mahan asi |
mahna devanamasuryah purohito vibhu jyotiradabhyam ||
verses.en:
Yea, Surya, thou art great in fame thou evermore, O God, art great.
Thou by thy greatness art the Gods' High Priest, divine, far-spread unconquerable light.

verses.sa:
इयं या नीच्यर्किणी रूपा रोहिण्या कृता ।
चित्रेव प्रत्यदर्श्यायत्यन्तर्दशसु बाहुषु ॥
verses.rom:
iyam ya nichyarkini rupa rohinya krita |
chitreva pratyadarshyayatyantardashasu bahushu ||
verses.en:
She yonder, bending lowly down, clothed in red hues and rich in rays,
Is seen, advancing as it were with various tints, amid the ten surrounding arms.

verses.sa:
प्रजा ह तिस्रो अत्यायमीयुर्न्यन्या अर्कमभितो विविश्रे ।
बृहद्ध तस्थौ भुवनेष्वन्तः पवमानो हरित आ विवेश ॥
verses.rom:
praja ha tisro atyayamiyurnyanya arkamabhito vivishre |
brihaddha tasthau bhuvaneshvantah pavamano harita a vivesha ||
verses.en:
Past and gone are three mortal generations: the fourth and last into the Sun hath entered.
He mid the worlds his lofty place hath taken. Into green plants is gone the Purifying.

verses.sa:
माता रुद्राणां दुहिता वसूनां स्वसादित्यानाममृतस्य नाभिः ।
प्र नु वोचं चिकितुषे जनाय मा गामनागामदितिं वधिष्ट ॥
verses.rom:
mata rudranam duhita vasunam svasadityanamamritasya nabhih |
pra nu vocham chikitushe janaya ma gamanagamaditim vadhishta ||
verses.en:
The Rudras' Mother, Daughter of the Vasus, centre of nectar, the Adityas' Sister-
To folk who understand will 1 proclaim it-injure not Aditi, the Cow, the sinless.

verses.sa:
वचोविदं वाचमुदीरयन्तीं विश्वाभिर्धीभिरुपतिष्ठमानाम् ।
देवीं देवेभ्यः पर्येयुषीं गामा मावृक्त मर्त्यो दभ्रचेताः ॥
verses.rom:
vachovidam vachamudirayantim vishvabhirdhibhirupatishthamanam |
devim devebhyah paryeyushim gama mavrikta martyo dabhrachetah ||
verses.en:
Weak-minded men have as a cow adopted me who came hither from the Gods, a Goddess,
Who, skilled in eloquence, her voice uplifteth, who standeth near at hand with all devotions.

verses.sa:
त्वमग्ने बृहद्वयो दधासि देव दाशुषे ।
कविर्गृहपतिर्युवा ॥
verses.rom:
tvamagne brihadvayo dadhasi deva dashushe |
kavirgrihapatiryuva ||
verses.en:
LORD of the house, Sage, ever young, high power of life, O Agni, God,
Thou givest to thy worshipper.

verses.sa:
स न ईळानया सह देवाँ अग्ने दुवस्युवा ।
चिकिद्विभानवा वह ॥
verses.rom:
sa na ilanaya saha devan agne duvasyuva |
chikidvibhanava vaha ||
verses.en:
So with our song that prays and serves, attentive, Lord of spreading light,
Agni, bring hitherward the Gods.

verses.sa:
त्वया ह स्विद्युजा वयं चोदिष्ठेन यविष्ठ्य ।
अभि ष्मो वाजसातये ॥
verses.rom:
tvaya ha svidyuja vayam chodishthena yavishthya |
abhi shmo vajasataye ||
verses.en:
For, Ever-Youthful One, with thee, best Furtherer, as our ally,
We overcome, to win the spoil.

verses.sa:
और्वभृगुवच्छुचिमप्नवानवदा हुवे ।
अग्निं समुद्रवाससम् ॥
verses.rom:
aurvabhriguvachchhuchimapnavanavada huve |
agnim samudravasasam ||
verses.en:
As Aurva Bhrgu used, as Apnavana used, I call the pure
Agni who clothes him with the sea.

verses.sa:
हुवे वातस्वनं कविं पर्जन्यक्रन्द्यं सहः ।
अग्निं समुद्रवाससम् ॥
verses.rom:
huve vatasvanam kavim parjanyakrandyam sahah |
agnim samudravasasam ||
verses.en:
1 call the Sage who sounds like wind, the Might that like Parjanya roars,
Agni who clothes him with the sea.

verses.sa:
आ सवं सवितुर्यथा भगस्येव भुजिं हुवे ।
अग्निं समुद्रवाससम् ॥
verses.rom:
a savam savituryatha bhagasyeva bhujim huve |
agnim samudravasasam ||
verses.en:
As Savitar's productive Power, as him who sends down bliss, I call
Agni who clothes him with the sea.

verses.sa:
अग्निं वो वृधन्तमध्वराणां पुरूतमम् ।
अच्छा नप्त्रे सहस्वते ॥
verses.rom:
agnim vo vridhantamadhvaranam purutamam |
achchha naptre sahasvate ||
verses.en:
Hither, for powerful kinship, I call Agni, him Who prospers you,
Most frequent at our solemn rites

verses.sa:
अयं यथा न आभुवत्त्वष्टा रूपेव तक्ष्या ।
अस्य क्रत्वा यशस्वतः ॥
verses.rom:
ayam yatha na abhuvattvashta rupeva takshya |
asya kratva yashasvatah ||
verses.en:
That through this famed One's power, he may stand by us even as Tvastar comes
Unto the forms that must he shaped.

verses.sa:
अयं विश्वा अभि श्रियोऽग्निर्देवेषु पत्यते ।
आ वाजैरुप नो गमत् ॥
verses.rom:
ayam vishva abhi shriyo'gnirdeveshu patyate |
a vajairupa no gamat ||
verses.en:
This Agni is the Lord supreme above all glories mid the Gods:
May he come nigh to us with strength.

verses.sa:
विश्वेषामिह स्तुहि होतॄणां यशस्तमम् ।
अग्निं यज्ञेषु पूर्व्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
vishveshamiha stuhi hotrinam yashastamam |
agnim yajneshu purvyam ||
verses.en:
Here praise ye him the most renowned of all the ministering Priests,
Agni, the Chief at sacrifice;

verses.sa:
शीरं पावकशोचिषं ज्येष्ठो यो दमेष्वा ।
दीदाय दीर्घश्रुत्तमः ॥
verses.rom:
shiram pavakashochisham jyeshtho yo dameshva |
didaya dirghashruttamah ||
verses.en:
Piercing, with purifying flame, enkindled in our homes, most high,
Swiftest to hear from far away.

verses.sa:
तमर्वन्तं न सानसिं गृणीहि विप्र शुष्मिणम् ।
मित्रं न यातयज्जनम् ॥
verses.rom:
tamarvantam na sanasim grinihi vipra shushminam |
mitram na yatayajjanam ||
verses.en:
Sage, laud the Mighty One who wins the spoil of victory like a steed,
And, Mitra like, unites the folk.

verses.sa:
उप त्वा जामयो गिरो देदिशतीर्हविष्कृतः ।
वायोरनीके अस्थिरन् ॥
verses.rom:
upa tva jamayo giro dedishatirhavishkritah |
vayoranike asthiran ||
verses.en:
Still turning to their aim in thee, the oblation-bearer's sister hymns
Have come to thee before the wind.

verses.sa:
यस्य त्रिधात्ववृतं बर्हिस्तस्थावसंदिनम् ।
आपश्चिन्नि दधा पदम् ॥
verses.rom:
yasya tridhatvavritam barhistasthavasamdinam |
apashchinni dadha padam ||
verses.en:
The waters find their place in him, for whom the threefold sacred grass
Is spread unbound, unlimited.

verses.sa:
पदं देवस्य मीळ्हुषोऽनाधृष्टाभिरूतिभिः ।
भद्रा सूर्य इवोपदृक् ॥
verses.rom:
padam devasya milhusho'nadhrishtabhirutibhih |
bhadra surya ivopadrik ||
verses.en:
The station of the Bounteous God hath, through his aid which none impair,
A pleasant aspect like the Sun.

verses.sa:
अग्ने घृतस्य धीतिभिस्तेपानो देव शोचिषा ।
आ देवान्वक्षि यक्षि च ॥
verses.rom:
agne ghritasya dhitibhistepano deva shochisha |
a devanvakshi yakshi cha ||
verses.en:
Blazing with splendour, Agni, God, through pious gifts of sacred oil,
Bring thou the Gods and worship them.

verses.sa:
तं त्वाजनन्त मातरः कविं देवासो अङ्गिरः ।
हव्यवाहममर्त्यम् ॥
verses.rom:
tam tvajananta matarah kavim devaso angirah |
havyavahamamartyam ||
verses.en:
The Gods as mothers brought thee forth, the Immortal Sage, O Angiras,
The bearer of our gifts to heaven.

verses.sa:
प्रचेतसं त्वा कवेऽग्ने दूतं वरेण्यम् ।
हव्यवाहं नि षेदिरे ॥
verses.rom:
prachetasam tva kave'gne dutam varenyam |
havyavaham ni shedire ||
verses.en:
Wise Agni, Gods established thee, the Seer, noblest messenger,
As bearer of our sacred gifts.

verses.sa:
नहि मे अस्त्यघ्न्या न स्वधितिर्वनन्वति ।
अथैतादृग्भरामि ते ॥
verses.rom:
nahi me astyaghnya na svadhitirvananvati |
athaitadrigbharami te ||
verses.en:
No cow have I to call mine own, no axe at hand wherewith to work,
Yet what is here I bring to thee.

verses.sa:
यदग्ने कानि कानि चिदा ते दारूणि दध्मसि ।
ता जुषस्व यविष्ठ्य ॥
verses.rom:
yadagne kani kani chida te daruni dadhmasi |
ta jushasva yavishthya ||
verses.en:
O Agni, whatsoever be the fuel that we lay for thee,
Be pleased therewith, Most Youthful God

verses.sa:
यदत्त्युपजिह्विका यद्वम्रो अतिसर्पति ।
सर्वं तदस्तु ते घृतम् ॥
verses.rom:
yadattyupajihvika yadvamro atisarpati |
sarvam tadastu te ghritam ||
verses.en:
That which the white-ant cats away, that over which the emmet crawls-
May all of this be oil to thee.

verses.sa:
अग्निमिन्धानो मनसा धियं सचेत मर्त्यः ।
अग्निमीधे विवस्वभिः ॥
verses.rom:
agnimindhano manasa dhiyam sacheta martyah |
agnimidhe vivasvabhih ||
verses.en:
When he enkindles Agni, man should with his heart attend the song:
I with the priests have kindled him.

verses.sa:
अदर्शि गातुवित्तमो यस्मिन्व्रतान्यादधुः ।
उपो षु जातमार्यस्य वर्धनमग्निं नक्षन्त नो गिरः ॥
verses.rom:
adarshi gatuvittamo yasminvratanyadadhuh |
upo shu jatamaryasya vardhanamagnim nakshanta no girah ||
verses.en:
THAT noblest Furtherer hath appeared, to whom men bring their holy works.
Our songs of praise have risen aloft to Agni who was barn to give the Arya strength.

verses.sa:
प्र दैवोदासो अग्निर्देवाँ अच्छा न मज्मना ।
अनु मातरं पृथिवीं वि वावृते तस्थौ नाकस्य सानवि ॥
verses.rom:
pra daivodaso agnirdevan achchha na majmana |
anu mataram prithivim vi vavrite tasthau nakasya sanavi ||
verses.en:
Agni of Divodasa turned, as 'twere in majesty, to the Gods.
Onward he sped along the mother earth, and took his station in the height of heaven.

verses.sa:
यस्माद्रेजन्त कृष्टयश्चर्कृत्यानि कृण्वतः ।
सहस्रसां मेधसाताविव त्मनाग्निं धीभिः सपर्यत ॥
verses.rom:
yasmadrejanta krishtayashcharkrityani krinvatah |
sahasrasam medhasataviva tmanagnim dhibhih saparyata ||
verses.en:
Him before whom the people shrink when he performs his glorious deeds,
Him who wins thousands at the worship of the Gods, himself, that Agni, serve with son s.

verses.sa:
प्र यं राये निनीषसि मर्तो यस्ते वसो दाशत् ।
स वीरं धत्ते अग्न उक्थशंसिनं त्मना सहस्रपोषिणम् ॥
verses.rom:
pra yam raye ninishasi marto yaste vaso dashat |
sa viram dhatte agna ukthashamsinam tmana sahasraposhinam ||
verses.en:
The mortal man whom thou wouldst lead to opulence, O Vasu, he who brings thee gifts.
He, Agni, wins himself a hero singing lauds, yea, one who feeds a thousand men.

verses.sa:
स दृळ्हे चिदभि तृणत्ति वाजमर्वता स धत्ते अक्षिति श्रवः ।
त्वे देवत्रा सदा पुरूवसो विश्वा वामानि धीमहि ॥
verses.rom:
sa drilhe chidabhi trinatti vajamarvata sa dhatte akshiti shravah |
tve devatra sada puruvaso vishva vamani dhimahi ||
verses.en:
He with the steed wins spoil even in the fenced fort, and gains imperishable fame.
In thee, O Lord of wealth, continually we lay all precious offerings to the Gods.

verses.sa:
यो विश्वा दयते वसु होता मन्द्रो जनानाम् ।
मधोर्न पात्रा प्रथमान्यस्मै प्र स्तोमा यन्त्यग्नये ॥
verses.rom:
yo vishva dayate vasu hota mandro jananam |
madhorna patra prathamanyasmai pra stoma yantyagnaye ||
verses.en:
To him who dealeth out all wealth, who is the cheerful Priest of men,
To him, like the first vessels filled with savoury juice, to Agni go the songs of praise.

verses.sa:
अश्वं न गीर्भी रथ्यं सुदानवो मर्मृज्यन्ते देवयवः ।
उभे तोके तनये दस्म विश्पते पर्षि राधो मघोनाम् ॥
verses.rom:
ashvam na girbhi rathyam sudanavo marmrijyante devayavah |
ubhe toke tanaye dasma vishpate parshi radho maghonam ||
verses.en:
Votaries, richly-gifted, deck him with their songs, even as the steed who draws the car.
On both, Strong Lord of men! on child and grandson pour the bounties which our nobles give.

verses.sa:
प्र मंहिष्ठाय गायत ऋताव्ने बृहते शुक्रशोचिषे ।
उपस्तुतासो अग्नये ॥
verses.rom:
pra mamhishthaya gayata ritavne brihate shukrashochishe |
upastutaso agnaye ||
verses.en:
Sing forth to him, the Holy, most munificent, sublime with his refulgent glow,
To Agni, ye Upastutas.

verses.sa:
आ वंसते मघवा वीरवद्यशः समिद्धो द्युम्न्याहुतः ।
कुविन्नो अस्य सुमतिर्नवीयस्यच्छा वाजेभिरागमत् ॥
verses.rom:
a vamsate maghava viravadyashah samiddho dyumnyahutah |
kuvinno asya sumatirnaviyasyachchha vajebhiragamat ||
verses.en:
Worshipped with gifts, enkindled, splendid, Maghavan shall win himself heroic fame.
And will not his most newly shown benevolence come to us with abundant strength?

verses.sa:
प्रेष्ठमु प्रियाणां स्तुह्यासावातिथिम् ।
अग्निं रथानां यमम् ॥
verses.rom:
preshthamu priyanam stuhyasavatithim |
agnim rathanam yamam ||
verses.en:
Priest, presser of the juice! praise now the dearest Guest of all our friends,
Agni, the driver of the cars.

verses.sa:
उदिता यो निदिता वेदिता वस्वा यज्ञियो ववर्तति ।
दुष्टरा यस्य प्रवणे नोर्मयो धिया वाजं सिषासतः ॥
verses.rom:
udita yo nidita vedita vasva yajniyo vavartati |
dushtara yasya pravane normayo dhiya vajam sishasatah ||
verses.en:
Who, finder-out of treasures open and concealed, bringeth them hither, Holy One;
Whose waves, as in a cataract, are hard to pass, when he, through song, would win him strength.

verses.sa:
मा नो हृणीतामतिथिर्वसुरग्निः पुरुप्रशस्त एषः ।
यः सुहोता स्वध्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
ma no hrinitamatithirvasuragnih puruprashasta eshah |
yah suhota svadhvarah ||
verses.en:
Let not the noble Guest, Agni, be wroth with us: by many a man his praise is sung,
Good Herald, skilled in sacrifice.

verses.sa:
मो ते रिषन्ये अच्छोक्तिभिर्वसोऽग्ने केभिश्चिदेवैः ।
कीरिश्चिद्धि त्वामीट्टे दूत्याय रातहव्यः स्वध्वरः ॥
verses.rom:
mo te rishanye achchhoktibhirvaso'gne kebhishchidevaih |
kirishchiddhi tvamitte dutyaya ratahavyah svadhvarah ||
verses.en:
O Vasu, Agni, let not them be harmed who come in any way with lauds to thee.
Even the lowly, skilled in rites, with offered gifts, seeketh thee for the envoy's task.

verses.sa:
आग्ने याहि मरुत्सखा रुद्रेभिः सोमपीतये ।
सोभर्या उप सुष्टुतिं मादयस्व स्वर्णरे ॥
verses.rom:
agne yahi marutsakha rudrebhih somapitaye |
sobharya upa sushtutim madayasva svarnare ||
verses.en:
Friend of the Maruts, Agni, come with Rudras to the Soma-draught,
To Sobhar's fair song of praise, and be thou joyful in the light.
VALAKHILYA
